````text
"""Start/reuse the local saved Ghidra project, then serve the pinned MCP bridge."""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
workspace = here.parents[3]
env = dict(os.environ, GHIDRA_MCP_URL='http://127.0.0.1:8089')
pwsh = Path('C:/Users/adako/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/native/powershell/pwsh.exe')
subprocess.run([str(pwsh), '-NoProfile', '-File', str(here/'Start-D2Ghidra.ps1')],
               cwd=workspace, env=env, check=True, stdout=sys.stderr, stderr=sys.stderr,
               creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW, timeout=55)
from bridge_mcp_ghidra.cli import main
os.environ['GHIDRA_MCP_URL'] = env['GHIDRA_MCP_URL']
sys.argv = ['bridge-mcp-ghidra', '--transport', 'stdio']
main()
````

## outputs/d2-coop-lab/analysis/ghidra/configure_timeouts.py

[configure_timeouts.py](<../../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/analysis/ghidra/configure_timeouts.py>)

````text
"""Set only the registered project MCP server's startup and call timeouts."""
import re
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

config = Path('C:/Users/adako/.codex/config.toml')
text = config.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
parsed = tomllib.loads(text)
server = parsed['mcp_servers']['d2-ghidra']
assert 'ghidra-mcp-6.0.0' in server['command']
pattern = r'(\[mcp_servers\.d2-ghidra\]\s*\n)([^\[]*)'
match = re.search(pattern, text)
if not match:
    raise RuntimeError('Expected Codex MCP server section not found')
body = match[2]
body = re.sub(r'(?m)^(startup_timeout_sec|tool_timeout_sec)\s*=.*\n?', '', body)
replacement = match[1] + 'startup_timeout_sec = 60\ntool_timeout_sec = 180\n' + body
updated = text[:match.start()] + replacement + text[match.end():]
tomllib.loads(updated)
config.write_text(updated, encoding='utf-8')
````

## outputs/d2-coop-lab/analysis/ghidra/find_direct_callers.py

[find_direct_callers.py](<../../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/analysis/ghidra/find_direct_callers.py>)

````text
"""Find static E8 candidates and their PE unwind ranges; Ghidra must confirm calls."""
import argparse
import bisect
import hashlib
import json
import struct
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('rva',type=lambda s:int(s,0))
ns=parser.parse_args()
b=(root/'input/Dishonored2.exe').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='b671f8249422862bf557d00aab2f4bb671ed4515cc10ad8a8a9decad84516180'
u16=lambda p:struct.unpack_from('<H',b,p)[0]
u32=lambda p:struct.unpack_from('<I',b,p)[0]
pe=u32(0x3c);opt=pe+24;table=opt+u16(pe+20)
sections=[]
for i in range(u16(pe+6)):
    p=table+40*i
````

## outputs/d2-coop-lab/analysis/ghidra/Start-D2Ghidra.ps1

[Start-D2Ghidra.ps1](<../../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/analysis/ghidra/Start-D2Ghidra.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param()
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$workspace=Split-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent) -Parent) -Parent
$toolRoot=Join-Path $workspace 'work/tools'
$ghidra=Join-Path $toolRoot 'ghidra_12.1.4_PUBLIC'
$java=Join-Path $toolRoot 'jdk-21.0.12.1+1/bin/java.exe'
$jar=Join-Path $toolRoot 'ghidra-mcp-extension-6.0.0/GhidraMCP/lib/GhidraMCP-6.0.0.jar'
$runtime=Join-Path $toolRoot 'ghidra-runtime'
$project=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'project/Dishonored2-B671F824.gpr'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $runtime | Out-Null
$health=$null
try {$health=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8089/health' -TimeoutSec 2}catch{}
if($health){
 if($health.version-ne'6.0.0-headless'){throw 'Port 8089 belongs to a different server version'}
 if((Test-Path -LiteralPath $project)-and$health.program_name-ne'Dishonored2.exe'){throw 'Ghidra is running but the expected saved program is not loaded'}
 $health;return
}
$jars=@($jar)+@(Get-ChildItem "$ghidra/Ghidra" -Filter '*.jar' -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object FullName)
$arguments=@('-Xmx2G','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2','-Djava.awt.headless=true',('-Duser.home='+$runtime),('-Dapplication.settingsdir='+$runtime+'/settings'),('-Dapplication.cachedir='+$runtime+'/cache'),('-Dapplication.tempdir='+$runtime+'/tmp'),('-Dghidra.home='+$ghidra),'-Dapplication.name=GhidraMCP','-classpath',($jars -join ';'),'com.xebyte.headless.GhidraMCPHeadlessServer','--bind','127.0.0.1','--port','8089')
````

## outputs/d2-coop-lab/Build-D2CarryCompactHoldAssets.ps1

[Build-D2CarryCompactHoldAssets.ps1](<../../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/Build-D2CarryCompactHoldAssets.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/carry-compact-hold-v38-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/carry-compact-hold-v38-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

## outputs/d2-coop-lab/Enable-D2MixamoCrouch.ps1

[Enable-D2MixamoCrouch.ps1](<../../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/Enable-D2MixamoCrouch.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Off)
# Explicit isolated-session opt-in; never edits Steam assets or first-person rigs.
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$expected='29978C5426F33E2E96929D06C77E81E54044F0B57CC01672513B89583328E6B9'
foreach($role in 'host','client'){
 $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if((Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne$l.executable-or!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-FileHash (Join-Path (Split-Path $l.executable) 'dinput8.dll')).Hash-ne$expected){throw 'Unexpected isolated test build'}
}
foreach($role in 'host','client'){
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $role -Command $(if($Off){'coop_mixamo_crouch off'}else{'coop_mixamo_crouch on'}) -WaitConsumed|Out-Null
}
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400
foreach($role in 'host','client'){
 $m=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json.mixamo.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if($Off){if($m.active){throw "$role did not disable"}}
 elseif(!$m.active-or!$m.persistent){throw "$role refused mirrored crouch. Confirm fresh follow, native crouch reference and equipped clone sword; command receipt alone is not success."}
 [pscustomobject]@{Role=$role;Active=$m.active;CurrentSession=$m.persistent;Phase=$m.phase;Applied=$m.applied}
}
````

## outputs/d2-coop-lab/Enable-D2ShadowCrouch.ps1

[Enable-D2ShadowCrouch.ps1](<../../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/Enable-D2ShadowCrouch.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([ValidateSet('native','upright')][string]$Style='native')
# Opt-in visual prototype for the existing isolated Dunwall session.
# Captures each clone's native whole-body reference; does not reload or save.
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$expected='29978C5426F33E2E96929D06C77E81E54044F0B57CC01672513B89583328E6B9'
function State($r){
 $file=Get-Item "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json"
 if(([DateTime]::UtcNow-$file.LastWriteTimeUtc).TotalSeconds-gt2){throw "Stale $r bridge"}
 Get-Content $file.FullName -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
}
function Cmd($r,$s){& "$PSScriptRoot/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $s -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
$before=@{};$results=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$mutated=$false
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  $p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid
  if($p.Path-ne$l.executable-or!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-FileHash (Join-Path (Split-Path $l.executable) 'dinput8.dll')).Hash-ne$expected){throw 'Unexpected live isolated build'}
  $s=State $r
````

## outputs/d2-coop-lab/Invoke-D2AssetLint.ps1

[Invoke-D2AssetLint.ps1](<../../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/Invoke-D2AssetLint.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path,[switch]$Json)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$tool=Join-Path $root 'work/tools/void-slice-cc58fc7'
$pin=Get-Content (Join-Path $tool 'pin.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$exe=Join-Path $tool 'voidslice.exe'
if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $exe).Hash-ne$pin.binary_sha256){throw 'Pinned Void Slice executable differs'}
$inputFile=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path).FullName
if(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $inputFile -PathType Leaf)){throw 'One existing asset text file is required'}
if($Json){& $exe lint $inputFile --json}else{& $exe lint $inputFile}
# Preserve native exit status. Warnings (including duplicate array indices)
# still return0; inspect diagnostics. Known native MD6 tuples false-positive.
exit $LASTEXITCODE
````

````text
# Read-only asset inspection through the pinned Void Explorer library.
# Exports go only to this project's research/asset-exports directory.
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$NamePattern,
````

````text
function ReadLiveJson([string]$path){
    # Native status writers can briefly hold/truncate their own file. Retry
    # the actual read, never substitute an older cached snapshot or relax
    # the native startup/epoch checks below.
    for($attempt=0;$attempt-lt8;$attempt++){
        try{
            $parsed=Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -ErrorAction Stop|ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
            if($null-eq$parsed){throw 'Native status file is temporarily empty'}
            return $parsed
        }
        catch{if($attempt-eq7){throw};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}
    }
}
````

## outputs/d2-coop-lab/Test-D2ActorPose.ps1

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param()

$probe=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'bin\d2_runtime_probe.exe'
function Read-State([string]$Role) {
    $root=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
    $launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
    if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'Unexpected game target.'}
    $file=Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'coop-status.json')
    if(([DateTime]::UtcNow-$file.LastWriteTimeUtc).TotalSeconds -gt 1.5){throw 'Stale engine status.'}
    $status=Get-Content -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    if(!$status.remoteFresh -or $status.connectionState -ne 3){throw 'Steam peer unavailable.'}
    $json=& $probe $launch.pid --entities
    if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'Entity inspection failed.'}
    $entities=($json | ConvertFrom-Json).entities
    $expectedHandle='0x'+([uint32]$status.probeActorHandle).ToString('x')
    $actors=@($entities | Where-Object { $_.handle -eq $expectedHandle -and $_.name -match '^d2coop_probe_(corvo|emily)(?:_renamed_\d+)?$' })
    if($actors.Count -ne 1 -or !$actors[0].physicsBodies){throw 'Expected one clone with native physics bodies.'}
````

````text
    $raw=& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe') $launch[$role].pid --ai-decision $s.probeActorHandle
    if($LASTEXITCODE){throw "$role native decision unavailable at $stage"};$a=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json
    $raw=& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe') $launch[$role].pid --ai-idle $s.probeActorHandle
    if($LASTEXITCODE){throw "$role native idle-break unavailable at $stage"};$idle=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json
    $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{Role=$role;Stage=$stage;Bridge=$s;Reset=$r;Ai=$a;Idle=$idle})
    # Native pause stops scheduler servicing. Its own pending-resume state (3)
    # can retain inactive membership after our reference reaches zero; the
    # resumed-and-rebound check below proves servicing and acquisition work.
    $deferredResume=!$held -and $stage -eq 'native_pause' -and $s.localGameLogicState -eq 2 -and $a.pauseState -eq 3
````

## outputs/d2-coop-lab/Test-D2CinematicHold.ps1

[Test-D2CinematicHold.ps1](<../../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/Test-D2CinematicHold.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]

function Read-Sample([string]$role) {
    $root=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work/lab-instances/$role"
    $launch=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'launch.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
    if((Get-Process -Id $launch.pid).Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'Unexpected game process.'}
    $file=Get-Item (Join-Path $root 'coop-status.json')
    if(([DateTime]::UtcNow-$file.LastWriteTimeUtc).TotalSeconds -gt 1.5){throw 'Stale game status.'}
    $status=Get-Content $file.FullName -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
    if(!$status.remoteFresh -or $status.connectionState -ne 3){throw 'Native Steam peer unavailable.'}
    $native=& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe') $launch.pid --midnight
    if($LASTEXITCODE){throw 'Independent sequence read failed.'}
    $native=$native|ConvertFrom-Json
    $sequences=@($native.instances|Where-Object playerChannel -ge 0)
    if($sequences.Count -ne 1){throw 'Need exactly one player cinematic sequence.'}
    return [pscustomobject]@{Status=$status;Sequence=$sequences[0];Channels=$native.channels}
}
````

## outputs/d2-coop-lab/Test-D2CinematicIdentity.ps1

[Test-D2CinematicIdentity.ps1](<../../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/Test-D2CinematicIdentity.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([ValidateSet('Ready','Intro','Choice','PostChoice','Completed')][string]$Stage='Ready',
      [ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$CinematicRole='client')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$record=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'research\native-cinematic-identity-verification.json'
function Get-NativeSignature($nodes) {
    $keys=@(foreach($node in $nodes) {
        if(!$node.ownerName -or $null -eq $node.nativeNodeId){throw 'Independent native observer could not resolve an identity.'}
        [bigint]$hash=[bigint]::Parse('14695981039346656037')
        foreach($byte in [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($node.ownerName)){$hash=(($hash -bxor $byte)*1099511628211) -band [bigint]::Parse('18446744073709551615')}
        [pscustomobject]@{OwnerId=$hash;NodeId=[uint32]$node.nativeNodeId;OwnerName=$node.ownerName}
    })
    if(!$keys.Count){return '0'}
    $keys=@($keys|Sort-Object OwnerId,NodeId)
    $bytes=[Collections.Generic.List[byte]]::new()
    $bytes.AddRange([BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]$keys.Count))
    foreach($key in $keys){$bytes.AddRange([BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$key.OwnerId));$bytes.AddRange([BitConverter]::GetBytes($key.NodeId))}
    [bigint]$signature=[bigint]::Parse('14695981039346656037')
    foreach($byte in $bytes){$signature=(($signature -bxor $byte)*1099511628211) -band [bigint]::Parse('18446744073709551615')}
````

````text
  $moved=0.;for($i=0;$i-lt3;$i++){$moved+=[Math]::Pow($b.localPosition[$i]-$observerPositions[$target][$i],2)}
  if($moved-gt.0004){throw 'Uncommanded observer movement invalidated the separated action fixture'}
 }
````
````text
 $a=Native $target '--animation' $b.probeActorHandle;$sk=Native $target '--skeleton' $b.probeActorHandle;$w=Native $target '--avatar-sword-attachment' $b.probeActorHandle
 $r=[pscustomobject]@{Role=$source;Stage=$stage;At=[DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToString('o');Source=(State $source);Target=(State $target);Player=(Native $source '--player-states');
  Input=@($a.declaredInputs|Where-Object name -eq animBasicInputData1)[0];Root=$sk.root;Stable=$sk.stable;Attachment=$w;
  Joints=@($sk.joints|Where-Object nativeName -in 'right_arm_jnt','right_elbow_jnt','right_wrist_jnt'|Select-Object nativeName,localPose)}
 $rows.Add($r);$r
````

````text
  $src=Native $source '--skeleton' 1
  $dst=if($stage-eq'Standing'){Native $target '--skeleton' $b.probeActorHandle}else{Native $target '--skeleton-final' $b.probeActorHandle $b.bodyPublicationAddress}
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
````

````text
    $root=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
    $launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
    if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw "Unexpected $Role process."}
    $file=Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'coop-status.json')
    if(([DateTime]::UtcNow-$file.LastWriteTimeUtc).TotalSeconds -gt 1.5){throw "Stale $Role status: engine may be loading or stopped."}
    $status=Get-Content -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    if($status.nativeInterface -ne 'SteamNetworkingSockets012' -or !$status.steamAvailable -or
       $status.connectionState -ne 3 -or !$status.remoteFresh -or !$status.localPoseAvailable -or !$status.remotePoseAvailable){throw "$Role native Steam connection or pose unavailable."}
    $status
}
function Distance($A,$B) {
    $sum=0.0;for($i=0;$i -lt $A.Count;$i++){$difference=[double]$A[$i]-[double]$B[$i];$sum+=$difference*$difference}
    [Math]::Sqrt($sum)
}
````

````text
const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),vm=require('vm');
const lab=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
let source=fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'verify-arm-stream.cjs'),'utf8');
source=source.replace("||r.DllSha256!==hash(path.join(lab,'bin/dinput8.dll'))","");
````

````text
const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');
const lab=path.resolve(__dirname,'..'),r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(lab,'research/arm-stream-observations.json'),'utf8').replace(/^\uFEFF/,''));
const dot=(a,b)=>a.reduce((v,x,i)=>v+x*b[i],0);
const vec=(a,b)=>a.map((x,i)=>x-b[i]);
const norm=a=>{const n=Math.hypot(...a);return a.map(x=>x/n);};
const angle=(a,b)=>Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,dot(norm(a),norm(b)))))*180/Math.PI;
const point=(m)=>m.slice(12,15);
const rows=[];
for(const c of r.Cases){
 const fingers=[['thumb',[5,6,7,8],[38,39,c.Role==='host'?63:60]],['index',[16,17,18,19],[40,41,c.Role==='host'?65:62]],['middle',[27,28,29,30],[42,43,c.Role==='host'?67:64]],['ring',[38,39,40,41],[44,45,c.Role==='host'?69:66]],['pinky',[48,49,50,51,52],[46,47,48,c.Role==='host'?71:68]]];

 const mats=row.Target.phases.find(p=>p.phase===3).matrices;
 for(const[name,from,to]of fingers){
  const src=from.map(i=>point(c.SourceRig.joints[i].globalPose));
  const dst=to.map(i=>point(mats.find(m=>m.joint===i).matrix));
  const srcSegments=src.slice(1).map((p,i)=>vec(p,src[i])),dstSegments=dst.slice(1).map((p,i)=>vec(p,dst[i]));
  rows.push({Role:c.Role,Finger:name,SourceBends:srcSegments.slice(1).map((p,i)=>angle(srcSegments[i],p)),TargetBends:dstSegments.slice(1).map((p,i)=>angle(dstSegments[i],p)),Source:src,Target:dst});
 }
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(lab,'research/hand-grip-geometry-analysis.json'),JSON.stringify({Loader:r.DllSha256,Scope:'Historical DBA7 idle source and target geometry, not synchronized snapshots; diagnostic only.',Rows:rows},null,2));
````

````text
        [ValidateRange(1,500)][int]$RetryWindowMs=150
    )
    # Same-directory rename keeps readers on a complete old or new packet.
    # Windows can temporarily refuse replacement while another handle is open.
    # Retry only sharing/access errors; never recreate or extend a control lease.
    $temporary=Join-Path (Split-Path $Path -Parent) ('packet-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')+'.tmp')
    $watch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    try {
        [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($temporary,$Bytes)
        while($true) {
            if([DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $ExpiresUtc){throw 'Packet expired before atomic publication.'}
            try {
                [IO.File]::Move($temporary,$Path,$true)
                return
````

````text
const {spawnSync} = require('node:child_process');
// Windows environment keys are case-insensitive. MSBuild rejects duplicate
// Path/PATH entries inherited from some task hosts; normalize only the child.
const environment = {};
for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(process.env)) environment[key.toUpperCase()] = value;
const result = spawnSync(process.argv[2], process.argv.slice(3), {env:environment,stdio:'inherit',shell:false});
if (result.error) throw result.error;
process.exitCode = result.status ?? 1;
````

````text
"""Encode evidence at its recorded timing; no motion interpolation or speedup."""
import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def encode(rows,folder,name):
    manifest=folder/'encode.ffconcat'
    lines=['ffconcat version 1.0']
    for file,duration in rows:
        lines+=['file '+"'"+file+"'",'option framerate 1000',f'duration {duration:.9f}']
    lines+=['file '+"'"+rows[-1][0]+"'",'option framerate 1000']
    manifest.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-y','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-f','concat','-safe','0','-i',str(manifest),'-vf','fps=30','-c:v','libx264','-crf','18','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-movflags','+faststart',str(P/name)],check=True)

folder=P/'runtime-take-5/video'
frames=json.loads((folder/'timestamps.json').read_text())
encode([(v['file'],max(.001,(frames[i+1]['ms']-v['ms'])/1000) if i<len(frames)-1 else 1/12) for i,v in enumerate(frames)],folder,'d2-generated-sequence.mp4')
folder=P/'authoring-video'
paths=sorted(folder.glob('frame_*.png'))
assert len(paths)==240,len(paths)
````

````text
"""Bounded D2PROOF2 export; pose data and a validated distance-to-phase curve."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import struct
from pathlib import Path

folder=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'exports'
candidate=json.loads((folder/'corvo-generated-candidate.json').read_text())
frames=candidate['frames']+[candidate['frames'][-1]]
assert len(frames)==481 and len(candidate['joints'])==215
layout='\n'.join(f'{name}:{parent}' for name,parent in zip(candidate['joints'],candidate['parent_indices']))
layout_hash=int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(layout.encode()).digest()[:8],'little')
assert layout_hash==0x00db32d37719931f
curve=[]
origin=candidate['root_track'][120][0]
for i in range(481):
    d=0 if i<=120 else max(0,candidate['root_track'][min(i,360)][0]-origin)
    curve.append(max(d,curve[-1] if curve else 0))
data=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ4I',b'D2PROOF2',2,215,481,60,layout_hash,120,360,405,0))
````

## work/animgen-feasibility/milestone-092E/encode_videos.py

[encode_videos.py](<../../../work/animgen-feasibility/milestone-092E/encode_videos.py>)

````text
"""Encode evidence at its recorded timing; no motion interpolation or speedup."""
import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def encode(rows,folder,name):
    manifest=folder/'encode.ffconcat'
    lines=['ffconcat version 1.0']
    for file,duration in rows:
        lines+=['file '+"'"+file+"'",'option framerate 1000',f'duration {duration:.9f}']
    lines+=['file '+"'"+rows[-1][0]+"'",'option framerate 1000']
    manifest.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-y','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-f','concat','-safe','0','-i',str(manifest),'-vf','fps=30','-c:v','libx264','-crf','18','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-movflags','+faststart',str(P/name)],check=True)

folder=P/'runtime-take-5/video'
frames=json.loads((folder/'timestamps.json').read_text())
encode([(v['file'],max(.001,(frames[i+1]['ms']-v['ms'])/1000) if i<len(frames)-1 else 1/12) for i,v in enumerate(frames)],folder,'d2-generated-sequence.mp4')
folder=P/'authoring-video'
paths=sorted(folder.glob('frame_*.png'))
assert len(paths)==240,len(paths)
````

## work/animgen-feasibility/milestone-092E/export_candidate.py

[export_candidate.py](<../../../work/animgen-feasibility/milestone-092E/export_candidate.py>)

````text
"""Bounded D2PROOF2 export; pose data and a validated distance-to-phase curve."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import struct
from pathlib import Path

folder=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'exports'
candidate=json.loads((folder/'corvo-generated-candidate.json').read_text())
frames=candidate['frames']+[candidate['frames'][-1]]
assert len(frames)==481 and len(candidate['joints'])==215
layout='\n'.join(f'{name}:{parent}' for name,parent in zip(candidate['joints'],candidate['parent_indices']))
layout_hash=int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(layout.encode()).digest()[:8],'little')
assert layout_hash==0x00db32d37719931f
curve=[]
origin=candidate['root_track'][120][0]
for i in range(481):
    d=0 if i<=120 else max(0,candidate['root_track'][min(i,360)][0]-origin)
    curve.append(max(d,curve[-1] if curve else 0))
data=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ4I',b'D2PROOF2',2,215,481,60,layout_hash,120,360,405,0))
````

````text
exec(compile(helper_prefix, str(helper_path), 'exec'), globals())

donor_mesh = json.loads((OUT / 'uefn-native-mesh.json').read_text())
````

## work/animgen-feasibility/milestone-092E/runtime-build/Restore-D2Lab.ps1

[Restore-D2Lab.ps1](<../../../work/animgen-feasibility/milestone-092E/runtime-build/Restore-D2Lab.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Doppelganger)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
function State([string]$role){Get-Content (Join-Path $root "work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json") -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Command([string]$role,[string]$text){& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Send-D2Command.ps1') -Role $role -Command $text|Out-Null}
# A restarted process can leave an older process's status file on disk until
# its first engine update. Wait for a fresh, usable native state before input.
foreach($role in 'host','client') {
    $launch=Get-Content (Join-Path $root "work/lab-instances/$role/launch.json") -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
    $process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
    if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'Unexpected lab process.'}
    $statusPath=Join-Path $root "work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json"
    $startup=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    do {
        $fresh=(Test-Path $statusPath) -and (Get-Item $statusPath).LastWriteTimeUtc -ge $process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime()
        if($fresh){$state=State $role;$fresh=$state.localGameLogicState -in 1,2,6,13 -and !$state.localPendingGameLogicState}
        if(!$fresh){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250}
    }while(!$fresh -and $startup.ElapsedMilliseconds -lt 45000)
    if(!$fresh){throw "$role did not reach a fresh native menu/gameplay state."}
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

````text
"""Read-only final-published pose checks. Execute with Blender's mathutils.

The phase is reconstructed from observed root travel, not selected by finding a
convenient matching pose. Publication sampling gives a bounded timing ambiguity
at the movement-to-guard boundary. Native correctives are excluded from source
rotation comparisons because the game deliberately recomputes them.
"""
import bisect, json, math, statistics, struct
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix, Quaternion, Vector

P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def mat(a):return Matrix([[a[c*4+r] if r<3 else float(c==3) for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)])
def root(a):
    m=Matrix.Identity(4);m.translation=Vector(a[:3])
    for c in range(3):
        for r in range(3):m[r][c]=a[3+c*3+r]
    return m
def stats(xs):
````

````text
import bpy

assert motion.get('generated_motion_captured') and len(motion['frames']) == 480
````

````text
for obj in s.objects:

        obj.scale*=3
bpy.ops.render.render(animation=True)
````

````text
"""Separate Corvo authoring candidate: generated locomotion + D2 FP guard.

Reads the preserved authoring helpers and native rig, never overwrites either.
No runtime installation is performed by this script.
"""
import bpy, json, math, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix, Quaternion, Vector

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'exports'
PROOF = OUT.parent.parent / 'fullbody-proof'
bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=str(PROOF / 'corvo-fullbody-authored.blend'))
# Reuse the frozen, already-reviewed native limb/hand/FP-reference helpers.
helper_path = PROOF / 'milestone-F4F' / 'author_sequence.py'
helper_source = helper_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
helper_prefix = helper_source.split('frames=[];errors=[];fps=60;duration=6.;rootTrack=[]')[0]
assert len(helper_prefix) < len(helper_source)
exec(compile(helper_prefix, str(helper_path), 'exec'), globals())
donor = json.loads((OUT / 'generated-forward-probe.json').read_text())
donor_mesh = json.loads((OUT / 'uefn-native-mesh.json').read_text())
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Mesh,[string]$Skeleton,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Output)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$out=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Output)
if(!$out.StartsWith((Join-Path $root 'work/fullbody-proof'),[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw 'Output outside proof workspace'}
$tool=Join-Path $root 'work/tools/void-tools-1.2.0/Void Explorer'
$dll=Join-Path $tool 'Void.Utils.dll'
if((Get-FileHash $dll).Hash -ne '59CCE9A1316157FFE795F0E8F179C6EE2BE3DEA43036A106B38834913AFD4A1F'){throw 'Unexpected library'}
[void][Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom((Join-Path $tool 'ComponentAce.Compression.Libs.zlib.dll'))
[void][Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom($dll)
$bones=$null
if($Skeleton){$sk=[Void.Utils.Resources.Meshes.EdgeSkeleton]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Skeleton));$bones=[Void.Utils.Meshes.VoidBone]::GetBones($sk)}
$model=[Void.Utils.Resources.Meshes.BMD6Model]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Mesh))
$data=$model.GetMeshData($bones)
$geo=$data.GeometryData
$verts=@($geo.Vertices)
$weights=@(for($i=0;$i -lt $verts.Count;$i++){
  ,@(if($geo.VertexBoneWeights){foreach($w in $geo.VertexBoneWeights[$i]){,@($w.BoneName,$w.BoneWeightDouble)}})
})
````

````text
"""Build a native-space skinned authoring rig; no edits to the game or existing scenes."""
import bpy,json,math
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix,Quaternion,Vector
root=Path(r'C:/Users/adako/Documents/Codex/2026-10-08/i-x20/work/fullbody-proof')
native=json.loads((root/'inputs/native-corvo.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
joints=native['joints']
assert 'D2_Proof_Corvo_Rig' not in bpy.data.objects, 'Open the existing authored blend and run author_sequence.py; do not import duplicate rigs.'
s=bpy.data.scenes.new('D2_Corvo_Fullbody_Native');bpy.context.window.scene=s
s.unit_settings.system='METRIC';s.render.fps=60
rig=bpy.data.objects.new('D2_Proof_Corvo_Rig',bpy.data.armatures.new('D2_Proof_Corvo_Skeleton'))
s.collection.objects.link(rig);bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=rig;rig.select_set(True)
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
bind=[]
for j in joints:
    q=j['bindLocalQTS'];m=Quaternion((q[3],q[0],q[1],q[2])).normalized().to_matrix().to_4x4();m.translation=Vector(q[4:7]);p=j['parent']
    g=m if p<0 else bind[p]@m;bind.append(g)
    b=rig.data.edit_bones.new(j['nativeName']);b.length=.045;b.matrix=g
    if p>=0:b.parent=rig.data.edit_bones[joints[p]['nativeName']]
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$frames=Get-Content "$PSScriptRoot/controller-video-4/timestamps.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$lines=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$lines.Add('ffconcat version 1.0')
for($i=0;$i-lt$frames.Count;$i++){
 $lines.Add("file 'controller-video-4/$($frames[$i].path)'")
 $duration=if($i+1-lt$frames.Count){($frames[$i+1].ms-$frames[$i].ms)/1000}else{.07}
 $lines.Add('duration '+$duration.ToString('F9',[Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture))
}
$lines.Add("file 'controller-video-4/$($frames[-1].path)'")
[IO.File]::WriteAllLines("$PSScriptRoot/runtime.ffconcat",$lines,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
& ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -safe 0 -f concat -i "$PSScriptRoot/runtime.ffconcat" -ss 1.4 -t 9.8 -vf fps=30 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart "$PSScriptRoot/d2-fullbody-sequence.mp4"
if($LASTEXITCODE){throw 'Runtime encoding failed'}
& ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -safe 0 -f concat -i "$PSScriptRoot/preview.ffconcat" -vf fps=30 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart "$PSScriptRoot/blender-sequence.mp4"
if($LASTEXITCODE){throw 'Authoring encoding failed'}
[pscustomobject]@{Runtime="$PSScriptRoot/d2-fullbody-sequence.mp4";Authoring="$PSScriptRoot/blender-sequence.mp4";ActualCaptureHz=($frames.Count-1)/(($frames[-1].ms-$frames[0].ms)/1000);DurationSource='Per-frame monotonic timestamp; no playback speedup';NoAudio=$true}
````

## work/fullbody-proof/milestone-F4F/Export-NativeMesh.ps1

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Mesh,[string]$Skeleton,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Output)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$out=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Output)
if(!$out.StartsWith((Join-Path $root 'work/fullbody-proof'),[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw 'Output outside proof workspace'}
$tool=Join-Path $root 'work/tools/void-tools-1.2.0/Void Explorer'
$dll=Join-Path $tool 'Void.Utils.dll'
if((Get-FileHash $dll).Hash -ne '59CCE9A1316157FFE795F0E8F179C6EE2BE3DEA43036A106B38834913AFD4A1F'){throw 'Unexpected library'}
[void][Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom((Join-Path $tool 'ComponentAce.Compression.Libs.zlib.dll'))
[void][Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom($dll)
$bones=$null
if($Skeleton){$sk=[Void.Utils.Resources.Meshes.EdgeSkeleton]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Skeleton));$bones=[Void.Utils.Meshes.VoidBone]::GetBones($sk)}
$model=[Void.Utils.Resources.Meshes.BMD6Model]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Mesh))
$data=$model.GetMeshData($bones)
$geo=$data.GeometryData
$verts=@($geo.Vertices)
$weights=@(for($i=0;$i -lt $verts.Count;$i++){
  ,@(if($geo.VertexBoneWeights){foreach($w in $geo.VertexBoneWeights[$i]){,@($w.BoneName,$w.BoneWeightDouble)}})
})
````

````text
"""Render the final proof with its comparison camera; execute in Blender MCP."""
import bpy
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
s=bpy.data.scenes['D2_Corvo_Fullbody_Native'];bpy.context.window.scene=s
s.camera.location=(1.3,4.8,2.6)
s.camera.rotation_euler=(Vector((.2,0,.92))-s.camera.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
s.camera.data.ortho_scale=2.22
s.render.resolution_x=640;s.render.resolution_y=640;s.frame_step=4
s.render.filepath=str(p/'preview-frames/frame_');bpy.ops.render.render(animation=True)
s.render.resolution_x=1000;s.render.resolution_y=1000;s.frame_step=1;s.frame_set(185)
s.render.filepath=str(p/'final-authoring-guard.png');bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(p/'corvo-fullbody-authored.blend'))
result={'file':bpy.data.filepath,'frameStepForVideo':4,'fps':s.render.fps}
````

````text
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

## work/Inspect-AvatarEquipment.ps1

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent;$probe="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe"
$rows=@(foreach($role in 'host','client'){
 $launch=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if((Get-Process -Id $launch.pid).Path-ne$launch.executable){throw 'Unexpected process'}
 $before=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if($before.localGameLogicState-ne1-or!$before.probeActorHandle){throw 'No current gameplay counterpart'}
 function Native($option,$address){$raw=& $probe $launch.pid $option $address;if($LASTEXITCODE){throw "Read failed: $role $option $address"};$raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
 function Word($obj,$offset){($obj.words|Where-Object offset -eq $offset).word}
 foreach($handle in $before.probeActorHandle,1){
  $components=Native '--components' $handle;$inventory=@($components.components|Where-Object type -eq '.?AVarkCpntInventory@@')
  if($inventory.Count-ne1){throw 'Missing/ambiguous inventory'}
  $obj=Native '--object' $inventory[0].pointer;$pointer=Word $obj '0x58';$count=[Convert]::ToUInt64((Word $obj '0x60').Substring(2),16)-band0xffffff
  if($count-gt16){throw 'Equipment count too large'}
  $equipmentList=if($count){Native '--object' $pointer}else{$null}
  $items=@(for($i=0;$i-lt$count;$i++){
   $entry=Native '--object' (Word $equipmentList ('0x{0:x}'-f($i*8)))
   $item=Native '--object' (Word $entry '0x0');$component=Word $entry '0x10';$declaration=Word $entry '0x18'
   $equipment=if($declaration-ne'0x0'){Native '--object' $declaration}else{$null}
   $cpnt=if($component-ne'0x0'){Native '--object' $component}else{$null}
````

## work/Inspect-PlayerSword.ps1

[Inspect-PlayerSword.ps1](<../../../work/Inspect-PlayerSword.ps1>)

````text
param([ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role='host',[string]$Label='snapshot')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent;$probe="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe"
$launch=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$Role/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
if((Get-Process -Id $launch.pid).Path-ne$launch.executable){throw 'Unexpected process'}
function Native($option,$address=''){$arguments=@($launch.pid,$option);if($address){$arguments+=$address};$raw=& $probe @arguments;if($LASTEXITCODE){throw "Read failed: $Role $option $address"};$raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Word($obj,$offset){($obj.words|Where-Object offset -eq $offset).word}
$before=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$Role/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$components=Native '--components' 1;$inventory=@($components.components|Where-Object type -eq '.?AVarkCpntInventory@@')
if($inventory.Count-ne1){throw 'Missing/ambiguous inventory'}
$inv=Native '--object' $inventory[0].pointer;$pointer=Word $inv '0x58';$count=[Convert]::ToUInt64((Word $inv '0x60').Substring(2),16)-band0xffffff
if(!$count-or$count-gt16){throw 'Equipment count outside observed scope'}
$list=Native '--object' $pointer;$sword=$null
for($i=0;$i-lt$count;$i++){
 $entry=Native '--object' (Word $list ('0x{0:x}'-f($i*8)));$item=Native '--object' (Word $entry '0x0')
 if(($item.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x8').pointerText-ne'models/weapons/ply_sword/ply_sword'){continue}
 if($sword){throw 'Ambiguous sword'}
 $component=Native '--object' (Word $entry '0x10');$decl=Native '--object' (Word $entry '0x18');$entity=Native '--object' (Word $component '0x10')
 $frame=Native '--object' (Word $entity '0x358')
 $sword=[pscustomobject]@{Entry=$entry;Item=$item;Component=$component;Declaration=$decl;Entity=$entity;Frame=$frame}
}
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
````

````text
"""Run through the connected Blender MCP; creates a separate scene, no deletions."""
import bpy
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(r"C:/Users/adako/Documents/Codex/2026-10-08/i-x20/work/mixamo-crouch")
clip = root / "source/crouched-walking-inplace-60fps.fbx"
destination = root / "crouched-walking-source.blend"
if destination.exists() or bpy.data.scenes.get("D2_Mixamo_Source"):
    raise RuntimeError("Existing experiment; inspect before rerunning import")
if bpy.context.object and bpy.context.object.mode != 'OBJECT':
    raise RuntimeError("Unexpected active edit mode; no scene modification")
````

````text
param([ValidateSet('corvo','emily')][string]$Character='corvo')

$target=if($source-eq'host'){'client'}else{'host'}
$stride=if($Character-eq'corvo'){2.04}else{2.05}
function State($r){Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Mix{Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$target/coop-status.json.mixamo.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Cmd($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function Stance($r,$v){if((State $r).localPlayerStance-ne$v){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button B -DurationMs 150|Out-Null;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 900}}
Cmd $target 'coop_mixamo_crouch off'
Stance $source 0;Stance $target 0
Cmd $source 'setviewpos -33 -153 68.1 90 0';Cmd $target 'setviewpos -29 -151.5 68.1 200 22'
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600
Stance $source 1;Cmd $target 'coop_mixamo_crouch on';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
$before=State $target;$m0=Mix
if(!$m0.active-or!$m0.persistent){throw 'Session candidate failed to arm'}
& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $source -LeftY 16000 -DurationMs 750|Out-Null
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1500 # input publication returns immediately; include the 750ms hold and interpolation/status settling
````

## work/mixamo-crouch/verify_attachment.py

[verify_attachment.py](<../../../work/mixamo-crouch/verify_attachment.py>)

````text
import json,math,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
name=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'sword-before-fix'
data=json.loads((p/(name+'.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def mul(a,b):return [sum(a[k*3+i%3]*b[i//3*3+k] for k in range(3)) for i in range(9)]
rows=[]
for a in data:
 if not a['stable']:continue
 assert a['joint']==17 and a['tag']=='right_hand_wpn' and not any(a['offset'])
 x,y,z,w=a['quaternion']
 q=[1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-z*w),2*(x*z+y*w),2*(x*y+z*w),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-x*w),2*(x*z-y*w),2*(y*z+x*w),1-2*(x*x+y*y)]
 j=a['jointMatrix'];r=a['parentRenderRoot']
 pos=[r[i]+sum(r[3+k*3+i]*j[12+k] for k in range(3)) for i in range(3)]
 basis=mul(r[3:],mul([j[i//3*4+i%3] for i in range(9)],q))
 rows.append({'tick':a['tick'],'position_error_m':math.dist(pos,a['weaponRenderRoot'][:3]),'basis_error':max(abs(v-b) for v,b in zip(basis,a['weaponRenderRoot'][3:]))})
assert len(rows)>=3,'Insufficient coherent attachment samples'
report={'source':name+'.json','scope':'Rendered sword vs native phase-3 attachment reconstruction; does not prove visual finger grip or absence of transient lag','stable_samples':len(rows),'max_position_error_m':max(r['position_error_m'] for r in rows),'max_basis_error':max(r['basis_error'] for r in rows),'rows':rows}
(p/(name+'-analysis.json')).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='rows'},indent=2))
````

````text
"""Compare complete native pose publication phases; no game writes."""

 phases={p['phase']:{v['joint']:v['matrix'] for v in p['matrices']} for p in s['phases']}

  if i not in phases.get(0,{}) or i not in phases.get(3,{}):continue
  a,b=phases[0][i],phases[3][i]
  pos=math.dist(a[12:15],b[12:15]);mat=max(abs(a[k]-b[k]) for k in [0,1,2,4,5,6,8,9,10,12,13,14])
  if mat>1e-5:changes.append(dict(joint=i,name=j['nativeName'],position_delta=pos,matrix_delta=mat))
 rows.append(dict(file=f.name,changed=len(changes),changes=changes))
out=folder/'phase-analysis.json';out.write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
for r in rows:
 print(r['file'],r['changed'],'changed')
 for v in r['changes']:
````

````text
"""Compare independently inventoried native source/peer particle transforms.

Requires completed watcher files. Same-machine nearest samples are useful for
stationary attachment correctness, never a measurement of packet latency.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, json, math
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
arg=argparse.ArgumentParser();arg.add_argument('take');a=arg.parse_args()
p=R/'work/natural-moveset'/a.take;assert p.parent==R/'work/natural-moveset'
read=lambda n:[json.loads(l) for l in (p/n).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines() if l.strip()]
source=[(r['tick'],e) for r in read('possession-effects.ndjson') if r['valid'] for e in r['effects'] if e['name'].endswith('/possession_target_human_01.fx')]
peer=[(r['tick'],e) for r in read('peer-effects.ndjson') if r['valid'] for e in r['effects'] if e['name']=='models/effects/d2coop/possession_target_remote.fx']
assert source and peer, 'No independent paired particle samples'
rows=[]
for tick,e in peer:
    st,se=min(source,key=lambda x:abs(x[0]-tick))
    rows.append(dict(tick=tick,sourceTick=st,ageMs=tick-st,id=e['id'],owner=e['owner'],sourceId=se['id'],distance=math.dist(e['origin'],se['origin']),axisMax=max(abs(x-y) for x,y in zip(e['axis'],se['axis']))))
x=dict(samples=len(rows),maxDistance=max(x['distance'] for x in rows),maxAxisDelta=max(x['axisMax'] for x in rows),maxNearestSampleGap=max(abs(x['ageMs']) for x in rows),rows=rows,scope='Nearest same-machine native inventory sample; stationary target. This is not a transport-latency measurement or proof of NPC world authority.')
(p/'independent-transform-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2))
````

````text
for name,phase in [('active','source_present'),('hidden','source_absent')]:
    rows=read(T/f'quiet-{name}.json');assert len(rows)>=8
    assert all(bool(r['activeModels'])==(name=='active') for r in rows)
    first,last=[next(p for p in r['timings']['phases'] if p['phase']==phase) for r in (rows[0],rows[-1])]
    n=last['intervalCount']-first['intervalCount'];assert n>0
    elapsed=last['intervalTotalMs']-first['intervalTotalMs'];assert elapsed>1000
    stages={}
    for a,b in zip(first['stages'],last['stages']):
        assert a['stage']==b['stage'];count=b['count']-a['count'];ms=b['totalMs']-a['totalMs'];assert count>=0 and ms>=0
        stages[a['stage']]={'calls':count,'totalMs':ms,'meanCallMs':ms/count if count else None}
````

````text
           -cols[1][0]*(cols[0][1]*cols[2][2]-cols[0][2]*cols[2][1])
````

## work/movement-integration/analyze_root_trace.py

````text
import json,math,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);r=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));rows=r['samples'];spikes=[]
rates=[];dts=[]
for a,b in zip(rows,rows[1:]):
    dt=(b['t']-a['t'])/1000
    if dt<=0:continue
    d=math.dist(a['target'][:2],b['target'][:2]);rate=d/dt;rates.append(rate);dts.append(dt)
    if rate>10 or abs(b['target'][2]-a['target'][2])>.15:
        spikes.append(dict(t=b['t'],dt=dt,rate=rate,distance=d,vertical=b['target'][2]-a['target'][2],seq=b['sequence'],prev=a['sequence']))
summary=dict(samples=len(rows),maximum_rate=max(rates),minimum_dt=min(dts),mean_dt=sum(dts)/len(dts),spikes=spikes)
p.with_suffix('.analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2));print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
````

````text
"""Require actual displacement and gait activity, independently of input values."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,json,math
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];P=R/'work/natural-moveset'
a=argparse.ArgumentParser();a.add_argument('take');args=a.parse_args();t=P/args.take
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
rows=read(t/'states.json'); result=read(t/'result.json'); phase=[x for x in rows if 900<=x['ms']<=6200]
distance=sum(math.dist(a['player']['position'][:2],b['player']['position'][:2]) for a,b in zip(phase,phase[1:]))
movingCast=[x for x in phase if x['movement']['powerWeight']>.5 and x['movement']['speed']>.1]
advance=sum((b['movement']['phase']-a['movement']['phase'])%1 for a,b in zip(phase,phase[1:]) if a['movement']['speed']>.1 and b['movement']['speed']>.1)
stop=[x for x in rows if 5300<x['ms']<6200]
motion=dict(take=args.take,requestedAxis=result.get('move'),distance=distance,maximumRemoteSpeed=max(x['movement']['speed'] for x in phase),
    activeWalkingCastSamples=len(movingCast),gaitCyclesAdvancedWhileMoving=advance,
    stoppedPhaseRange=max(x['movement']['phase'] for x in stop)-min(x['movement']['phase'] for x in stop) if stop else None,
    walkingCoveragePassed=bool(result['passed'] and distance>.2 and len(movingCast)>=4 and advance>.1),
    scope='Observed source path length plus remote gait speed/phase during native casting. Numerical eligibility does not establish foot sliding or visual acceptance.')
(t/'walking-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(motion,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(motion))
````

````text
previous = W / 'candidate-doppelganger-holstered-v495'

A.mkdir()

shutil.copytree(R / 'work/natural-moveset/doppelganger-holstered-banks-v495', A / 'banks')
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-agility-fixture-v1/Observe-DoubleJump.ps1

[Observe-DoubleJump.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-agility-fixture-v1/Observe-DoubleJump.ps1>)

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-double-jump-v1')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null
$pids=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function I($r,$b='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $b -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Q($r,$mode,$id=0){for($i=0;$i-lt10;$i++){$raw=if($id){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw "Probe $r $mode"}
function Jump($r,$trial,$second){
 I $r;C $r 'setviewpos -34 -153 68.1 0 0';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 900
 I $r A 100;$watch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();$sent=$false;$jumps=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
 while($watch.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt3500){
  # Hold across the native minimum second-impulse time. A short pulse can
  # expire before that time when wall time advances faster than game time.
  if($second-and!$sent-and$watch.ElapsedMilliseconds-ge180){I $r A 650;$sent=$true}
  $n=Q $r '--player-states';$rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{role=$r;trial=$trial;ms=$watch.ElapsedMilliseconds;native=$n;fixture=(S $r '.agility-fixture.json')})
  foreach($a in @($n.active|Where-Object id -eq 2)){$jumps.Add($a.jumpResearch)}
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15
 }
 if(!$jumps.Count){throw "No native jump samples: $r $trial"}
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-agility-fixture-v1/Send-D2Command.ps1

[Send-D2Command.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-agility-fixture-v1/Send-D2Command.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_movement_resume|coop_movement_feet|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_power_fixture|coop_agility_fixture|coop_power_fx|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-air-clock-v2/build_air_combat_bank.py

[build_air_combat_bank.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-air-clock-v2/build_air_combat_bank.py>)

````text
"""Append authored airborne combat balance to the protected v15 body bank.

The native sword scene remains the attack clock. The jump donor supplies free
legs and pelvis balance, never a world trajectory, floor constraint or FP hand
anchor. Landing blends back to the original grounded action at the same phase.
"""
import sys, struct, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['library-retarget-manifest.json'],'air-combat-bank-sources-v1')
OUT=P/'air-combat-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'power-banks-v1'/f'{role}-power-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data)
 assert magic==b'D2MOVE15' and count==126
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE16',16,n,141,fps,layout)+data[32:])
 rig=rig_for(role);donor,frames=L.load(role,'sword_attack_jumpa');entry=24+121*n*28;sources=[]
 for grounded in range(44,59):
  poses=[];cid=126+grounded-44
````

````text
"""Keep the original air test; require uninterrupted body ownership in v170."""
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];P=R/'work/natural-moveset'
s=(P/'Test-MesmerizeAirNetwork-v169.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
at=" $checks.Add('Exact source airborne phase drives remote cast plus native-air locomotion; jump stays bounded and returns to the same floor')"
assert s.count(at)==1
s=s.replace(at,at+'''
 $bodyRows=@($rows|Where-Object {$_.ms-ge900-and$_.ms-le5000})
 $clockBefore=[int]$rows[0].movement.clockRejection.count
 $dropouts=@($bodyRows|Where-Object {$_.movement.clockRejection.count-ne$clockBefore-or!$_.movement.active-or$_.movement.weight-lt.9})
 [ordered]@{samples=$bodyRows.Count;baselineRejects=$clockBefore;minimumWeight=($bodyRows.movement.weight|Measure-Object -Minimum).Minimum;dropouts=@($dropouts|Select-Object ms,movement)}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12|Set-Content "$out/air-clock-continuity.json"
 if($bodyRows.Count-lt20-or$dropouts.Count){throw 'Airborne native cast introduced a body-clock rejection, lease loss or body-weight dropout'}
 $checks.Add('Takeoff, airborne cast, contact settlement and standing recovery retain body ownership without a clock rejection or body-weight dropout')
''')
(P/'Test-MesmerizeAirNetwork-v170.ps1').write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
runner=R/'work/movement-integration/Invoke-NativeLabOperation.ps1';s=runner.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
assert s.count('Test-MesmerizeAirNetwork-v169.ps1')==1
runner.write_text(s.replace('Test-MesmerizeAirNetwork-v169.ps1','Test-MesmerizeAirNetwork-v170.ps1'),encoding='utf-8')
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-auto-crouch-v651/prepare_auto_crouch_v651.py

[prepare_auto_crouch_v651.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-auto-crouch-v651/prepare_auto_crouch_v651.py>)

````text
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
B=R/'work/movement-integration/auto-crouch-pre-v651'
shutil.copytree(S,B)
def edit(name,old,new):
 p=S/name;t=p.read_text();assert t.count(old)==1,(name,t.count(old));p.write_text(t.replace(old,new))
edit('native_player_states.h','inline bool nativePlayerMotion(','''//649/650 native window-sill observations: physical stance2, AutoCrouch10,
// optionally the independent right-arm EquipChange53. Map presentation only;
// retain actual state IDs and capsule for all ownership checks and gameplay.
inline bool nativePlayerAutoCrouchStates(const NativePlayerStates& s,std::uintptr_t base){
    if(s.player.logic!=1||!s.defaultMode||s.player.current!=2||s.active.empty()||s.active.size()>2)return false;
    unsigned crouch=0,equip=0;
    for(const auto& a:s.active){
        if(a.id==10&&a.vtable==base+0x1c812b8)++crouch;
        else if(a.id==53&&a.vtable==base+0x1c79cf8)++equip;
        else return false;
    }
    return crouch==1&&equip<=1;
````

````text
"""Reauthor crouched power weight transfer around the balanced full-body idle."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['windblast-source-manifest-v1.json','darkvision-source-manifest-v1.json'],'balanced-crouch-powers-v3')
O=P/'balanced-crouch-power-banks-v3';O.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 rig=rig_for(role);n=len(rig.joints);data=(P/'crouch-balance-banks-v1'/f'{role}-crouch-balance-bank.bin').read_bytes();bank=bytearray(data);entry=24+121*n*28;modified=[]
 def previous(cid):return [qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+cid*entry+24+j*28))for j in range(n)]
 right=[]
 for i in range(n):
  k=i
  while k>=0 and k!=16:k=rig.joints[k]['parent']
  if k==16 and i!=16 and 'helper'not in rig.joints[i]['nativeName']:right.append(i)
 for alias,start,duration in (('native_phase_dark_vision_fire',195,933),('native_phase_windblast_fire',199,1000)):
  m,fs=L.load(role,alias);ref=fs[0];refG=rig.fk(ref);wind=start==199
  for armed in (True,False):
   cid=start+int(not armed);rest=previous(17 if armed else 76);restG=rig.fk(rest);errors=[];heights=[];poses=[];arm_clamps=[]
   def authored(t):
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-balanced-crouch-80E9-v3/build_crouch_balance_v1.py

[build_crouch_balance_v1.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-balanced-crouch-80E9-v3/build_crouch_balance_v1.py>)

````text
"""Separate Posture-100 idle comparison; do not promote until visually tested."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['mixamo-retarget-manifest-v5.json'],'crouch-balance-sources-v1')
O=P/'crouch-balance-banks-v1';O.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 rig=rig_for(role);J=rig.joints;n=len(J);path=P/'windblast-context-banks-v1'/f'{role}-windblast-context-bank.bin';data=path.read_bytes();bank=bytearray(data);entry=24+121*n*28
 assert struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data)[:4]==(b'D2MOVE28',28,n,201)
 m,walk=L.load(role,'mixamo_crouched_walking_posture100');walk=walk[:-1];globals_=[rig.fk(f)for f in walk]
 def previous(cid,f=0):return [qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+cid*entry+24+(f*n+j)*28))for j in range(n)]
 mean=copy_pose(walk[0])
 for k in range(1,len(walk)):mean=blend(mean,walk[k],1/(k+1))
 # Average the whole locomotion stance, not a kneeling donor. Feet retain
 # their own mean lateral/forward spacing and contact the native floor.
 targets=[];orient=[];standG=rig.fk(previous(0))
 for ankle in (21,25):
  t=sum((g[ankle].translation for g in globals_),Vector())/len(globals_);t.z=standG[ankle].translation.z;targets.append(t)
  orient.append(rig.fk(mean)[ankle].to_3x3())
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-bendtime-balanced-v42/build_bendtime_balance_v42.py

[build_bendtime_balance_v42.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-bendtime-balanced-v42/build_bendtime_balance_v42.py>)

````text
"""Whole-body Bend Time context candidates with one common phase reference."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['bendtime-bank-source-manifest-v40.json'],'bendtime-balanced-v42')
OUT=P/'bendtime-balanced-banks-v42';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'bendtime-banks-v40'/f'{role}-bendtime-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE38'and count==238
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE39',39,n,247,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28
 rig=rig_for(role);_,start=L.load(role,'native_phase_bend_time_in');reference=start[0];rg=rig.fk(reference);right=[];clips=[]
 for i in range(n):
  k=i
  while k>=0 and k!=16:k=rig.joints[k]['parent']
  if k==16 and i!=16 and 'helper'not in rig.joints[i]['nativeName']:right.append(i)
 for phaseIndex,(phase,duration)in enumerate([('in',533),('loop',300),('out',433)]):
  m,fs=L.load(role,'native_phase_bend_time_'+phase)
  for context,(restid,crouched,armed)in enumerate(((59,False,False),(17,True,True),(76,True,False))):
   cid=238+phaseIndex*3+context;rest=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+restid*entry+24+j*28))for j in range(n)];cg=rig.fk(rest)
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_movement_resume|coop_movement_feet|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_power_fixture|coop_darkvision_fixture|coop_windblast_fixture|coop_bendtime_fixture|coop_ranged_fixture|coop_ranged_prop|coop_agility_fixture|coop_carry_attachment|coop_power_fx|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-checkpoint-retry-v740/stage_checkpoint_retry_v740.py

[stage_checkpoint_retry_v740.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-checkpoint-retry-v740/stage_checkpoint_retry_v740.py>)

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-checkpoint-retry-v740'; P=W/'candidate-door-catalog-v728'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v740.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-CheckpointRetry-v740.ps1','Deploy-CheckpointRetry-v740.ps1','stage_checkpoint_retry_v740.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Native checkpoint memory continuation preserves fixed SLOT82 permission when the exact native routine returns AL=0; consumes it at AL=1 or loading entry. Scoped diagnostics capture consumed callbacks and save-I/O state. Same ordinary door catalogue and protocol69/bank67/357. Runtime pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
"""One bounded actor-only breakout candidate; existing authoring format and donors."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import struct,json,hashlib
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;O=P/'choke-breakout-banks-v592';O.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
rd=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
rows=rd(P/'library-retarget-manifest.json');reports=[]
def blend(a,b,t):
 a=np.array(a,dtype=float);b=np.array(b,dtype=float)
 b[...,:4]*=np.where(np.sum(a[...,:4]*b[...,:4],axis=-1,keepdims=True)<0,-1,1)
 out=a+(b-a)*t;out[...,:4]/=np.linalg.norm(out[...,:4],axis=-1,keepdims=True);return out
def sample(a,t):
 at=np.clip(t,0,len(a)-1);lo=int(at);return blend(a[lo],a[min(lo+1,len(a)-1)],at-lo)
def ease(t):
 t=np.clip(t,0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t)
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 old=(P/'choke-banks-v581'/f'{role}-choke-bank.bin').read_bytes();magic,v,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',old);assert(magic,v,count)==(b'D2MOVE63',63,351)
 release=P/'choke-sequences-v1'/f'nonlethal_back_release_sequence-{role}.bin';m=rd(release.with_suffix('.json'));raw=release.read_bytes();assert sha(raw)==m['sha256'];assert(m['joints'],m['layout_hash'])==(n,layout)
 frames=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<f4',offset=28).reshape(m['frames'],n,7);mark=next(x for x in m['phase_marks'] if x['phase']=='choke_cancel');start=round(mark['at']*m['fps']);releaseFrames=frames[start:]
````

````text
import numpy as np
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;O=P/'choke-banks-v581';O.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
rd=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 old=(P/'trap-banks-v575'/f'{role}-trap-bank.bin').read_bytes();magic,v,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',old);assert(magic,v,count)==(b'D2MOVE62',62,348)
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE63',63,n,351,fps,layout)+old[32:])
 p=P/'choke-sequences-v1'/f'nonlethal_back_finish_sequence-{role}.bin';m=rd(p.with_suffix('.json'));raw=p.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==m['sha256'];assert(m['joints'],m['layout_hash'])==(n,layout)
 values=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<f4',offset=28).reshape(m['frames'],n,7);parts=[]
 for j,(phase,duration) in enumerate((('chokeback_in',.6),('choke_loop',1.4),('choke_win',1.8))):
  mark=next(x for x in m['phase_marks'] if x['phase']==phase);start=round(mark['at']*m['fps']);end=start+round(duration*m['fps']);assert end<len(values)
  at=np.linspace(start,end,120);lo=at.astype(int);hi=np.minimum(lo+1,end);t=(at-lo)[:,None,None];a=values[lo].astype(float);b=values[hi].astype(float);b[...,:4]*=np.where(np.sum(a[...,:4]*b[...,:4],axis=-1,keepdims=True)<0,-1,1)
  q=a+(b-a)*t;q[...,:4]/=np.linalg.norm(q[...,:4],axis=-1,keepdims=True);assert np.isfinite(q).all();q=q.astype('<f4')
  bank.extend(struct.pack('<IIIIff',348+j,121,0,0,0,duration));bank.extend(q.tobytes());bank.extend(q[0].tobytes())
  parts.append(dict(variant=j+1,phase=phase,startFrame=start,endFrame=end,duration=duration))
 assert bank[32:len(old)]==old[32:];out=O/f'{role}-choke-bank.bin';out.write_bytes(bank)
 reports.append(dict(role=role,bank=str(out.relative_to(P)),sha256=hashlib.sha256(bank).hexdigest().upper(),version=63,clips=351,source=str(p.relative_to(P)),sourceSha256=m['sha256'],segments=parts,prior348PayloadsUnchanged=True,runtime_verified=False,visual_accepted=False))
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json,struct,hashlib
import numpy as np
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;O=P/'choke-banks-v581';O.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
rd=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 old=(P/'trap-banks-v575'/f'{role}-trap-bank.bin').read_bytes();magic,v,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',old);assert(magic,v,count)==(b'D2MOVE62',62,348)
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE63',63,n,351,fps,layout)+old[32:])
 p=P/'choke-sequences-v1'/f'nonlethal_back_finish_sequence-{role}.bin';m=rd(p.with_suffix('.json'));raw=p.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==m['sha256'];assert(m['joints'],m['layout_hash'])==(n,layout)
 values=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<f4',offset=28).reshape(m['frames'],n,7);parts=[]
 for j,(phase,duration) in enumerate((('chokeback_in',.6),('choke_loop',1.4),('choke_win',1.8))):
  mark=next(x for x in m['phase_marks'] if x['phase']==phase);start=round(mark['at']*m['fps']);end=start+round(duration*m['fps']);assert end<len(values)
  at=np.linspace(start,end,120);lo=at.astype(int);hi=np.minimum(lo+1,end);t=(at-lo)[:,None,None];a=values[lo].astype(float);b=values[hi].astype(float);b[...,:4]*=np.where(np.sum(a[...,:4]*b[...,:4],axis=-1,keepdims=True)<0,-1,1)
  q=a+(b-a)*t;q[...,:4]/=np.linalg.norm(q[...,:4],axis=-1,keepdims=True);assert np.isfinite(q).all();q=q.astype('<f4')
  bank.extend(struct.pack('<IIIIff',348+j,121,0,0,0,duration));bank.extend(q.tobytes());bank.extend(q[0].tobytes())
  parts.append(dict(variant=j+1,phase=phase,startFrame=start,endFrame=end,duration=duration))
 assert bank[32:len(old)]==old[32:];out=O/f'{role}-choke-bank.bin';out.write_bytes(bank)
 reports.append(dict(role=role,bank=str(out.relative_to(P)),sha256=hashlib.sha256(bank).hexdigest().upper(),version=63,clips=351,source=str(p.relative_to(P)),sourceSha256=m['sha256'],segments=parts,prior348PayloadsUnchanged=True,runtime_verified=False,visual_accepted=False))
(P/'choke-bank-manifest-v581.json').write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2))
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
````
````text
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
````
````text
A=W/'candidate-climb-query-v659'; P=W/'candidate-auto-crouch-v651'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v659.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-ClimbQuery-v659.ps1','Deploy-ClimbQuery-v659.ps1','stage_climb_query_v659.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Read-only fixed native climbable-chain definition lookup through coop_decl_probe. Tests loaded identity and embedded spawnable flag; no entity creation, reparse, native mode mutation or new movement binding. Retains651 behavior and banks.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
````
````text
A=W/'candidate-coin-sync-v792'; P=W/'candidate-coin-fixture-v790'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v792.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-CoinSync-v792.ps1','Deploy-CoinSync-v792.ps1','stage_coin_sync_v792.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Native Steam exact-coin channel with guarded ordinary reward hook, authored identity, per-world once-only receipts, host commits, menu retention and coordinated checkpoint rebind. Runtime pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````
