````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-coin-sync-v794'; P=W/'candidate-coin-sync-v792'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v794.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-CoinSync-v794.ps1','Deploy-CoinSync-v794.ps1','stage_coin_sync_v794.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Native Steam exact-coin channel with thread-safe queued ordinary reward hook, authored identity, per-world once-only receipts, host commits, menu retention and coordinated checkpoint rebind. Runtime pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime

A=W/'candidate-coin-sync-v800'; P=W/'candidate-coin-sync-v794'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v800.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-CoinSync-v800.ps1','Deploy-CoinSync-v800.ps1','stage_coin_sync_v800.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Bounded ordinary coin catalog with authored names and declared quantities, independent receipts, serialized native wallet transactions, host commits, menu retention and checkpoint rebind. Runtime pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-coin-sync-v811'; P=W/'candidate-coin-sync-v804'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v811.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-CoinSync-v811.ps1','Deploy-CoinSync-v811.ps1','stage_coin_sync_v811.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Bounded shared currency/ammo/stored-potion catalog with native capacity-aware outcomes, per-item receipts, serialized native reward transactions, Steam host commits and checkpoint rebind; packet version3. Runtime pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-coin-sync-v814'; P=W/'candidate-coin-sync-v811'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v814.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-CoinSync-v814.ps1','Deploy-CoinSync-v814.ps1','stage_coin_sync_v814.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Bounded shared currency/ammo/stored-potion catalog with native capacity-aware outcomes, per-item receipts, serialized native reward transactions, Steam host commits and checkpoint rebind; packet version3; finite native inventory capacity fixture for isolated edge tests. Runtime pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````

````text
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v821.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')

A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
````

````text
"""Reuse bank65 and the existing native build/deploy/test pipeline."""
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; N=R/'work/natural-moveset'
s=(W/'Build-Lethal-v604.ps1').read_text().replace('v604.log','v610.log').replace('Build604','Build610')
(W/'Build-CombatTarget-v610.ps1').write_text(s)
s=(W/'Deploy-Lethal-v604.ps1').read_text().replace('ChokeDeploy604','CombatTargetDeploy610').replace('stage_lethal_v604.py','stage_combat_target_v610.py')
(W/'Deploy-CombatTarget-v610.ps1').write_text(s)
s=(N/'Test-LethalNetwork-v605.ps1').read_text().replace('LethalNetwork605','CombatTarget611').replace('candidate-lethal-v604','candidate-combat-target-v610').replace('archived604','archived610').replace("name='rear-lethal'","name='targeted-slash'")
for a,b in [('-1.15*$forwardX','+1.15*$forwardX'),('-1.15*$forwardY','+1.15*$forwardY'),('[Math]::Atan2($forwardY,$forwardX)','[Math]::Atan2(-$forwardY,-$forwardX)'),('-.9*$fx','+.9*$fx'),('-.9*$fy','+.9*$fy'),('-.85*$fx','+.85*$fx'),('-.85*$fy','+.85*$fy'),('[Math]::Atan2($fy,$fx)','[Math]::Atan2(-$fy,-$fx)')]:
 assert a in s,a;s=s.replace(a,b)
a=s.index('   $paired=@('); b=s.index('   $receiverHealthAfter=',a)
s=s[:a]+'''   $hits=@($allScenes|Where-Object {$_.state-eq3-and$_.asset-match'sword_slash_rightb?\\.midnightscene$'-and$_.bindingsResearch.Count-eq3})
   $hits|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 9|Set-Content "$out/targeted-scenes.json"
   if($hits.Count-lt2){throw 'Native target-bearing sword scene not observed'};$checks.Add('Ordinary sword input produces native three-actor targeted slash')
   $validated=@($samples|Where-Object {$_.player.combatSceneValid-and$_.player.combatScene.variant-in1,2-and$_.player.combatScene.targetHandle-eq$g.handle})
   if($validated.Count-lt2){throw 'Targeted combat reader did not validate'};$checks.Add('Independent reader validates exact player, right arm and native enemy target')
   if(!@($validated|Where-Object {$_.sword.equipped-and$_.sword.started}).Count){throw 'Sword premise absent'};$checks.Add('Native sword equipped and started during targeted slash')
   $played=@($samples|Where-Object {$_.movement.combatVariant-in1,2-and$_.movement.combatWeight-gt.65-and$_.movement.weight-gt.85})
   if(!$played.Count){throw 'Remote targeted attack animation absent'};$checks.Add('Existing full-body combat clip plays through native Steam source semantics')
   $lastEnd=($validated|Measure-Object ms -Maximum).Maximum
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json,shutil,hashlib,datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];W=R/'work/movement-integration';L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab';A=W/'candidate-combat-target-v610';P=W/'candidate-lethal-v604'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
rd=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==rd(P/'identity.json')['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke'):
 text=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v610.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');assert text and not any(x in text for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False);shutil.copytree(L/'src',A/'src')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for p in (W/'prepare_combat_target_v610.py',W/'Build-CombatTarget-v610.ps1',W/'Deploy-CombatTarget-v610.ps1',R/'work/natural-moveset/Test-CombatTarget-v611.ps1',Path(__file__)):shutil.copy2(p,A/p.name)
banks=[dict(path=str(p.relative_to(R)),sha256=sha(p)) for p in sorted((P/'banks').glob('*.bin'))];assert len(banks)==2
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=65,bankVersion=65,clips=353,banks=banks,runtimeVerified=False,scope='Read-only target-bearing combat reader: exact native607 right/rightb, Scene_1/2,1000ms,standing. Validates owned player/arm and one reciprocal unique NPC; excludes partner. No bank/protocol changes, no native damage/event replay. Live validation pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
````

````text
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
rd=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==rd(P/'identity.json')['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke'):
 text=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v616.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');assert text and not any(x in text for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False);shutil.copytree(L/'src',A/'src')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for p in (W/'prepare_crouch_combat_v616.py',W/'Build-CrouchCombat-v616.ps1',W/'Deploy-CrouchCombat-v616.ps1',R/'work/natural-moveset/Test-CrouchCombat-v617.ps1',Path(__file__)):shutil.copy2(p,A/p.name)
banks=rd(P/'identity.json')['banks'];assert len(banks)==2
for bank in banks:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=66,bankVersion=65,clips=353,banks=banks,runtimeVerified=False,scope='Native613 crouched target-bearing right/left933 and owned hit-recovery right866/left666. Existing bank65/353 reused; protocol66 adds combat variants15/16. Continue prior authored strike into follow-through and blend native stance recovery. Source owns all victim events/outcomes. Build and runtime validation pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````

````text
"""Keep a native low sword guard while the other arm and body cast freely.
Actor-space rotations act on the native arm chain; no wrist position target.
"""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['bendtime-balanced-source-manifest-v42.json'],'crouch-power-guard-v50')
OUT=P/'crouch-power-guard-banks-v50';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'outofmana-context-banks-v46'/f'{role}-outofmana-context-bank.bin').read_bytes();bank=bytearray(data)
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert version==41 and count==251
 size=24+121*n*28;rig=rig_for(role);clips=[]
 rest=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+17*size+24+j*28))for j in range(n)];rg=rig.fk(rest)
 for cid,phase in ((239,'in'),(245,'out')):
  fs=[[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+cid*size+24+(f*n+j)*28))for j in range(n)]for f in range(120)];poses=[];max_move=0;grip_error=0
  for f,p in enumerate(fs):
   t=f/119;weight=.88*(ease(t/.25) if phase=='in' else 1-ease(t))
   out=copy_pose(p);g=rig.fk(p)
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-darkvision-contexts-v26-v1/build_darkvision_contexts_v1.py

[build_darkvision_contexts_v1.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-darkvision-contexts-v26-v1/build_darkvision_contexts_v1.py>)

````text
"""Whole-body stance/equipment adaptations, preserving native lengths and feet."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['darkvision-source-manifest-v1.json'],'darkvision-contexts-v1')
OUT=P/'darkvision-context-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'darkvision-banks-v1'/f'{role}-darkvision-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE25'and count==194
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE26',26,n,197,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28
 rig=rig_for(role);m,fs=L.load(role,'native_phase_dark_vision_fire');reference=fs[0];rg=rig.fk(reference)
 right=[]
 for i in range(n):
  k=i
  while k>=0 and k!=16:k=rig.joints[k]['parent']
  if k==16 and i!=16 and 'helper'not in rig.joints[i]['nativeName']:right.append(i)
 clips=[]
 for cid,restid,crouched,armed in ((194,59,False,False),(195,17,True,True),(196,76,True,False)):
  rest=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+restid*entry+24+j*28))for j in range(n)];cg=rig.fk(rest)
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_movement_resume|coop_movement_feet|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_power_fixture|coop_darkvision_fixture|coop_agility_fixture|coop_power_fx|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-darkvision-integration-v25-v3/build_darkvision_bank_v1.py

[build_darkvision_bank_v1.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-darkvision-integration-v25-v3/build_darkvision_bank_v1.py>)

````text
"""Append the authored whole-body Dark Vision cast; native source owns time/VFX."""
import sys, struct, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['power-retarget-manifest-v1.json'],'darkvision-sources-v1')
OUT=P/'darkvision-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'keyhole-banks-v2'/f'{role}-keyhole-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data)
 assert magic==b'D2MOVE24' and count==193
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE25',25,n,194,fps,layout)+data[32:])
 rig=rig_for(role);grip=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+24+j*28))for j in range(n)]
 fingers=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
  while k>=0 and k!=16:k=rig.joints[k]['parent']
  if k==16 and j!=16 and 'helper'not in rig.joints[j]['nativeName']:fingers.append(j)
 m,fs=L.load(role,'power_dark_vision_fire')
````

````text
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Baseline,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Evidence)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$name='models/interactive/notes/note_dw_frommeagan.inventoryitem'
$m=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$armed=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
function C($r,$s){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $s -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function Q($r){$l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid;if(!$l.assetExperiment-or$p.Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-[DateTime]$l.startedAt).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Isolated identity differs'};$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $l.pid --player-inventory;if($LASTEXITCODE){throw 'Native inventory read failed'};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 try{$owned=$m.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Native operation active'}
 if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $Evidence){throw 'Unique note restoration evidence required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $Evidence|Out-Null
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $expected=Get-Content "$Baseline/inventory-before-$r.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$before=Q $r
  $before|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12|Set-Content "$Evidence/before-$r.json"
  $a=@($expected.items|Where-Object name -eq $name);$b=@($before.items|Where-Object name -eq $name)
  if($a.Count-ne1-or$b.Count-ne1-or$a[0].quantity-notin0,1-or$b[0].quantity-notin0,1){throw 'Known scalar note not found'}
  $otherBefore=@($before.items|Where-Object name -ne $name|ForEach-Object {"$($_.name):$($_.quantity)"});$otherExpected=@($expected.items|Where-Object name -ne $name|ForEach-Object {"$($_.name):$($_.quantity)"})
  if(Compare-Object $otherExpected $otherBefore){throw 'Other inventory differs; narrow note restore cannot repair it'}
  if($a[0].quantity-ne$b[0].quantity){
   $armed.Add($r);C $r 'coop_movement_fixture off';C $r 'coop_movement_fixture 60000'
   $wait=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();do{$iso=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json.observer-isolation.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($iso.active-and$iso.ready-and$iso.movementFixture){break};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50}while($wait.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt3000)
   $iso|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4|Set-Content "$Evidence/isolation-$r.json";if(!$iso.active-or!$iso.ready-or!$iso.movementFixture){throw 'Native isolated fixture not ready'}
   C $r $(if($a[0].quantity){'coop_note_fixture restore_present'}else{'coop_note_fixture restore_absent'})
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
````

````text
a=s.index(' & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button B');b=s.index(' $hwnd=',a)
s=s[:a]+''' $expectedStance=if($Stance-eq'crouched'){1}else{0}
 if($expectedStance){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button B -DurationMs 180|Out-Null;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300}
 if($Holstered){
  & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role client -Pitch -60 -Evidence "$out/holster-look-away.json" -Quick
  & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button X -DurationMs 1000|Out-Null;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1200
  & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role client -Pitch 12 -Evidence "$out/holster-look-restored.json" -Quick
 }
 $w.Restart();$setupRows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
 do{
  $m=S host '.movement.json';$native=Q client '--player-states';$nativeSword=Q client '--player-sword'
  $setupRows.Add([pscustomobject]@{ms=$w.ElapsedMilliseconds;native=$native;sword=$nativeSword;movement=$m;source=(S client '.shadow-stream.json');peer=(S host '.shadow-stream.json')})
  if($native.stance-eq$expectedStance-and[Math]::Abs($m.stanceMix-$expectedStance)-lt.02-and$m.active-and$m.presentedDrawn-ne[bool]$Holstered-and$nativeSword.equipped-ne[bool]$Holstered-and[Math]::Abs($m.armedMix-$(if($Holstered){0}else{1}))-lt.02){break};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 40
 }while($w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt4500)
 $setupRows|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 14|Set-Content "$out/context-setup.json"
 if($native.stance-ne$expectedStance-or[Math]::Abs($m.stanceMix-$expectedStance)-gt.02-or!$m.active-or$m.presentedDrawn-eq[bool]$Holstered-or$nativeSword.equipped-eq[bool]$Holstered){throw 'Native/remote stance and equipment context not ready'}
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-context-v258/Test-DominoContextNetwork-v258.ps1

[Test-DominoContextNetwork-v258.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-context-v258/Test-DominoContextNetwork-v258.ps1>)

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=12,[ValidateSet('standing','crouched')][string]$Stance='standing',[switch]$Holstered,[ValidateRange(0,12000)][int]$Move=0)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$rawMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --domino-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $dirty=$true;C client 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C host 'setviewpos -44.39 -153.27 68.1 203 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role host -Pitch 15 -Evidence "$out/observer-camera.json" -Quick
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-context-wire-v261/build_domino_contexts_v243.py

[build_domino_contexts_v243.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-context-wire-v261/build_domino_contexts_v243.py>)

````text
"""Whole-body Domino stance candidates, preserving the v192 standing payload.

The first-person source supplies phase timing, not fixed body-space wrists.
New contexts remain offline candidates until their native runtime cases pass.
"""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['domino-bank-source-manifest-v192.json'],'domino-contexts-v243')
OUT=P/'domino-context-banks-v243';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'domino-banks-v192'/f'{role}-domino-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data)
 assert magic==b'D2MOVE47'and version==47 and count==289
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE48',48,n,301,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28
 rig=rig_for(role);_,initial=L.load(role,'native_domino_entry');reference=initial[0];refG=rig.fk(reference);right=[];clips=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
````

````text
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --domino-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $dirty=$true;C client 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C host 'setviewpos -44.39 -153.27 68.1 203 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role host -Pitch 15 -Evidence "$out/observer-camera.json" -Quick
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-crouch-final-v252/build_domino_contexts_v243.py

[build_domino_contexts_v243.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-crouch-final-v252/build_domino_contexts_v243.py>)

````text
"""Whole-body Domino stance candidates, preserving the v192 standing payload.

The first-person source supplies phase timing, not fixed body-space wrists.
New contexts remain offline candidates until their native runtime cases pass.
"""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['domino-bank-source-manifest-v192.json'],'domino-contexts-v243')
OUT=P/'domino-context-banks-v243';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'domino-banks-v192'/f'{role}-domino-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data)
 assert magic==b'D2MOVE47'and version==47 and count==289
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE48',48,n,301,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28
 rig=rig_for(role);_,initial=L.load(role,'native_domino_entry');reference=initial[0];refG=rig.fk(reference);right=[];clips=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
````

````text
"""Prepare offline stance authoring; does not enable any runtime context."""
from pathlib import Path

s=(P/'build_mesmerize_contexts_v132.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
s=s.replace('Mesmerize','Domino').replace('mesmerize-bank-source-manifest-v77.json','domino-bank-source-manifest-v192.json').replace('mesmerize-contexts-v132','domino-contexts-v243').replace('mesmerize-context-banks-v132','domino-context-banks-v243').replace("P/'mesmerize-banks-v77'/f'{role}-mesmerize-bank.bin'","P/'domino-banks-v192'/f'{role}-domino-bank.bin'")
s=s.replace("b'D2MOVE45'and version==45 and count==276", "b'D2MOVE47'and version==47 and count==289").replace("b'D2MOVE46',46,n,285", "b'D2MOVE48',48,n,301")
s=s.replace("'native_mesmerize_in'","'native_domino_entry'").replace("[('in',466),('loop',1200),('out',666)]", "[('entry',266),('aim',1333),('select',400),('exit',266)]")
s=s.replace("'native_mesmerize_'+phase", "'native_domino_'+phase").replace('cid=276+phaseIndex*3+context','cid=289+phaseIndex*3+context')
s=s.replace("phase=='in'", "phase=='entry'").replace("phase=='out'", "phase=='exit'")
s=s.replace('native_mesmerize_', 'native_domino_').replace('variant=16+phaseIndex','variant=19+phaseIndex')
s=s.replace('v77 donor', 'v192 whole-body donor').replace('v77 standing payload','v192 standing payload')
s=s.replace("f'{role}-mesmerize-context-bank.bin'", "f'{role}-domino-context-bank.bin'").replace("format='D2MOVE46',clips=285", "format='D2MOVE48',clips=301")
s=s.replace('mesmerize-context-source-manifest-v132.json','domino-context-source-manifest-v243.json').replace('mesmerize-context-bank-manifest-v132.json','domino-context-bank-manifest-v243.json').replace('MESMERIZE_CONTEXTS_GENERATED','DOMINO_CONTEXTS_GENERATED')
(P/'build_domino_contexts_v243.py').write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
````

````text
 $ox=[double]$ground.position[0]+2.5;$oy=[double]$ground.position[1]-1.8;$oz=[double]$ground.position[2]+1.7
 $oyaw=[Math]::Atan2([double]$ground.position[1]-$oy,[double]$ground.position[0]-$ox)*180/[Math]::PI
 C host ('setviewpos {0} {1} {2} {3} 0'-f$ox.ToString('F4',$ci),$oy.ToString('F4',$ci),$oz.ToString('F4',$ci),$oyaw.ToString('F4',$ci))

'''

s=s.replace('$cast=$false;$stood=$false','$cast=$false;$stood=$false;$secondCast=$false')
anchor='  if(!$stood-and$w.ElapsedMilliseconds-ge6500)'
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=12)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$rawMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --domino-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $dirty=$true;C client 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C host 'setviewpos -44.39 -153.27 68.1 203 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role host -Pitch 15 -Evidence "$out/observer-camera.json" -Quick
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-crouch-v246/build_domino_contexts_v243.py

[build_domino_contexts_v243.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-crouch-v246/build_domino_contexts_v243.py>)

````text
"""Whole-body Domino stance candidates, preserving the v192 standing payload.

The first-person source supplies phase timing, not fixed body-space wrists.
New contexts remain offline candidates until their native runtime cases pass.
"""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['domino-bank-source-manifest-v192.json'],'domino-contexts-v243')
OUT=P/'domino-context-banks-v243';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'domino-banks-v192'/f'{role}-domino-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data)
 assert magic==b'D2MOVE47'and version==47 and count==289
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE48',48,n,301,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28
 rig=rig_for(role);_,initial=L.load(role,'native_domino_entry');reference=initial[0];refG=rig.fk(reference);right=[];clips=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-final-context-v264/prepare_domino_final_context_network_v264.py

[prepare_domino_final_context_network_v264.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-final-context-v264/prepare_domino_final_context_network_v264.py>)

````text
"""Generalize the proven armed crouch final test to explicit equipment/stance.
This harness is prepared before reader promotion; native evidence must come first.
"""
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; P=R/'work/natural-moveset'; W=R/'work/movement-integration'
s=(P/'Test-DominoCrouchFinalNetwork-v256.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
c=(P/'Test-DominoTargetContextNetwork-v262.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
s=s.replace('[int]$Pitch=12)',"[int]$Pitch=0,[ValidateSet('standing','crouched')][string]$Stance='crouched',[switch]$Holstered)")
a=s.index(' & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button B -DurationMs 180')
b=s.index(' $hwnd=',a)
ca=c.index(' $expectedStance='); cb=c.index(' $hwnd=',ca)
s=s[:a]+c[ca:cb].replace('move=$Move;', 'move=0;')+' $groundState=if($expectedStance){6}else{0}\n'+s[b:]
s=s.replace('if(!$stood-and$w.ElapsedMilliseconds-ge9500){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button B -DurationMs 180|Out-Null;', 'if(!$stood-and$w.ElapsedMilliseconds-ge9500){if($expectedStance){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button B -DurationMs 180|Out-Null};')
s=s.replace("player=(Q client '--player-states');movement=$m", "player=(Q client '--player-states');sword=(Q client '--player-sword');movement=$m")
s=s.replace("stream=$stream;effects=$fx", "stream=$stream;sourceStream=(S client '.shadow-stream.json');effects=$fx")
s=s.replace('$_.activeStates[0]-eq6','$_.activeStates[0]-eq$groundState').replace('$_.stance-ne1','$_.stance-ne$expectedStance')
s=s.replace("if(!$sword.equipped-or!(Q client '--player-sword').equipped)","if($sword.equipped-eq[bool]$Holstered-or(Q client '--player-sword').equipped-eq[bool]$Holstered)")
s=s.replace('$_.player.stance-ne1-or$_.movement.stanceMix-lt.98', '$_.player.stance-ne$expectedStance-or[Math]::Abs($_.movement.stanceMix-$expectedStance)-gt.02-or$_.movement.presentedDrawn-eq[bool]$Holstered-or$_.sword.equipped-eq[bool]$Holstered')
s=s.replace('finalSamples=$final.Count;', 'stance=$Stance;holstered=[bool]$Holstered;move=0;finalSamples=$final.Count;')
s=s.replace("source='client';checks=", "source='client';stance=$Stance;holstered=[bool]$Holstered;move=0;checks=")
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-final-context-v264/prepare_domino_holstered_final_v263.py

[prepare_domino_holstered_final_v263.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-final-context-v264/prepare_domino_holstered_final_v263.py>)

````text
"""Derive a bounded, source-only native final-selection observation.

No runtime writes beyond the existing reversible inventory fixture and native
input. Look away before X so holstering cannot also pickpocket the target.
"""
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; P=R/'work/natural-moveset'; W=R/'work/movement-integration'
s=(P/'Observe-NativeDominoCrouchFinal-v251.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
s=s.replace('[switch]$AimGuard)',"[switch]$AimGuard,[ValidateSet('standing','crouched')][string]$Stance='crouched')")
s=s.replace('coop_domino_fixture 20000','coop_domino_fixture 40000')
a=s.index(' & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button B -DurationMs 180')
b=s.index(' $hwnd=',a)
s=s[:a]+''' $expectedStance=if($Stance-eq'crouched'){1}else{0}
 $groundState=if($expectedStance){6}else{0}
 if($expectedStance){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button B -DurationMs 180|Out-Null;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500}
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role client -Pitch -60 -Evidence "$out/holster-look-away.json" -Quick
 & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button X -DurationMs 1000|Out-Null;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1200
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role client -Pitch 0 -Evidence "$out/holster-look-return.json" -Quick
 $context=Q client '--player-states';$sword=Q client '--player-sword'
 [ordered]@{stance=$Stance;native=$context;sword=$sword}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content "$out/context-before.json"
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-final-context-v264/summarize_domino_holstered_final_v263.py

[summarize_domino_holstered_final_v263.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-final-context-v264/summarize_domino_holstered_final_v263.py>)

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'natural-moveset'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for stance,ground in [('crouched',6),('standing',0)]:
 t=P/f'domino-holstered-{stance}-final-observe-v263'
 if not(t/'result.json').exists():continue
 result=read(t/'result.json');raw=read(t/'crouched-final-raw-proof.json');rows=read(t/'states.json')
 assert result['passed'] and all(not x['sword']['equipped']for x in rows)
 final=[]
 for x in rows:
  for scene in x['midnight']['instances']:
   if scene.get('state')==3 and scene.get('subscene')=='Cast_final_Select':
    final.append(dict(timeMs=scene['clockWords'][1],durationMs=scene['sceneDurationMs'],states=[a['id']for a in x['player']['active']],holstered=not x['sword']['equipped'],scene=scene))
 assert len(raw)>=8 and all(x['sceneDurationMs']==400 for x in raw)
 assert all(len(x['bindingsResearch'])==2 and all(b['reciprocal']for b in x['bindingsResearch'])for x in raw)
 out=dict(take=t.name,stance=stance,holstered=True,rawFinalSamples=len(raw),rawClockMs=[min(x['clockWords'][1]for x in raw),max(x['clockWords'][1]for x in raw)],independentFinalRows=final,groundState=ground,passed=result['passed'],complete=False,scope='Native source provenance. Independent state/scene probes are sequential, not atomic. Reader must keep reciprocal ownership, equipment rereads, exact ground state and400ms bound. No peer proof in this observation.')
 (t/'final-context-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items()if k not in ('independentFinalRows','scope')}|{'independentFinalStates':[{k:v for k,v in x.items()if k!='scene'}for x in final]}))
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_movement_resume|coop_movement_feet|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_power_fixture|coop_darkvision_fixture|coop_windblast_fixture|coop_mesmerize_fixture|coop_mesmerize_visual|coop_bendtime_fixture|coop_ranged_fixture|coop_grenade_fixture|coop_potion_fixture|coop_grenade_prop|coop_ranged_prop|coop_agility_fixture|coop_carry_attachment|coop_power_fx|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

````text
complete-body authored acting; there are no camera-space wrist constraints.

import sys,struct,json,hashlib,math

from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
from finger_reference import HandReference
from edge_data import poses as read_edge
L=Library(['power-retarget-manifest-v1.json'],'domino-sources-v192')

reference=next(r for r in read(P/'fp-power-reference-manifest.json')['rows'] if 'ply_leftarm_power_phantasmal_select'in r['aliases'])
fp=read_edge(P/reference['sample_file']);assert fp['sha256']==reference['sample_sha256']
fingerFrames=[[qts(v)for v in f]for f in fp['frames']]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'mesmerize-context-banks-v132'/f'{role}-mesmerize-context-bank.bin').read_bytes()
````

````text
'''+a)
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-door-api-v707'; P=W/'candidate-diagnostic-slices-v702'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v707.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-DoorApi-v707.ps1','Deploy-DoorApi-v707.ps1','stage_door_api_v707.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Strict native Openable reader and explicit isolated ordinary-door native request proof. No network door synchronization yet. Retains702 scheduling, protocol69 and bank67/357.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
````

````text
A=W/'candidate-door-api-v713'; P=W/'candidate-door-api-v710'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v713.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-DoorApi-v713.ps1','Deploy-DoorApi-v713.ps1','stage_door_api_v713.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='712 analysis: fresh Moving target is -1; interrupt API74d7a0 incorrectly finalizes it before starting.713 uses native74a400 queue and component resume, matching ordinary interaction and opposite close clip. Strict native identity retained. No network door synchronization yet. Retains702 scheduling, protocol69 and bank67/357.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-door-catalog-v728'; P=W/'candidate-door-catalog-v725'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v728.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-DoorSync-v728.ps1','Deploy-DoorSync-v728.ps1','stage_door_sync_v728.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Authored ordinary-door catalog: unique native names and definitions, per-door native Steam host ordering, per-door lifetime and animation-generation pins, bounded round-robin service. No hardcoded door or map name. Locked/blocked/linked/broken/ambiguous doors excluded at arm; explicit isolated fixture still required. Runtime pending. Protocol69 and bank67/357 unchanged.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-door-session-v763'; P=W/'candidate-door-side-v755'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v763.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-DoorSession-v763.ps1','Deploy-DoorSession-v763.ps1','stage_door_session_v763.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Explicit ordinary-door session keeps ID-only intent across verified coordinated same-map checkpoint loads. Old native bindings retire before load; both-complete and restored local role/counterpart plus fresh paired epochs allow a new catalog and new arms. Session mode does not pause AI or depend on movement isolation. Legacy one-world fixture mode retained. Session change, uncoordinated world change or failed checkpoint retires intent. Same protocol69/bank67/357 and exact native queue. Runtime pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-doppelganger-fx-v448/build_doppelganger_fx_assets_v441.py

[build_doppelganger_fx_assets_v441.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-doppelganger-fx-v448/build_doppelganger_fx_assets_v441.py>)

````text
"""Reproducible native cosmetic FX/material derivatives; does not install them."""
from pathlib import Path
import copy,hashlib,json
from inspect_midnight_events import parse,walk
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab';A=L/'assets'
def arr(xs):return {'num':len(xs),**{f'item[{i}]':x for i,x in enumerate(xs)}}
def items(d):return [d[f'item[{i}]']for i in range(d['num'])]
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
def emit(o,n=0):
 if isinstance(o,dict):return '{\n'+''.join('\t'*(n+1)+k+' = '+emit(v,n+1)+(';'if not isinstance(v,dict)else'')+'\n'for k,v in o.items())+'\t'*n+'}'
 if isinstance(o,str):return o if o in ('true','false','NULL')else json.dumps(o)
 return str(o)
manifest=[]
def write(d,path,resource,kind,classname,source,**details):
 text=emit(d)+'\n';assert parse(text)==d
 path.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
 manifest.append(dict(resource=resource,generated=str(path),sha256=sha(path),source=str(source),source_sha256=sha(source),kind=kind,classname=classname,runtime_verified=False,**details))
for phase in ('spawn','despawn'):
 src=L/f'research/asset-exports/native-doppelganger-fx-v436/game1_patch/generated.decls.fx.models.effects.gameplay.powers.doppelganger.decoy.spawn_despawn.decoy_{phase}_01..fx.decl'
 original=parse(src.read_text());d=copy.deepcopy(original);removed=[]
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
p=S/'doppelganger_fx_scene.h';assert not p.exists()
s=(S/'mesmerize_visual_scene.h').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').replace('MesmerizeVisual','DoppelgangerFx').replace('mesmerizeVisual','doppelgangerFx')
s=s.replace('// Bounded local model experiment. No gameplay/AI or native scene event tracks.','// Cosmetic441 native FX/material tracks only; body pose/root stay network-owned.')
s=s.replace('struct DoppelgangerFxTarget {std::uintptr_t actor=0;unsigned handle=0;};','using DoppelgangerFxTarget=NativeDoppelgangerVisual;')
start=s.index(' return variant==1?');end=s.index('\n}',start)
s=s[:start]+' return variant==1?"midnight/d2coop/doppelganger_fx_spawn.midnightscene":variant==2?"midnight/d2coop/doppelganger_fx_despawn.midnightscene":nullptr;'+s[end:]
s=s.replace('"Mesmerize"','"AIGroup1"').replace('elapsed>700','elapsed>=doppelgangerFxDuration(variant)')
s=s.replace('if(!s.handle||!s.declaration||worldIdentityEntity(memoryRead,observedGame,target.handle)!=target.actor)return false;',
    'if(!s.handle||!s.declaration||!currentDoppelgangerVisual(target,observedGame))return false;')
s=s.replace('if(s.handle||!resource||elapsed>=doppelgangerFxDuration(variant)||!carryVictimApis()',
    'if(s.handle||!resource||elapsed>=doppelgangerFxDuration(variant)||!currentDoppelgangerVisual(target,observedGame)||!carryVictimApis()')
p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')

p=S/'doppelganger_world_stream.h';s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
old='r.sequence,r.event,r.digest,r.handle,r.generation,r.present);'
new='r.sequence,r.event,r.digest,r.handle,r.generation,r.present,r.fxKnown,r.fxScene,r.fxVariant,r.fxTimeMs);'
assert s.count(old)==1;s=s.replace(old,new)
old=r'\"present\":%u}",i?",":"",r.sequence';new=r'\"present\":%u,\"fxKnown\":%u,\"fxScene\":%u,\"fxVariant\":%u,\"fxTimeMs\":%u}",i?",":"",r.sequence'
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/doppelganger-visual-v423-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/doppelganger-visual-v423-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
def edit(p,a,b):
    s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');assert s.count(a)==1,(p,a[:90]);p.write_text(s.replace(a,b),encoding='utf-8')
p=S/'doppelganger_visual.h'
edit(p,'SRWLOCK doppelgangerCloneLock=', '''// Probe brackets native phase3 publication and this exact expected pose.
struct DoppelgangerClonePublication {
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> sequence{0};std::atomic<std::uintptr_t> animation{0};
    std::uint64_t sourceSequence=0;std::array<std::array<float,12>,kDoppelgangerJoints> expected{};
} doppelgangerClonePublication;
static_assert(offsetof(DoppelgangerClonePublication,expected)==24);
void doppelgangerClonePosePhase(void* component,int phase,bool finished){
    auto& p=doppelgangerClonePublication;if(phase!=3||p.animation.load()!=reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(component))return;
    if(finished){const auto seq=p.sequence.load();p.sequence.fetch_add((seq&1)?1:2);}else if(!(p.sequence.load()&1))p.sequence.fetch_add(1);
}
SRWLOCK doppelgangerCloneLock=''')
edit(p,'        ++doppelgangerCloneApplied;doppelgangerCloneAppliedSequence.store(s.sequence);','''        if(doppelgangerClonePublication.sequence.load()&1){
            doppelgangerClonePublication.sourceSequence=s.sequence;
            for(unsigned j=0;j<kDoppelgangerJoints;++j)for(unsigned c=0;c<4;++c)for(unsigned r=0;r<3;++r)doppelgangerClonePublication.expected[j][c*3+r]=s.local[j].v[c*4+r];
        }
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-double-jump-v21-v1/double_jump_contacts_v21.py

[double_jump_contacts_v21.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-double-jump-v21-v1/double_jump_contacts_v21.py>)

````text
import json,sys,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
take=sys.argv[1];root=P/take
rows=json.loads((root/'states.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));out=[]
for armed in (True,False):
 for moving in (False,True):
  samples=[r for r in rows if r['armed']==armed and r['moving']==moving and r['movement'].get('secondJump') and r.get('videoTime')]
  if not samples:continue
  start=min(r['videoTime']for r in samples)-.65
  times=[max(0,start+.24*f)for f in range(10)]
  filename=f"contact-{'armed'if armed else'empty'}-{'moving'if moving else'standing'}.jpg"
  subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(P/'make_contact_sheet.py'),str(P/f'{take}.mp4'),str(root/filename),*[str(t)for t in times]],check=True)
  out.append(dict(armed=armed,moving=moving,video_times=times,selection='Expanded approximate wall-time interval; video frames show actual phases. Encoder startup and status publication are not phase-synchronized.',contact=filename))
(root/'contact-times.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2));print('CONTACTS',take,len(out))
````

````text
"""Finite manual native hand-effect experiment; no network activation yet."""
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
def edit(name,pairs):
 p=S/name;s=p.read_text()
 for a,b in pairs:assert s.count(a)==1,(name,a,s.count(a));s=s.replace(a,b)
 p.write_text(s)
edit('native_power_fx.h',[
 ('std::uint64_t epoch=0,streamToken=0,peerToken=0;ULONGLONG expires=0;', 'std::uint64_t epoch=0,streamToken=0,peerToken=0;ULONGLONG expires=0;std::array<float,3> handPoint{};'),
 ('const char* powerFxResult="idle";', 'std::uint64_t powerFxHandUpdates=0;\nconst char* powerFxResult="idle";'),
 ('kind==10?"models/effects/gameplay/powers/bend_time/bend_time_01.fx":', 'kind==10?"models/effects/gameplay/powers/bend_time/bend_time_01.fx":\n        kind==11?"models/effects/gameplay/player_generic/tatoo/out_of_mana/out_of_mana_01.fx":'),
 ('bool startNativePowerFx(unsigned kind,', '''bool nativeFailureFxHand(float* point,float* axis){
    NativeSkeleton s{};
    if(!readNativeSkeleton(memoryRead,reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(gameImage),probeHandle,s)||!s.stable||s.logic!=1||
       s.game!=observedGame||s.actor!=probeActor||!bodyShadowTarget(s)||s.parents.size()!=(localRole?215u:219u)||
       s.parents[9]!=8||s.parents[10]!=9||s.globalPose.size()!=s.parents.size())return false;
    const auto& hand=s.globalPose[9];
    for(unsigned r=0;r<3;++r){point[r]=s.root[r];for(unsigned k=0;k<3;++k)point[r]+=s.root[3+k*3+r]*hand[12+k];
        for(unsigned c=0;c<3;++c){axis[c*3+r]=0;for(unsigned k=0;k<3;++k)axis[c*3+r]+=s.root[3+k*3+r]*hand[c*4+k];}}
    for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i)if(!std::isfinite(point[i])||std::fabs(point[i])>100000)return false;
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Doppelganger)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'

function ReadLiveJson([string]$path){
    # Native status writers can briefly hold/truncate their own file. Retry
    # the actual read, never substitute an older cached snapshot or relax
    # the native startup/epoch checks below.
    for($attempt=0;$attempt-lt8;$attempt++){
        try{
            $parsed=Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -ErrorAction Stop|ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
            if($null-eq$parsed){throw 'Native status file is temporarily empty'}
            return $parsed
        }
        catch{if($attempt-eq7){throw};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}
    }
}
function State([string]$role){ReadLiveJson (Join-Path $root "work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json")}
function Command([string]$role,[string]$text){& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Send-D2Command.ps1') -Role $role -Command $text|Out-Null}
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/grenade-fx-presentation-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/grenade-fx-presentation-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
$Kind='grenade';$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$target=if($Character-eq'corvo'){'client'}else{'host'};$source=if($target-eq'client'){'host'}else{'client'}
$pids=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Q($r,$mode,$id=0){$raw=if($id){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if($LASTEXITCODE){throw "Probe failed $mode"};$raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
try{
 $before=@{}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid
  & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -DurationMs 100|Out-Null
  foreach($c in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_review_clip off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_authoring_proof off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_ranged_prop off','coop_grenade_prop off','coop_probe_follow exact','coop_probe_locomotion on','coop_shadow_loco combat','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $c}
  $before[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory'
 }
 C $source 'setviewpos -34.3 -154.8 68.1 0 0'
 C $target $(if($Closeup){'setviewpos -33.0 -153.8 68.1 223 0'}else{'setviewpos -31.7 -152.9 68.1 216 0'})
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role $target -Pitch 15 -Evidence "$out/camera.json"
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-grenade-scene-watch-v53/Test-NativeGrenadeScene-v53.ps1

[Test-NativeGrenadeScene-v53.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-grenade-scene-watch-v53/Test-NativeGrenadeScene-v53.ps1>)

````text
param([ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-grenade-equip-v52')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventories=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$start=0
function C($r,$text){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $text -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function I($r,$button='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$handle=0){for($a=0;$a-lt12;$a++){$raw=if($handle){& "$root/work/build/Release/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $handle}else{& "$root/work/build/Release/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 25};throw "Native read $r $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_grenade_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventories[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventories[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 if((Q $Source '--player-grenade-scene').valid){throw 'Unexpected baseline scene'}
 $before=Q $Source '--player-grenade';if($before.quantity-or$before.equipped-or$before.started){throw 'Grenade already owned/selected'};$before|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$out/before.json"
 if((Q $Source '--player-states').stance-ne0){I $Source B 180;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700}
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role $Source -Pitch 0 -Evidence "$out/source-camera.json"
 $hwnd=(Get-Process -Id $pids[$Source]).MainWindowHandle.ToInt64();if(!$hwnd){throw 'No source window'}
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-hard-landing-v22-v1/Build-D2Lab.ps1

[Build-D2Lab.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-hard-landing-v22-v1/Build-D2Lab.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param()
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$workspaceRoot = Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$buildDirectory = Join-Path $workspaceRoot 'work\build'
$vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
$vsRoot = & $vswhere -latest -products '*' -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath
if (-not $vsRoot) { throw 'Visual Studio C++ Build Tools are required.' }
$cmake = Join-Path $vsRoot 'Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe'
$nodeCommand = Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$nodePath = if ($nodeCommand) { $nodeCommand.Source } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $nodePath)) { throw 'Node.js is needed to normalize the build environment.' }
$cleanRunner = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling\run-clean.cjs'
& $nodePath $cleanRunner $cmake -S $PSScriptRoot -B $buildDirectory -G 'Visual Studio 17 2022' -A x64
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'CMake configuration failed.' }
& $nodePath $cleanRunner $cmake --build $buildDirectory --config Release
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Build failed.' }
$bin = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'bin'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $bin -Force | Out-Null
foreach ($file in 'dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe','d2_proxy_smoke.exe','d2_steam_probe.exe') {
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-hard-landing-v22-v1/build_hard_landing_bank_v1.py

[build_hard_landing_bank_v1.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-hard-landing-v22-v1/build_hard_landing_bank_v1.py>)

````text
"""Complete-body non-damaging CatFall recovery; native scene owns its timing."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['mixamo-retarget-manifest-v5.json'],'hard-landing-sources-v1')
OUT=P/'hard-landing-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
def donor_time(t):
 if t<.18:return .17+(.45-.17)*t/.18
 if t<.26:return .45+(1.-.45)*(t-.18)/.08
 return 1.+(.8)*(t-.26)/.74
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'double-jump-banks-v1'/f'{role}-double-jump-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE21'and count==179
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE22',22,n,181,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28
 m,donor=L.load(role,'mixamo_hard_landing');assert m['frames']==61 and m['fps']==30
 rig=rig_for(role);hand=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
````

````text
"""Append direct crouched CatFall recovery; preserve all standing landing clips."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library([],'hard-landing-crouch-sources-v1');OUT=P/'hard-landing-crouch-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'hard-landing-banks-v1'/f'{role}-hard-landing-bank.bin').read_bytes();magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE22'and count==181
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE23',23,n,183,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28;rig=rig_for(role);clips=[]
 for unarmed in (False,True):
  cid=181+int(unarmed);source=179+int(unarmed);restId=76 if unarmed else 17
  rest=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+restId*entry+24+j*28))for j in range(n)]
  donor=[[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+source*entry+24+(f*n+j)*28))for j in range(n)]for f in range(120)]
  def authored(t):
   # Native crouch requests can end CatFall near .6 of its nominal clock.
   # Finish low before that boundary, while preserving initial compression.
   pose=blend(sample(donor,t),rest,ease((t-.24)/.32));preview_helpers(rig,pose)
   return pose
  poses=[authored(f/119)for f in range(120)];poses.append(poses[0]);bank.extend(struct.pack('<IIIIff',cid,121,0,0,0.,1.))
````

````text
p='\n'.join(line for line in p.splitlines() if 'publishHeartMechanism' not in line)
p=p.replace('rangedPropDefinition(3)','rangedPropDefinition(4)').replace('p.kind=3','p.kind=4')
p=p.replace('if(!heartPropIdleCalibration(localRole?1u:2u,offset,axis)){refuse("calibration_missing");return;}', '''{
            std::array<float,12> qts{};std::copy(heartHandTracks[localRole?0:1][0][0],heartHandTracks[localRole?0:1][0][0]+7,qts.begin());qts[8]=qts[9]=qts[10]=1;
            BodyMatrix m{};if(!bodyFromQts(qts,m)){refuse("calibration_missing");return;}
            for(unsigned r=0;r<3;++r){offset[r]=m.v[12+r];for(unsigned c=0;c<3;++c)axis[c*3+r]=m.v[c*4+r];}
        }''')
a=p.index('    AcquireSRWLockShared(&heartMechanismLock);');b=p.rfind('\n',a,p.index('testFixtureOnly',a))+1
p=p[:a]+p[b:]
p=p.replace('fprintf(f,"\\"testFixtureOnly', 'fprintf(f,"{\\"testFixtureOnly')
(S/'heart_prop.h').write_text(p+'\n')
q=S/'ranged_prop.h';s=q.read_text().replace('    if(kind==3)return "models/weapons/d2coop/grenade_prop.def";','    if(kind==3)return "models/weapons/d2coop/grenade_prop.def";\n    if(kind==4)return "models/weapons/d2coop/heart_prop.def";');q.write_text(s)
q=S/'engine_bridge.cpp';s=q.read_text().replace('#include "grenade_prop.h"','#include "grenade_prop.h"\n#include "heart_prop.h"').replace('serviceGrenadeProp(tick);','serviceGrenadeProp(tick);serviceHeartProp(tick);').replace('writeGrenadeProp();','writeGrenadeProp();writeHeartProp();');q.write_text(s)
````
