````text
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src';W=R/'work/movement-integration';B=W/'heart-binding-pre-v564';B.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
files=['native_player_states.h','shadow_stream.h','shadow_action_protocol.h','movement_semantics.h','movement_bank.h','movement_playback.h','ranged_prop.h','engine_bridge.cpp']
for name in files:shutil.copy2(S/name,B/name)
def edit(name,fn):
 p=S/name;p.write_text(fn(p.read_text()))
predicate='''inline bool nativePlayerGroundHeartStates(const NativePlayerStates& s,std::uintptr_t base){
    if(s.player.logic!=1||!s.defaultMode||s.player.current>1||s.active.empty()||s.active.size()>4)return false;
    unsigned ground=0,heart=0,right=0,left=0,draw=0;
    for(const auto& a:s.active){
        if((s.player.current==0&&a.id==0&&a.vtable==base+0x1c85628)||(s.player.current==1&&a.id==6&&a.vtable==base+0x1c84258))++ground;
        else if(a.id==67&&a.vtable==base+0x1c80b78)++heart;
        else if(a.id==53&&a.vtable==base+0x1c79cf8)++right;
        else if(a.id==64&&a.vtable==base+0x1c79cf8)++left;
        else if(a.id==81&&a.vtable==base+0x1c7df88)++draw;
        else return false;
    }
    return ground==1&&heart==1&&right<=1&&left<=1&&draw<=1;
}
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-high-mantle-v20-v2/index_high_mantle_v20.py

[index_high_mantle_v20.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-high-mantle-v20-v2/index_high_mantle_v20.py>)

````text
"""Index real native high-climb takes without claiming general traversal coverage."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
digest='9393D00E68310D25D1E185BDA46B32F76EDC112189E4863D26B86E43B458B4E9'
archive=P.parent/'movement-integration/candidate-high-mantle-v20-v2'
assert sha(archive/'dinput8.dll')==digest
rows=read(P/'runtime-video-manifest.json');tests=[];checks=0
for role,source in [('corvo','host'),('emily','client')]:
 for crouched in [False,True]:
  take=f'high-mantle-{role}'+('-crouched'if crouched else'')+'-v20-lit-v1'
  result=read(P/take/'result.json')
  assert result['passed'] and result['dll']==digest and result['sources']==[source]
  assert result['high'] and result['bankVersion']==20 and result['recorded'] and result['crouched']==crouched
  tests.append(take);checks+=len(result['checks'])
  for name in ['contact-armed.jpg','contact-empty.jpg']:assert(P/take/name).is_file()
  video=P/f'{take}.mp4'
  cap=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-select_streams','v:0','-show_entries','stream=nb_frames,duration,avg_frame_rate,width,height','-of','json',str(video)]))['streams'][0]
````

````text
 data=(P/'hard-landing-crouch-banks-v1'/f'{role}-hard-landing-crouch-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE23'and count==183
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE24',24,n,193,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28;rig=rig_for(role)
 mi,enter=L.load(role,'empty_distraction_look_keyhole_in');ml,loop=L.load(role,'empty_distraction_look_keyhole_loop');mo,leave=L.load(role,'empty_distraction_look_keyhole_out')
 rests={i:[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+i*entry+24+j*28))for j in range(n)]for i in (59,76)}
 lookup={j['nativeName']:i for i,j in enumerate(rig.joints)};pairs=[]
 for j in rig.joints:

  pairs.append(lookup.get(other,lookup[name]))
 reflection=Matrix.Diagonal((1,-1,1));clips=[]
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-keyhole-v24-v5/build_keyhole_bank_v2.py

[build_keyhole_bank_v2.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-keyhole-v24-v5/build_keyhole_bank_v2.py>)

````text
"""Native full-body NPC donor adapted to observed player keyhole phases."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['interaction-retarget-manifest.json','campaign-retarget-manifest.json'],'keyhole-sources-v2')
OUT=P/'keyhole-banks-v2';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'hard-landing-crouch-banks-v1'/f'{role}-hard-landing-crouch-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE23'and count==183
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE24',24,n,193,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28;rig=rig_for(role)
 mi,enter=L.load(role,'empty_distraction_look_keyhole_in');ml,loop=L.load(role,'empty_distraction_look_keyhole_loop');mo,leave=L.load(role,'empty_distraction_look_keyhole_out')
 rests={i:[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+i*entry+24+j*28))for j in range(n)]for i in (59,76)}
 # The NPC donor starts/ends standing. Reusing that middle segment for a
 # crouched player caused a visible stand-up dip in actual v24-v4 video.
 # Use only its low kneeling preparation/recovery for crouched variants.
 ceiling=max(rests[76][2].translation.z,loop[0][2].translation.z)+.02
 in_cut=next(i for i,f in enumerate(enter)if i>len(enter)//4 and f[2].translation.z<=ceiling)/(len(enter)-1)
 out_cut=next(i for i,f in enumerate(leave)if f[2].translation.z>ceiling)/(len(leave)-1)
````

````text
 for a,b in changes:
  assert a in s,(name,a);s=s.replace(a,b)
 p.write_text(s)
edit('combat_presentation.h',[
 ('return v>=15?48+v-15:', 'return v==17?353:v>=15?48+v-15:'),
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-knee-pole-v19-v4/verify_knee_pole.py

[verify_knee_pole.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-knee-pole-v19-v4/verify_knee_pole.py>)

````text
"""Check actual D2 publication before/after the authored knee-plane correction.

Phase2 is the native terrain solution; phase3 is the final corrected skeleton.
This does not replace the existing flat-ground ankle or visual acceptance test.
"""
import argparse,json,math
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('folder',type=Path);p.add_argument('--min-poses',type=int,default=5);a=p.parse_args()
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
dot=lambda a,b:sum(x*y for x,y in zip(a,b))
sub=lambda a,b:[x-y for x,y in zip(a,b)]
norm=lambda a:math.sqrt(dot(a,a))
def pole_error(ref,actual,hip):
 axis=sub(actual[hip+2][12:15],actual[hip][12:15]);axis=[x/norm(axis)for x in axis]
 out=[]
 for poses in (ref,actual):
  knee=sub(poses[hip+1][12:15],poses[hip][12:15]);d=dot(knee,axis);v=[x-d*y for x,y in zip(knee,axis)];n=norm(v)
  if n<.005:return None
  out.append([x/n for x in v])
 return math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1,min(1,dot(*out)))))
````

````text
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;O=P/'lethal-banks-v604';O.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
rd=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 old=(P/'choke-breakout-banks-v592'/f'{role}-choke-bank.bin').read_bytes();magic,v,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',old);assert(magic,v,count)==(b'D2MOVE64',64,352)
 p=P/'paired-native-v1'/f'paired_fast_back_tall-{role}.bin';m=rd(p.with_suffix('.json'));raw=p.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==m['sha256'];assert(m['joints'],m['layout_hash'])==(n,layout);assert not m['root_writes'] and not m['events'] and not m['first_person_constraints']
 a=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<f4',offset=28).reshape(m['frames'],n,7).astype(float);at=np.linspace(0,len(a)-1,120);lo=at.astype(int);hi=np.minimum(lo+1,len(a)-1);t=(at-lo)[:,None,None];x=a[lo].copy();y=a[hi].copy();y[...,:4]*=np.where(np.sum(x[...,:4]*y[...,:4],axis=-1,keepdims=True)<0,-1,1);q=x+(y-x)*t;q[...,:4]/=np.linalg.norm(q[...,:4],axis=-1,keepdims=True);q=q.astype('<f4')
 assert np.isfinite(q).all() and np.max(np.abs(q[:,:2]-[0,0,0,1,0,0,0]))<1e-6
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE65',65,n,353,fps,layout)+old[32:]);bank.extend(struct.pack('<IIIIff',352,121,0,0,0,1.333));bank.extend(q.tobytes());bank.extend(q[0].tobytes());assert bank[32:len(old)]==old[32:]
 out=O/f'{role}-choke-bank.bin';out.write_bytes(bank);reports.append(dict(role=role,bank=str(out.relative_to(P)),sha256=hashlib.sha256(bank).hexdigest().upper(),version=65,clips=353,prior352PayloadsUnchanged=True,variant=5,nativeScene='assassination_fast_back.midnightscene/Npc/1333',source=str(p.relative_to(P)),sourceSha256=m['sha256'],sourceDuration=m['duration'],conversion='Existing native Doppelganger paired actor donor;120 samples plus guard. Network root retained; source root track and all events excluded. Native player clock1333ms.',root_writes=False,events=False,runtime_verified=False,visual_accepted=False,complete=False))
````

````text
"""Reuse paired actor channel for exact native596 fast rear assassination."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];W=R/'work/movement-integration';S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src';B=W/'lethal-pre-v604';B.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
def edit(name, pairs):
 p=S/name;shutil.copy2(p,B/name);s=p.read_text()
 for a,b in pairs:assert a in s,(name,a);s=s.replace(a,b)
 p.write_text(s)
edit('choke_presentation.h',[
 ('// Presentation only: observed native rear-choke phases, no victim events.','// Legacy choke field names carry paired actor presentation only.\n// Variants1-4: rear choke;5: native fast-back lethal. Never replay victim events.'),
 ('0,600,1400,1800,1500};return v<=4','0,600,1400,1800,1500,1333};return v<=5'),('s.variant<=4','s.variant<=5')])
edit('native_player_states.h',[
 ('inline bool nativePlayerMotion(','''// Native596 on both roles: exclusive Assassination13, standing0/default mode.
inline bool nativePlayerGroundAssassinationStates(const NativePlayerStates& s,std::uintptr_t base){
    return s.player.logic==1&&s.defaultMode&&s.player.current==0&&s.active.size()==1&&
        s.active[0].id==13&&s.active[0].vtable==base+0x1c83468;
}
inline bool nativePlayerGroundPairedStates(const NativePlayerStates& s,std::uintptr_t base){
    return nativePlayerGroundChokeStates(s,base)||nativePlayerGroundAssassinationStates(s,base);
}
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=12,[ValidateSet('entry','release')][string]$AirCase='entry')
$Stance='standing';$Holstered=$false;$Move=0
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$targetMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --mesmerize-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_mesmerize_visual off','coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $linksBefore=S host '.mesmerize-links.json';$linksBefore|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6|Set-Content "$out/links-before.json"
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-mesmerize-crouch-v133/build_mesmerize_contexts_v132.py

[build_mesmerize_contexts_v132.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-mesmerize-crouch-v133/build_mesmerize_contexts_v132.py>)

````text
"""Whole-body Mesmerize stance candidates, preserving the v77 standing payload.

The first-person source supplies phase timing, not fixed body-space wrists.
New contexts remain offline candidates until their native runtime cases pass.
"""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['mesmerize-bank-source-manifest-v77.json'],'mesmerize-contexts-v132')
OUT=P/'mesmerize-context-banks-v132';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'mesmerize-banks-v77'/f'{role}-mesmerize-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data)
 assert magic==b'D2MOVE45'and version==45 and count==276
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE46',46,n,285,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28
 rig=rig_for(role);_,initial=L.load(role,'native_mesmerize_in');reference=initial[0];refG=rig.fk(reference);right=[];clips=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-mesmerize-empty-air-v178/prepare_mesmerize_empty_air_network_v178.py

[prepare_mesmerize_empty_air_network_v178.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-mesmerize-empty-air-v178/prepare_mesmerize_empty_air_network_v178.py>)

````text
"""Add native-observed holstered air cases to the unchanged recovery harness."""
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];P=R/'work/natural-moveset'
s=(P/'Test-MesmerizeAirNetwork-v170.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
a="[string]$AirCase='entry')\n$Stance='standing';$Holstered=$false;$Move=0"
assert s.count(a)==1
s=s.replace(a,"[string]$AirCase='entry',[switch]$Holstered)\n$Stance='standing';$Move=0")
s=s.replace('Armed native Emily Mesmerize air entry or air release drives whole-body cast and air locomotion through Steam.', 'Native Emily Mesmerize air entry or air release drives whole-body cast and air locomotion through Steam; the holstered field distinguishes empty-hand and sword contexts.')
(P/'Test-MesmerizeAirNetwork-v178.ps1').write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
runner=R/'work/movement-integration/Invoke-NativeLabOperation.ps1';s=runner.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
a='Test-MesmerizeAirNetwork-v170.ps1" -Take $Take -Pitch $Pitch -AirCase $AirCase'
assert s.count(a)==1
runner.write_text(s.replace(a,'Test-MesmerizeAirNetwork-v178.ps1" -Take $Take -Pitch $Pitch -AirCase $AirCase -Holstered:$Holstered'),encoding='utf-8')
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-mesmerize-network-v73/build_mesmerize_bank_v73.py

[build_mesmerize_bank_v73.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-mesmerize-network-v73/build_mesmerize_bank_v73.py>)

````text
"""Append native-clock Mesmerize body acting; no gameplay/FX or root tracks."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['power-retarget-manifest-v1.json'],'mesmerize-sources-v73')
OUT=P/'mesmerize-banks-v73';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'crouched-grenade-banks-v62'/f'{role}-crouched-grenade-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE44'and count==273
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE45',45,n,276,fps,layout)+data[32:])
 rig=rig_for(role);grip=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+24+j*28))for j in range(n)];fingers=[];sources=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
  while k>=0 and k!=16:k=rig.joints[k]['parent']
  if k==16 and j!=16 and 'helper'not in rig.joints[j]['nativeName']:fingers.append(j)
 for offset,(phase,duration)in enumerate([('in',466),('loop',1200),('out',666)]):
  m,fs=L.load(role,'power_mesmerize_fire_'+phase);poses=[]
  for f in range(120):
   pose=sample(fs,f/119)
````

````text
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --mesmerize-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}

 foreach($r in 'host','client'){

  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
````
````text
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_mesmerize_visual off','coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
````

````text
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --mesmerize-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_mesmerize_visual off','coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $visualBefore=S host '.mesmerize-visual.json';$worldBefore=S host '.mesmerize-world-stream.json'
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-mesmerize-visual-v76/Build-D2MesmerizeVisualAssets.ps1

[Build-D2MesmerizeVisualAssets.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-mesmerize-visual-v76/Build-D2MesmerizeVisualAssets.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/mesmerize-visual-v76-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/mesmerize-visual-v76-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
"""Reproducible native cosmetic FX/material derivatives; does not install them."""
from pathlib import Path
import copy,hashlib,json
from inspect_midnight_events import parse,walk
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab';A=L/'assets'
def arr(xs):return {'num':len(xs),**{f'item[{i}]':x for i,x in enumerate(xs)}}
def items(d):return [d[f'item[{i}]']for i in range(d['num'])]
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
def emit(o,n=0):
 if isinstance(o,dict):return '{\n'+''.join('\t'*(n+1)+k+' = '+emit(v,n+1)+(';'if not isinstance(v,dict)else'')+'\n'for k,v in o.items())+'\t'*n+'}'
 if isinstance(o,str):return o if o in ('true','false','NULL')else json.dumps(o)
 return str(o)
manifest=[]
def write(d,path,resource,kind,classname,source,**details):
 text=emit(d)+'\n';assert parse(text)==d
 path.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
 manifest.append(dict(resource=resource,generated=str(path),sha256=sha(path),source=str(source),source_sha256=sha(source),kind=kind,classname=classname,runtime_verified=False,**details))
for phase in ('spawn','despawn'):
 src=L/f'research/asset-exports/native-doppelganger-fx-v436/game1_patch/generated.decls.fx.models.effects.gameplay.powers.doppelganger.decoy.spawn_despawn.decoy_{phase}_01..fx.decl'
 original=parse(src.read_text());d=copy.deepcopy(original);removed=[]
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
````

````text
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v700.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')

for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Bounded engine-thread service and diagnostic-file timing only. No gameplay, networking, identity, freshness, animation or bank changes.693 crouched loot retained.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````

````text
"""Preserve v46 harness and create v48 paired effect assertions."""

def replace(a,b):

 s=s.replace(a,b)

replace("stream=(S client '.shadow-stream.json')", "stream=(S client '.shadow-stream.json');fx=(S client '.power-fx.json')")
replace("$fxAfter=S client '.power-fx.json';if($fxAfter.started-ne$fxBefore.started-or$fxAfter.active){throw 'Failure created unsolicited observer effect'}", """$fxAfter=S client '.power-fx.json'
 $failureFx=@($rows|ForEach-Object {$_.fx.effects}|Where-Object kind -eq 11)
 $ids=@($failureFx|Select-Object -ExpandProperty id -Unique)
 if($fxAfter.started-ne($fxBefore.started+2)-or$fxAfter.active-or$ids.Count-ne2-or$fxAfter.handUpdates-le$fxBefore.handUpdates){throw 'Expected exactly two finite native hand effects'}
 if(@($failureFx|Where-Object {$_.owner-ne$avatar-or$_.record-eq'0x0'}).Count){throw 'Failure FX ownership mismatch'}
 if(@($rows|Where-Object {$_.ms-lt$events[2].ms-and$_.fx.started-ne$fxBefore.started}).Count){throw 'Successful cast triggered failure FX'}
 $checks.Add('Exactly one finite owned native hand effect per failed scene, with no effect on successful casts and no replay')""")
replace("Remote failure recovers to original stance with original sword, health and no observer screen effect", "Remote failure recovers to original stance with original sword and health; both owned hand effects finish")
replace("Native time dilation remains source-local; no remote power activation or animation damage.", "Two source-confirmed failures trigger two native world hand effects at delayed presentation time. Wrist-centred placement; native time remains source-local and no remote power activation or animation damage occurs.")
dest=P/'Test-OutOfManaFx.ps1';assert not dest.exists();dest.write_text(s)
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-authority-v837'; P=W/'candidate-usable-sync-v831'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v837.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcAuthority-v837.ps1','Deploy-NpcAuthority-v837.ps1','stage_npc_authority_v837.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Preserves831 shared windows and821 pickup families. Adds general authored-NPC identity and component-generation binding, generic client-side decision/reflex owned pause leases and opt-in 12-second batch ownership proof. No new root/body/combat transport. Runtime verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v850'; P=W/'candidate-npc-stream-v847'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v850.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcCombat-v850.ps1','Deploy-NpcCombat-v850.ps1','stage_npc_combat_v850.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Experimental generic NPC ordinary sword authority: client request, host native outcome ordering, repeated nonfatal native damage, per-actor incarnation and session nonces, deduplication. Unsupported or fatal damage stops this bounded adapter. Native pose/checkpoint lifecycle847 retained. Runtime combat verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v855'; P=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v852'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v855.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcCombat-v855.ps1','Deploy-NpcCombat-v855.ps1','stage_npc_combat_v855.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Experimental generic NPC ordinary sword authority: client request, host native outcome ordering, repeated nonfatal native damage, per-actor incarnation and session nonces, deduplication. Unsupported or fatal damage stops this bounded adapter. Native pose/checkpoint lifecycle847 retained. Runtime combat verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v860'; P=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v857'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v860.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcCombat-v860.ps1','Deploy-NpcCombat-v860.ps1','stage_npc_combat_v860.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Experimental generic NPC ordinary sword authority: client request, host native outcome ordering, repeated nonfatal native damage, per-actor incarnation and session nonces, deduplication. Unsupported or fatal damage stops this bounded adapter. Native pose/checkpoint lifecycle847 retained. Runtime combat verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v865'; P=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v863'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v865.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcCombat-v865.ps1','Deploy-NpcCombat-v865.ps1','stage_npc_combat_v865.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Experimental generic NPC ordinary sword authority: client request, host native outcome ordering, repeated nonfatal native damage, per-actor incarnation and session nonces, deduplication. Unsupported or fatal damage stops this bounded adapter. Native pose/checkpoint lifecycle847 retained. Runtime combat verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v871'; P=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v869'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v871.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcCombat-v871.ps1','Deploy-NpcCombat-v871.ps1','stage_npc_combat_v871.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Experimental native melee and terminal outcome authority: client request, host native outcome ordering, ordinary sword, generic fatality and assassination damage, per-actor incarnation and session nonces, deduplication. Native pose/AI references retire before death; scoped terminal tombstones reject duplicate damage. Runtime lethal verification pending. Native pose/checkpoint lifecycle847 retained. Runtime combat verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
````

````text
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v884'; P=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v879'

assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v884.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcCombat-v884.ps1','Deploy-NpcCombat-v884.ps1','stage_npc_combat_v884.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Experimental native melee and terminal outcome authority: client request, host native outcome ordering, ordinary sword, generic fatality and assassination damage, per-actor incarnation and session nonces, deduplication. Native pose/AI references retire before death; scoped terminal tombstones reject duplicate damage. Runtime lethal verification pending. Extends native fixed-slot checkpoint retry permission through pre-cache save-I/O deferral observed878; runtime verification pending. Adds bounded packet diagnostics for post-reload combat negotiation failure882; no protocol or acceptance change.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v891'; P=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v889'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v891.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcCombat-v891.ps1','Deploy-NpcCombat-v891.ps1','stage_npc_combat_v891.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Experimental native melee and terminal outcome authority: client request, host native outcome ordering, ordinary sword, generic fatality and assassination damage, per-actor incarnation and session nonces, deduplication. Native pose/AI references retire before death; scoped terminal tombstones reject duplicate damage. Runtime lethal verification pending. Extends native fixed-slot checkpoint retry permission through pre-cache save-I/O deferral observed878; runtime verification pending. Retains native AI and combat bindings through skeletal packet gaps while reliable heartbeats and exact native ownership stay current. Old render data still expires. Records a bounded failing native joint transform/root and adds source pose rejection diagnostics and explicit failure on uncommitted actor retirement. Runtime verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v896'; P=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v894'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v896.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcCombat-v896.ps1','Deploy-NpcCombat-v896.ps1','stage_npc_combat_v896.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Experimental native melee and terminal outcome authority: client request, host native outcome ordering, ordinary sword, generic fatality and assassination damage, per-actor incarnation and session nonces, deduplication. Native pose/AI references retire before death; scoped terminal tombstones reject duplicate damage. Runtime lethal verification pending. Extends native fixed-slot checkpoint retry permission through pre-cache save-I/O deferral observed878; runtime verification pending. Retains native AI and combat bindings through skeletal packet gaps while reliable heartbeats and exact native ownership stay current. Old render data still expires. Releases finite test source-frame ownership on verified native host ground-assassination state13 while retaining AI leases. Adds an explicit finite AI-only fixture without reference-frame holds to compare native finisher root motion. Records a bounded failing native joint transform/root and adds source pose rejection diagnostics and explicit failure on uncommitted actor retirement. Runtime verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v907'; P=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v905'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v907.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcCombat-v907.ps1','Deploy-NpcCombat-v907.ps1','stage_npc_combat_v907.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Adds a bounded per-actor FIFO for compound native client damage contacts, preserving pending request order until acknowledgement instead of dropping the second contact. Adds native evaluated-health subtraction ownership hook, floating-point damage conservation, and nested native damage capture. Experimental native melee and terminal outcome authority: client request, host native outcome ordering, ordinary sword, generic fatality and assassination damage, per-actor incarnation and session nonces, deduplication. Native pose/AI references retire before death; scoped terminal tombstones reject duplicate damage. Runtime lethal verification pending. Extends native fixed-slot checkpoint retry permission through pre-cache save-I/O deferral observed878; runtime verification pending. Retains native AI and combat bindings through skeletal packet gaps while reliable heartbeats and exact native ownership stay current. Old render data still expires. Releases finite test source-frame ownership on verified native host ground-assassination state13 while retaining AI leases. Adds an explicit finite AI-only fixture without reference-frame holds to compare native finisher root motion. Records a bounded failing native joint transform/root and adds source pose rejection diagnostics and explicit failure on uncommitted actor retirement. Runtime verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v915'; P=W/'candidate-npc-combat-v911'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v915.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcCombat-v915.ps1','Deploy-NpcCombat-v915.ps1','stage_npc_combat_v915.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Suppresses client-owned replica world callbacks for bound host-authoritative NPC victims unless an exact current native local-player source is attributable; local player requests retain profile validation. Adds host-owned corpse collision outcomes with native NPC source-arm mapping and replica duplicate-world suppression; combat wire3/232bytes, bounded source-death ordering wait, zero harmless corpse results. Runtime verification pending. Adds a bounded per-actor FIFO for compound native client damage contacts, preserving pending request order until acknowledgement instead of dropping the second contact. Adds native evaluated-health subtraction ownership hook, floating-point damage conservation, and nested native damage capture. Experimental native melee and terminal outcome authority: client request, host native outcome ordering, ordinary sword, generic fatality and assassination damage, per-actor incarnation and session nonces, deduplication. Native pose/AI references retire before death; scoped terminal tombstones reject duplicate damage. Runtime lethal verification pending. Extends native fixed-slot checkpoint retry permission through pre-cache save-I/O deferral observed878; runtime verification pending. Retains native AI and combat bindings through skeletal packet gaps while reliable heartbeats and exact native ownership stay current. Old render data still expires. Releases finite test source-frame ownership on verified native host ground-assassination state13 while retaining AI leases. Adds an explicit finite AI-only fixture without reference-frame holds to compare native finisher root motion. Records a bounded failing native joint transform/root and adds source pose rejection diagnostics and explicit failure on uncommitted actor retirement. Runtime verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````

````text
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Callback-time native source snapshots for bounded NPC damage capture; ranged test fixture can use existing native combat ownership instead of unsafe independent movement AI holds. from pathlib import Path
````
````text
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-npc-stream-v842'; P=W/'candidate-npc-stream-v840'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v842.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-NpcStream-v842.ps1','Deploy-NpcStream-v842.ps1','stage_npc_stream_v842.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Extends840 multi-NPC root/body authority with protocol2 compact14byte native joints (3312byte224-joint packet), per-connection native Steam512KiB/s budget and queue/decode diagnostics. Preserves full rig,80ms source-timed root/body interpolation, native local first person and owned client AI. General combat/outcomes, spawn/checkpoint lifecycle and runtime verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
"""Sample exact installed out-of-mana references; no game-process writes."""
import json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;R=P.parent.parent
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
native=read(R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports/native-outofmana-v45/manifest.json')
prior=read(R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports/natural-power-reference/manifest.json')
sk=next(r for r in prior['Resources'] if r['Name'].endswith('.md6skl'))
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(sk['ExportFile']).read_bytes()).hexdigest().lower()==sk['Sha256'].lower()
out=P/'outofmana-reference-v45';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True);rows=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 r=next(r for r in native['Resources'] if f'/{role}/leftarm/ply_leftarm_power_outofmana.md6anim' in r['Name'])
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(r['ExportFile']).read_bytes()).hexdigest().lower()==r['Sha256'].lower()
 target=out/(role+'.edgepose')
 run=subprocess.run([str(P/'build/Release/d2_sample_edge.exe'),'C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Dishonored2/Dishonored2.exe',r['ExportFile'],sk['ExportFile'],str(target)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
 assert run.returncode==0,run.stdout+run.stderr
 rows.append(dict(role=role,asset=r['Name'],asset_sha256=r['Sha256'],sample=str(target.relative_to(P)),sample_sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),sampling=json.loads(run.stdout),skeleton=sk['Name'],skeleton_sha256=sk['Sha256']))
(P/'outofmana-reference-manifest-v45.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(scope='Native 333 ms scene timing and finger reference only; no first-person wrist constraints. Shared native left-arm reference skeleton, as in the prior power-reference sampler.',rows=rows),indent=2))
print('OUTOFMANA_REFERENCES',len(rows))
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-outofmana-v45/Trace-BendTimePresentation.ps1

````text
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(1000,15000)][int]$DurationMs=10800)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!(Test-Path "$out/result.json")-and(Test-Path $out)){
 $rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$w=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
 while($w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt$DurationMs){
  try{
   $m=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/client/coop-status.json.movement.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
   $s=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/host/coop-status.json.shadow-stream.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
   $r=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/client/coop-status.json.shadow-stream.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
   $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{utcMs=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();ms=$w.ElapsedMilliseconds;active=$m.active;event=$m.powerEvent;variant=$m.powerVariant;amount=$m.powerAmount;weight=$m.powerWeight;applied=$m.applied;sourceEvent=$s.sourceEvent;sourceState=$s.sourceState;sourceToken=$s.token;targetToken=$r.token;remoteEvent=$r.remoteEvent;ready=$r.ready;epoch=$r.epoch;peerEpoch=$r.peerEpoch})
  }catch{}
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20
 }
 $rows|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content "$out/presentation-trace.json"
 "PRESENTATION_TRACE $($rows.Count) samples"
}else{throw 'Existing or missing take; trace refused'}
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil,struct,datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];W=R/'work/movement-integration';L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab';A=W/'candidate-partner-assassination-v387';assert not A.exists()
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
exe=R/'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe';assert sha(exe)=='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
b=exe.read_bytes();pe=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,0x3c)[0];n=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,pe+6)[0];opt=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,pe+20)[0];rva=0x3b00a0;found=[]
for i in range(n):
 p=pe+24+opt+i*40;size,va,raw_size,raw=struct.unpack_from('<IIII',b,p+8)
 if va<=rva and rva+16<=va+raw_size:found.append(raw+rva-va)
assert len(found)==1;prologue=b[found[0]:found[0]+16];assert prologue==bytes.fromhex('4053574883ec38488bfa488bd94885d2')
logs=[W/f'partner-assassination-{k}-v387.log' for k in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke')]
for p in logs:
 t=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');assert t and not any(s in t for s in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL:','FAIL ','Traceback')),p
A.mkdir();shutil.copytree(L/'src',A/'src');shutil.copytree(W/'candidate-possession-partner-v374/banks',A/'banks')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for p in [Path(__file__),*logs,W/'Build-PartnerAssassination-v387.ps1',R/'work/natural-moveset/Observe-PartnerChoke-v386.ps1']:shutil.copy2(p,A/p.name)
x=json.loads((W/'candidate-possession-partner-v374/identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
x.update(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),runtimeVerified=False,banks=[dict(path=str(p),sha256=sha(p)) for p in sorted((A/'banks').glob('*.bin'))],scope='Candidate387 rejects current partner at native assassination eligibility3b00a0 after reciprocal local PlayerStates context and current registered partner proof. All other NPC calls forwarded unchanged. Bank54/319 and Possession374 unchanged. Native movement collision intentionally unchanged per user. Static tests passed; runtime pending.')
x.pop('runtimeVerificationScope',None)
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-possession-draw-v366/Test-PossessionDrawNetwork-v364.ps1

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=30,[ValidateSet('standing','crouched')][string]$Stance='standing')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $dirty=$true
 C host 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C client 'setviewpos -44.39 -153.27 68.1 203 0';
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role client -Pitch -3 -Evidence "$out/observer-camera.json" -Quick
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=30,[ValidateSet('standing','crouched')][string]$Stance='standing')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash

function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $dirty=$true
 C host 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C client 'setviewpos -44.39 -153.27 68.1 203 0';
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role client -Pitch -3 -Evidence "$out/observer-camera.json" -Quick
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-possession-fixture-v321/prepare_possession_fixture_v321.py

[prepare_possession_fixture_v321.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-possession-fixture-v321/prepare_possession_fixture_v321.py>)

````text
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src';W=R/'work/movement-integration';P=R/'work/natural-moveset'
def change(p,old,new):
 s=p.read_text();assert s.count(old)==1,(p,old[:90],s.count(old));p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
# Reuse the structurally verified power equipment contract, with exact new RTTI/assets.
p=S/'native_player_possession_item.h';assert not p.exists()
s=(S/'native_player_swarm_item.h').read_text().replace('Swarm','Possession').replace('swarm','possession').replace('devouring_possession','possession').replace('1b51f28','1b531c8').replace('1b51de8','1b53088')
s=s.replace('components/characters/player/base/powers/possession/power.cpntpowerdevouringswarm','components/characters/player/base/powers/possession/possession.cpntpowerpossession')
# The general replacement changes the cpnt name to devouringpossession.
s=s.replace('components/characters/player/base/powers/possession/power.cpntpowerdevouringpossession','components/characters/player/base/powers/possession/possession.cpntpowerpossession')
s=s.replace('// Static v265 exact PE RTTI:', '// Static v320 exact PE RTTI:')
s=s.replace('    if(selectedOnly&&!inv.slots[1])return false;', '''    if(selectedOnly&&(inv.slots[1]<inv.items||inv.slots[1]>=inv.items+inv.itemCount*56||(inv.slots[1]-inv.items)%56))return false;''')
assert 'components/characters/player/base/powers/possession/possession.cpntpowerpossession' in s and 'devouring' not in s
p.write_text(s)
````

````text
 s=(W/f'possession-fixture-{kind}-v322.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');assert s and 'FAIL:' not in s and 'error C' not in s and 'error LNK' not in s

(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2))
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=30)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$ownedMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $dirty=$true
 C host 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role host -Pitch $Pitch -Evidence "$out/source-camera.json" -Quick
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-possession-fixture-v322/prepare_possession_scene_v322.py

[prepare_possession_scene_v322.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-possession-fixture-v322/prepare_possession_scene_v322.py>)

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src';W=R/'work/movement-integration';P=R/'work/natural-moveset'
# Preserve the raw discovery and its incomplete transitional binding sample.
t=P/'possession-empty-v321b';rows=[json.loads(x)for x in(t/'midnight.ndjson').read_text().splitlines()if x.strip()]
scenes=[s for r in rows for s in r.get('instances',[])if s.get('state')==3 and 'power_possession_cast_'in s.get('asset','')]
complete=[s for s in scenes if len(s.get('bindingsResearch',[]))==1 and all(b.get('reciprocal')for b in s['bindingsResearch'])]
summary=dict(scope='Post-run read-only interpretation of failed321b raw discovery; not a passing runtime receipt',rawActiveSamples=len(scenes),completeBindingSamples=len(complete),incomplete=[s for s in scenes if s not in complete],phases=[])
for asset in sorted({s['asset']for s in complete}):
 v=[s for s in complete if s['asset']==asset];summary['phases'].append(dict(asset=asset,samples=len(v),durationMs=sorted({s['sceneDurationMs']for s in v}),handles=sorted({s['id']for s in v}),clockMin=min(s['clockWords'][0]for s in v),clockMax=max(s['clockWords'][0]for s in v),armHandles=sorted({b['handle']for s in v for b in s['bindingsResearch']})))
(t/'read-only-analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
p=S/'native_player_possession_scene.h';assert not p.exists()
s=(S/'native_player_swarm_scene.h').read_text().replace('Swarm','Possession').replace('swarm','possession')
start=s.index('// v266');end=s.index('inline unsigned',start)
s=s[:start]+'''//321b empty-target cast: native Corvo Running0+UsePower63 owns one
//PlayerLeftArm binding. In333ms and loop200ms observed. Reject partially
//initialized/recycled scenes. Successful-target out/transfer is not admitted
//until separately observed. Read-only; no remote power or damage events.
'''+s[end:]
s=s.replace('duration==400)return 23','duration==333)return 26').replace('duration==333)return 24','duration==200)return 27')
````

````text
"""Compare independently inventoried native source/peer particle transforms.

Requires completed watcher files. Same-machine nearest samples are useful for
stationary attachment correctness, never a measurement of packet latency.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, json, math
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
arg=argparse.ArgumentParser();arg.add_argument('take');a=arg.parse_args()
p=R/'work/natural-moveset'/a.take;assert p.parent==R/'work/natural-moveset'
read=lambda n:[json.loads(l) for l in (p/n).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines() if l.strip()]
source=[(r['tick'],e) for r in read('possession-effects.ndjson') if r['valid'] for e in r['effects'] if e['name'].endswith('/possession_target_human_01.fx')]
peer=[(r['tick'],e) for r in read('peer-effects.ndjson') if r['valid'] for e in r['effects'] if e['name']=='models/effects/d2coop/possession_target_remote.fx']
assert source and peer, 'No independent paired particle samples'
rows=[]
for tick,e in peer:
    st,se=min(source,key=lambda x:abs(x[0]-tick))
    rows.append(dict(tick=tick,sourceTick=st,ageMs=tick-st,id=e['id'],owner=e['owner'],sourceId=se['id'],distance=math.dist(e['origin'],se['origin']),axisMax=max(abs(x-y) for x,y in zip(e['axis'],se['axis']))))
x=dict(samples=len(rows),maxDistance=max(x['distance'] for x in rows),maxAxisDelta=max(x['axisMax'] for x in rows),maxNearestSampleGap=max(abs(x['ageMs']) for x in rows),rows=rows,scope='Nearest same-machine native inventory sample; stationary target. This is not a transport-latency measurement or proof of NPC world authority.')
(p/'independent-transform-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2))
````

No audio.',
````text
 'possession-target-fx-side-v355':'Both temporal sheets viewed. Peer side camera is blocked by a bookshelf pillar until the late reframe; source native target halo/streaks, entry and exit are visible.19 runtime checks include19 independent peer-native FX records with the exact streamed effect ID and Corvo clone owner. Particle appearance remains unproven in this take. No audio.',
 'possession-target-fx-cancel-v358':'Both temporal sheets viewed at0.7,1,1.3,1.7,2.1,3 seconds. Peer native target halo and streaks appear at the guard head, then clear after native source cancellation. Source first-person aim/cancel remains native. This accepts the scoped stationary target-particle appearance/retirement only; independently simulated NPC alignment across movement and full Possession gameplay remain unfinished. No audio.'
}
latest='Native source aim cancellation358 passes7 checks: one remote target halo/streak effect starts and stops, normal movement stays ready, mana is unchanged, both checkpoints and protected14 restore. Both game videos visibly show the target particles and cancellation;16 independent peer transform samples are within7.43mm of the nearest source sample. This is scoped stationary cosmetic presentation only. Shared NPC control/outcomes, other host kinds, complete movement and playable co-op remain unfinished.'
for take,note in notes.items():
 t=P/take;r=json.loads((t/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));assert r['passed']
 review=dict(inspected=True,method='Viewed source and peer temporal contact sheets',evidence=['peer-sheet.jpg','source-sheet.jpg'],complete=False,visual_accepted=False,target_particles_accepted=take.endswith('cancel-v358'),notes=note)
 (t/'visual-review.json').write_text(json.dumps(review,indent=2))
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(W/'record_reviewed_possession_take.py'),take,'--label',take.rsplit('-v',1)[-1]+' target particles','--notes',latest],check=True)
archive=W/'candidate-possession-fx-probe-v355'
receipt={take:json.loads((P/take/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')) for take in notes}
receipt['targetParticlesVisualEvidence']='possession-target-fx-cancel-v358/visual-review.json';receipt['transformComparison']=json.loads((P/'possession-target-fx-cancel-v358/independent-transform-comparison.json').read_text())
(archive/'runtime-verification-v358.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))
for p in [P/'Test-PossessionFxLifecycle-v358.ps1',W/'analyze_possession_target_replication.py',Path(__file__)]:shutil.copy2(p,archive/p.name)
d=R/'documentation/handoff-2026-10-11/32-native-possession-investigation.md';s=d.read_text();assert '## Visible target particles and cancellation,354–358' not in s
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
````
````text
import datetime, hashlib, json, shutil, struct
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; N=R/'work/natural-moveset'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
exe=R/'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe'
assert sha(exe)=='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
b=exe.read_bytes(); pe=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,0x3c)[0]; count=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,pe+6)[0]; opt=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,pe+20)[0]
sections=pe+24+opt; rva=0x3c22f0; offsets=[]
for i in range(count):
 p=sections+i*40; size,va,raw_size,raw=struct.unpack_from('<IIII',b,p+8)
 if va<=rva and rva+14<=va+raw_size:offsets.append(raw+rva-va)
assert len(offsets)==1
actual=b[offsets[0]:offsets[0]+14]; expected=bytes.fromhex('48895c241844884c242088542410'); assert actual==expected
(W/'possession-partner-prologue-v374.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(executable=str(exe),sha256=sha(exe),rva=hex(rva),fileOffset=hex(offsets[0]),bytes=actual.hex(),wholeInstructions=3,length=14,confirmed=True),indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
s=(N/'Observe-PossessionPartner-v373.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
s=s.replace('$cast=$false;$cancelled=$false','$cast=$false;$released=$false')
s=s.replace("$w.Restart();$cast=", "$filterBefore=S host '.possession-partner-filter.json';if(!$filterBefore.installed){throw 'Partner filter not installed'}\n $w.Restart();$cast=")
s=s.replace('I host 255 8000','I host 255 2500').replace('Native Corvo LT held toward exact partner, cancellation before release','Native Corvo LT held toward exact partner, then normal release')
start=s.index('  if($cast-and!$cancelled-and$w.ElapsedMilliseconds-ge3600){')
end=s.index("  $cp=Q host '--object'",start)
````

````text
change('shadow_action_protocol_tests.cpp','oldDark.powerVariant=28;','oldDark.powerVariant=29;')
````
