````text
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
def change(name,old,new):
 p=S/name;s=p.read_text();assert s.count(old)==1,(name,old,s.count(old));p.write_text(s.replace(old,new),encoding='utf-8')
change('shadow_stream.h','#include "native_player_possession_scene.h"','#include "native_player_possession_scene.h"\n#include "native_player_possession_occupation.h"')
change('shadow_stream.h','    NativePlayerRangedScene ranged{};','    const bool possessionOccupied=nativeStateValid&&!stunValid&&!powerValid&&readNativeHumanPossessionOccupation(memoryRead,base,states);\n    NativePlayerRangedScene ranged{};')
change('shadow_stream.h','if(stunValid)action=16;else if(powerValid)', 'if(possessionOccupied)action=17;else if(stunValid)action=16;else if(powerValid)')
change('shadow_stream.h','(stunValid||powerValid||rangedValid||grenadeValid||carryValid||carryPreparing||nativePlayerShadowAction(states,base,action))','(possessionOccupied||stunValid||powerValid||rangedValid||grenadeValid||carryValid||carryPreparing||nativePlayerShadowAction(states,base,action))')
change('shadow_action_protocol.h','version=49,','version=50,')
change('shadow_action_protocol.h','p.version==49','p.version==50')
change('shadow_action_protocol.h','p.state<=16','p.state<=17')
change('shadow_action_protocol.h','    return stun&&grenade&&carry','    const bool possession=p.state!=17||(p.kind==1&&p.character==1&&p.role==0&&p.swordState==1&&!p.powerVariant&&!p.airStage&&!p.rangedKind&&!p.grenadeHeld&&!p.carryVariant&&!p.stunVariant&&!p.combatVariant&&!p.equipmentVariant);\n    return possession&&stun&&grenade&&carry')
change('movement_semantics.h','s.state>16','s.state>17')
change('movement_playback.h','void requestMovementEquipment(bool drawn);','void requestMovementEquipment(bool drawn);\nvoid requestPossessionBodyVisibility(bool hide);')
change('movement_playback.h','bool equipmentRequest=false,equipmentDrawn=true;','bool equipmentRequest=false,equipmentDrawn=true,possessionHidden=false;')
change('movement_playback.h','const bool semanticValid=shadowStream.movement.sample(pose.time,semantic);','const bool semanticValid=shadowStream.movement.sample(pose.time,semantic);\n        possessionHidden=semanticValid&&semantic.state==17&&p.bank.hasPossessionRelease();')
change('movement_playback.h','    if(equipmentRequest)requestMovementEquipment(equipmentDrawn);','    requestPossessionBodyVisibility(possessionHidden);\n    if(possessionHidden)requestMovementEquipment(false);\n    else if(equipmentRequest)requestMovementEquipment(equipmentDrawn);')
change('engine_bridge.cpp','#include "shadow_equipment.h"','#include "shadow_equipment.h"\n#include "possession_body_visibility.h"')
change('engine_bridge.cpp','writeAvatarSword(tick);writeShadowEquipment(tick);','writeAvatarSword(tick);writeShadowEquipment(tick);writePossessionBodyVisibility();')
change('engine_bridge.cpp','serviceShadowEquipment(tick);serviceShadowStream(tick);','serviceShadowEquipment(tick);serviceShadowStream(tick);servicePossessionBodyVisibility(tick);')
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=0)

if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$peerCapture=$null;$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$ownedMonitor=$null;$targetMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function O($r,$mode,$arg=0){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{readValid=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $preflight=Q host '--watch-possession-state' 100
 $preflight|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/probe-preflight.json"
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=0)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$ownedMonitor=$null;$targetMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function O($r,$mode,$arg=0){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{readValid=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $dirty=$true
 C host 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800
````

````text
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
````

````text
   $fresh=@((Q host '--world-npcs').npcs|Where-Object {$_.handle-eq$target.handle-and$_.spawnerName-eq$target.spawnerName-and$_.reciprocal-and$_.unique})
   if($fresh.Count-ne1){throw 'Original guard identity changed before cast'}
   $yaw=[Math]::Atan2([double]$fresh[0].position[1]+155.07,[double]$fresh[0].position[0]+48.59)*180/[Math]::PI
   C host ('setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 {0} 0' -f $yaw.ToString('F4',[Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture))
   $fresh[0]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/aim-guard-at-cast.json"
   I host 255 500;""")
s=s.replace('Native Corvo LT1800 then release at verified human target','Native Corvo LT500 then release at freshly revalidated human target')
s=s.replace("if($cast-and!$exitSent-and$w.ElapsedMilliseconds-ge7600){I host 255 120;", "if($cast-and!$exitSent-and$w.ElapsedMilliseconds-ge7600){$exitState=Q host '--player-states';if($exitState.stance-ne18-or$exitState.defaultMode){throw 'No occupied-host mode before leave-host input'};I host 255 120;")
````

````text
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
````

````text
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function O($r,$mode,$arg=0){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{readValid=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off'){C $r $cmd}
  C $r 'coop_movement_fixture 60000'
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $preflight=Q host '--watch-possession-state' 100
````

````text
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop

$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)

[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)

$consumed=$false
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-read-note-v670'; P=W/'candidate-loot-motion-v666'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v670.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-ReadNote-v670.ps1','Deploy-ReadNote-v670.ps1','stage_read_note_v670.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Native ReadNote4 with exact class VT1c61e68 joins the existing same-world movement pause/resume and finite NPC fixture policies. Gameplay readiness remains false while reading.666 standing loot behavior retained. Protocol69 and bank67/357 unchanged; runtime verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
"""Bounded first runtime Shadow Walk body candidate. No gameplay/root/events."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,struct
import numpy as np
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=P/'shadowwalk-banks-v523';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
rd=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
reports=[]
def resample(data,u):
    f=u*(len(data)-1);a=np.floor(f).astype(int);b=np.minimum(a+1,len(data)-1);t=(f-a)[:,None,None]
    x=data[a];y=data[b].copy();dot=np.sum(x[:,:,:4]*y[:,:,:4],axis=2,keepdims=True)
    y[:,:,:4]=np.where(dot<0,-y[:,:,:4],y[:,:,:4]);r=x+(y-x)*t
    r[:,:,:4]/=np.linalg.norm(r[:,:,:4],axis=2,keepdims=True)
    return r.astype('<f4')
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
    old=(P/'doppelganger-holstered-banks-v495'/f'{role}-doppelganger-holstered-bank.bin').read_bytes()
    magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',old)
    assert (magic,version,count,fps)==(b'D2MOVE57',57,331,60)
    bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE58',58,n,335,fps,layout)+old[32:]);clips=[]
    for offset,(alias,duration,end) in enumerate([('enter',1.,1.),('idle',2.8,1.),('move_forward',None,1.),('exit',1.133,.6)]):
        p=P/'shadow-body-v1'/f'shadow_walk_{alias}-{role}.bin';meta=rd(p.with_suffix('.json'));raw=p.read_bytes()
````

````text
"""Bounded first runtime Shadow Walk body candidate. No gameplay/root/events."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,struct
import numpy as np
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=P/'shadowwalk-banks-v523';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
rd=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
reports=[]
def resample(data,u):
    f=u*(len(data)-1);a=np.floor(f).astype(int);b=np.minimum(a+1,len(data)-1);t=(f-a)[:,None,None]
    x=data[a];y=data[b].copy();dot=np.sum(x[:,:,:4]*y[:,:,:4],axis=2,keepdims=True)
    y[:,:,:4]=np.where(dot<0,-y[:,:,:4],y[:,:,:4]);r=x+(y-x)*t
    r[:,:,:4]/=np.linalg.norm(r[:,:,:4],axis=2,keepdims=True)
    return r.astype('<f4')
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
    old=(P/'doppelganger-holstered-banks-v495'/f'{role}-doppelganger-holstered-bank.bin').read_bytes()
    magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',old)
    assert (magic,version,count,fps)==(b'D2MOVE57',57,331,60)
    bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE58',58,n,335,fps,layout)+old[32:]);clips=[]
    for offset,(alias,duration,end) in enumerate([('enter',1.,1.),('idle',2.8,1.),('move_forward',None,1.),('exit',1.133,.6)]):
        p=P/'shadow-body-v1'/f'shadow_walk_{alias}-{role}.bin';meta=rd(p.with_suffix('.json'));raw=p.read_bytes()
````

````text
"""Bind only v266-observed Swarm phases; keep world effects out of pose packets."""
from pathlib import Path

 p=S/name;s=p.read_text();assert old in s,(name,old[:100]);p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
s=(S/'native_player_domino_scene.h').read_text()
s=s.replace('domino','swarm').replace('Domino','Swarm')
start=s.index('// Observed');end=s.index('template<class Read>')
s=s[:start]+'''// v266: exact native standing, armed Corvo input. Body and left arm are
// reciprocal bindings; UsePower63 retires during the 1600ms release scene.
// No rat spawn, damage or animation events are executed by this reader.
inline unsigned nativeSwarmVariant(const std::string& asset,const std::string& sub,unsigned duration){
    if(sub!="Scene_1")return 0;
    const std::string prefix="midnight/gameplay/player/base/powers/power_swarm_cast_";
    if(asset==prefix+"in.midnightscene"&&duration==400)return 23;
    if(asset==prefix+"loop.midnightscene"&&duration==333)return 24;
    if(asset==prefix+"out.midnightscene"&&duration==1600)return 25;
    return 0;
}
''' +s[end:]
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-binding-v268/prepare_swarm_binding_v267.py

[prepare_swarm_binding_v267.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-binding-v268/prepare_swarm_binding_v267.py>)

````text
"""Bind only v266-observed Swarm phases; keep world effects out of pose packets."""
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];S=P/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
def edit(name,old,new):
 p=S/name;s=p.read_text();assert old in s,(name,old[:100]);p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
s=(S/'native_player_domino_scene.h').read_text()
s=s.replace('domino','swarm').replace('Domino','Swarm')
start=s.index('// Observed');end=s.index('template<class Read>')
s=s[:start]+'''// v266: exact native standing, armed Corvo input. Body and left arm are
// reciprocal bindings; UsePower63 retires during the 1600ms release scene.
// No rat spawn, damage or animation events are executed by this reader.
inline unsigned nativeSwarmVariant(const std::string& asset,const std::string& sub,unsigned duration){
    if(sub!="Scene_1")return 0;
    const std::string prefix="midnight/gameplay/player/base/powers/power_swarm_cast_";
    if(asset==prefix+"in.midnightscene"&&duration==400)return 23;
    if(asset==prefix+"loop.midnightscene"&&duration==333)return 24;
    if(asset==prefix+"out.midnightscene"&&duration==1600)return 25;
    return 0;
}
''' +s[end:]
````

````text
"""Whole-body Swarm stance candidates, preserving the v267 standing payload.

The first-person source supplies phase timing, not fixed body-space wrists.
New contexts remain offline candidates until their native runtime cases pass.
"""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['swarm-bank-source-manifest-v267.json'],'swarm-contexts-v272')
OUT=P/'swarm-context-banks-v272';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'swarm-banks-v267'/f'{role}-swarm-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data)
 assert magic==b'D2MOVE49'and version==49 and count==304
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE50',50,n,313,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28
 rig=rig_for(role);_,initial=L.load(role,'native_swarm_in');reference=initial[0];refG=rig.fk(reference);right=[];clips=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed,[ValidateRange(100,9000)][int]$ReceiptTimeoutMs=2500)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_movement_resume|coop_movement_feet|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_power_fixture|coop_darkvision_fixture|coop_windblast_fixture|coop_mesmerize_fixture|coop_domino_fixture|coop_swarm_fixture|coop_mesmerize_visual|coop_bendtime_fixture|coop_ranged_fixture|coop_grenade_fixture|coop_potion_fixture|coop_grenade_prop|coop_ranged_prop|coop_agility_fixture|coop_carry_attachment|coop_power_fx|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_domino_fixture*' -and $Command -notmatch '^coop_domino_fixture (20000|40000|off)$'){throw 'Domino fixture accepts only finite observed research durations or off.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_swarm_fixture*' -and $Command -notmatch '^coop_swarm_fixture (20000|40000|off)$'){throw 'Swarm fixture accepts only finite research durations or off.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-diagnostic-v313/Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/swarm-rat-gait-v301-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/swarm-rat-gait-v301-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
from pathlib import Path

needle='struct MovementPlayback {\n'
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,needle+'''    // Fixed-size evidence for presentation eligibility failures. No relaxed leases.
    struct EligibilityRecord {
        double now=0,poseTime=0,firstSemantic=0,lastSemantic=0;
        unsigned mask=0,state=0,motion=0,stance=0,semanticCount=0;
        ULONGLONG stateAge=0;bool motionValid=false;
    };
    std::array<EligibilityRecord,16> eligibilityRecords{};
    std::uint64_t eligibilityFailures=0,eligibilityRecordCount=0;
    unsigned eligibilityMask=0;
''')
start=s.index('        const bool eligible=semanticValid&&')
end=s.index('\n        if(p.secondJump.advance',start)
old=s[start:end]
split='&&shadowStream.until>tick&&shadowStream.peerReady&&\n            shadowStream.lastState&&tick-shadowStream.lastState<250&&'
assert split in old
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/swarm-rat-gait-v301-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/swarm-rat-gait-v301-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];N=R/'work/natural-moveset'
s=(N/'Test-SwarmNetwork-v269.ps1').read_text()
a=s.index(' $phaseCoverage=@(');b=s.index(' $continuity=@(',a)
s=s[:a]+''' $sourceStream=S host '.shadow-stream.json';$peerStream=S client '.shadow-stream.json'
 [ordered]@{source=$sourceStream;peer=$peerStream}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12|Set-Content "$out/power-event-history.json"
 $sent=@($sourceStream.powerSentHistory|Where-Object {$_.variant-in23,24,25})
 $received=@($peerStream.powerReceivedHistory|Where-Object {$_.variant-in23,24,25})
 if(!$sent.Count-or$sent.Count-ne$received.Count){throw 'Swarm sender/receiver retained event counts differ'}
 if(Compare-Object @($sent|ForEach-Object {"$($_.event):$($_.variant):$($_.durationMs)"}) @($received|ForEach-Object {"$($_.event):$($_.variant):$($_.durationMs)"})){throw 'Swarm accepted receiver events differ from sent events'}
 $phaseCoverage=@(foreach($v in 23,24,25){
  $nativeIds=@($scenes|Where-Object variant -eq $v|ForEach-Object handle|Sort-Object -Unique)
  $sourceEvents=@($sent|Where-Object variant -eq $v)
  $nativeSent=@($sourceEvents.nativeScene|Sort-Object -Unique)
  if(!$nativeIds.Count-or(Compare-Object $nativeIds $nativeSent)){throw "Phase $v strict-native scene IDs differ from actual sent scene IDs"}
  [pscustomobject]@{variant=$v;nativeHandles=$nativeIds;sourceEvents=$sourceEvents;acceptedEvents=@($received|Where-Object variant -eq $v);sampledPoseEvents=@($rows|Where-Object {$_.movement.powerVariant-eq$v-and$_.movement.powerWeight-gt.5}|ForEach-Object {$_.movement.powerEvent}|Sort-Object -Unique)}
 })
 $phaseCoverage|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/phase-incarnations.json"
 $checks.Add('Bounded send/accept histories exactly match strict native scene incarnations, including sub-status-interval final aim loops')
''' +s[b:]
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-inventory-v265/inspect_static_rtti_v265.py

[inspect_static_rtti_v265.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-inventory-v265/inspect_static_rtti_v265.py>)

````text
"""Read-only MSVC x64 RTTI table lookup from the pinned D2 PE file.

Match the type descriptor, self-referential complete object locator and pointer
to that locator. This discovers candidates, never authorizes runtime writes.
"""
import argparse,hashlib,json,struct
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
a=argparse.ArgumentParser();a.add_argument('type');a.add_argument('output');args=a.parse_args()
exe=R/'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe';data=exe.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest().upper()=='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
u16=lambda o:struct.unpack_from('<H',data,o)[0]
u32=lambda o:struct.unpack_from('<I',data,o)[0]
u64=lambda o:struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,o)[0]
pe=u32(0x3c);assert data[pe:pe+4]==b'PE\0\0';n=u16(pe+6);opt=pe+24;assert u16(opt)==0x20b;base=u64(opt+24)
sections=[]
for i in range(n):
 o=opt+u16(pe+20)+i*40
 sections.append(dict(name=data[o:o+8].rstrip(b'\0').decode(),virtualSize=u32(o+8),rva=u32(o+12),size=u32(o+16),raw=u32(o+20),flags=u32(o+36)))
def rva(offset):
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-inventory-v265/prepare_swarm_inventory_v265.py

[prepare_swarm_inventory_v265.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-inventory-v265/prepare_swarm_inventory_v265.py>)

````text
"""Strict Corvo inventory reader and finite native acquisition experiment.

Static RTTI/installed assets are known; runtime instantiated ownership remains
a candidate until recorded. No remote swarm, spawn call or damage call added.
"""
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
item='models/powers/devouring_swarm/devouring_swarm.inventoryitem'
component='components/characters/player/base/powers/devouring_swarm/power.cpntpowerdevouringswarm'
def convert(s):
 return s.replace('models/powers/phantasmallink/phantasmal_link.inventoryitem',item).replace('components/characters/player/base/powers/phantasmallink/phantasmal_link.cpntpowerphantasmallink',component).replace('Domino','Swarm').replace('domino','swarm').replace('0x1b52ec8','0x1b51f28').replace('0x1b52d88','0x1b51de8')
s=convert((S/'native_player_domino_item.h').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
a=s.index('// Exact installed');b=s.index('template<class Read>',a)
s=s[:a]+'''// Static v265 exact PE RTTI: component1b51f28 and declaration1b51de8.
// Installed Void item/component definitions specify Corvo and slot1. Saved
// baseline inventory contains a zero-quantity uninstantiated entry. Native
// grant/inline declaration ownership is a candidate until the isolated test.
// Both named and inline-parent forms require the exact component name/type.
// This reader never grants, activates, spawns or applies damage.
'''+s[b:]
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
````
````text
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/swarm-rat-gait-v301-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/swarm-rat-gait-v301-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-rat-buffer-v302/Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1

[Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-rat-buffer-v302/Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/swarm-rat-gait-v301-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/swarm-rat-gait-v301-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-rat-clock-v303/Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1

[Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-rat-clock-v303/Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/swarm-rat-gait-v301-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/swarm-rat-gait-v301-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
````
````text
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
````
````text
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/swarm-rat-leaf-v296-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/swarm-rat-leaf-v296-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
 $pose1=Get-Content "$out/visual-early-skeleton-1.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if(!$pose0.stable-or!$pose1.stable-or$pose0.joints.Count-ne31-or$pose1.joints.Count-ne31){throw 'Stable31-joint animation observations required'}
 $poseDeltas=@(for($i=1;$i-lt31;$i++){
  if($pose0.joints[$i].nativeName-ne$pose1.joints[$i].nativeName){throw 'Joint identity changed'}
  $delta=0.0;for($j=0;$j-lt12;$j++){$delta=[Math]::Max($delta,[Math]::Abs($pose0.joints[$i].localPose[$j]-$pose1.joints[$i].localPose[$j]))}
  [pscustomobject]@{joint=$pose0.joints[$i].nativeName;maxLocalDelta=$delta}
 })
 $changing=@($poseDeltas|Where-Object maxLocalDelta -gt.01)
 [ordered]@{treeActive=$pose1.treeActive;treeOutput=$pose1.treeHasOutput;changingJoints=$changing.Count;deltas=$poseDeltas;visualAcceptance=$false}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content "$out/animation-output-summary.json"
 if($changing.Count-lt4){throw 'Native rat walking did not produce significant joint-local motion'}
 $checks.Add('At least4 joints change locally above0.01 over120ms; root displacement and floating-point noise cannot satisfy this animation check')
"""+needle)
````

````text
void serviceSwarmRatVisual(ULONGLONG tick){

}
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-rat-profile-v309/Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1

[Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-swarm-rat-profile-v309/Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/swarm-rat-gait-v301-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/swarm-rat-gait-v301-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
````
````text
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/swarm-rat-gait-v301-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/swarm-rat-gait-v301-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
````
````text
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/swarm-rat-gait-v301-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/swarm-rat-gait-v301-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
 $checks.Add('Each owned rat uses its replicated size through native reference-frame dispatch; frame/entity/render readbacks all match and gait stride accounts for size')
''')
````

````text
"""Animation-only native rat experiment, no SwarmAgent/AI/possession components."""
from pathlib import Path
import copy,json,hashlib,struct
from inspect_midnight_events import parse,walk
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;LAB=P.parents[1]/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def emit(o,depth=0):
 indent='\t'*depth
 if isinstance(o,dict):return '{\n'+''.join(indent+'\t'+k+' = '+emit(v,depth+1)+(';'if not isinstance(v,dict)else'')+'\n'for k,v in o.items())+indent+'}'
 if isinstance(o,str):return o if o in ('true','false','NULL')else json.dumps(o)
 return str(o)
manifest=[]
resources=read(LAB/'research/asset-exports/native-rat-visual-v291/manifest.json')['Resources']
for phase,alias in [('idle','rat_idle01'),('walk','rat_walk'),('run','rat_run')]:
 source=next(x for x in resources if x['Name'].endswith('/'+alias+'.md6anim'))
 raw=Path(source['ExportFile']).read_bytes();assert raw[:4]==b'80AE'
 frames=struct.unpack_from('<H',raw,16)[0];fps=struct.unpack_from('<f',raw,8)[0];duration=round((frames-1)/fps*1000)
 assert 100<=duration<=20000 and 1<=fps<=240
 d=copy.deepcopy(parse((LAB/'assets/mesmerize_visual_loop.midnightscene').read_text()))
 group=d['edit']['m_groupsInfo']['item[0]'];group['m_name']='Rat';group['m_declsMD6']['item[0]']='models/characters/animals/rat/rat.md6'
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=30,[ValidateSet('standing','crouched')][string]$Stance='standing',[switch]$Holstered,[ValidateRange(0,12000)][int]$Move=0)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$worldRows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $visualBaseline=S client '.swarm-rat-visual.json';$visualBaseline|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/visual-baseline.json"
 $dirty=$true
 C host 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C client 'setviewpos -46.3 -151.8 68.1 220 0';
````

````text
from pathlib import Path

read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
assert not A.exists()
for kind in ('build','smoke','action'):
 s=(W/f'swarm-spawn-fx-{kind}-v315.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');assert s and 'FAIL:' not in s and 'error C' not in s and 'error LNK' not in s
A.mkdir();shutil.copytree(S/'src',A/'src');(A/'assets').mkdir()
for p in (S/'assets').glob('swarm_*'):
 if p.is_file():shutil.copy2(p,A/'assets'/p.name)
for b in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/b,A/b)
for p in [Path(__file__),W/'prepare_swarm_spawn_fx_v315.py',W/'Invoke-NativeLabOperation.ps1',S/'Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1',S/'Build-D2SwarmSpawnFxAssets.ps1',S/'Send-D2Command.ps1',R/'work/natural-moveset/Test-SwarmRatVisualNetwork-v315.ps1',*W.glob('swarm-spawn-fx-*-v315.log')]:shutil.copy2(p,A/p.name)
x=read(W/'candidate-swarm-fx-observe-v312/identity.json');x.update(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),assetHashes={p.name:sha(p)for p in(A/'assets').iterdir()},runtimeVerified=False,scope='Candidate315:314 started one native receiver effect but duplicate-test command was missing from both allowlists. Exact duplicate command admitted in engine and sender; idle preflight added.  source-owned native Swarm summon burst over a separate176-byte Steam packet. Bounded discovery requires a newly observed source world, reciprocal equipment/world owner, exact declaration+A0, native cast25, finite early window. Stream baseline prevents late-join replay. Receiver requires matching world event, power event, tokens and clock, plays only isolated native-derived particle/sound FX without rumble, retires after1600ms or world/stream change. No native gameplay invocation. Trails, marker, attack/death FX and audio perception remain unverified.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2))
for b in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/b,S/'bin'/b)
print(json.dumps({k:x[k]for k in ('dll','probe')}))
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/swarm-rat-gait-v301-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/swarm-rat-gait-v301-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed,[ValidateRange(100,9000)][int]$ReceiptTimeoutMs=2500)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_movement_resume|coop_movement_feet|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_power_fixture|coop_darkvision_fixture|coop_windblast_fixture|coop_mesmerize_fixture|coop_domino_fixture|coop_swarm_fixture|coop_swarm_fx|coop_mesmerize_visual|coop_bendtime_fixture|coop_ranged_fixture|coop_grenade_fixture|coop_potion_fixture|coop_grenade_prop|coop_ranged_prop|coop_agility_fixture|coop_carry_attachment|coop_power_fx|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_domino_fixture*' -and $Command -notmatch '^coop_domino_fixture (20000|40000|off)$'){throw 'Domino fixture accepts only finite observed research durations or off.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_swarm_fixture*' -and $Command -notmatch '^coop_swarm_fixture (20000|40000|off)$'){throw 'Swarm fixture accepts only finite research durations or off.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_swarm_fx*' -and $Command -ne 'coop_swarm_fx duplicate'){throw 'Swarm FX test accepts only duplicate of a previously observed source event.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];W=R/'work/movement-integration';S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab';P=R/'work/natural-moveset'
def edit(p,a,b):
 s=p.read_text();assert a in s,(p,a);p.write_text(s.replace(a,b))
edit(S/'src/engine_bridge.cpp','writeSwarmWorld();writeSwarmSpawnFx();writeSwarmRatVisual();','writeSwarmWorld();writeSwarmSpawnFx();writeSwarmTrails();writeSwarmRatVisual();')
edit(S/'src/engine_bridge.cpp','presentSwarmWorld(tick);serviceSwarmRatVisual(tick);serviceSwarmSpawnFx(tick);','presentSwarmWorld(tick);serviceSwarmRatVisual(tick);serviceSwarmSpawnFx(tick);serviceSwarmTrails(tick);')
edit(W/'Invoke-NativeLabOperation.ps1','Test-SwarmRatVisualNetwork-v317.ps1','Test-SwarmRatVisualNetwork-v318.ps1')
s=(P/'Test-SwarmRatVisualNetwork-v317.ps1').read_text().replace('(124+72*$_.peer.count)','(124+128*$_.peer.count)')
s=s.replace(" $visualBaseline=S client '.swarm-rat-visual.json'"," $trailsSourceBaseline=S host '.swarm-trails.json';$trailsPeerBaseline=S client '.swarm-trails.json'\n [ordered]@{source=$trailsSourceBaseline;peer=$trailsPeerBaseline}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content \"$out/trails-baseline.json\"\n $visualBaseline=S client '.swarm-rat-visual.json'")
s=s.replace("nativeFxPeer=(S client '.power-fx.json')})","nativeFxPeer=(S client '.power-fx.json');trailsSource=(S host '.swarm-trails.json');trailsPeer=(S client '.swarm-trails.json')})")
needle=" $checks.Add('One exact source-owned summon FX record transmits through native Steam and starts one owned remote native particle/sound effect; duplicate rejected and finite effect retired')"
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,needle+'''
 $trailsSource=S host '.swarm-trails.json';$trailsPeer=S client '.swarm-trails.json'
 [ordered]@{source=$trailsSource;peer=$trailsPeer}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12|Set-Content "$out/trails-summary.json"
 if(($trailsSource.sourceDiscovered-$trailsSourceBaseline.sourceDiscovered)-ne7-or($trailsPeer.started-$trailsPeerBaseline.started)-ne7-or
    ($trailsPeer.refused-$trailsPeerBaseline.refused)-ne0-or($trailsPeer.updated-$trailsPeerBaseline.updated)-lt100-or
    ($trailsPeer.interpolated-$trailsPeerBaseline.interpolated)-lt50-or$trailsPeer.maxReadbackError-gt.00001-or$trailsPeer.active-ne0){throw 'Rat trail presentation count, transform, interpolation or retirement failed'}
 $trailRecords=@($worldRows|ForEach-Object{$_.trailsPeer.effects}|Where-Object{$_.active})
 if(@($trailRecords.sourceId|Sort-Object -Unique).Count-ne7-or@($trailRecords.nativeId|Sort-Object -Unique).Count-ne7){throw 'Seven unique native trail owners were not observed'}
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed,[ValidateRange(100,9000)][int]$ReceiptTimeoutMs=2500)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_movement_resume|coop_movement_feet|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_power_fixture|coop_darkvision_fixture|coop_windblast_fixture|coop_mesmerize_fixture|coop_domino_fixture|coop_swarm_fixture|coop_swarm_fx|coop_mesmerize_visual|coop_bendtime_fixture|coop_ranged_fixture|coop_grenade_fixture|coop_potion_fixture|coop_grenade_prop|coop_ranged_prop|coop_agility_fixture|coop_carry_attachment|coop_power_fx|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_domino_fixture*' -and $Command -notmatch '^coop_domino_fixture (20000|40000|off)$'){throw 'Domino fixture accepts only finite observed research durations or off.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_swarm_fixture*' -and $Command -notmatch '^coop_swarm_fixture (20000|40000|off)$'){throw 'Swarm fixture accepts only finite research durations or off.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_swarm_fx*' -and $Command -ne 'coop_swarm_fx duplicate'){throw 'Swarm FX test accepts only duplicate of a previously observed source event.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=30,[ValidateSet('standing','crouched')][string]$Stance='standing',[switch]$Holstered,[ValidateRange(0,12000)][int]$Move=0)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$worldRows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 C host 'coop_swarm_fx duplicate' # Idle no-op validates command admission before the cast
 $fxSourceBaseline=S host '.swarm-spawn-fx.json';$fxPeerBaseline=S client '.swarm-spawn-fx.json'
 [ordered]@{source=$fxSourceBaseline;peer=$fxPeerBaseline}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content "$out/spawn-fx-baseline.json"
````

````text
from pathlib import Path

read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
assert not A.exists()
for kind in ('build','smoke','action'):
 s=(W/f'swarm-trails-{kind}-v319.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');assert s and 'FAIL:' not in s and 'error C' not in s and 'error LNK' not in s
A.mkdir();shutil.copytree(S/'src',A/'src');(A/'assets').mkdir()
for p in (S/'assets').glob('swarm_*'):
 if p.is_file():shutil.copy2(p,A/'assets'/p.name)
for b in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/b,A/b)
for p in [Path(__file__),W/'prepare_swarm_trails_v319.py',W/'Invoke-NativeLabOperation.ps1',S/'Build-D2SwarmRatVisualAssets.ps1',S/'Build-D2SwarmSpawnFxAssets.ps1',S/'Send-D2Command.ps1',R/'work/natural-moveset/Test-SwarmRatVisualNetwork-v319.ps1',*W.glob('swarm-trails-*-v319.log')]:shutil.copy2(p,A/p.name)
x=read(W/'candidate-swarm-fx-observe-v312/identity.json');x.update(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),assetHashes={p.name:sha(p)for p in(A/'assets').iterdir()},runtimeVerified=False,scope='Candidate319:318 started7 trails and verified411 transform updates but classified3 end-of-life record checks as refusals. Native record expiry is now explicit completion with persistent refusal diagnostics; tombstones remain unchanged.  version2 rat world packet carries optional strictly attributed native rat spawn-trail IDs, ages and transforms. Bounded source discovery7/16scans/750ms, read-only native frame/pool ownership checks, cached record samples expire at2500ms. Receiver starts each source ID once within200ms, interpolates matching IDs only, updates guarded owned particle record with no callback, preserves tombstones through lease gaps, and retires on source absence/scope changes. Native particle declaration reused unchanged; no AI/damage or first-person modification. Runtime verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2))
for b in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/b,S/'bin'/b)
print(json.dumps({k:x[k]for k in ('dll','probe')}))
````

````text
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$worldRows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 C host 'coop_swarm_fx duplicate' # Idle no-op validates command admission before the cast
 $fxSourceBaseline=S host '.swarm-spawn-fx.json';$fxPeerBaseline=S client '.swarm-spawn-fx.json'
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$worldRows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 C host 'coop_swarm_fx duplicate' # Idle no-op validates command admission before the cast
 $fxSourceBaseline=S host '.swarm-spawn-fx.json';$fxPeerBaseline=S client '.swarm-spawn-fx.json'
 [ordered]@{source=$fxSourceBaseline;peer=$fxPeerBaseline}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content "$out/spawn-fx-baseline.json"
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
p=R/'work/natural-moveset/Test-SwarmContextNetwork-v276.ps1'
s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
s=s.replace("$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();", "$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$worldRows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();")
s=s.replace("  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 30\n", "  $worldRows.Add([pscustomobject]@{ms=$w.ElapsedMilliseconds;source=(S host '.swarm-world.json');peer=(S client '.swarm-world.json')})\n  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 30\n")
anchor=" $scenes|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 16|Set-Content"
assert s.count(anchor)==1
insert=''' $worldRows|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 16|Set-Content "$out/world-states.json"
 $sourceWorld=S host '.swarm-world.json';$peerWorld=S client '.swarm-world.json'
 [ordered]@{source=$sourceWorld;peer=$peerWorld}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12|Set-Content "$out/world-history.json"
 $live=@($worldRows|Where-Object {$_.peer.leased-and$_.peer.present-eq1-and$_.peer.count-gt0})
 if($live.Count-lt20-or$sourceWorld.sent-lt20-or$peerWorld.presented-lt20){throw 'Insufficient live native Steam rat snapshots'}
 $matched=@(foreach($r in $peerWorld.history){$sent=@($sourceWorld.history|Where-Object sequence -eq $r.sequence);if(!$sent.Count){continue};if($sent.Count-ne1-or$sent[0].digest-ne$r.digest-or$sent[0].count-ne$r.count-or$sent[0].handle-ne$r.handle){throw 'Accepted rat wire differs from source'};$r})
 if($matched.Count-lt20){throw 'Insufficient overlapping exact source/accepted rat packets'}
 $checks.Add('More than20 accepted Steam world snapshots exactly match source wire digests, native rat identities and counts')
 if(@($live|Where-Object {$_.peer.bytes-ne(124+72*$_.peer.count)}).Count){throw 'Rat wire length/count mismatch'}
 [ordered]@{liveSamples=$live.Count;matchedPackets=$matched.Count;counts=@($live.peer.count|Sort-Object -Unique);rejected=$peerWorld.rejected;unknown=$sourceWorld.unknown;scopedReadMaxMs=$sourceWorld.scopedReadMaxMs;remoteVisuals=$false;remoteDamage=$false}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$out/world-summary.json"
 $checks.Add('World samples preserve bounded native agent sets and exact variable payload size; source reader timing retained')
 C host 'coop_shadow_stream off';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1200
````

````text
 p=S/n;s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');assert s.count(old)==1,(n,old[:100],s.count(old));p.write_text(s.replace(old,new),encoding='utf-8')

 '// Native semantic states and explicit unbound ground presentation18. No pointers, resource names or damage requests.')
change('shadow_action_protocol.h','return possession&&stun&&grenade&&carry&&ranged&&power&&traversal&&equipment&&combat&&',
 '''// Unbound presentation can never carry a gesture, target, effect or air event.
    const bool unbound=p.state!=18||(p.kind==1&&!p.combatVariant&&!p.equipmentVariant&&!p.traversalVariant&&
        !p.powerVariant&&!p.rangedKind&&!p.grenadeHeld&&!p.carryVariant&&!p.stunVariant&&!p.airStage);
    return unbound&&possession&&stun&&grenade&&carry&&ranged&&power&&traversal&&equipment&&combat&&''')
change('movement_semantics.h','s.state>17','s.state>18')
change('movement_playback.h','const bool actionEligible=(semantic.state==0||','const bool actionEligible=(semantic.state==0||semantic.state==18||')
````

## work/movement-integration/candidate-usable-state-v829/stage_usable_state_v829.py

[stage_usable_state_v829.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-usable-state-v829/stage_usable_state_v829.py>)

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib, datetime
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; L=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A=W/'candidate-usable-state-v829'; P=W/'candidate-coin-sync-v821'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
previous=json.loads((P/'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v829.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-UsableState-v829.ps1','Deploy-UsableState-v829.ps1','stage_usable_state_v829.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Preserves821 shared pickup families and all prior co-op behavior. Adds owned read-only native state-list inspection and a finite local indexed-window transition fixture. No shared usable protocol yet; native API runtime verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))

````

````text
assert sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll')==previous['dll']
for tag in ('build','world-tests','action-tests','bank-tests','smoke','resume-tests','checkpoint-tests'):
    t=(W/f'shadowwalk-body-{tag}-v831.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert t and not any(x in t for x in ('error C','error LNK','FAIL ','Traceback'))
A.mkdir(exist_ok=False); shutil.copytree(L/'src', A/'src')
shutil.copy2(L/'Send-D2Command.ps1', A/'Send-D2Command.ps1')
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(R/'work/build/Release'/name,A/name)
for name in ('Build-UsableSync-v831.ps1','Deploy-UsableSync-v831.ps1','stage_usable_sync_v831.py'):shutil.copy2(W/name,A/name)
for bank in previous['banks']:assert sha(R/bank['path'])==bank['sha256']
identity=dict(created=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),dll=sha(A/'dinput8.dll'),probe=sha(A/'d2_runtime_probe.exe'),previous=P.name,protocol=69,bankVersion=67,clips=357,banks=previous['banks'],runtimeVerified=False,scope='Preserves829 native reader and fixture plus821 pickup families. Adds opt-in native-window state-list synchronization over existing Steam transport, host-ordered targets, semantic descriptor matching, duplicate rejection, menu retention and coordinated checkpoint renewal. Runtime verification pending.')
(A/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))
for name in ('dinput8.dll','d2_runtime_probe.exe'):shutil.copy2(A/name,L/'bin'/name)
print(json.dumps(identity))
````
