````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/windblast-presentation-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/windblast-presentation-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

[build_windblast_contexts_v1.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/candidate-windblast-context-worldfx-EACA/build_windblast_contexts_v1.py>)

````text
"""Whole-body stance/equipment adaptations, preserving native lengths and feet."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['windblast-source-manifest-v1.json'],'windblast-contexts-v1')
OUT=P/'windblast-context-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'windblast-banks-v1'/f'{role}-windblast-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE27'and count==198
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE28',28,n,201,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28
 rig=rig_for(role);m,fs=L.load(role,'native_phase_windblast_fire');reference=fs[0];rg=rig.fk(reference)
 right=[]
 for i in range(n):
  k=i
  while k>=0 and k!=16:k=rig.joints[k]['parent']
  if k==16 and i!=16 and 'helper'not in rig.joints[i]['nativeName']:right.append(i)
 clips=[]
 for cid,restid,crouched,armed in ((198,59,False,False),(199,17,True,True),(200,76,True,False)):
  rest=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+restid*entry+24+j*28))for j in range(n)];cg=rig.fk(rest)
````

$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)

$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

from pathlib import Path
import json,bisect
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];P=R/'work/natural-moveset/possession-human-v326'
read=lambda name:[json.loads(x)for x in(P/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines()if x.strip()]
target=read('target-state.ndjson');states=read('owned-scenes.ndjson');ts=[x['tick']for x in target];ss=[x['tick']for x in states]
def nearest(rows,ticks,tick):
 i=bisect.bisect_left(ticks,tick);idx=min(range(max(0,i-1),min(len(rows),i+1)),key=lambda j:abs(ticks[j]-tick));return rows[idx],ticks[idx]-tick
out=[]
for frame in read('midnight.ndjson'):
 for scene in frame.get('instances',[]):
  if scene.get('state')!=3 or not scene.get('asset','').endswith('/power_possession_cast_out.midnightscene'):continue
  t,td=nearest(target,ts,frame['tick']);s,sd=nearest(states,ss,frame['tick'])
  out.append(dict(tick=frame['tick'],scene=scene['id'],clock=scene['clockWords'][0],duration=scene['sceneDurationMs'],bindings=scene.get('bindingsResearch'),targetOffsetMs=td,target=t,stateOffsetMs=sd,state=s))
assert out
(P/'release-correlations.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(nonAtomic=True,scope='Nearest independent watcher samples, diagnostic correlation only; strict co-owned reader still required',samples=out),indent=2))
contexts=set((x['target'].get('internalState'),x['target'].get('physicsStance'),tuple(x['state'].get('activeStates',[])))for x in out)
print(json.dumps(dict(samples=len(out),contexts=sorted(contexts,key=str),maxOffsetMs=max(max(abs(x['targetOffsetMs']),abs(x['stateOffsetMs']))for x in out))))

## work/movement-integration/Deploy-CompactHold-v38.ps1

[Deploy-CompactHold-v38.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/Deploy-CompactHold-v38.ps1>)

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
if((Get-Item $game).Attributes-band[IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint){throw 'Not isolated physical game'}
foreach($f in (Get-Content "$PSScriptRoot/protected-save-hashes-before-v4.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)){
 if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.Path).Hash-ne$f.Hash){throw 'Protected file changed'}
}
$candidate=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'candidate-compact-hold-v38'
$identity=Get-Content "$candidate/identity.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
if((Get-FileHash "$candidate/dinput8.dll").Hash-ne$identity.dll){throw 'Candidate changed'}
foreach($role in 'host','client'){
 $launch=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 $p=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
 if($p.Path-ne(Join-Path $game 'Dishonored2.exe')-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-([DateTime]$launch.startedAt)).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Game identity changed'}
 Stop-Process -Id $p.Id
 if(!$p.WaitForExit(15000)){throw 'Isolated process did not exit'}
}
& "$lab/Build-D2CarryCompactHoldAssets.ps1" -Install
Copy-Item -LiteralPath "$candidate/dinput8.dll" -Destination "$lab/bin/dinput8.dll" -Force
````

## work/movement-integration/Deploy-FetalRelease-v35.ps1

[Deploy-FetalRelease-v35.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/Deploy-FetalRelease-v35.ps1>)

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
if((Get-Item $game).Attributes-band[IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint){throw 'Not isolated physical game'}
foreach($f in (Get-Content "$PSScriptRoot/protected-save-hashes-before-v4.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)){
 if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.Path).Hash-ne$f.Hash){throw 'Protected file changed'}
}
$candidate=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'candidate-fetal-release-v35'
$identity=Get-Content "$candidate/identity.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
if((Get-FileHash "$candidate/dinput8.dll").Hash-ne$identity.dll){throw 'Candidate changed'}
foreach($role in 'host','client'){
 $launch=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 $p=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
 if($p.Path-ne(Join-Path $game 'Dishonored2.exe')-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-([DateTime]$launch.startedAt)).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Game identity changed'}
 Stop-Process -Id $p.Id
 if(!$p.WaitForExit(15000)){throw 'Isolated process did not exit'}
}
& "$lab/Build-D2CarryFetalAssets.ps1" -Install
Copy-Item -LiteralPath "$candidate/dinput8.dll" -Destination "$lab/bin/dinput8.dll" -Force
````

## work/movement-integration/Deploy-GrenadeProp-v55.ps1

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$exe=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe'
$archive=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'candidate-grenade-prop-v55';$identity=Get-Content "$archive/identity.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
foreach($f in Get-Content "$PSScriptRoot/protected-save-hashes-before-v4.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json){if((Get-FileHash $f.Path).Hash-ne$f.Hash){throw 'Protected file differs'}}
foreach($r in 'host','client'){
 $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
 if(!$p){continue};if($p.Path-ne$exe-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-([DateTime]$l.startedAt)).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Isolated process identity changed'}
 Stop-Process -Id $p.Id;if(!$p.WaitForExit(15000)){throw 'Isolated process did not exit'}
}
& "$lab/Build-D2GrenadePropAssets.ps1" -Install *> "$PSScriptRoot/grenade-prop-install-v55.log"

if(!$installed.Installed-or!$installed.OriginalSteamIndicesUnchanged){throw 'Asset installation unconfirmed'}
Copy-Item "$archive/dinput8.dll" "$lab/bin/dinput8.dll" -Force;Copy-Item "$archive/d2_runtime_probe.exe" "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" -Force
& "$PSScriptRoot/Deploy-SourceClock.ps1"
if((Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash-ne$identity.dll-or(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash-ne$identity.probe){throw 'Live pins differ'}
'Grenade cosmetic prop candidate deployed with preserved asset backup'

## work/movement-integration/Deploy-SourceClock.ps1

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$exe=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe'
if((Get-Item (Split-Path $exe)).Attributes-band[IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint){throw 'Not physical isolated game'}
$before=Get-Content "$PSScriptRoot/protected-save-hashes-before-v4.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
foreach($f in $before){if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.Path).Hash-ne$f.Hash){throw 'Protected save differs'}}
foreach($role in 'host','client'){
 $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
 if(!$p){continue} # A crashed isolated instance has nothing left to stop.
 if($p.Path-ne$exe-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-([DateTime]$l.startedAt)).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Game identity changed'}
 Stop-Process -Id $p.Id
 if(!$p.WaitForExit(15000)){throw 'Isolated process did not fully exit; loader remains protected'}
}
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
foreach($role in 'host','client'){& "$lab/Start-D2Lab.ps1" -Role $role -AssetExperiment|Out-Null}
& "$root/work/PrepareShadowSword.ps1"
foreach($f in $before){if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.Path).Hash-ne$f.Hash){throw 'Protected save changed'}}
'Source clock candidate ready; protected saves unchanged'

## work/movement-integration/disassemble_checkpoint_v740.py

````text
from pathlib import Path
import sys,struct,hashlib,json
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'work/tools/capstone-5.0.6-local'))
from capstone import Cs,CS_ARCH_X86,CS_MODE_64
p=R/'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe';data=p.read_bytes()
sha=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest().upper()
assert sha=='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
pe=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,0x3c)[0];sections=struct.unpack_from('<H',data,pe+6)[0];opt=struct.unpack_from('<H',data,pe+20)[0]
def section(rva,length):
    for i in range(sections):
        at=pe+24+opt+i*40;vs,va,rawsize,raw=struct.unpack_from('<IIII',data,at+8)
        if va<=rva and rva+length<=va+rawsize:return data[raw+rva-va:raw+rva-va+length]
    raise ValueError('Unmapped RVA')
rows=[]
for rva,length in [(0x65db00,0x70),(0x659190,0x80),(0x6597ca,0x1d5)]:
    blob=section(rva,length)
    lines=[f'{i.address:x} {i.bytes.hex()} {i.mnemonic} {i.op_str}' for i in Cs(CS_ARCH_X86,CS_MODE_64).disasm(blob,0x140000000+rva)]
    rows.append(dict(rva=hex(rva),hex=blob.hex(),instructions=lines))
out=dict(exe=str(p),sha256=sha,capstone='5.0.6',rows=rows)
````

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('documentation/handoff-2026-10-11/25-native-mesmerize-investigation.md');s=p.read_text();a=s.index('[Cosmetic assets v76]');s=s[:a]+'''## Cosmetic model and scene lifecycle v76

[Cosmetic assets](../../work/natural-moveset/mesmerize-visual-assets-v76.json) are now installed **only in the physical isolated clone**. [Install receipt](../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/mesmerize-visual-v76-asset-install.json) records exact resource hashes, verified installed bytes and unchanged Steam indices. The installer preserves a dated clone index/resource backup. [Generator](../../work/natural-moveset/build_mesmerize_visual_assets_v76.py) retains native model animation and removes every non-animation Midnight track, including native delete/timed events. It excludes the gameplay Mesmerize, attributes and AI-attention components. Runtime confirms the four remaining component vtables: AnimEvolved `1b80408`, MidnightProxy `1c59ac8`, Audio `1c4e588`, ReferenceFrame `1c573e8`.

[Scene helper](../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/src/mesmerize_visual_scene.h) reuses verified native Midnight creation/start/stop APIs. [Fixture](../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/src/mesmerize_visual_fixture.h) verifies exact cloned definition, all four component declarations/owners, incarnation and world epoch. It caches creation immediately and never respawns an ambiguously created object. The finite manual experiment runs the three scenes, stops the scene and hides the cached model; checkpoint reload discards the world.

[Raw native startup decompilation](../../work/ghidra-mesmerize-scene-start-v76.json) includes eight functions. `14072af30` binds the native owner to Mesmerize and uses wrapper `1407d91c0`; that wrapper creates through `1407d6040` and starts through `1407d9270` with flags `0x100002`. Start validation calls `1407cbc20`, and `1407d2160` sets running state3. Native Mesmerize state1 shows the entity before starting its scene.

The initial [v76 failure](../../work/natural-moveset/mesmerize-visual-model-v76/result.json) and [v76b diagnostic failure](../../work/natural-moveset/mesmerize-visual-model-v76b/result.json) preserve immediate hidden-model startup refusal. [v76c](../../work/natural-moveset/mesmerize-visual-model-v76c/result.json) adds a200ms initialization interval and shows/refreshes before starting Midnight: all three scene starts and finite hide pass. Both changes were made together; their individual causal effects are not isolated. The overall v76c result remains failed because the harness incorrectly invoked the Emily-only equipment reader on Corvo. That harness error was fixed; no failed result was overwritten.

[v76d passes six checks](../../work/natural-moveset/mesmerize-visual-model-v76d/result.json): one model, exactly one start for each native scene, one owned native body effect and its stop, unchanged player/avatar health and inventory, both checkpoint resets and protected14. The original body FX declares particles and spatial spawn/loop/stop sound; its rumble is disabled. No gameplay power component is involved. The recording is silent, so audio quality is unverified. [Inspected model sheet](../../work/natural-moveset/mesmerize-visual-model-v76d/model-sheet.jpg) shows the dark animated particle form present and later absent. Model-only v76c is very faint. Camera/light do not justify fine visual acceptance. Both inspected recordings are in the dashboard as **manual cosmetic proofs**, not gameplay bindings.

## Forward gesture and Steam world candidate v77–78

[Reproducible v77 body build](../../work/natural-moveset/build_mesmerize_bank_v77.py) rotates the native support donor's complete left shoulder chain forward by65 degrees, eased on entry/recovery. It does not impose an FP wrist target. Native body acting, bone translations, sword grip/attachment, feet and root ownership remain as in v73. [Both actual banks pass](../../work/movement-integration/mesmerize-banks-v77.log); format45/276 and the prior273 payloads are retained. Runtime visual comparison is pending.

[New world protocol](../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/src/mesmerize_world_protocol.h) is separately versioned1/160bytes; body protocol40/336bytes remains unchanged. It requires Emily/source roles, exact sessions/worlds/map, stream incarnation tokens, fresh root/sample clocks, proper finite rotation basis and a committed source entity incarnation. Foreign handles are opaque IDs, never resolved locally. Order rejects duplicates, handle substitution, transform drift, phase regression and revival after retirement. [Tests pass](../../work/movement-integration/mesmerize-world-protocol-v78b.log).

[Candidate v78](../../work/movement-integration/candidate-mesmerize-world-network-v78/identity.json) publishes only the exact equipment+d4 committed world relationship. Native states1/3/2 drive cosmetic spawn/idle/removal; state changes are reliable Steam messages and heartbeats have a short lease. Unreadable native state produces silence, not an invented gameplay removal. Explicit native removal permits a bounded700ms visual exit. [Paired harness](../../work/natural-moveset/Test-MesmerizeWorldNetwork-v78.ps1) records source and receiver, checks duplicates and checkpoint cleanup. Runtime test is in progress.

if($Command -like 'coop_swarm_fixture*' -and $Command -notmatch '^coop_swarm_fixture (20000|40000|off)$'){throw 'Swarm fixture accepts only finite research durations or off.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_doppelganger_fixture*' -and $Command -notmatch '^coop_doppelganger_fixture (20000|40000|off)$'){throw 'Doppelganger fixture accepts only finite research durations or off.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_shadowwalk_fixture*' -and $Command -notmatch '^coop_shadowwalk_fixture (20000|40000|off)$'){throw 'Shadow Walk fixture accepts only finite research durations or off.'}
if($Command -like 'coop_swarm_fx*' -and $Command -ne 'coop_swarm_fx duplicate'){throw 'Swarm FX test accepts only duplicate of a previously observed source event.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)

## work/movement-integration/heavy-fixture-recovery-v631/run-script.ps1

[run-script.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/heavy-fixture-recovery-v631/run-script.ps1>)

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out="$PSScriptRoot/heavy-fixture-recovery-v631"
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$failure=$null;$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Native operation active'}
 New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out -ErrorAction Stop|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){Copy-Item "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" "$out/before-$r.json"}
 & "$root/work/PrepareShadowSword.ps1" *> "$out/restore.log"
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if((Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne"$root\work\asset-game\Dishonored2.exe"){throw 'Wrong isolated process'}
  $s=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$s.probeActorHandle-or$s.localGameLogicState-ne1-or!$s.remoteFresh){throw 'Fresh active partner fixture absent'}
  $raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $l.pid --player-inventory;if($LASTEXITCODE){throw 'Inventory read failed'}
  $after=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$raw|Set-Content "$out/inventory-$r.json"
  $before=Get-Content "$root/work/natural-moveset/native-heavy-emily-v630/inventory-before-$r.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(Compare-Object @($before.items|ForEach-Object {"$($_.name):$($_.quantity)"}) @($after.items|ForEach-Object {"$($_.name):$($_.quantity)"})){throw 'Restored inventory differs'}
  $raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $l.pid --health 1;if($LASTEXITCODE-or($raw|ConvertFrom-Json).current-ne56){throw 'Player health differs'}
  $raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $l.pid --health $s.probeActorHandle;if($LASTEXITCODE-or($raw|ConvertFrom-Json).current-ne40){throw 'Partner health differs'}
  $s|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/after-$r.json"
````

raw=ns['raw'];tableRva,tableSize=struct.unpack_from('<II',raw,ns['opt']+112+3*8);table=ns['offset'](tableRva);functions=[]
for at in range(table,table+tableSize,12):
 b,e,u=struct.unpack_from('<III',raw,at)
 if b<=0x863799<e:functions.append(dict(begin=hex(0x140000000+b),end=hex(0x140000000+e),unwind=hex(0x140000000+u)))
vt=ns['offset'](0x1c83468);slots=[]

 address=struct.unpack_from('<Q',raw,vt+i*8)[0]
 if not 0x140000000<=address<0x1441ca800:break
 slots.append(dict(slot=hex(i*8),address=hex(address)))

Slot semantics need Ghidra/runtime evidence.')

"""Find exact-image x64 exception-table boundaries, without guessing function starts."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,struct,hashlib,json
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('rva',type=lambda s:int(s,16));a=p.parse_args()
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];b=(R/'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest().upper()=='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
u16=lambda p:struct.unpack_from('<H',b,p)[0];u32=lambda p:struct.unpack_from('<I',b,p)[0]
pe=u32(0x3c);opt=pe+24;assert u16(opt)==0x20b
sections=[]
for i in range(u16(pe+6)):
 s=opt+u16(pe+20)+i*40;sections.append((u32(s+12),u32(s+16),u32(s+20)))
def raw(v):
 for r,n,o in sections:
  if r<=v<r+n:return o+v-r
 raise ValueError(hex(v))
rva,size=struct.unpack_from('<II',b,opt+112+3*8);rows=[]
for off in range(raw(rva),raw(rva)+size,12):
 begin,end,unwind=struct.unpack_from('<III',b,off)
 if begin<=a.rva<end:rows.append(dict(start=hex(begin),end=hex(end),unwind=hex(unwind),prologue=b[raw(begin):raw(begin)+32].hex()))
print(json.dumps(dict(query=hex(a.rva),matches=rows),indent=2))
````

## work/movement-integration/inspect_pe_rtti.py

[inspect_pe_rtti.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/inspect_pe_rtti.py>)

````text
"""Read-only MSVC x64 RTTI extraction from the pinned D2 image; no process access."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,struct,json,hashlib
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('type');p.add_argument('output');a=p.parse_args()
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];exe=root/'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe';blob=exe.read_bytes()
digest=hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest().upper()
assert digest=='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180','Wrong executable'
u16=lambda n:struct.unpack_from('<H',blob,n)[0];u32=lambda n:struct.unpack_from('<I',blob,n)[0];u64=lambda n:struct.unpack_from('<Q',blob,n)[0]
nt=u32(0x3c);assert blob[nt:nt+4]==b'PE\0\0';opt=nt+24;assert u16(opt)==0x20b
base=u64(opt+24);sections=[]
for i in range(u16(nt+6)):
 h=opt+u16(nt+20)+i*40
 sections.append(dict(name=blob[h:h+8].rstrip(b'\0').decode(),virtualSize=u32(h+8),rva=u32(h+12),size=u32(h+16),offset=u32(h+20),flags=u32(h+36)))
def rva(offset):
 for s in sections:
  if s['offset']<=offset<s['offset']+s['size']:return s['rva']+offset-s['offset']
 raise ValueError('Offset outside sections')
def executable(address):
 v=address-base
 return any(s['flags']&0x20000000 and s['rva']<=v<s['rva']+s['virtualSize'] for s in sections)
````

## work/movement-integration/lookup_runtime_functions.py

[lookup_runtime_functions.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/lookup_runtime_functions.py>)

````text
"""Read x64 PE exception-directory boundaries; never modify the executable."""
import struct,sys,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'asset-game'/'Dishonored2.exe'
b=p.read_bytes();pe=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,0x3c)[0]
assert b[pe:pe+4]==b'PE\0\0'
sections=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,pe+6)[0];opt=pe+24;size=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,pe+20)[0]
assert struct.unpack_from('<H',b,opt)[0]==0x20b
table=opt+size
def offset(rva):
    for i in range(sections):
        virtual,base,raw_size,raw=struct.unpack_from('<IIII',b,table+i*40+8)
        if base<=rva<base+max(virtual,raw_size):return raw+rva-base
    raise ValueError(hex(rva))
rva,n=struct.unpack_from('<II',b,opt+112+3*8);data=offset(rva)
for address in sys.argv[1:]:
    a=int(address,16);a=a-0x140000000 if a>=0x140000000 else a
    found=[dict(address=hex(a),begin=hex(start),end=hex(end),unwind=hex(unwind)) for start,end,unwind in struct.iter_unpack('<III',b[data:data+n]) if start<=a<end]
    print(json.dumps(found))
````

$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'

function C($r,$s){& outputs/d2-coop-lab/Send-D2Command.ps1 -Role $r -Command $s -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function S($r){for($attempt=0;$attempt-lt40;$attempt++){try{return(Get-Content "work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw -ErrorAction Stop|ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop)}catch{if($attempt-eq39){throw};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 25}}}
& outputs/d2-coop-lab/Restore-D2Lab.ps1 -Doppelganger|Out-Null
foreach($r in 'host','client'){C $r 'setviewpos -39.4 -161.4 68.1 270 20';& outputs/d2-coop-lab/Send-D2Input.ps1 -Role $r -Button X -DurationMs 400|Out-Null}
$seen=@{host=$false;client=$false};$watch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
do{$ready=$true;foreach($r in 'host','client'){$s=S $r;if($s.localGameLogicState-eq5){$seen[$r]=$true};if(!$seen[$r]-or$s.localGameLogicState-ne1-or$s.localPendingGameLogicState){$ready=$false}};if(!$ready){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150}}while(!$ready-and$watch.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt45000)
if(!$ready){throw 'Both native Mayhew scenes did not complete'}
C host 'setviewpos -33 -153 68.1 90 0';C client 'setviewpos -33 -148 68.1 270 0'
foreach($r in 'host','client'){C $r 'coop_probe_follow exact';C $r 'coop_probe_locomotion on'}
'Native sword fixture ready'

## work/movement-integration/pe_readonly.py

[pe_readonly.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/pe_readonly.py>)

````text
"""Exact-build PE metadata inspection. Reads bytes only; never loads or executes them."""
import argparse,hashlib,json,struct
from pathlib import Path
EXPECTED='b671f8249422862bf557d00aab2f4bb671ed4515cc10ad8a8a9decad84516180'
EXE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent/'asset-game/Dishonored2.exe'
def inspect(type_name=None,address=None):
 b=EXE.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==EXPECTED
 def u32(at):return struct.unpack_from('<I',b,at)[0]
 pe=u32(0x3c);assert b[pe:pe+4]==b'PE\0\0'
 opt=pe+24;assert struct.unpack_from('<H',b,opt)[0]==0x20b
 base=struct.unpack_from('<Q',b,opt+24)[0]
 count=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,pe+6)[0];sec=opt+struct.unpack_from('<H',b,pe+20)[0]
 sections=[struct.unpack_from('<8sIIII',b,sec+i*40)for i in range(count)]
 def rva(off):
  for name,vsize,va,size,ptr in sections:
   if ptr<=off<ptr+size:return va+off-ptr
  raise ValueError('Not mapped file offset')
 def off(va):
  for name,vsize,start,size,ptr in sections:
   if start<=va<start+size:return ptr+va-start
````

from pathlib import Path

edit('native_player_states.h','inline bool nativePlayerMotion(','''//649/650 native window-sill observations: physical stance2, AutoCrouch10,
// optionally the independent right-arm EquipChange53. Map presentation only;
// retain actual state IDs and capsule for all ownership checks and gameplay.
inline bool nativePlayerAutoCrouchStates(const NativePlayerStates& s,std::uintptr_t base){
    if(s.player.logic!=1||!s.defaultMode||s.player.current!=2||s.active.empty()||s.active.size()>2)return false;
    unsigned crouch=0,equip=0;
    for(const auto& a:s.active){
        if(a.id==10&&a.vtable==base+0x1c812b8)++crouch;
        else if(a.id==53&&a.vtable==base+0x1c79cf8)++equip;
        else return false;
    }
    return crouch==1&&equip<=1;

for i,(name,call) in enumerate(ordinary):helper+=f'        case {i}:timedNativeService("{name}",[&]{{{call}}});break;\n'

## work/movement-integration/prepare_door_observation_v641.py

[prepare_door_observation_v641.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/prepare_door_observation_v641.py>)

````text
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; N=R/'work/natural-moveset'
s=(N/'Observe-NativeDoor-v640.ps1').read_text().replace('native-unlocked-door-corvo-v640','native-unlocked-door-corvo-v641').replace('NativeDoor640','NativeDoor641')
# PowerShell hex ffffffff is signed -1; it retained adjacent changing flags.
# Explicit unsigned decimal mask reads only the native generation DWORD.
s=s.replace('-band 0xffffffff','-band [uint64]4294967295')
s=s.replace("if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntOpenable@@'-or(W $o '0x10')-ne$d.owner-or((W $o '0x18')-band [uint64]4294967295)-ne$d.generation){throw 'Door component lifetime changed'}", "if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntOpenable@@'-or(W $o '0x10')-ne$d.owner-or((W $o '0x18')-band [uint64]4294967295)-ne$d.generation){$o|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7|Set-Content \"$out/failed-door-$r.json\";throw 'Door component lifetime changed'}")
s=s.replace("$peerCapture.WaitForExit(15000)","$peerCapture.WaitForExit(35000)")
s=s.replace("}catch{$failure=$_.Exception.Message}finally{", "}catch{$failure=$_.Exception.Message;if($samples){$samples|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 17|Set-Content \"$out/partial-observations.json\"};if($inputs){$inputs|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content \"$out/partial-inputs.json\"}}finally{")
p=N/'Observe-NativeDoor-v641.ps1'
if p.exists(): raise SystemExit('Unique script exists')
p.write_text(s)
print('641 fixes unsigned generation/state masks and retains partial diagnostics. No production code changed.')
````

    $position=($xyz|ForEach-Object {$_.ToString('F4',[Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)})-join' '
    C host "setviewpos $position 90 0"
    $events.Add([pscustomobject]@{videoTime=([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()-$start)/1000;input='Observer camera follows source-owned clone for disappearance inspection';position=$xyz})

from pathlib import Path

R = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
W, N = R / 'work/movement-integration', R / 'work/natural-moveset'

def replace_once(s, old, new):
    assert s.count(old) == 1, old
    return s.replace(old, new)

s = (N / 'Observe-NativeDoppelgangerCrouch-v489.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
s = replace_once(s, '[int]$Pitch=30)', "[int]$Pitch=30,[ValidateSet('standing','crouched')][string]$Stance='standing')")
start = s.index(' & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button B')
end = s.index(' $hwnd=', start)
s = s[:start] + ''' $expectedStance=if($Stance-eq'crouched'){1}else{0}
 $groundState=if($expectedStance){6}else{0}
 if($expectedStance){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button B -DurationMs 180|Out-Null;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500}
 # Native X can interact; look away from all actors before the holster hold.
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role client -Pitch -60 -Evidence "$out/holster-look-away.json" -Quick
 & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role client -Button X -DurationMs 1000|Out-Null
 Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1200
````

from pathlib import Path
import json
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; W=R/'work/movement-integration'; N=R/'work/natural-moveset'; S=R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
read=lambda p:p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
def change(p,old,new):
    s=read(p); assert s.count(old)==1,(p,old)
    p.write_text(s.replace(old,new),encoding='utf-8')
def create(p,s):
    assert not p.exists(),p
    p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
for take in ('native-doppelganger-holstered-standing-v493','native-doppelganger-holstered-crouched-v494'):
    assert json.loads(read(N/take/'result.json'))['passed']
    evidence=json.loads(read(N/take/'holstered-observations.json'))
    assert evidence['swordEquippedWhileCasting']==0 and evidence['swordHolsteredWhileCasting']>=3

change(S/'native_player_doppelganger_scene.h','//406b standing and489 crouched armed Emily:', '//406b/489 armed and493/494 holstered ground contexts for Emily:')
change(S/'native_player_doppelganger_scene.h','||!item.started||!item.player.sword.equipped||','||!item.started||')
change(S/'shadow_action_protocol.h','version=52,','version=53,')
change(S/'shadow_action_protocol.h','p.version==52','p.version==53')
change(S/'shadow_action_protocol.h','if(variant>=29&&variant<=31)return swordState==2;','if(variant>=29&&variant<=31)return swordState==1||swordState==2;')
````

target=N/'Test-MidnightFx-v439.ps1';assert not target.exists()

anchor=" $checks.Add('Native1000ms clone spawn scene observed with reciprocal binding to independently enumerated source clone; raw instance retained for strict reader development')"
assert s.count(anchor)==1
s=s.replace(anchor,anchor+'''
 $midnightSamples=@(Get-Content "$out/native-midnight.ndjson"|ForEach-Object {$_|ConvertFrom-Json})
 $fxScenes=@($midnightSamples.instances|Where-Object {$_.asset-eq'midnight/gameplay/human/common/doppelganger/doppelganger_spawn.midnightscene'-and$_.state-eq3})
 $resolved=@($fxScenes|Where-Object {$_.bindingsResearch.Count-eq1-and$_.bindingsResearch[0].reciprocal-and$_.bindingsResearch[0].fxResearch.valid-and@($_.bindingsResearch[0].fxResearch.tracks.records).Count-eq5})
 if(!$resolved.Count){throw 'No stable reciprocal native five-helper FX track snapshot; research capture retained'}
 $proof=$resolved[0];$fxRecords=@($proof.bindingsResearch[0].fxResearch.tracks.records)
 if(@($fxRecords|Where-Object {!$_.keyResolved-or$_.helperType-ne'.?AVidEntity@@'}).Count-or@($fxRecords.helperHandle|Sort-Object -Unique).Count-ne5){throw 'Native key/helper identity unresolved'}
 $expectedSockets=@('decoy_root','sl_l_arm','sl_r_arm','decoy_spawn_l_hand','decoy_spawn_r_hand')|Sort-Object
 if(Compare-Object $expectedSockets ($fxRecords.socket|Sort-Object)){throw 'Native spawn sockets differ from exported exact scene'}
 $fxRows=@(Get-Content "$out/native-effects.ndjson"|ForEach-Object {$_|ConvertFrom-Json}|Where-Object valid)
 foreach($rec in $fxRecords){if(!@($fxRows.effects|Where-Object {$_.owner-eq$rec.helperHandle-and$_.name-eq$rec.effect}).Count){throw 'Track helper/effect absent from independent native FX map'}}
 $proof|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 16|Set-Content "$out/confirmed-fx-scene.json"
 $checks.Add('Native clone scene group and five FX keys resolve exact sockets and distinct helpers independently matched to native FX-map owners/declarations')
''')

"""Bind only v266-observed Swarm phases; keep world effects out of pose packets."""
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];S=P/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
def edit(name,old,new):
 p=S/name;s=p.read_text();assert old in s,(name,old[:100]);p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
s=(S/'native_player_domino_scene.h').read_text()
s=s.replace('domino','swarm').replace('Domino','Swarm')
start=s.index('// Observed');end=s.index('template<class Read>')
s=s[:start]+'''// v266: exact native standing, armed Corvo input. Body and left arm are
// reciprocal bindings; UsePower63 retires during the 1600ms release scene.
// No rat spawn, damage or animation events are executed by this reader.
inline unsigned nativeSwarmVariant(const std::string& asset,const std::string& sub,unsigned duration){
    if(sub!="Scene_1")return 0;
    const std::string prefix="midnight/gameplay/player/base/powers/power_swarm_cast_";
    if(asset==prefix+"in.midnightscene"&&duration==400)return 23;
    if(asset==prefix+"loop.midnightscene"&&duration==333)return 24;
    if(asset==prefix+"out.midnightscene"&&duration==1600)return 25;
    return 0;
}
''' +s[end:]
````

"""Derive an exact-type read-only Windblast inventory reader; no generic grants."""
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
s=(P/'native_player_darkvision_item.h').read_text()
s=s.replace('DarkVision','Windblast').replace('Dark Vision','Windblast').replace('darkvision','windblast')
s=s.replace('std::uintptr_t manager=0;unsigned managerFlags=0;bool instantiated=false,managerStarted=false;','bool instantiated=false;')
s=s.replace('if(!readNativePlayerSword(read,base,p.player)||p.player.sword.logic!=1)return false;','if(!readNativePlayerSword(read,base,p.player)||p.player.sword.logic!=1||p.player.character!=1)return false;')
s=s.replace('0x1b51c18','0x1b53488').replace('0x1b51ad8','0x1b53348')
start=s.index('    // The exact player has88')
end=s.index('\n}',start)
s=s[:start]+'''    // Exact RTTI and asset identity precede any fixture acquisition. The
    // Windblast equipment has its own native entity; no player vision manager.
    if(!member(p.entity,p.component,64))return false;
    p.instantiated=true;return true;'''+s[end:]
s=s.replace('||a.manager!=b.manager||a.managerFlags!=b.managerFlags','')
(P/'native_player_windblast_item.h').write_text(s)
print('Prepared exact Corvo-only Windblast item reader')
````

 foreach($r in 'host','client'){

  b=C.create_string_buffer(size);done=C.c_size_t()
  if not k.ReadProcessMemory(h,at,b,size,C.byref(done)) or done.value!=size:raise OSError(C.get_last_error(),hex(at))
````

## First paired native beam proof, v223

[v223 final receipt](../../work/natural-moveset/domino-beam-network-v223/result.json) passes twelve checks and completes checkpoint cleanup on candidate222. The receiver starts exactly two marks plus one native beam, uses source FX282 as its opaque incarnation and local FX442 on its owned Emily avatar, updates it91 times, and has zero beam refusals. Both endpoint positions are independently read back: start separation0.2499m and end separation0.000149m across sequential, non-simultaneous source/receiver queries. The native target moves on the stairs during this observation. These bounds verify position following; they do not measure fine temporal alignment or NPC synchronization.

Receiver ownership stops by700ms. Its native beam record is already gone at the first949ms fade query; remaining marks finish by2509ms. No slot restarts or transform updates occur after stop. Both inventories/player health/checkpoints restore and all14 protected hashes pass. [Candidate222 runtime evidence](../../work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-links-v222/runtime-verification.json) records this bounded functional acceptance.

**Visual limitation:** the source beam is visible, but the receiver camera's3.5m lateral offset landed inside level geometry near the stairs. Its inspected recording does not establish visual beam quality. This functional pass is retained with `visualAccepted:false`; v225 changes only the harness camera offset and repeats the checks. The beam starts after both native source casts and source placement settle, so this test does not prove cast-phase continuity through traversal. v218 separately covers standing native body/mark flow.

**AI-hold precision:** the existing movement fixture owns decision/reflex suspension references. It does not freeze all in-flight movement or animation: v223's second guard continued down the stairs after selection. This explains changing mark coordinates and is another reason not to infer shared NPC state from cosmetic beam replication. No additional NPC mutation was introduced by the beam implementation.
'''
f.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
````

## Native mark retirement and first bounded world proof, v204–v209

The initial v204 counter assertion incorrectly counted packets rejected before receiver playback became ready. v205 therefore compares counters with a captured ready-state baseline. v206 passes body/identity/position checks but fails a700ms effect-record removal assertion. Its inspected receiver video exposes the important remaining limitation: the mark follows source-world NPC coordinates even when the corresponding receiver NPC is elsewhere. No attachment or gameplay acceptance is claimed.

[v208 diagnostic](../../work/natural-moveset/domino-mark-retirement-v208/mark-stop-timeline.json) retains the original failed assertion and records the exact same receiver-owned FX ID2262 and frozen transform after700,1200 and2200ms, absent4200ms. Local ownership stops once; it is not a new/restarted mark. [Stop decompilation](../../work/ghidra-domino-stop-v207.json) and [particle stop](../../work/ghidra-domino-particle-stop-v208.json) distinguish stopping components from removing the manager ID record. Native1a31f0 calls223c20; particle220ca0 calls228080, which starts stop timing and clears flag0x4. Native1a3250 uses a conditional component stop instead.1a1880/1a1990 remove pending requests, not the effect-ID map itself. The existing stop routine is retained; no broader or unowned effect is deleted.

[Original FX export](../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports/domino-mark-fx-v207/manifest.json) confirms a looping native particle group and native stop sound. [Particle export](../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports/domino-mark-particles-v209/manifest.json) preserves its authored emission/lifetime data. Both use pinned Void read-only export and verify original indices. Exact recorded lifetime, rather than inferred asset semantics alone, determines the test bound.

[v209 final receipt](../../work/natural-moveset/domino-mark-fade-v209/result.json) passes11 checks after complete cleanup and process exit. Candidate203 sends the exact native mark incarnation through Steam, creates one receiver-owned native validated mark, maintains the source world transform, and recovers four body phases.68 continuity samples keep body weight1.0 with zero clock rejections. Receiver shutdown retires the local mark slot by700ms, freezes its transform, creates no further mark, and the native record disappears3272ms after the stop request. The source native mark remains independently alive until checkpoint cleanup. Both inventories/health and all14 protected save/settings hashes pass.

## Native beam reader confirmed, v221; network candidate222

The [v221 final receipt](../../work/natural-moveset/domino-link-clear-view-v221/result.json) passes ten checks with all477 connection snapshots valid and227 containing two directed edges plus exactly one beam. The independently observed beam start/end transforms match the selected native nodes and opening interpolation. [Pinned probe verification](../../work/movement-integration/probe-domino-links-v217/runtime-verification.json) records the actual results.

The inspected video shows the first marked guard upstairs, the native first-person cast beside the lower guard, and the persistent beam running up to the first target. The second source placement was grounded at61.0036469 before casting. Both inventories/checkpoints and fourteen protected hashes pass. v219 had instead looked into the balcony floor and correctly failed its second selection; its video remains indexed.

**Fixture qualification:** `observer_isolation.h` already holds decision/reflex references for five exact native NPCs during movement tests, including both tutorial guards. They are held at their positions when the fixture is enabled, which vary with setup timing. Earlier wording about patrol variation should be read as this run-start variation, not a claim that the guards remained autonomously patrolling throughout these captures. This does not prove active AI synchronization. No new NPC hold, relocation or spawn was added forv221; only the source player moved, with its stream disabled.

The [exported native link FX declaration](../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports/domino-beam-fx-v220/manifest.json), SHA256`13493613BF4D8B216365DB4E23F10C8B0FC763E04499AA328D8BB2E5C4BC5195`, contains a looping native particle link and a disabled validation layer. Its authored fade is not treated as proof of runtime record retirement. The original Steam indices/executable were hash checked around read-only Void export.

s=f.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')+'''
## Partner picker candidate, v211

[Native picker decompilation](../../work/ghidra-domino-picker-v210.json) identifies447250 as the candidate-return function.4478c0 calls it before comparing/replacing equipment+c8 and creating native aim FX. Returning null for the exact current co-op partner therefore uses the native no-target path, rather than the later insufficient-mana path447460. Other returned actors remain untouched. Native ranking and ray queries still run once. This does not choose enemies behind the excluded partner or modify the native candidate list.

Ghidra decompilation and raw bytes succeeded, but its disassembly/context endpoints returned empty/no instruction for these functions, and its xref index omitted the direct caller. [Read-only original-disk Capstone check](../../work/domino-picker-disk-disassembly-v211.json) independently confirms the exact executable hash,18 complete non-relative bytes at447250 and direct call4478e4. Capstone5.0.6 comes from the already bundled Ghidra wheel, extracted only to `work/tools/capstone-5.0.6-local`, with its wheel hash recorded. The Ghidra limitations are preserved rather than treating absent xrefs as absence of callers.

[Identity helper](../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/src/domino_partner_identity.h) checks current local Emily equipment, selected inventory slot, quantity, started flags, reciprocal component/entity registration, and the current registered partner generation before/after reading. [Synthetic tests](../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/src/domino_partner_identity_tests.h) cover ordinary guards, other components, inactive/deselected equipment, pending world changes and recycled/racing partner handles. The [native wrapper](../../outputs/d2-coop-lab/src/domino_partner_filter.h) calls the original picker exactly once, then returns null only for that proven identity. It leaves unrelated actors unchanged and records failures/costs. It does not invoke link or damage methods.

[Archived candidate211](../../work/movement-integration/candidate-domino-partner-v211/identity.json) passes identity tests and proxy smoke, with body44/bank47/world1 unchanged. The first isolated native partner capture is v212; runtime acceptance requires its final receipt and a separate normal-guard regression. Candidate creation alone is not proof.
'''

## Partner exclusion and native connection evidence, v212–v217

## work/movement-integration/record_reviewed_possession_take.py

````text
"""Index an already visually inspected Possession take without asserting completion.

The visual-review.json must be written from actual inspection before invoking.
Failed takes remain eligible as labelled evidence; they are never relabelled passes.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,json,hashlib,subprocess
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];P=R/'work/natural-moveset'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def write(p,v):p.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('take');p.add_argument('--label',required=True);p.add_argument('--notes',required=True);a=p.parse_args()
T=P/a.take;assert T.parent==P and T.is_dir()
r=read(T/'result.json');review=read(T/'visual-review.json');assert review['inspected'] and not review.get('complete')
videos=read(P/'runtime-video-manifest.json');ann=read(P/'review-evidence-annotations.json');item=ann['items']['corvo_possession_enter_loop_exit']
for suffix,role in [('', 'peer'),('-source','source')]:
 v=P/(a.take+suffix+'.mp4');info=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_entries','stream=avg_frame_rate','-of','json',str(v)],text=True));n,d=map(float,info['streams'][0]['avg_frame_rate'].split('/'))
 row=dict(video=v.name,character='corvo',label=f'Possession · {a.label} · {role}',alias='native_possession_lifecycle',requirements=['corvo_possession_enter_loop_exit'],gameplay_bound=False,complete=False,visual_accepted=False,evidence=f'{a.take}/result.json',visual_review=f'{a.take}/visual-review.json',proxy_sha256=r['dll'],actual_capture_hz=n/d,video_sha256=hashlib.sha256(v.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper(),checks_passed=r['passed'],scope=review['notes'])
 videos=[x for x in videos if x['video']!=v.name];videos.append(row);item.setdefault('native_integration',{})[v.name]=row
item['notes']=a.notes
write(P/'runtime-video-manifest.json',videos);write(P/'review-evidence-annotations.json',ann)
````

"""Index inspected native takes with source-only versus network scope explicit."""
import argparse,datetime,json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'natural-moveset'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
write=lambda p,v:p.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
def sha(p):
    with p.open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest().upper()
a=argparse.ArgumentParser();a.add_argument('take');a.add_argument('--source-only',action='store_true');a.add_argument('--notes',required=True);args=a.parse_args()
t=P/args.take;r=read(t/'result.json');now=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
sheets=['source-sheet.jpg'] if args.source_only else ['native-sheet.jpg','source-sheet.jpg']
assert all((t/x).exists() for x in sheets)
review=f'{args.take}/visual-review.json'
write(P/review,dict(inspected=True,at=now,method='Inspected actual-game temporal sheets',evidence=sheets,visual_accepted=False,complete=False,notes=args.notes))
videos=read(P/'runtime-video-manifest.json');added=[]
for suffix in ([''] if args.source_only else ['','-source']):
    video=f'{args.take}{suffix}.mp4';f=P/video;assert f.exists()
    meta=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_entries','stream=avg_frame_rate','-of','json',str(f)],text=True));n,d=map(float,meta['streams'][0]['avg_frame_rate'].split('/'))
    row=dict(video=video,character='corvo' if r['source']=='host' else 'emily',label=f'Native {"source observation" if args.source_only else "stun network"} · {args.take}{suffix}',alias='hit_react_stun' if 'stun' in args.take else 'grenade_air_observation' if '-air-' in args.take else 'grenade_crouch_observation',requirements=['hit_reactions_directions'] if 'stun' in args.take else ['grenade_equip_aim_throw'],gameplay_bound=bool(r['passed']) and not args.source_only,complete=False,visual_accepted=False,evidence=f'{args.take}/result.json',visual_review=review,proxy_sha256=r['dll'],actual_capture_hz=n/d,video_sha256=sha(f),checks_passed=r['passed'],scope=r['scope'])
    videos=[x for x in videos if x['video']!=video];videos.append(row);added.append(row)
````

raw=p.read_bytes();s=raw.decode('utf-8',errors='surrogateescape')
if any(0xdc80<=ord(c)<=0xdcff for c in s):
 backup=W/'movement-integration/chapter31-before-encoding-repair-v315.bin'
 if not backup.exists():backup.write_bytes(raw)
 s=''.join(bytes([ord(c)-0xdc00]).decode('cp1252') if 0xdc80<=ord(c)<=0xdcff else c for c in s)
heading='## Candidate315: native summon effect verified in both instances'
````

$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$expected=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe'
$observed=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "name = 'Dishonored2.exe'")
foreach($role in 'host','client') {
    $profile=(Join-Path $root "work/lab-instances/$role").Replace('\','/')
    $matches=@($observed|Where-Object {$_.ExecutablePath -eq $expected -and $_.CommandLine.Contains($profile)})
    if($matches.Count -ne 1){throw "Expected exactly one actual isolated $role process"}
    $process=Get-Process -Id $matches[0].ProcessId
    $file=Join-Path $root "work/lab-instances/$role/launch.json"
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $file -Destination (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "$role-sandbox-launch.json")
    $launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath $file -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
    $launch.pid=$process.Id;$launch.startedAt=$process.StartTime.ToString('o')
    $launch|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath $file
    [pscustomobject]@{Role=$role;Pid=$process.Id;Responding=$process.Responding;StatusUpdated=(Get-Item (Join-Path $root "work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json")).LastWriteTime}
}

  $s|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/after-$r.json"

"""Withdraw collision-only experiment after the user's explicit scope correction."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime, hashlib, json, shutil
R = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
W = R / 'work/movement-integration'
L = R / 'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
A = W / 'candidate-possession-partner-v374'
E = W / 'candidate-partner-collision-v380'
receipt = W / 'native-collision-restoration-v383.json'
assert not receipt.exists(), 'Already prepared; inspect receipt instead of replaying'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
identity = json.loads((A / 'identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert identity['dll'] == sha(A / 'dinput8.dll') == 'AD06C1A322AD45C7A511A1D74AB1058156F87DC527041F36CB82C894D6500BF2'
assert identity['probe'] == sha(A / 'd2_runtime_probe.exe')
for name in ('engine_bridge.cpp', 'world_identity_tests.cpp'):
    assert sha(L/'src'/name) == sha(E/'src'/name), 'Preserve unrecognized newer edits'
for name in ('partner_collision_identity.h', 'partner_collision_identity_tests.h', 'partner_collision_filter.h'):
    assert sha(L/'src'/name) == sha(E/'src'/name), 'Research must remain archived'
for name in ('engine_bridge.cpp', 'world_identity_tests.cpp'):
    shutil.copy2(A/'src'/name, L/'src'/name)

## work/movement-integration/save_air_bookmark_v164.py

[save_air_bookmark_v164.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/save_air_bookmark_v164.py>)

````text
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('work/handoff-project-bookmarks-current.json')
a=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
b={"address":"141c80ed8","category":"D2Coop/Mesmerize-air-v163","comment":"CONFIRMED exact B671F824 source observations: v151 armed Emily Jump2/Fall3 + UsePower63 holds Mesmerize aim loop (1200ms). v161 early LT release: Jump2-only and Fall3-only overlap exact out666ms; same reciprocal left arm67225, peak1.4026m, same-floor recovery. v163 A+LT entry: two Jump2+UsePower63/in466ms samples then Fall3+UsePower63/loop1200ms; peak1.4415m. Raw Midnight then state reads differ16–31ms, corroborated across adjacent rows and actual-game video. All source cleanup checks pass. This generic UsePower vtable alone does NOT authorize an action: exact owned selected Mesmerize item, scene incarnation/phase and left-arm bindings remain necessary. Empty-hand air and remote air integration are not proven by these observations.","type":"Note"}
a=[v for v in a if not (v.get('address')==b['address'] and v.get('category')==b['category'])]
a.append(b)
p.write_text(json.dumps(a,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(len(a))
````

## work/movement-integration/save_low_mantle_milestone.py

[save_low_mantle_milestone.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/save_low_mantle_milestone.py>)

````text
import json,hashlib,shutil,datetime
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;ROOT=P.parent.parent;N=ROOT/'work/natural-moveset';SRC=ROOT/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
dll=ROOT/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll';digest=sha(dll);assert digest=='5830AE3E10EE6AC802D4BFD7C14AEB6096555ECC766F19C4DC061A308D4BA390'
tests=['low-mantle-v6-recovery-test','low-mantle-v12-priority']
for t in tests:assert read(N/t/'result.json')['passed']
for f in read(P/'protected-save-hashes-before-v4.json'):assert sha(Path(f['Path']))==f['Hash']
out=P/'verified-low-mantle-5830';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir();shutil.copytree(SRC,out/'src');shutil.copy2(dll,out/'dinput8.dll');shutil.copytree(N/'low-mantle-banks-v2',out/'banks')
for name in ('build_low_mantle_bank.py','build_low_mantle_contact.py','low-mantle-bank-manifest-v2.json','Test-LowMantle.ps1','Record-IntegratedStance.ps1'):shutil.copy2(N/name,out/name)
for t in tests:shutil.copytree(N/t,out/t)
facts=dict(dll_sha256=digest,bank_format='D2MOVE12 / 113 clips',action_protocol='10 / 208 bytes',tests=tests,checks=29,complete=False,visual_accepted=False,protected_saves_unchanged=True,
 binding='Observed mantle_low_idle Scene_1 500 ms. Exactly one actual player plus optional owned right arm. Owned sword_equip_fast binds only right arm; both roles observed, 500 ms each.',

 }
 C host "setviewpos $X $Y $Z $Yaw 0";Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1000
 & "$root/work/natural-moveset/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role host -Pitch 12 -Evidence "$out/camera.json"
 $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/host/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$window=(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).MainWindowHandle.ToInt64()
 & ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -nostdin -f lavfi -i "gfxcapture=hwnd=${window}:capture_cursor=0:max_framerate=10:width=-2:height=-2,hwdownload,format=bgra" -frames:v 1 "$out/view.png"

## work/movement-integration/summarize_combat_timing.py

[summarize_combat_timing.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/summarize_combat_timing.py>)

````text
import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
folder=root/'work/natural-moveset/native-combat-timing-v1'
rows=json.loads((folder/'states.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
groups={}
for row in rows:
    key=(row['role'],row['trial'])
    out=groups.setdefault(key,{'role':key[0],'trial':key[1],'scenes':{},'flags':[]})
    for scene in row['midnight']['instances']:
        asset=scene.get('asset','')
        if '/player/base/combat/' not in asset: continue
        sid=str(scene['id'])
        entry=out['scenes'].setdefault(sid,{'asset':asset,'subscene':scene.get('subscene'),'duration':scene.get('sceneDurationMs'),'first_ms':row['ms'],'last_ms':row['ms'],'state':[],'clock_min':scene['clockWords'][0],'clock_max':scene['clockWords'][0]})
        entry['last_ms']=row['ms']
        if scene['state'] not in entry['state']:entry['state'].append(scene['state'])
        entry['clock_min']=min(entry['clock_min'],scene['clockWords'][0]);entry['clock_max']=max(entry['clock_max'],scene['clockWords'][0])
    for state in row['native']['active']:
        if 'slashResearch' in state:
            flags=state['slashResearch']['flags_d0_db']
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'natural-moveset'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for stance,ground in [('crouched',6),('standing',0)]:
 t=P/f'domino-holstered-{stance}-final-observe-v263'
 if not(t/'result.json').exists():continue
 result=read(t/'result.json');raw=read(t/'crouched-final-raw-proof.json');rows=read(t/'states.json')
 assert result['passed'] and all(not x['sword']['equipped']for x in rows)
 final=[]
 for x in rows:
  for scene in x['midnight']['instances']:
   if scene.get('state')==3 and scene.get('subscene')=='Cast_final_Select':
    final.append(dict(timeMs=scene['clockWords'][1],durationMs=scene['sceneDurationMs'],states=[a['id']for a in x['player']['active']],holstered=not x['sword']['equipped'],scene=scene))
 assert len(raw)>=8 and all(x['sceneDurationMs']==400 for x in raw)
 assert all(len(x['bindingsResearch'])==2 and all(b['reciprocal']for b in x['bindingsResearch'])for x in raw)
 out=dict(take=t.name,stance=stance,holstered=True,rawFinalSamples=len(raw),rawClockMs=[min(x['clockWords'][1]for x in raw),max(x['clockWords'][1]for x in raw)],independentFinalRows=final,groundState=ground,passed=result['passed'],complete=False,scope='Native source provenance. Independent state/scene probes are sequential, not atomic. Reader must keep reciprocal ownership, equipment rereads, exact ground state and400ms bound. No peer proof in this observation.')
 (t/'final-context-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items()if k not in ('independentFinalRows','scope')}|{'independentFinalStates':[{k:v for k,v in x.items()if k!='scene'}for x in final]}))
````

## work/movement-integration/Test-NativeSetupSkip-v680.ps1

[Test-NativeSetupSkip-v680.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/Test-NativeSetupSkip-v680.ps1>)

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));Set-Location $root
$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'native-setup-skip-v680';$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$failure=$null;$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$pids=@{}
function S($r){for($i=0;$i-lt10;$i++){try{return(Get-Content "work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if($LASTEXITCODE){throw "Probe failed $mode"};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
function Snapshot{
 $rows=@{}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){$s=S $r;$rows[$r]=@{state=$s;character=(Q $r '--character');inventory=(Q $r '--player-inventory');playerStates=(Q $r '--player-states');health=(Q $r '--health' 1);partnerHealth=(Q $r '--health' $s.probeActorHandle)}}
 return $rows
}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Native operation active'}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){$l=Get-Content "work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid}
 $before=Snapshot;$before|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 15|Set-Content "$out/before-full-playback-baseline.json"
 $watch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
 & "$root/work/PrepareShadowSword.ps1" -EvidencePath "$out/skip-receipt.json" *> "$out/reset.log"
 $elapsed=$watch.ElapsedMilliseconds;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1200
 $after=Snapshot;$after|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 15|Set-Content "$out/after-native-skip.json"
 $receipt=Get-Content "$out/skip-receipt.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
````

      CoopMesmerizeWorldPacket m{};m.sequence=1;m.sourceSession=22;m.targetSession=11;m.sourceWorldEpoch=7;m.targetWorldEpoch=3;m.mapId=99;m.sourceToken=9;m.targetToken=4;m.event=1;m.sampleTimeUs=1000000;m.rootSequence=99;m.nativeHandle=0xc881200;m.state=1;m.transform={-33,-155,66,1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1};
      check(validMesmerizeWorldPacket(m,h,c),"Mesmerize exact Emily world cosmetic scope");
      auto bad=m;bad.role=0;check(!validMesmerizeWorldPacket(bad,h,c),"Corvo cannot author Mesmerize world");

      bad=m;bad.state=0;check(!validMesmerizeWorldPacket(bad,h,c),"Preview or unknown Mesmerize state refused");
      bad=m;bad.nativeHandle=0x3fff0010;check(!validMesmerizeWorldPacket(bad,h,c),"Absent handle cannot create Mesmerize");
      bad=m;bad.reserved=1;check(!validMesmerizeWorldPacket(bad,h,c),"Unknown Mesmerize semantics refused");
      MesmerizeWorldOrder order;check(order.accept(m)&&!order.accept(m),"Mesmerize incarnation starts once");
      auto loop=m;loop.sequence++;loop.sampleTimeUs+=100000;loop.state=3;
      MesmerizeWorldOrder orphan;check(!orphan.accept(loop),"Orphan active object cannot spawn");check(order.accept(loop),"Native active state follows spawn");
      bad=loop;bad.sequence++;bad.sampleTimeUs+=100000;bad.nativeHandle++;check(!order.accept(bad),"Handle replacement inside same event refused");
      bad=loop;bad.sequence++;bad.sampleTimeUs+=100000;bad.state=1;check(!order.accept(bad),"Active world cannot replay spawn");
      bad=loop;bad.sequence++;bad.sampleTimeUs+=100000;bad.transform[0]+=.03f;check(!order.accept(bad),"Static world anchor cannot drift");

````text
"""Bounded Dunwall contact study. Roots/events stay outside the pose bank."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['library-retarget-manifest.json'],'crouch-mantle-sources-v1')
OUT=P/'crouch-mantle-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
observed=read(P/'native-traversal-variants-corvo-v1/states.json')
samples=[];height=span=0
for r in observed:
 if r['trial']!='crouch-normal' or not any(a['id']==8 for a in r['state']['active']):continue
 s=r['state'];a=next(a for a in s['active'] if a['id']==8)['mantleResearch'];scene=next(v for v in r['midnight']['instances'] if v['id']==a['scene24']);delta=Vector(a['goalBc'])-Vector(a['startE8']);h=Vector((delta.x,delta.y,0));unit=h.normalized();pos=Vector(s['position'])-Vector(a['startE8']);height=delta.z;span=h.length
 samples.append((min(499,scene['clockWords'][0])/500,pos.dot(unit),pos.z))
samples=[(0,0,0)]+sorted(dict((v[0],v)for v in samples).values())+[(1,span,height)]
def trajectory(t):
 for a,b in zip(samples,samples[1:]):
  if a[0]<=t<=b[0]:
   w=(t-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]);return Vector((a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*w,0,a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*w))
 raise ValueError(t)
````

## work/movement-integration/verified-darkvision-D01C/build_darkvision_bank_v1.py

[build_darkvision_bank_v1.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-darkvision-D01C/build_darkvision_bank_v1.py>)

````text
"""Append the authored whole-body Dark Vision cast; native source owns time/VFX."""
import sys, struct, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['power-retarget-manifest-v1.json'],'darkvision-sources-v1')
OUT=P/'darkvision-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'keyhole-banks-v2'/f'{role}-keyhole-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data)
 assert magic==b'D2MOVE24' and count==193
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE25',25,n,194,fps,layout)+data[32:])
 rig=rig_for(role);grip=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+24+j*28))for j in range(n)]
 fingers=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
  while k>=0 and k!=16:k=rig.joints[k]['parent']
  if k==16 and j!=16 and 'helper'not in rig.joints[j]['nativeName']:fingers.append(j)
 m,fs=L.load(role,'power_dark_vision_fire')
````

## work/movement-integration/verified-darkvision-D01C/Send-D2Command.ps1

[Send-D2Command.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-darkvision-D01C/Send-D2Command.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_movement_resume|coop_movement_feet|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_power_fixture|coop_darkvision_fixture|coop_agility_fixture|coop_power_fx|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

## work/movement-integration/verified-darkvision-ground-96C1/Send-D2Command.ps1

[Send-D2Command.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-darkvision-ground-96C1/Send-D2Command.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_movement_resume|coop_movement_feet|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_power_fixture|coop_darkvision_fixture|coop_agility_fixture|coop_power_fx|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

## work/movement-integration/verified-equipment-0E32/build_equipment_bank.py

[build_equipment_bank.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-equipment-0E32/build_equipment_bank.py>)

````text
"""Native unarmed directions and body-relative sword contact, event-free v9 bank."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['library-retarget-manifest.json','unarmed-retarget-manifest.json','stance-retarget-manifest.json'],'equipment-bank-sources-v3')
OUT=P/'equipment-banks-v3';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
attachment=read(P/'native-shadow-equipment-v6/samples.json')
contacts={}
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'combat-banks-v1'/f'{role}-combat-bank.bin').read_bytes();magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE08' and count==59
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE09',9,n,89,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28;rig=rig_for(role);sources=[]
 def previous(cid):return [[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+cid*entry+24+(f*n+j)*28))for j in range(n)]for f in range(121)]
 def write(cid,fs,stride=0,angle=0):
  assert len(fs)==121;bank.extend(struct.pack('<IIIIff',cid,121,0,0,stride,angle))
  for f in fs:
   assert max(abs(f[j][a][b]-float(a==b))for j in (0,1)for a in range(4)for b in range(4))<1e-6
   assert max((f[j].translation-rig.bind[j].translation).length for j in range(3,27)if j!=17)<1e-5
   for m in f:bank.extend(struct.pack('<7f',*row(m)))
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````
