## work/movement-integration/verified-low-mantle-5830/build_low_mantle_bank.py

[build_low_mantle_bank.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-low-mantle-5830/build_low_mantle_bank.py>)

````text
"""Isolated first native-timed mantle; roots/events remain absent."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['library-retarget-manifest.json'],'low-mantle-sources-v1')
OUT=P/'low-mantle-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'vertical-peek-banks-v1'/f'{role}-vertical-peek-bank.bin').read_bytes();magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE11' and count==111
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE12',12,n,113,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28;rig=rig_for(role)
 # The player has already jumped when Mantle takes over. Omit the donor's
 # preliminary approach steps, preserving its complete climb and tuck.
 m,donor=L.load(role,'sword_mantlelow_walkleft_in');start=10;assert m['fps']==30 and len(donor)==31
 empty=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+59*entry+24+j*28))for j in range(n)]
 hand=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
  while k>=0 and k!=16:k=rig.joints[k]['parent']
  if k==16 and 'helper'not in rig.joints[j]['nativeName']:hand.append(j)
 sources=[]
````

## work/movement-integration/verified-low-mantle-5830/build_low_mantle_contact.py

[build_low_mantle_contact.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-low-mantle-5830/build_low_mantle_contact.py>)

````text
"""Bounded Dunwall contact study. Roots/events stay outside the pose bank."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['library-retarget-manifest.json'],'low-mantle-sources-v2')
OUT=P/'low-mantle-banks-v2';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
observed=read(P/'low-mantle-v3-test/states.json')
samples=[];height=span=0
for r in observed:
 if r['source']!='host' or not r['armed'] or r['trial']!=1 or not r['native'].get('traversalSceneValid'):continue
 s=r['native'];a=s['active'][0]['mantleResearch'];delta=Vector(a['goalBc'])-Vector(a['startE8']);h=Vector((delta.x,delta.y,0));unit=h.normalized();pos=Vector(s['position'])-Vector(a['startE8']);height=delta.z;span=h.length
 samples.append((s['traversalScene']['timeMs']/500,pos.dot(unit),pos.z))
samples=[(0,0,0)]+samples+[(1,span,height)]
def trajectory(t):
 for a,b in zip(samples,samples[1:]):
  if a[0]<=t<=b[0]:
   w=(t-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]);return Vector((a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*w,0,a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*w))
 raise ValueError(t)
````

````text
"""Index read-only native references without claiming remote animation playback."""
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;ROOT=P.parent.parent
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
def write(p,value):
    temp=p.with_suffix(p.suffix+'.tmp');temp.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');temp.replace(p)
manifest=read(P/'runtime-video-manifest.json');cases={}
for character in ['corvo','emily']:
    take=f'native-carry-{character}-reader-v2';folder=P/take;result=read(folder/'result.json')
    assert result['passed'] and not result['remote_gameplay_bound'] and not result['visual_accepted']
    assert result['video_sha256']==sha(folder/'native.mp4') and result['actual_capture_hz']>=24
    review=read(folder/'source-review.json');assert review['inspected'] and not review['remote_visual_accepted']
    assert review['sheet_sha256']==sha(folder/'native-sheet.png')
    video=take+'/native.mp4'
    row=dict(video=video,character=character,label=character.title()+' · Native carry source reference · remote binding pending',alias='native_carry_source_reference',native_source_only=True,
             actual_capture_hz=result['actual_capture_hz'],timing='Actual elapsed capture timing; no speedup',travelling=False,gameplay_bound=False,visual_accepted=False,
             scope='Original first-person native pickup, standing/crouched carrying and release. Validates scene ownership and timing for the future remote port. This recording does not show the authored remote movement or synchronized corpse attachment.',
             requirements=['carry_body_lift_idle_move_drop_throw'],evidence=take+'/result.json',source_review=take+'/source-review.json',proxy_sha256=result['identity']['proxySha256'],probe_sha256=result['identity']['probeSha256'])
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-power-fixture-v1',[ValidateSet('host','client')][string[]]$Sources=@('host','client'),[ValidateSet('cancel','expire','pause')][string]$Mode='cancel')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null
$pids=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function InputState($r,$button='Neutral') {& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs 180|Out-Null}
function Probe($r,$mode,$id=0){for($i=0;$i-lt12;$i++){$raw=if($id){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50};throw "Native read $r $mode"}
function State($r,$suffix='.power-fixture.json'){return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
function AwaitResult($r,$result,$ms=6000){$w=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();do{$s=State $r;$rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{role=$r;ms=$w.ElapsedMilliseconds;state=$s});if($s.result-eq$result){return $s};if($s.lost){throw "Power fixture cleanup lost: $($s.result)"};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 60}while($w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt$ms);throw "Power fixture deadline: $($s.result)"}
$protected=Get-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/protected-save-hashes-before-v4.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
try{
 foreach($f in $protected){if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.Path).Hash-ne$f.Hash){throw 'Protected save differs'}}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){$l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;InputState $r;C $r 'coop_movement_bank off';C $r 'coop_shadow_stream off';C $r 'coop_movement_fixture off';C $r 'coop_power_fixture off'}
 foreach($r in $Sources){
  $peer=if($r-eq'host'){'client'}else{'host'};$before=Probe $r '--player-power';$inventory=Probe $r '--player-inventory';$sword=Probe $r '--player-sword';$health=Probe $r '--health' 1
  $before|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content "$out/$r-before.json";$inventory|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6|Set-Content "$out/$r-inventory-before.json"
  if($before.quantity-ne0-or$before.equipped-or$before.started){throw 'Baseline power is not unavailable'}
  $s=State $r;C $r 'coop_power_fixture 20000';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400;$refused=State $r
  if($refused.active-or$refused.refused-ne($s.refused+1)){throw 'Unisolated fixture did not refuse'};$checks.Add("${r}: grant refused outside NPC-isolated scope")
  C $r 'coop_movement_fixture 60000';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600;C $r 'coop_power_fixture 20000';$ready=AwaitResult $r 'native_power_ready'
````

## work/movement-integration/verified-remote-muzzle-BD99-v1/build_remote_muzzle_v1.py

[build_remote_muzzle_v1.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-remote-muzzle-BD99-v1/build_remote_muzzle_v1.py>)

````text
"""Derive a reversible remote-only native muzzle with a shorter streak layer."""
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from inspect_midnight_events import parse

P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LAB = P.parents[1] / 'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
particle = LAB / 'research/asset-exports/ranged-muzzle-particle-comparison-v1/game1_patch/generated.decls.particledt.models.effects.weapons.gun.muzzle_1p..particledt.decl'
fx_dir = LAB / 'research/asset-exports/ranged-muzzle-fx-reference-v1/game1_patch'
dest = LAB / 'assets/ranged-muzzle-presentation-v1-source'
dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
text = particle.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
before = parse(text)
start = text.index('\n\t\t\titem[5] = {')
end = text.index('\n\t\t\titem[6] = {', start)
stage = text[start:end]
assert 'm_name = "sparkyStreaks";' in stage
````

## work/movement-integration/verified-unarmed-DD5D/build_unarmed_special_bank.py

[build_unarmed_special_bank.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-unarmed-DD5D/build_unarmed_special_bank.py>)

````text
"""Restore the hands-free donor motion for sprint, lean, slide and airborne.

Keeps the verified v9 payload unchanged. All roots remain identity, animation
events are absent, and anatomical translations stay native. No game writes.
"""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['dynamics-retarget-manifest.json','mixamo-dynamic-retarget-manifest.json','mixamo-jump-retarget-manifest.json','library-retarget-manifest.json','jumps-retarget-manifest-v2.json'],'unarmed-special-sources-v1')
OUT=P/'unarmed-special-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'equipment-banks-v3'/f'{role}-equipment-bank.bin').read_bytes();magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE09' and count==89
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE10',10,n,107,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28;rig=rig_for(role);sources=[]
 def previous(cid):return [[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+cid*entry+24+(f*n+j)*28))for j in range(n)]for f in range(121)]
 def metadata(cid):return struct.unpack_from('<ff',data,32+cid*entry+16)
 def emit(cid,poses,alias,source):
  assert len(poses)==121
  poses[-1]=copy_pose(poses[0]);stride,angle=metadata(cid-63);bank.extend(struct.pack('<IIIIff',cid,121,0,0,stride,angle))
````

````text
function Status($r,$suffix=''){for($i=0;$i-lt8;$i++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}

function Collect($src,$dst,$label,$ms){
 $samples=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$watch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
 while($watch.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt$ms){
  $m=Status $dst '.movement.json';$s=Status $dst '.shadow-stream.json'
  if(!$m.active-or$m.version-ne10-or!$s.ready-or!$s.armed){throw "Presentation retired during $label"}
  if(!(Status $src '.observer-isolation.json').ready-or!(Status $dst '.observer-isolation.json').ready){throw 'Fixture retired'}
  $base=Status $src;$row=[pscustomobject]@{source=$src;label=$label;ms=$watch.ElapsedMilliseconds;movement=$m;stream=$s;nativeMotion=$base.localPlayerMotion;sourcePosition=$base.localPosition;observerPosition=(Status $dst).localPosition};$samples.Add($row);$rows.Add($row);Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 35
 }
 $sword=Q $dst '--avatar-sword' $handles[$dst]
 if($sword.equipped-or$sword.started){throw "Weaponless action $label redrew remote sword"}
 return $samples
}
````

## work/movement-integration/verified-vault-B1CB/build_vault_bank.py

[build_vault_bank.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-vault-B1CB/build_vault_bank.py>)

````text
"""Pose-only native vault sequence; replicated native geometry owns root travel."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['library-retarget-manifest.json'],'vault-bank-sources-v1')
OUT=P/'vault-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[];liftCurves=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'crouch-mantle-banks-v1'/f'{role}-low-mantle-bank.bin').read_bytes();magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE13' and count==115
 entry=24+121*n*28;bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE14',14,n,117,fps,layout)+data[32:]);rig=rig_for(role)
 mi,fi=L.load(role,'sword_vaultthrough_walkleft_in');mo,fo=L.load(role,'sword_vaultthrough_walk_out')
 # The native traversal takes ~450ms across its start/end planes. Retain the
 # donor's compression, support, clearance and landing, cropping its long
 # walking approach and walking recovery. No extra gameplay root is written.
 frames=fi[9:]+fo[1:15];roots=mi['root_track'][9:]+[row(qts(mi['root_track'][-1])@qts(r))for r in mo['root_track'][1:15]]
 hand=[]
 for j in range(n):
  k=j
  while k>=0 and k!=16:k=rig.joints[k]['parent']
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,[switch]$WaitConsumed)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tooling/Publish-D2Packet.ps1')
if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_movement_resume|coop_movement_feet|coop_review_clip|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_shadow_equipment|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_movement_fixture|coop_power_fixture|coop_darkvision_fixture|coop_windblast_fixture|coop_agility_fixture|coop_power_fx|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

[Build-D2WindblastPresentationAssets.ps1](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-windblast-crouch-fx-EACA/Build-D2WindblastPresentationAssets.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Install)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core'){throw 'Requires PowerShell 7.'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$game=Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game'
$steam='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Dishonored2'
$package=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'assets/windblast-presentation-v1'
$stage=Join-Path $root 'work/windblast-presentation-install-stage-v1'
$expectedExe='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
function Assert-LocalPath([string]$Path) {
 $full=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
 if(!$full.StartsWith($root+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw "Outside project: $full"}
 for($p=[IO.DirectoryInfo]::new($full);$p -and $p.FullName.Length -ge $root.Length;$p=$p.Parent){
  if($p.Exists -and ($p.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)){throw "Reparse point: $($p.FullName)"}
 }
}
foreach($p in @($game,(Join-Path $game 'base'),$package,$stage)){Assert-LocalPath $p}
if((Get-FileHash "$game/Dishonored2.exe").Hash -ne $expectedExe){throw 'Wrong isolated executable.'}
if($Install -and (Get-Process -Name Dishonored2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Path -eq "$game\Dishonored2.exe")){throw 'Close isolated asset instances before installation.'}
````

## work/movement-integration/verified-windblast-crouch-fx-EACA/build_windblast_contexts_v1.py

[build_windblast_contexts_v1.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/verified-windblast-crouch-fx-EACA/build_windblast_contexts_v1.py>)

````text
"""Whole-body stance/equipment adaptations, preserving native lengths and feet."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['windblast-source-manifest-v1.json'],'windblast-contexts-v1')
OUT=P/'windblast-context-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'windblast-banks-v1'/f'{role}-windblast-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE27'and count==198
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE28',28,n,201,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28
 rig=rig_for(role);m,fs=L.load(role,'native_phase_windblast_fire');reference=fs[0];rg=rig.fk(reference)
 right=[]
 for i in range(n):
  k=i
  while k>=0 and k!=16:k=rig.joints[k]['parent']
  if k==16 and i!=16 and 'helper'not in rig.joints[i]['nativeName']:right.append(i)
 clips=[]
 for cid,restid,crouched,armed in ((198,59,False,False),(199,17,True,True),(200,76,True,False)):
  rest=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+restid*entry+24+j*28))for j in range(n)];cg=rig.fk(rest)
````

## work/movement-integration/verify_knee_pole.py

[verify_knee_pole.py](<../../../work/movement-integration/verify_knee_pole.py>)

````text
"""Check actual D2 publication before/after the authored knee-plane correction.

Phase2 is the native terrain solution; phase3 is the final corrected skeleton.
This does not replace the existing flat-ground ankle or visual acceptance test.
"""
import argparse,json,math
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('folder',type=Path);p.add_argument('--min-poses',type=int,default=5);a=p.parse_args()
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
dot=lambda a,b:sum(x*y for x,y in zip(a,b))
sub=lambda a,b:[x-y for x,y in zip(a,b)]
norm=lambda a:math.sqrt(dot(a,a))
def pole_error(ref,actual,hip):
 axis=sub(actual[hip+2][12:15],actual[hip][12:15]);axis=[x/norm(axis)for x in axis]
 out=[]
 for poses in (ref,actual):
  knee=sub(poses[hip+1][12:15],poses[hip][12:15]);d=dot(knee,axis);v=[x-d*y for x,y in zip(knee,axis)];n=norm(v)
  if n<.005:return None
  out.append([x/n for x in v])
 return math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1,min(1,dot(*out)))))
````

````text
"""Validate captured native phase data, independent of animation implementation.

Flat-floor mode checks that native IK preserves authored leg swing and bone
lengths. Stair mode checks anatomy while allowing necessary terrain correction.
These are structural checks; actual game footage remains required.
"""
import argparse,json,math
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('folder',type=Path);p.add_argument('--stairs',action='store_true');a=p.parse_args()
read=lambda path:json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
result=read(a.folder/'result.json');assert result['failure']is None,result['failure']
rows=[]
for file in a.folder.glob('pose-*.json'):
 s=read(file);assert s['stable']and s['finalPublicationComplete']
 phases={x['phase']:{m['joint']:m['matrix']for m in x['matrices']}for x in s['phases']}
 before,after=phases[0],phases[3];pelvis=[after[2][12+k]-before[2][12+k]for k in range(3)]
 length_error=0.;swing_error=0.;rotation_error=0.;ankle_error=0.
 for i in range(19,27):
  parent=s['joints'][i]['parent']
  length_error=max(length_error,abs(math.dist(before[i][12:15],before[parent][12:15])-math.dist(after[i][12:15],after[parent][12:15])))
````

````text
"""Inspect generated displacement and find comparable left-contact cycle cuts."""
import json,math
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix,Quaternion,Vector
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
report=[]
for file in sorted((P/'donors').glob('*.json')):
    d=json.loads(file.read_text());fs=d['frames'];names=d['names'];root=Matrix.Identity(4);track=[]
    for f in fs:
        track.append(root.copy());a=f['root_delta']
        root=root@Matrix.LocRotScale(Vector(a[:3]),Quaternion((a[6],*a[3:6])),Vector(a[7:10]))
    delta=track[360].translation-track[120].translation
    intended=Vector((math.sin(math.radians(d['request']['angle'])),math.cos(math.radians(d['request']['angle'])),0))
    travel=delta.length*.01;alignment=delta.normalized().dot(intended) if delta.length>.001 else None
    joints=[names.index(n) for n in ('pelvis','spine_01','spine_05','thigh_l','calf_l','foot_l','thigh_r','calf_r','foot_r')]
    def score(a,b):
        total=0
        for j in joints:
            qa=fs[a]['local'][j][3:7];qb=fs[b]['local'][j][3:7]
            dot=min(1,abs(sum(x*y for x,y in zip(qa,qb))))
````

````text
source=source.replace("self.solve(local,14,15,16,self.hand.translation,Vector((.02,-.64,1.2)));self.orient(local,16,self.hand.to_3x3())",
 "g=self.fk(local);delta=g[5]@self.chest.inverted();hand=delta@self.hand;pole=delta@Vector((.02,-.64,1.2))\n  self.solve(local,14,15,16,hand.translation,pole);self.orient(local,16,hand.to_3x3())")
source=source.replace("goal=root.inverted()@world.lerp", "offset=self.locks[side]-world\n    if offset.length>.10:self.locks[side]=world+offset.normalized()*.10\n    goal=root.inverted()@world.lerp")

  for n,f in enumerate(donor['frames'][:301]):
   q=f['feedback_rotation'];raw=-math.atan2(2*q[3]*q[2],1-2*q[2]*q[2]);yaw+=(raw-last_yaw+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi;last_yaw=raw
````

````text
 report.append({'take':take,'output':name+'.mp4','frames':len(rows),'capture_hz':(len(rows)-1)*1000/(rows[-1]['time']-rows[0]['time']),'container_fps':30,'timing':'Original screenshot intervals retained; no speedup'})
````

````text
 recovery='Protected SLOT81 fixtures reloaded; Mayhew native scene completed without speedup; restored-walk-result.json passes on both post-reload clone incarnations.'))
````

````text
"""Produce independent seeded locomotion donors using the proven native evaluator.

Only evaluated pose/root/contact data is saved. No native D2 files or sample
assets are changed. Directional/loop suitability is assessed after generation.
"""
import json, math, pathlib, unreal

P=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=P/'donors';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
FPS=60
CONTROLLER='/AnimGenExample/Characters/UEFN_Mannequin/Animations/AGC_AnimGenCharacter'
MESH='/AnimGenExample/Characters/UEFN_Mannequin/Meshes/SKM_UEFN_Mannequin'
actors=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem)
directions=[('forward',0),('forward_left',45),('left',90),('back_left',135),('back',180),('back_right',-135),('right',-90),('forward_right',-45)]
cases=[{'name':'idle','speed':0,'angle':0,'turn':0}]
for gait,speed in (('walk',100),('run',300),('sprint',500)):
    for direction,angle in directions:
        cases.append({'name':gait+'_'+direction,'speed':speed,'angle':angle,'turn':0})
for turn in (-180,-90,90,180):
    cases.append({'name':'turn_'+('left' if turn>0 else 'right')+'_'+str(abs(turn)),'speed':0,'angle':0,'turn':turn})
````

## work/moveset-growth/index_fullbody_sources.py

[index_fullbody_sources.py](<../../../work/moveset-growth/index_fullbody_sources.py>)

````text
"""Read existing Void exports; candidates only, never an autoplay allowlist."""
import json,re,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root=P.parent.parent/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports'
entries=[];seen=set()
for path in root.rglob('*.decl'):
 if '.animset.' not in path.name:continue
 text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');sk=re.search(r'\bskeleton\s+"([^"]+)"',text)
 if not sk or not any(s in sk[1] for s in ('base_tall','base_female')):continue
 for alias,asset in re.findall(r'alias\s*\{\s*name\s+"([^"]+)"\s+anim\s+"([^"]+)"',text):
  if (sk[1],alias,asset) in seen:continue
  seen.add((sk[1],alias,asset))
  families=[family for family,pattern in [('running','run|sprint'),('turning','turn'),('traversal','jump|fall|land|climb|vault|ladder|slide|swim'),('stance','crouch|sneak|undertable|lean'),('combat','attack|parry|dodge|hit|block'),('paired','assass|choke|fatality')] if re.search(pattern,alias,re.I)]
  if not families:continue
  # Event names present in the source set are warnings for a later clip-specific
  # audit, not evidence that this alias necessarily dispatches every event.
  event_names=sorted(set(re.findall(r'\bevent\s+"([^"]+)"',text)))
  entries.append(dict(alias=alias,asset=asset,skeleton=sk[1],role_candidate='corvo' if 'base_tall' in sk[1] else 'emily',families=families,
    source=str(path.relative_to(P.parent.parent)),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),set_event_names=event_names,
````

````text
"""Keep original screenshot times; 30fps container does not imply 30Hz capture."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
report=[]
for take,name in [('corvo-video-1','corvo-walking'),('emily-video-2','emily-walking')]:
 rows=json.loads((P/take/'frames.json').read_text());lines=['ffconcat version 1.0']
 for i,row in enumerate(rows):
  lines.append("file 'frames/"+row['file']+"'")
  lines.append('duration '+str((rows[i+1]['time']-row['time'])/1000 if i+1<len(rows) else .08))
 lines.append("file 'frames/"+rows[-1]['file']+"'")
 (P/take/'video.ffconcat').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
 subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-y','-safe','0','-i',str(P/take/'video.ffconcat'),'-vf','pad=ceil(iw/2)*2:ceil(ih/2)*2','-c:v','libx264','-crf','20','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-r','30',str(P/(name+'.mp4'))],check=True)
 report.append({'take':take,'output':name+'.mp4','frames':len(rows),'capture_hz':(len(rows)-1)*1000/(rows[-1]['time']-rows[0]['time']),'container_fps':30,'timing':'Original screenshot intervals retained; no speedup'})
(P/'video-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
````

## work/moveset-growth/milestone-7235/reports/generate_locomotion.py

[generate_locomotion.py](<../../../work/moveset-growth/milestone-7235/reports/generate_locomotion.py>)

````text
"""Produce independent seeded locomotion donors using the proven native evaluator.

Only evaluated pose/root/contact data is saved. No native D2 files or sample
assets are changed. Directional/loop suitability is assessed after generation.
"""
import json, math, pathlib, unreal

P=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=P/'donors';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
FPS=60
CONTROLLER='/AnimGenExample/Characters/UEFN_Mannequin/Animations/AGC_AnimGenCharacter'
MESH='/AnimGenExample/Characters/UEFN_Mannequin/Meshes/SKM_UEFN_Mannequin'
actors=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem)
directions=[('forward',0),('forward_left',45),('left',90),('back_left',135),('back',180),('back_right',-135),('right',-90),('forward_right',-45)]
cases=[{'name':'idle','speed':0,'angle':0,'turn':0}]
for gait,speed in (('walk',100),('run',300),('sprint',500)):
    for direction,angle in directions:
        cases.append({'name':gait+'_'+direction,'speed':speed,'angle':angle,'turn':0})
for turn in (-180,-90,90,180):
    cases.append({'name':'turn_'+('left' if turn>0 else 'right')+'_'+str(abs(turn)),'speed':0,'angle':0,'turn':turn})
````

````text
"""Native weighted preview of the new bank. No changes to preserved scenes."""
import bpy,json,math
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix,Quaternion,Vector
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=P/'previews';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def matrix(v):
 m=Quaternion((v[3],*v[:3])).normalized().to_matrix().to_4x4();m.translation=Vector(v[4:7]);return m
bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True);scene=bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine='BLENDER_WORKBENCH';scene.render.resolution_x=1300;scene.render.resolution_y=900;scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
scene.display.shading.light='STUDIO';scene.display.shading.color_type='MATERIAL';scene.display.shading.show_cavity=True;scene.display.shading.show_shadows=True
scene.display.shading.background_type='WORLD';scene.world=bpy.data.worlds.new('PreviewWorld');scene.world.color=(.055,.055,.06)
rigs=[]
for n,role in enumerate(('corvo','emily')):
 native=read(P.parent/f'mixamo-crouch/native-{role}.json');J=native['joints'];B=[matrix(j['bindLocalQTS']) for j in J];BG=[]
 rig=bpy.data.objects.new(role,bpy.data.armatures.new(role+'_skeleton'));scene.collection.objects.link(rig);bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=rig;rig.select_set(True)
 bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
 for i,j in enumerate(J):
  parent=j['parent'];g=B[i] if parent<0 else BG[parent]@B[i];BG.append(g);b=rig.data.edit_bones.new(j['nativeName']);b.length=.045;b.matrix=g
  if parent>=0:b.parent=rig.data.edit_bones[J[parent]['nativeName']]
````

````text
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $nodePath)) { throw 'Node.js is needed to normalize the build environment.' }

& $nodePath $cleanRunner $cmake -S $PSScriptRoot -B $buildDirectory -G 'Visual Studio 17 2022' -A x64
````

## work/moveset-growth/milestone-7235/scripts/Restore-D2Lab.ps1

[Restore-D2Lab.ps1](<../../../work/moveset-growth/milestone-7235/scripts/Restore-D2Lab.ps1>)

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Doppelganger)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
function State([string]$role){Get-Content (Join-Path $root "work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json") -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Command([string]$role,[string]$text){& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Send-D2Command.ps1') -Role $role -Command $text|Out-Null}
# A restarted process can leave an older process's status file on disk until
# its first engine update. Wait for a fresh, usable native state before input.
foreach($role in 'host','client') {
    $launch=Get-Content (Join-Path $root "work/lab-instances/$role/launch.json") -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
    $process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
    if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'Unexpected lab process.'}
    $statusPath=Join-Path $root "work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json"
    $startup=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    do {
        $fresh=(Test-Path $statusPath) -and (Get-Item $statusPath).LastWriteTimeUtc -ge $process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime()
        if($fresh){$state=State $role;$fresh=$state.localGameLogicState -in 1,2,6,13 -and !$state.localPendingGameLogicState}
        if(!$fresh){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250}
    }while(!$fresh -and $startup.ElapsedMilliseconds -lt 45000)
    if(!$fresh){throw "$role did not reach a fresh native menu/gameplay state."}
````

````text
[CmdletBinding()]

if($Command.Length -gt 510 -or $Command -match '[^\x20-\x7e]|;' -or $Command -notmatch '^(getviewpos|where|Ansel_PlayerVisible|LoadGame|listDecls|debugEntityByName|trigger|teleport|setviewpos|find|listModels|coop_authoring_proof|coop_movement_bank|coop_probe_smoothing|coop_pose_trace|coop_shadow_stream|coop_shadow_stream_duplicate|coop_shadow_action|coop_shadow_pose|coop_shadow_crouch|coop_shadow_damage_probe|coop_friendly_fire_probe|coop_mixamo_crouch|coop_shadow_loco|coop_decl_probe|coop_spawn_probe|coop_probe_follow|coop_probe_trace_pose|coop_probe_trace_transform|coop_probe_locomotion|coop_body_probe|coop_arm_probe|coop_probe_arm|coop_probe_arm_space|coop_arm_duplicate|coop_avatar_sword|coop_avatar_weapon|coop_avatar_weapon_duplicate|coop_probe_body|coop_cinematic_sync|coop_cinematic_hold|coop_cinematic_barrier|coop_world_observe|coop_damage_observe|coop_damage_sample|coop_enemy_damage|coop_enemy_outcome|coop_enemy_duplicate|coop_enemy_melee|coop_enemy_melee_duplicate|coop_sword_link|coop_sword_duplicate|coop_world_hold_ai|coop_guard_link|coop_guard_body|coop_guard_equipment|coop_guard_weapon|coop_observer_isolation|coop_source_isolation|coop_guard_health|coop_partner_enemy|coop_guard_nudge|coop_guard_stall|coop_character_probe|coop_loading_probe|coop_gameover_probe|coop_gameover_retry|coop_checkpoint_sync|coop_checkpoint_delay|RestartFromCheckpoint|RestartFromMemoryCheckpoint)( |$)') {throw 'Command is outside the bounded native research command set.'}
$workspaceRoot=Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent
$instanceRoot=Join-Path $workspaceRoot "work\lab-instances\$Role"
$launch=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'launch.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$process=Get-Process -Id $launch.pid -ErrorAction Stop
if($process.Path -ne $launch.executable){throw 'The recorded lab process no longer matches.'}
$sequence=[uint32]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()%4294967296L)
if(!$sequence){$sequence=1}
$bytes=[byte[]]::new(528)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]0x43433244).CopyTo($bytes,0)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes($sequence).CopyTo($bytes,4)
$expiresUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
[BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint64]$expiresUtc.ToFileTimeUtc()).CopyTo($bytes,8)
[Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Command).CopyTo($bytes,16)
Publish-D2Packet -Path (Join-Path $instanceRoot 'command.bin') -Bytes $bytes -ExpiresUtc $expiresUtc
$consumed=$false
````

````text
"""Native weighted turn preview; root rotation is authoring-only."""

   rig.rotation_euler.z=data['root_angles'][frame]
   for i,j in enumerate(J):
    rig.pose.bones[j['nativeName']].matrix_basis=B[i].inverted()@local[i];p=j['parent'];g.append(local[i] if p<0 else g[p]@local[i])

print('TURN_PREVIEW_COMPLETE')
````

````text
"""Native weighted preview of the new bank. No changes to preserved scenes."""
import bpy,json,math
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix,Quaternion,Vector
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=P/'previews';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def matrix(v):
 m=Quaternion((v[3],*v[:3])).normalized().to_matrix().to_4x4();m.translation=Vector(v[4:7]);return m
bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True);scene=bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine='BLENDER_WORKBENCH';scene.render.resolution_x=1300;scene.render.resolution_y=900;scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
scene.display.shading.light='STUDIO';scene.display.shading.color_type='MATERIAL';scene.display.shading.show_cavity=True;scene.display.shading.show_shadows=True
scene.display.shading.background_type='WORLD';scene.world=bpy.data.worlds.new('PreviewWorld');scene.world.color=(.055,.055,.06)
rigs=[]
for n,role in enumerate(('corvo','emily')):
 native=read(P.parent/f'mixamo-crouch/native-{role}.json');J=native['joints'];B=[matrix(j['bindLocalQTS']) for j in J];BG=[]
 rig=bpy.data.objects.new(role,bpy.data.armatures.new(role+'_skeleton'));scene.collection.objects.link(rig);bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=rig;rig.select_set(True)
 bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
 for i,j in enumerate(J):
  parent=j['parent'];g=B[i] if parent<0 else BG[parent]@B[i];BG.append(g);b=rig.data.edit_bones.new(j['nativeName']);b.length=.045;b.matrix=g
  if parent>=0:b.parent=rig.data.edit_bones[J[parent]['nativeName']]
````

````text
"""Match the evaluated component transform to ControlRoot during offline capture.

AnimNode_AnimGenController.cpp uses GetComponentTransform in FromPoseVectors.
Updating only ControlRoot fixes requested heading but leaves decoder feedback
in a different frame. Neither experiment changes D2 or installed UE assets.
"""
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source=(P/'probe_root_feedback.py').read_text()
source=source.replace("OUT=P/'donors-feedback'", "OUT=P/'donors-component-feedback'")
source=source.replace("'donor-manifest-feedback.json'", "'donor-manifest-component-feedback.json'")
needle="instance.set_editor_property('control_root',unreal.Transform(location=unreal.Vector(*root_pos),rotation=unreal.Rotator(pitch=0,yaw=root_yaw,roll=0)))"
replacement="root_transform=unreal.Transform(location=unreal.Vector(*root_pos),rotation=unreal.Rotator(pitch=0,yaw=root_yaw,roll=0))\\n            actor.set_actor_transform(root_transform,False,True)\\n            instance.set_editor_property('control_root',root_transform)"
# The parent script contains this code inside its multiline replacement string.
source=source.replace(needle,replacement)
assert needle not in source and 'set_actor_transform' in source
exec(compile(source,str(P/'probe_root_feedback.py'),'exec'),{'__file__':str(P/'probe_root_feedback.py'),'__name__':'__main__'})
````

````text
 if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'}

}
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600
foreach($r in 'host','client'){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button X -DurationMs 400|Out-Null}
$watch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();$seen=@{host=$false;client=$false};$records=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()

 $ready=$true
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
````

````text
"""Native full-body turn candidates with generated root/contact feedback.

Root transforms are authoring metadata only. No runtime installation here.
Use the accepted walking candidate's FP-inspired ready arm as the constraint.
"""
import json,math,bisect
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix,Quaternion,Vector
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=P/'turns';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
````

````text
"""Turn comparison with a chest-relative sword-ready constraint.

The blade follows the turning torso rather than holding its orientation in the
actor frame. Keep v1 and the component-feedback comparison for inspection.
"""
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source=(P/'retarget_turns.py').read_text().replace("OUT=P/'turns'","OUT=P/'turns-chest'").replace("P/'donors-feedback'","P/'donors-component-feedback'")
source=source.replace("self.hand=rg[16];self.binding", "self.hand=rg[16];self.chest=rg[5];self.binding")
old="self.solve(local,14,15,16,self.hand.translation,Vector((.02,-.64,1.2)));self.orient(local,16,self.hand.to_3x3())"
new="g=self.fk(local);delta=g[5]@self.chest.inverted();hand=delta@self.hand;pole=delta@Vector((.02,-.64,1.2))\n  self.solve(local,14,15,16,hand.translation,pole);self.orient(local,16,hand.to_3x3())"
assert old in source
source=source.replace(old,new)
exec(compile(source,str(P/'retarget_turns.py'),'exec'),{'__file__':str(P/'retarget_turns.py'),'__name__':'__main__'})
````

````text
 & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $src -RightTrigger 255 -DurationMs 180|Out-Null
 $observed=$false;$w=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
 do{$s=Capture $src $dst "slash-motion-$motion";if(@($s.native.active|Where-Object id -eq 39).Count-and$s.bridge.localPlayerMotionValid-and$s.bridge.localPlayerMotion-eq$motion-and$s.movement.weight-eq0){$observed=$true};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 30}while($w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt1100)
````

````text
"""Apply the bounded read-only contact-pair probe extension once."""
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src/runtime_probe.cpp'
s=p.read_text()
old='(argc==5&&std::strcmp(argv[2],"--skeleton-final"))'
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,'(argc==5&&std::strcmp(argv[2],"--skeleton-final")&&std::strcmp(argv[2],"--contact-pair"))')
needle='    if(argc==3&&(!std::strcmp(argv[2],"--windblast-effects")'
assert s.count(needle)==1
code=r'''    if(argc==5&&!std::strcmp(argv[2],"--contact-pair")){
        // Compact read-only observation of two known entity generations.
        // Sequential reads remain explicitly non-atomic. Do not suspend the game.
        NativeSkeleton pair[2]{};const auto begin=GetTickCount64();
        auto reader=[&](std::uintptr_t p,void* b,std::size_t n){return read(process.value,p,b,n);};
        for(unsigned i=0;i<2;++i){
            char* end=nullptr;const auto value=std::strtoull(argv[i+3],&end,0);
            if(!end||*end||value>0xffffffffull||!value||!readNativeSkeleton(reader,base,unsigned(value),pair[i])||!pair[i].stable)return 53;
        }
        const auto finish=GetTickCount64();
        if(pair[0].game!=pair[1].game||pair[0].actor==pair[1].actor||finish-begin>50)return 53;
````

````text
 r=s['root'];d=[p[k]-r[k]for k in range(3)]
 return [sum(r[3+c*3+k]*d[k]for k in range(3))for c in range(3)]
for take in sys.argv[1:]:
 f=P/take;c=read(f/'carrier-held.json');v=read(f/'victim-held.json');assert c['stable']and v['stable']
 a=world(v,'left_femur_jnt');b=world(v,'left_tibia_jnt');goal=local(c,[a[k]+.72*(b[k]-a[k])for k in range(3)])
 goal=[goal[k]+[.015,-.065,.035][k]for k in range(3)];hand=local(c,world(c,'left_wrist_jnt'))
 out=dict(left_target=goal,left_wrist=hand,left_error_m=math.dist(goal,hand),victim_root_in_carrier=local(c,v['root'][:3]),

  scope='Sequential held skeletons; authoring palm offsets remain hypotheses. No surface contact acceptance.')
````

````text
early=[r for r in summary if r['carry_phase']==1];lift=[r for r in summary if r['variant']==1];loop=[r for r in summary if r['variant']==2]
````

````text
"""Read-only sequential-snapshot diagnostics, not visual acceptance."""
import json,math,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def world(s,name):
    p=next(j['globalPose'][12:15]for j in s['joints']if j['nativeName']==name);r=s['root']
    return [r[k]+sum(r[3+c*3+k]*p[c]for c in range(3))for k in range(3)]
def local(s,p):
    r=s['root'];d=[p[k]-r[k]for k in range(3)]
    return [sum(r[3+c*3+k]*d[k]for k in range(3))for c in range(3)]
for take in sys.argv[1:]:
    f=P/take;trace=read(f/'contact-trace.json');rows=[];rejected=[]
    for r in trace:
        c=r['carrier'];v=r['victim'];before=r['movementBefore'];after=r['movementAfter']
        assert c['stable'] and v['stable']
        if after['carryVariant']not in [7,1] or after['carryAuthoredAmount']<before['carryAuthoredAmount']:
            rejected.append(dict(beginMs=r['beginMs'],reason='Crossed final hoist boundary; cannot average wrapped amount'));continue
        h=world(v,'left_femur_jnt');k=world(v,'left_tibia_jnt')
        left=local(c,[h[i]+.72*(k[i]-h[i])for i in range(3)])
````

````text
"""Check a stream armed before pickup, not one started after it."""

    def variant(r):return (r.get('native')or{}).get('carryScene',{}).get('variant',0)
    lift=[r for r in rows if variant(r)==1];held=[r for r in rows if variant(r)==2]
    streams=[r.get('observerStream')or{} for r in rows]

    received={s.get('carryRemote',0) for s in streams}
    checks=dict(harness_finished=result['failure']is None,
        preparation_observed=bool(prep),native_lift_observed=bool(lift),native_loop_observed=bool(held),
        receiver_continuously_ready=all(s.get('armed') and s.get('ready') for s in streams),
        sender_continuously_ready=all(s.get('armed') and s.get('ready') for s in source) if all(source) else None,
        no_receiver_restart=len({s.get('token')for s in streams})==1 and len({s.get('started')for s in streams})==1,
        received_pickup_and_loop={1,2}<=received,
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import json,math,struct
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'npc-rig-census-v839'
def quat(m):
    q=[0.]*4;t=m[0]+m[4]+m[8]
    if t>0:
        s=math.sqrt(t+1)*2;q=[(m[5]-m[7])/s,(m[6]-m[2])/s,(m[1]-m[3])/s,s*.25]
    else:
        i=1 if m[4]>m[0] else 0
        if m[8]>m[i*3+i]:i=2
        j=(i+1)%3;k=(i+2)%3;s=math.sqrt(max(0,1+m[i*3+i]-m[j*3+j]-m[k*3+k]))*2
        q[i]=s*.25;q[j]=(m[j*3+i]+m[i*3+j])/s;q[k]=(m[k*3+i]+m[i*3+k])/s;q[3]=(m[j*3+k]-m[k*3+j])/s
    n=math.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in q));return [v/n for v in q]
def rot(q):
````

````text
"""Decode every selected review movie and verify its saved animation sources.

This is delivery integrity, not visual acceptance. Content hashes cache costly
video decoding without accepting changed footage on a later audit.
"""
import json,hashlib,subprocess,datetime,concurrent.futures
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
catalog=read(P/'review-catalog.json');cachefile=P/'recording-decode-cache.json';cache=read(cachefile)if cachefile.exists()else{}
entries=[];source_errors=[]
for m in catalog['motions']:
 if set(m['roles'])!={'corvo','emily'}:source_errors.append(dict(id=m['id'],error='Both roles required'))
 for role,r in m['roles'].items():
  p=P/r['binary']
  if not p.is_file()or sha(p)!=r['sha256']:source_errors.append(dict(id=m['id'],role=role,error='Missing or changed animation bytes'))
 for v in m['videos']:
  side=read((P/v['path']).with_suffix('.json'));entries.append(dict(id=m['id'],path=v['path'],frames=side['frames'],fps=side['fps'],kind='authoring'))
for v in catalog['game_recordings']:entries.append(dict(id=v.get('alias')or v['video'],path=v['video'],kind='game'))
````

````text
"""Check corrected recording provenance without changing authored motion data."""
import json,hashlib,datetime
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
catalog=read(P/'review-catalog.json');prior=read(P/'boot-seam-v1/before/review-catalog.json');old={m['id']:m for m in prior['motions']};rows=[]
for m in catalog['motions']:
 failures=[]
 if m['roles']!=old[m['id']]['roles']:failures.append('Animation identity or duration changed')
 if len(m['videos'])!=1:failures.append('Expected one selected corrected movie')
 for v in m['videos']:
  meta=read((P/v['path']).with_suffix('.json'))
  previous=old[m['id']]['videos'][0]
  if abs(v['duration']-previous['duration'])>.04 or v['fps']!=previous['fps']:failures.append('Playback timing changed')
  previous_meta=read((P/previous['path']).with_suffix('.json'))
  for part in ['corvo-body','corvo-head','sword']:
   a=meta['render_inputs']['models'][part]['sha256'];b=previous_meta.get('render_inputs',{}).get('models',{}).get(part,{}).get('sha256')
   if b and a!=b:failures.append('Corvo geometry changed: '+part)
  if meta.get('skin_preview_version')!='corvo-shin-anchors-v1':failures.append('Old skin preview selected')
````

````text
"""Author sword-carrying sprint using the native armed shoulder/arm cycle.

An unarmed sprint's fist-to-face pump is inappropriate with a sword. Borrow
the complete native weapon arm, synchronized to the sprint's foot phase,
while retaining sprint pelvis, chest, legs and left-arm movement.
"""
import sys,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['dynamics-retarget-manifest.json'],'dynamics-armed-v3')
for role in ['corvo','emily']:
 rig=rig_for(role)
 b=(P/f'native-gaits/{role}-run_forward.bin').read_bytes();_,n,nf,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIfQ',b)
 native=[[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',b,28+(f*n+j)*28))for j in range(n)]for f in range(nf)]
 native_phase=max(range(nf-1),key=lambda f:rig.fk(native[f])[21].translation.x)/(nf-1)
 m,sprint=L.load(role,'sprint_forward')
 # The rendered sprint repeats a two-cycle donor twice = four strides.
 stride_time=m['stride_m']/m['source_cycles']/m['review_speed_mps']
 first_cycle=sprint[:round(stride_time*60)+1]
````

````text
 grips={j:grip_center(rig,reference,j)for j in [9,16]};orientations={}
````

````text
"""Offline carried-body contact study using actual native victim motion.

"""
import sys,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from finger_reference import HandReference
from edge_data import poses as edge_poses
fpmeta=read(P/'fp-carry-reference-manifest.json')['rows'][0];fpraw=edge_poses(P/fpmeta['sample_file']);fp=[[qts(v)for v in f]for f in fpraw['frames']]
L=Library(['library-retarget-manifest.json','gait-review-manifest.json','carry-victim-retarget-manifest.json'],'carry-body-v3');actors=[];victims=[]
for role in ['corvo','emily']:
 rig=rig_for(role);hand=HandReference(rig);vrig=rig_for('corvo');im,idle=L.load(role,'sword_idle');ig=rig.fk(idle[0])
 for action in ['idle','walk']:
  bm,body=L.load(role,'sword_idle'if action=='idle'else'walk_forward');vm,vbody=L.load('corvo','generic_carrycorpse_'+action)
  duration=3.2 if action=='walk' else 3.;count=round(duration*60)+1;ps=[];vs=[];roots=[];vroots=[];errors=[]
  for f in range(count):
   t=f/60;speed=.65;source_speed=(qts(bm['root_track'][-1]).translation-qts(bm['root_track'][0]).translation).length/max(bm['duration'],.001)
````

````text
"""Whole-body release acting at native carried-victim phase boundaries.

explicit evidence of the animation boundary, never a claim of native physics.
"""
import sys,math,json
from pathlib import Path

from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['carry-body-manifest-v3.json','carry-victim-retarget-manifest.json','library-retarget-manifest.json'],'carry-release-v3');actors=[];victims=[];metrics=[]
scenes=read(P/'carry-research/native-carry-scenes.json')
for role in ['corvo','emily']:
 rig=rig_for(role);vrig=rig_for('corvo');bm,loaded=L.load(role,'carry_body_idle');im,idle=L.load(role,'sword_idle');initial=qts(bm['partner']['root_track'][0]);vm,vbase=L.load('corvo','generic_carrycorpse_idle');support0=(initial@vrig.fk(vbase[0])[4]).translation
 for name,key in [('low','drop_low_stand'),('high','drop_high'),('soft','drop_soft')]:
  scene=next(s for s in scenes if s['asset'].endswith('/carry_corpse_'+key+'.midnightscene'));events=scene['rows'];handoff=next(e['start_ms']/1000 for e in events if e['class_name'].endswith('StartRagdoll'));early=next(e['start_ms']/1000 for e in events if e['properties'].get('m_event')=='ARK_MDNT_MSG_ENABLE_EARLY_RAGDOLL');actorend=max(e['duration_ms']/1000 for e in events if e['class_name']=='arkMidnightKeyPropAnim'and e['group'].startswith('Player'))
  dm,donor=L.load('corvo','generic_carrycorpse_drop'+name);rot=initial.to_3x3();attach=rot.to_4x4();attach.translation=support0-rot@vrig.fk(donor[0])[4].translation;duration=.4+actorend+.8;ps=[];vs=[];roots=[];vroots=[];errors=[];feet0=[rig.fk(loaded[0])[j].translation.copy()for j in [21,25]]
  for f in range(round(duration*60)+1):
   t=f/60;clock=max(0,min(handoff,t-.4));v=sample(donor,clock/dm['duration']);v=blend(vbase[0],v,ease(clock/.08));vr=sample([[qts(r)]for r in dm['root_track']],clock/dm['duration'])[0];world=attach@vr;vg=vrig.fk(v);p=sample(loaded,t/bm['duration'],True)
   act=ease((t-.35)/max(.18,early))*(1-ease((t-.4-actorend)/.65));p[2].translation+=Vector((-.07 if name=='high'else .10,0,-.045 if name=='high'else-.10))*act
````

````text
  a=j

 native={part:L.load('corvo','generic_'+role+'_'+part)for part in ['chokefront_in','chokeleft_in','chokeright_in','choke_loop','choke_win','choke_cancel']};base=Matrix.Translation((1,0,0));lm,loop=native['choke_loop'];lg=vrig.fk(loop[0]);looproot=qts(lm['root_track'][0]);neck0=(base@looproot@lg[11]).translation;feet0=[rig.fk(idle[0])[j].translation.copy()for j in [21,25]];feet1=[Vector((.36,.20,feet0[0].z)),Vector((-.10,-.18,feet0[1].z))]
````

````text
 duration=2*vm['duration'];count=round(duration*60)+1;ps=[];vs=[];errors=[];placement=Matrix.Translation((1,0,0));initial_feet=[rig.fk(idle[0])[j].translation.copy()for j in [21,25]]
````

````text
 v=b-a;u=max(0,min(1,(p-a).dot(v)/max(v.length_squared,1e-8)));return(p-a-v*u).length
def envelope(m,t):
 marks={p['phase']:p['at']for p in m.get('phase_marks',[])};takeoff=marks.get('takeoff',m['source']['takeoff_frame']/60);land=marks.get('landing',m['source']['landing_frame']/60+(.8 if m['selection']['alias']=='double_jump'else 0))
 return ease((t-takeoff+.28)/.28)*(1-ease((t-land-.04)/.25))

 m,baseline=L.load(role,'standing_jump_sequence')
````

````text
 for kind in ['button','lever','crank','wheel','key']:
````

## work/natural-moveset/author_pickup_contact_v1.py

[author_pickup_contact_v1.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/author_pickup_contact_v1.py>)

````text
"""Corvo-only bounded contact pilot, using measured isolated Mayhew geometry.

Keeps the full-body base and native proportions. This is not an arbitrary-body
solution. Source first-person joints are never used as constraints.
"""
import sys,math,json,hashlib,struct
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['body-lift-short-manifest-v6.json'],'body-lift-contact-v1')
trace=read(P/'native-paired-pickup-corvo-v24-fast/contact-analysis.json')
samples=sorted(trace['samples'],key=lambda r:r['phase'])
assert len(samples)>=8 and all(0<=r['phase_span']<.18 for r in samples)
def target(u,key):
    if u<=samples[0]['phase']:return Vector(samples[0][key])
    if u>=samples[-1]['phase']:return Vector(samples[-1][key])
    k=next(k for k in range(len(samples)-1)if samples[k]['phase']<=u<=samples[k+1]['phase'])
    a=samples[k];b=samples[k+1];span=b['phase']-a['phase'];t=(u-a['phase'])/span
    # Time-aware cubic Hermite interpolation, bounded by measured neighbours.
````

````text
def target(u,key):
    if u<=samples[0]['phase']:return Vector(samples[0][key])
    if u>=samples[-1]['phase']:return Vector(samples[-1][key])
    k=next(k for k in range(len(samples)-1)if samples[k]['phase']<=u<=samples[k+1]['phase'])
    a=samples[k];b=samples[k+1];span=b['phase']-a['phase'];t=(u-a['phase'])/span
    # Time-aware cubic Hermite interpolation, bounded by measured neighbours.
````

````text
"""Constant anatomical forearm/wrist offsets for the authored armed sprint.

Find a modest local rotation over the entire cycle, never a world-space wrist
lock. Primitive clearance is only a screening test; require rendered review.
"""
import sys, math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
L=Library(['dynamics-retarget-manifest.json'],'dynamics-armed-v2')
reports=[]
def segment_distance(p,a,b):
 v=b-a;t=max(0,min(1,(p-a).dot(v)/max(1e-12,v.length_squared)));return(p-a-v*t).length
def offset(pose,roll,bend):
 p=copy_pose(pose)
 for i,axis,angle in [(15,'Y',roll),(16,'Z',bend)]:
  old=p[i];p[i]=old@Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(angle),4,axis);p[i].translation=old.translation
 return p
for role in ['corvo','emily']:
 rig=rig_for(role);m,frames=L.load(role,'sprint_forward')
````

````text
"""Authored traversal transitions with obstacle-relative contacts.

World travel is metadata only. Native lengths and local first-person rig stay
unchanged. Contacts here are against neutral fixtures, not measured D2 geometry.
"""
import sys,math,json
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
from contact_hand import descendants,grip_center
L=Library(['mixamo-retarget-manifest-v5.json','library-retarget-manifest.json','ladder-contact-manifest-v2.json'],'top-transitions-v1')

def fixture(name,edge,height,ladder=False):
 vertices=[];ix=[]
````

## work/natural-moveset/boot-seam-v1/before/render_identity.py

[render_identity.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/boot-seam-v1/before/render_identity.py>)

````text
"""Pin the animation, trajectories, props, models and renderer behind a video."""
import json, hashlib, functools
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def digest(value):return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
@functools.lru_cache(None)
def file_sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def data_identity(pair):
 data={role:{k:m.get(k)for k in ['sha256','root_track','props','equipment_policy','frames','fps']}for role,m in pair.items()}
 for role,m in pair.items():
  if 'preview_placement'in m:data[role]['preview_placement']=m['preview_placement']
  if 'preview_view'in m:data[role]['preview_view']=m['preview_view']
  if 'preview_caption'in m:data[role]['preview_caption']=m['preview_caption']
 return digest(data)
def fingerprint(pair,overrides=None):
 models={}
 for role in ['corvo','emily']:
  for part in ['body','head']:
   path=(overrides or {}).get(role+'-'+part,(P.parent/'fullbody-proof'if role=='corvo'else P.parent/'moveset-growth')/f'{role}-{part}.json')
   models[role+'-'+part]=dict(path=str(Path(path).relative_to(P.parent)),sha256=file_sha(str(path)))
````

## work/natural-moveset/boot-seam-v1/before/rig_math.py

[rig_math.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/boot-seam-v1/before/rig_math.py>)

````text
"""Offline native-rig math. No first-person positional constraints or scene state."""
import json, math, re
from mathutils import Matrix, Quaternion, Vector

def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

def qts(q):
    m = Quaternion((q[3], *q[:3])).normalized().to_matrix().to_4x4()
    m.translation = Vector(q[4:7])
    return m

def ease(t):
    t = max(0, min(1, t))
    return t*t*(3-2*t)

class NativeRig:
    def __init__(self, joints):
        self.joints = joints
        self.bind = [qts(j['bindLocalQTS']) for j in joints]
````

````text
"""Bounded airborne curves: no root animation, physics, events or FP writes."""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
from mathutils import Quaternion
def blend(a,b,t):
    out=[]
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        q=Quaternion((x[3],*x[:3])).slerp(Quaternion((y[3],*y[:3])),t).normalized()
        out.append([q.x,q.y,q.z,q.w,*[x[k]+(y[k]-x[k])*t for k in range(4,7)]])
    return out
OUT=P/'air-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rows=[]
for manifest in ('jumps-retarget-manifest-v3.json','dynamics-retarget-manifest-v3.json','library-retarget-manifest.json'):

reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
    data=(P/'slide-banks-v1'/f'{role}-slide-bank.bin').read_bytes()
    magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data)
    assert magic==b'D2MOVE06' and count==37
````

````text
original declarations and the established carry-loop derivative stay intact.

def items(a): return [v for k,v in a.items() if k.startswith('item[')]
def arr(a): return dict(num=len(a), **{f'item[{i}]':v for i,v in enumerate(a)})
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
def emit(obj, depth=0):
    indent = '\t' * depth
    if isinstance(obj,dict):
        return '{\n' + ''.join(indent+'\t'+k+' = '+emit(v,depth+1)+(';' if not isinstance(v,dict) else '')+'\n' for k,v in obj.items()) + indent+'}'
````

````text
  p[2].translation+=crouch[2].translation-stand[2].translation
````

````text
 '// Generated by build_crossbow_mechanism_data.py from exact-game Edge samples.',
 'struct CrossbowMechanismClip {unsigned joints,frames;const float (*qts)[7];};']
reports=[]
def values(v):return ','.join(format(float(x),'.9f')+'f'for x in v)

 D=P/('item-mechanisms-runtime-v2' if role=='corvo' else 'item-mechanisms')
 sk=json.loads((D/f'crossbow_{role}-skeleton.json').read_text());n=len(sk['joints'])
 lines.append(f'inline constexpr short crossbow_{role}_parents[]={{'+','.join(str(j['parent'])for j in sk['joints'])+'};')
 lines.append(f'inline constexpr float crossbow_{role}_bind[][7]={{'+','.join('{'+values(j['bindLocalQTS'][:7])+'}'for j in sk['joints'])+'};')
 for part in ('idle','fire','outofammo'):
````

````text
 m,walk=L.load(role,'mixamo_crouched_walking_posture100');walk=walk[:-1];globals_=[rig.fk(f)for f in walk]

 mean=copy_pose(walk[0])
````

````text
"""Recordable bank motion at declared world speeds, not normalized-cycle time."""
import json,math,struct,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Quaternion,Matrix
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from rig_math import read
O=P/'gait-review';O.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
reports=[]
def blend(a,b,t):
 out=[]
 for x,y in zip(a,b):
  q=Quaternion((x[3],*x[:3])).slerp(Quaternion((y[3],*y[:3])),t).normalized();out.append([q.x,q.y,q.z,q.w,*[x[k]+(y[k]-x[k])*t for k in range(4,7)]])
 return out
def sample(fs,u):
 f=(u%1)*(len(fs)-1);a=int(f);return blend(fs[a],fs[min(a+1,len(fs)-1)],f-a)
def save(role,label,poses,roots,layout,source,notes):
 n=len(poses[0]);b=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIfQ',b'D2NATV01',n,len(poses),60,layout))
 for f in poses:
  for v in f:b.extend(struct.pack('<7f',*v))
 key=label+'-'+role;path=O/(key+'.bin');path.write_bytes(b)
````

````text
def sample(data,n=120):
 a=np.asarray(data,dtype=np.float64);at=np.linspace(0,len(a)-1,n);lo=at.astype(int);hi=np.minimum(lo+1,len(a)-1);t=(at-lo).reshape((-1,)+(1,)*(a.ndim-1))
 x=a[lo].copy();y=a[hi].copy();sgn=np.where(np.sum(x[...,:4]*y[...,:4],axis=-1,keepdims=True)<0,-1,1);y[...,:4]*=sgn
 z=x+(y-x)*t;z[...,:4]/=np.linalg.norm(z[...,:4],axis=-1,keepdims=True);assert np.isfinite(z).all();return z.astype('<f4')
rows=read(P/'grenade-authoring-manifest-v55.json');reports=[];tracks=[];out=P/'grenade-banks-v56';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE42',42,n,260,fps,layout)+base[32:]);roletracks=[];sources=[]
 for index,part in enumerate(parts):
  m=next(r for r in rows if r['role']==role and r['selection']['alias']=='grenade_'+part);raw=(P/m['binary']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==m['sha256'];assert m['joints']==n and m['layout_hash']==layout
  poses=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<f4',offset=28).reshape(m['frames'],n,7);p=sample(poses);assert np.max(np.abs(p[:,3:17,4:]-poses[0,3:17,4:]))<1e-5
  bank.extend(struct.pack('<IIIIff',251+index,121,0,0,0,m['duration']));bank.extend(p.tobytes());bank.extend(p[0].tobytes())
  roletracks.append(sample(m['props'][0]['attachment_track']).tolist());sources.append(dict(variant=index,alias=m['selection']['alias'],source=m['binary'],sha256=m['sha256']))
````

````text
        q=Quaternion((x[3],*x[:3])).slerp(Quaternion((y[3],*y[:3])),t).normalized()
        out.append([q.x,q.y,q.z,q.w,*[x[k]+(y[k]-x[k])*t for k in range(4,7)]])
    return out
````

````text
 samples.append((s['traversalScene']['timeMs']/500,pos.dot(unit),pos.z))

def trajectory(t):
 for a,b in zip(samples,samples[1:]):
  if a[0]<=t<=b[0]:
   w=(t-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]);return Vector((a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*w,0,a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*w))
 raise ValueError(t)
````

## work/natural-moveset/build_native_gaits.py

[build_native_gaits.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/build_native_gaits.py>)

````text
"""Two authored native gaits, distance-clocked and aligned by foot-contact phase."""
import sys,json,struct,math,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Quaternion,Vector
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from rig_math import read,qts,NativeRig,ease
OUT=P/'native-gaits';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
library=read(P/'library-retarget-manifest.json')
def blend(a,b,t):
 out=[]
 for x,y in zip(a,b):
  q=Quaternion((x[3],*x[:3])).slerp(Quaternion((y[3],*y[:3])),t);q.normalize()
  out.append([q.x,q.y,q.z,q.w,*[x[k]+(y[k]-x[k])*t for k in range(4,7)]])
 return out
def sample(frames,u):
 f=(u%1)*(len(frames)-1);a=int(f);return blend(frames[a],frames[min(a+1,len(frames)-1)],f-a)
def load(alias,role):
 m=next(m for m in library if m['role']==role and m['selection']['alias']==alias);b=(P/m['binary']).read_bytes();n=m['joints']
 fs=[[list(struct.unpack_from('<7f',b,28+(f*n+j)*28)) for j in range(n)]for f in range(m['frames'])]
 delta=Vector(m['root_track'][-1][4:7])-Vector(m['root_track'][0][4:7]);return m,fs,delta
````

````text
reports=[]
def resample(data,u):
    f=u*(len(data)-1);a=np.floor(f).astype(int);b=np.minimum(a+1,len(data)-1);t=(f-a)[:,None,None]
    x=data[a];y=data[b].copy();dot=np.sum(x[:,:,:4]*y[:,:,:4],axis=2,keepdims=True)
    y[:,:,:4]=np.where(dot<0,-y[:,:,:4],y[:,:,:4]);r=x+(y-x)*t

    return r.astype('<f4')
````

## work/natural-moveset/build_stance_bank.py

````text
"""Version-3 bank: native walk/run plus authored, distance-clocked crouch.

Preserves version-2 bank entries byte-for-byte. No game assets or animation
events are changed. Use Blender's Python for the existing rig math library.
"""
import sys, struct, json, hashlib, math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from rig_math import NativeRig, qts, read
from mathutils import Quaternion
OUT=P/'stance-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
directions=['forward','forward_left','left','back_left','back','back_right','right','forward_right']
metadata=read(P/'crouch-directions-retarget-manifest.json')+read(P/'stance-retarget-manifest.json')

def load(row):
    raw=(P/row['binary']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
    magic,n,frames,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIfQ',raw)
    assert magic==b'D2NATV01' and n==row['joints'] and frames==row['frames']
    return [[list(struct.unpack_from('<7f',raw,28+(f*n+j)*28))for j in range(n)]for f in range(frames)]

````

````text
events are absent, and anatomical translations stay native. No game writes.
"""
import sys,struct,json,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
from rig_math import ease
L=Library(['dynamics-retarget-manifest.json','mixamo-dynamic-retarget-manifest.json','mixamo-jump-retarget-manifest.json','library-retarget-manifest.json','jumps-retarget-manifest-v2.json'],'unarmed-special-sources-v1')
OUT=P/'unarmed-special-banks-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'equipment-banks-v3'/f'{role}-equipment-bank.bin').read_bytes();magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert magic==b'D2MOVE09' and count==89
 bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE10',10,n,107,fps,layout)+data[32:]);entry=24+121*n*28;rig=rig_for(role);sources=[]
 def previous(cid):return [[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+cid*entry+24+(f*n+j)*28))for j in range(n)]for f in range(121)]
 def metadata(cid):return struct.unpack_from('<ff',data,32+cid*entry+16)
 def emit(cid,poses,alias,source):
  assert len(poses)==121
  poses[-1]=copy_pose(poses[0]);stride,angle=metadata(cid-63);bank.extend(struct.pack('<IIIIff',cid,121,0,0,stride,angle))
````

````text
 entry=24+121*n*28;bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE14',14,n,117,fps,layout)+data[32:]);rig=rig_for(role)
 mi,fi=L.load(role,'sword_vaultthrough_walkleft_in');mo,fo=L.load(role,'sword_vaultthrough_walk_out')
````

````text
import sys,json,math
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Quaternion
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from edge_data import poses
from rig_math import read
rows=read(P/'native-expanded-sample-manifest.json')['rows']
def get(alias):
 r=next(r for r in rows if alias in r['aliases'] and r['source_role']=='corvo' and r['status']=='native_pose_sampled_offline')
 return poses(P/r['sample_file'])['frames']
def q(v):return Quaternion((v[3],*v[:3]))
def angle(a,b):return math.degrees(2*math.acos(min(1,abs(a.normalized().dot(b.normalized())))))
results=[]
bind=[j['bindLocalQTS'] for j in read(P/'base-tall.json')['joints']]
for gait in ['run','walk']:
 original=get('sword_'+gait+'_n');delta=get('sword_'+gait+'_n_add')
 for refname,refs in [('bind',[bind]),('sword_neutral',get('sword_neutral')),('sword_idle',get('sword_idle'))]:
  for ri,ref in enumerate(refs[:3]):
   for order in ['ref_delta','delta_ref']:
    errors=[];translations=[]
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-guard-choke-v574',[ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidateSet('finish','breakout')][string]$Outcome='breakout')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$peerCapture=$null
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$b='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $b -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read failed $mode"}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Another native operation remains active'}
 if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $out){throw 'Unique evidence take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 [ordered]@{pid=$PID;operation='ChokeNetwork593';take=$Take;started=(Get-Date).ToString('o');state='running'}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json"
 $dll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash
 $pin=Get-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/candidate-choke-breakout-v592/identity.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if($dll-ne$pin.dll){throw 'Expected archived592 candidate'}
````
````text
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_probe_follow exact','coop_probe_locomotion on','coop_shadow_loco combat','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Living fixture required'}
````

## work/natural-moveset/clip_io.py

[clip_io.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/clip_io.py>)

````text
"""Shared offline clip authoring helpers; never writes to the game or actor root."""
import json,math,struct,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix,Quaternion,Vector
from rig_math import read,qts,NativeRig,preview_helpers
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def copy_pose(p):return [m.copy()for m in p]
def blend(a,b,t):
 out=[]
 for x,y in zip(a,b):
  m=x.to_quaternion().slerp(y.to_quaternion(),t).normalized().to_matrix().to_4x4();m.translation=x.translation.lerp(y.translation,t);out.append(m)
 return out
def sample(frames,u,loop=False):
 u=u%1 if loop else max(0,min(1,u));f=u*(len(frames)-1);a=int(f);return blend(frames[a],frames[min(a+1,len(frames)-1)],f-a)
def row(m):
 q=m.to_quaternion().normalized();return [q.x,q.y,q.z,q.w,*m.translation]
def identity(x=0,y=0,z=0):return [0,0,0,1,x,y,z]
class Library:
 def __init__(self,manifests,out):
  self.rows=[r for name in manifests for r in read(P/name)];self.out=P/out;self.out.mkdir(exist_ok=True);self.reports=[]
````

## work/natural-moveset/compare_correctives.py

[compare_correctives.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/compare_correctives.py>)

````text
import sys,json,math,struct
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Quaternion,Matrix,Vector
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
result=[]
for c in read(P/'review-test-2/result.json')['cases']:
 meta=read(P/'native-retargeted'/(c['id']+'.json'));b=(P/meta['binary']).read_bytes();n=meta['joints'];frame=c['frame'];sample=read(Path(c['poseFile']))['samples'][-1]
 joints=read(P.parent/f"mixamo-crouch/native-{meta['role']}.json")['joints'];diffs=[]
 for j in range(n):
  v=struct.unpack_from('<7f',b,28+(frame*n+j)*28);a=sample['local'][j];m=Matrix([[a[col*4+row] if row<3 else float(col==3) for col in range(4)] for row in range(4)])
  ang=math.degrees(2*math.acos(min(1,abs(Quaternion((v[3],*v[:3])).normalized().dot(m.to_quaternion().normalized())))))
  dist=(Vector(v[4:7])-m.translation).length
  if ang>.15 or dist>.0001:diffs.append(dict(joint=j,name=joints[j]['nativeName'],angle=ang,distance=dist))
 result.append(dict(id=c['id'],changed=diffs))
(P/'corrective-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps([{**r,'changed':r['changed'][:10],'count':len(r['changed'])} for r in result],indent=2))
````

## work/natural-moveset/contact_hand.py

[contact_hand.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/contact_hand.py>)

````text
"""Fit contact at the palm/fingers instead of confusing wrist with grip."""
from clip_io import *
def descendants(rig,wrist):
 out=[]
 for i,j in enumerate(rig.joints):
  parent=i
  while parent>=0 and parent!=wrist:parent=rig.joints[parent]['parent']
  if parent==wrist and i!=wrist and 'helper'not in j['nativeName']:out.append(i)
 return out
def grip_center(rig,pose,wrist):
 side='left'if wrist==9 else'right';names={j['nativeName']:i for i,j in enumerate(rig.joints)};g=rig.fk(pose);inv=g[wrist].inverted()
 points=[inv@g[names[side+'_'+name+'_jnt']].translation for name in ['thumb02','index02','middle02','ring02','pinky03'] if side+'_'+name+'_jnt'in names]
 assert len(points)>=4
 return sum(points,Vector())/len(points)
def fit_contact(rig,pose,wrist,point,orientation,pole,local_grip):
 a,b=(7,8)if wrist==9 else(14,15)
 rig.solve(pose,a,b,wrist,point-orientation@local_grip,pole);rig.orient(pose,wrist,orientation)
 return (rig.fk(pose)[wrist]@local_grip-point).length
````

````text
from pathlib import Path

s = s.replace("$inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';", """$food=Q $r '--player-food';Save "$out/food-restored-$r.json" $food
  if($food.food.health-ne56-or$food.food.mana-ne100-or$food.food.stored){throw 'Restored food outcome differs'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';""")

  if($food.food.health-ne56-or$food.food.mana-ne100-or$food.food.stored){throw 'Refused fixture changed restorative values'}
  if(!$state.enabled-or$state.awardedCount""")
(N/'Test-PickupCatalogRestoration-v825.ps1').write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
````

````text
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
p = root / 'work/natural-moveset/Test-OrdinaryStack-v816.ps1'
s = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
s = s.replace("shared-pickup-ammo-input-v816", "shared-pickup-potion-input-v824")
s = s.replace("[ValidateSet('ammo','potion')][string]$Kind='ammo'", "[ValidateSet('ammo','potion','food')][string]$Kind='potion'")
s = s.replace("[string]$Source='client'", "[string]$Source='host'")
s = s.replace("$coin=if($Kind-eq'ammo'){'pickups_ammo_bullet_box_regular'}else{'pickups_life_potion_01_9'}", "$coin=if($Kind-eq'ammo'){'pickups_ammo_bullet_regular_1'}elseif($Kind-eq'food'){'pickups_fruit_apple_02_6'}else{'pickups_life_potion_01_9'}")
s = s.replace('OrdinaryStack816', 'OrdinaryFamilies824').replace('candidate-coin-sync-v814', 'candidate-coin-sync-v821').replace('Expected814', 'Expected821')
s = s.replace("if(!$ready){throw 'NPC fixture not ready'}", "foreach($r in 'host','client'){Save \"$out/isolation-before-approach-$r.json\" (S $r '.observer-isolation.json')}")
s = s.replace("foreach($r in 'host','client'){$iso=S $r '.observer-isolation.json';if(!$iso.ready-or$iso.remainingMs-lt12000){throw 'Finite fixture not available for ordinary input'};C $r 'coop_coin_sync on'}", """foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  Save "$out/isolation-before-input-$r.json" (S $r '.observer-isolation.json')
  $game=S $r;Save "$out/game-before-input-$r.json" $game;Save "$out/states-before-input-$r.json" (Q $r '--player-states')
  if($game.localGameLogicState-ne1-or$game.localPendingGameLogicState-ne0-or(Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56){throw 'Ordinary interaction requires healthy native gameplay'}
  Save "$out/food-before-$r.json" (Q $r '--player-food');C $r 'coop_coin_sync on'
 }""")
s = s.replace('if($state.catalogCount-ne24', 'if($state.catalogCount-ne51')
s = s.replace('$source=$r-eq$Source', '$isSource=$r-eq$Source').replace('$receipt.nativeSource-ne$source', '$receipt.nativeSource-ne$isSource').replace('if($source)', 'if($isSource)')
s = s.replace('-or$receipt.accepted-le0', "-or($Kind-ne'food'-and$receipt.accepted-le0)")
````

## work/natural-moveset/create_ranged_network_test.py
