````text
"""One-time derivative of the verified native action observation harness."""
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
t=(P/'Observe-RangedActions.ps1').read_text()
t=t.replace("'native-ranged-corvo-gun-actions-v1'","'ranged-corvo-gun-network-v29-v1'")
t=t.replace("$capture=$null;$start=0","$capture=$null;$sourceCapture=$null;$start=0")
t=t.replace("'coop_movement_bank off','coop_shadow_stream off'","'coop_movement_bank off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_ranged_prop off','coop_review_clip off'")
t=t.replace("C $Source 'setviewpos -33 -153 68.1 180 0';C $peer 'setviewpos -31 -148 68.1 180 0'","C $Source 'setviewpos -33.5 -153 68.1 90 0';C $peer 'setviewpos -30.7 -151.8 68.1 203 0'")
before=" $window=(Get-Process -Id $pids[$Source]).MainWindowHandle.ToInt64();if(!$window){throw 'No source game window'}"
after=""" & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role $peer -Pitch 12 -Evidence "$out/observer-camera.json"
 $character=if($Source-eq'host'){'corvo'}else{'emily'}
 Copy-Item "$PSScriptRoot/ranged-banks-v1/$character-ranged-bank.bin" "$root/work/lab-instances/$peer/coop-status.json.movement.bin" -Force
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){C $r 'coop_shadow_stream on'};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 550;C $peer 'coop_movement_bank on'
 $w.Restart();do{$m=S $peer '.movement.json';$prop=S $peer '.ranged-prop.json';if($m.active-and$m.version-eq29-and$m.rangedWeight-gt.9-and$prop.active){break};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50}while($w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt5000)
 if(!$m.active-or$m.version-ne29-or$m.rangedWeight-lt.9-or!$prop.active){[ordered]@{movement=$m;prop=$prop;stream=(S $peer '.shadow-stream.json');sourceStream=(S $Source '.shadow-stream.json');player=(Q $Source '--player-states')}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content "$out/ready-failure.json";throw 'Ranged network body/prop did not become ready'}
 $checks.Add('Native Steam v25 scene stream, v29 body bank and automatic cosmetic weapon attach ready')
 $prop|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$out/prop-initial.json"
 $window=(Get-Process -Id $pids[$peer]).MainWindowHandle.ToInt64();if(!$window){throw 'No peer game window'}"""
assert before in t;t=t.replace(before,after)
before=' Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700;if($capture.HasExited)'
````

## work/natural-moveset/crouch-combat-corvo-v617/run-script.ps1

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-guard-choke-v574',[ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidateSet('finish','breakout')][string]$Outcome='breakout')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$peerCapture=$null
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$b='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $b -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read failed $mode"}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Another native operation remains active'}
 if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $out){throw 'Unique evidence take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 [ordered]@{pid=$PID;operation='CrouchCombat617';take=$Take;started=(Get-Date).ToString('o');state='running'}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json"
 $dll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash
 $pin=Get-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/candidate-crouch-combat-v616/identity.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if($dll-ne$pin.dll){throw 'Expected archived616 candidate'}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_probe_follow exact','coop_probe_locomotion on','coop_shadow_loco combat','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Living fixture required'}
````

````text
 ('low-mantle-sources-v2','crouch-mantle-sources-v1'),
 ("OUT=P/'low-mantle-banks-v2'","OUT=P/'crouch-mantle-banks-v1'"),
 ("observed=read(P/'low-mantle-v3-test/states.json')","observed=read(P/'native-traversal-variants-corvo-v1/states.json')"),
 ("if r['source']!='host' or not r['armed'] or r['trial']!=1 or not r['native'].get('traversalSceneValid'):continue","if r['trial']!='crouch-normal' or not any(a['id']==8 for a in r['state']['active']):continue"),
 ("s=r['native'];a=s['active'][0]['mantleResearch'];delta=", "s=r['state'];a=next(a for a in s['active'] if a['id']==8)['mantleResearch'];scene=next(v for v in r['midnight']['instances'] if v['id']==a['scene24']);delta="),
 ("s['traversalScene']['timeMs']/500","min(499,scene['clockWords'][0])/500"),
 ("data=(P/'low-mantle-banks-v1'","data=(P/'low-mantle-banks-v2'"),
 ("bank=bytearray(data[:32+111*entry])","bank=bytearray(struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ',b'D2MOVE13',13,n,115,fps,layout)+data[32:])"),
 ("stand=previous(59 if unarmed else 0)","stand=previous(76 if unarmed else 17)"),
 ("111+int(unarmed)","113+int(unarmed)"),
 ("native_low_mantle_contact","native_low_mantle_crouched_exit_contact"),
 ("bank[:32+111*entry]==data[:32+111*entry]","bank[32:len(data)]==data[32:]"),
 ("low-mantle-v3-test/states.json: host armed trial1","native-traversal-variants-corvo-v1/states.json: crouch-normal"),
 ("low-mantle-source-manifest-v2.json","crouch-mantle-source-manifest-v1.json"),
````

````text
 r=next(r for r in rows if alias in r['aliases'] and r['source_role']=='corvo' and r['status']=='native_pose_sampled_offline')
 return r,poses(P/r['sample_file'])['frames']
def q(v):return Quaternion((v[3],*v[:3])).normalized()
om,of=get('empty_walk_n');dm,df=get('empty_walk_n_add');ref=[]
for a,b in zip(of[0],df[0]):
 rotation=(q(a)@q(b).inverted()).normalized();ref.append([rotation.x,rotation.y,rotation.z,rotation.w,*[a[k]-b[k]for k in range(4,7)]])
results=[]
for gait in ('walk','run'):
 om,of=get('empty_'+gait+'_n');dm,df=get('empty_'+gait+'_n_add');assert len(of)==len(df)
 err=[];translations=[]
````

## work/natural-moveset/diagnose_bank.py

[diagnose_bank.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/diagnose_bank.py>)

````text
import struct,math,json
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
for role in ['corvo','emily']:
 b=(P/'native-gaits'/f'{role}-gait-bank.bin').read_bytes();version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<IIIIQ',b,8);entry=24+121*n*28
 assert len(b)==32+count*entry
 errors=[]
 for c in range(count):
  at=32+c*entry;idx,fc,flags,res,stride,angle=struct.unpack_from('<IIIIff',b,at)
  if idx!=c or fc!=121 or flags or res:errors.append((c,'metadata'))
  if c and not(.2<=stride<=(6 if c>8 else 3)):errors.append((c,'stride',stride))
  expected=((c-1)%8)*math.pi/4 if c else 0
  if abs(math.remainder(angle-expected,2*math.pi))>.0001:errors.append((c,'angle',angle))
  for f in range(121):
   for j in range(n):
    v=struct.unpack_from('<7f',b,at+24+(f*n+j)*28)
    if any(not math.isfinite(x) or abs(x)>3 for x in v):errors.append((c,f,j,'value'))
    norm=sum(x*x for x in v[:4])
    if abs(norm-1)>.001:errors.append((c,f,j,'quaternion',norm))
    if j<2 and any(abs(v[k]-(1 if k==3 else 0))>.00001 for k in range(7)):errors.append((c,f,j,'root'))
````

## work/natural-moveset/diagnose_boot_seam.py

````text
"""Bounded comparison of preview calf helpers with final D2 publication."""
import sys,json,struct,math
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix,Quaternion
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import rig_for,read,qts
def mat(a):return Matrix([[a[col*4+row] if row<3 else float(col==3) for col in range(4)]for row in range(4)])
rows=[]
for folder in ['stance-pose-test-1','review-test-2','jumps-v3-pose-test-1','carry-release-v3-pose-test-1']:
 r=read(P/folder/'result.json');metas={m['id']:m for m in read(P/r.get('manifest','native-retarget-manifest.json'))}
 for c in r['cases']:
  if c['role']!='corvo':continue
  m=metas[c['id']];rig=rig_for('corvo');b=(P/m['binary']).read_bytes();local=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',b,28+(c['frame']*m['joints']+i)*28))for i in range(m['joints'])];s=read(Path(c['poseFile']))['samples'][0];actual=[mat(a)for a in s['local']];G=rig.fk(local);A=rig.fk(actual)
  for i,k in [(196,21),(203,25)]:
   bind=rig.bind[i];q=(bind.inverted()@actual[i]).to_quaternion();aq=(rig.bind[k].inverted()@actual[k]).to_quaternion();delta=(A[i].translation-G[i].translation).length
   row=dict(clip=m.get('selection',{}).get('alias',m['id']),helper=i,preview_native_position_error=delta,native_translation_error=(actual[i].translation-bind.translation).length,helper_delta_q=list(q),ankle_delta_q=list(aq),native_helper_translation=list(actual[i].translation),old_preview_translation=list(local[i].translation));rows.append(row)
(P/'boot-seam-diagnosis.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
for r in rows:print(r['clip'],r['helper'],'poserr',round(r['preview_native_position_error'],4),'helperQ',[round(v,4)for v in r['helper_delta_q']],'ankleQ',[round(v,4)for v in r['ankle_delta_q']])
````

````text
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$rawMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --domino-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}

  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
````
````text
 $dirty=$true;C client 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C host 'setviewpos -44.39 -153.27 68.1 203 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role host -Pitch 15 -Evidence "$out/observer-camera.json" -Quick
````

````text
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$rawMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --domino-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
````
````text
 $dirty=$true;C client 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C host 'setviewpos -44.39 -153.27 68.1 203 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role host -Pitch 15 -Evidence "$out/observer-camera.json" -Quick
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$finalMonitor=$null;$cancelMonitor=$null;$peerCapture=$null;$networkStarted=$false;$peerRows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$targetMonitor=$null;$linkMonitor=$null;$strictMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --domino-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $dirty=$true
 # Suspending AI decisions does not stop an existing native navigation animation.
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=12,[switch]$AimGuard,[ValidateSet('standing','crouched')][string]$Stance='standing')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$strictMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --domino-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
````
````text
 $dirty=$true
 # Suspending AI decisions does not stop an existing native navigation animation.
````

````text
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}

  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
````
````text
 $dirty=$true;C client 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C host 'setviewpos -44.39 -153.27 68.1 203 0'
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=12,[switch]$AimGuard)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$cancelMonitor=$null;$peerCapture=$null;$networkStarted=$false;$peerRows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$targetMonitor=$null;$linkMonitor=$null;$strictMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --domino-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
````
````text
 $dirty=$true
 # Suspending AI decisions does not stop an existing native navigation animation.
````

````text
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}

  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}

 }
````
````text
 $dirty=$true;C client 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0'
````

````text
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$targetMonitor=$null;$strictMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --domino-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){

  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $dirty=$true;C client 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role client -Pitch $Pitch -Evidence "$out/source-camera.json" -Quick
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=30)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
````
````text
 foreach($r in 'client','host'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_doppelganger_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
````
````text
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $visualStart=S host '.doppelganger-visual.json';$visualStart|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/visual-start.json"
 $dirty=$true
 C client 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C host 'setviewpos -47.39 -156.87 68.1 90 0';
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'client','host'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_doppelganger_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
````
````text
 $cloneStart=S client '.doppelganger-world.json';$sequenceFloor=[uint64](($cloneStart.history.sequence|Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum)
 $epochStart=@{host=(S host).localEpoch;client=(S client).localEpoch}
 $epochStart|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$out/world-start.json"
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'client','host'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_doppelganger_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $cloneStart=S client '.doppelganger-world.json';$sequenceFloor=[uint64](($cloneStart.history.sequence|Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum)
````
````text
 $cloneStart|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/sender-start.json"
 $epochStart=@{host=(S host).localEpoch;client=(S client).localEpoch}
````

````text
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}

  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_doppelganger_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
````
````text
 $dirty=$true
 C client 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C host 'setviewpos -44.39 -153.27 68.1 203 0';
````

## work/natural-moveset/double_jump_contacts_v21.py

[double_jump_contacts_v21.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/double_jump_contacts_v21.py>)

````text
import json,sys,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
take=sys.argv[1];root=P/take
rows=json.loads((root/'states.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));out=[]
for armed in (True,False):
 for moving in (False,True):
  samples=[r for r in rows if r['armed']==armed and r['moving']==moving and r['movement'].get('secondJump') and r.get('videoTime')]
  if not samples:continue
  start=min(r['videoTime']for r in samples)-.65
  times=[max(0,start+.24*f)for f in range(10)]
  filename=f"contact-{'armed'if armed else'empty'}-{'moving'if moving else'standing'}.jpg"
  subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(P/'make_contact_sheet.py'),str(P/f'{take}.mp4'),str(root/filename),*[str(t)for t in times]],check=True)
  out.append(dict(armed=armed,moving=moving,video_times=times,selection='Expanded approximate wall-time interval; video frames show actual phases. Encoder startup and status publication are not phase-synchronized.',contact=filename))
(root/'contact-times.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2));print('CONTACTS',take,len(out))
````

## work/natural-moveset/edge_data.py

[edge_data.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/edge_data.py>)

````text
"""Read-only Edge skeleton metadata and native-sampled poses, exact D2 format."""
from pathlib import Path
import struct, hashlib, re

def skeleton(path):
    b=Path(path).read_bytes()
    def u16(o): return struct.unpack_from('<H',b,o)[0]
    def u32(o): return struct.unpack_from('<I',b,o)[0]
    assert b[:4]==b'60SE' and u32(4)==len(b)
    count=u16(0x10);assert 0<count<=512
    p=0x30+u32(0x30)
    def take(fmt):
        nonlocal p
        values=struct.unpack_from('<'+fmt,b,p);p+=struct.calcsize('<'+fmt)
        return values[0] if len(values)==1 else values
    def string():
        nonlocal p
        n=take('I');assert n<4096 and p+n<=len(b)
        s=b[p:p+n].decode('utf-8');p+=n;return s
    version=take('I');inherit=string()
````

## work/natural-moveset/encode_runtime.py

[encode_runtime.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/encode_runtime.py>)

````text
"""Preserve actual capture intervals; label pose-only runtime review honestly."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,argparse
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('takes',nargs='*');args=parser.parse_args()
prior=P/'runtime-video-manifest.json';report=json.loads(prior.read_text())if prior.exists()else[]
for take in (args.takes or ['native-corvo-1','native-emily-1']):
 d=P/take;rows=json.loads((d/'frames.json').read_text());events=json.loads((d/'take.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));assert not events['failure']
 lines=['ffconcat version 1.0']
 for i,row in enumerate(rows):
  lines.append("file 'frames/"+row['file']+"'");lines.append('duration '+str((rows[i+1]['time']-row['time'])/1000 if i+1<len(rows) else .08))
 lines.append("file 'frames/"+rows[-1]['file']+"'");(d/'video.ffconcat').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
 out=P/(take+'.mp4')
 subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-y','-safe','0','-i',str(d/'video.ffconcat'),'-vf','pad=ceil(iw/2)*2:ceil(ih/2)*2','-c:v','libx264','-crf','19','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-r','30','-movflags','+faststart',str(out)],check=True)
 report=[r for r in report if r['video']!=out.name]
 report.append(dict(video=out.name,character=events['character'],alias=events.get('alias'),actual_capture_hz=(len(rows)-1)*1000/(rows[-1]['time']-rows[0]['time']),container_fps=30,timing='Actual capture intervals, no speedup',scope=events['scope']))
(P/'runtime-video-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='equipment-review-v48')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null
$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$captures=@();$chapters=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$pids=@{};$handles=@{};$probe=Join-Path $lab 'bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe'
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function I($r,$button='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function ReadStatus($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function B($r){ReadStatus $r};function M($r){ReadStatus $r '.movement.json'};function S($r){ReadStatus $r '.shadow-stream.json'}
function Q($r,$mode,$id=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($id){& $probe $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& $probe $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 10};throw "Read $r $mode"}

}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){

  $pids[$r]=$l.pid;$handles[$r]=(B $r).probeActorHandle;I $r;C $r 'coop_movement_bank off';C $r 'coop_shadow_stream off'
  $role=if($r-eq'host'){'emily'}else{'corvo'};$bank=Get-Content "$PSScriptRoot/outofmana-context-bank-manifest-v46.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json|Where-Object role -eq $role
````

````text
$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$captures=@();$chapters=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$pids=@{};$handles=@{};$probe=Join-Path $lab 'bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe'
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$button='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function ReadStatus($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function B($r){ReadStatus $r};function M($r){ReadStatus $r '.movement.json'};function S($r){ReadStatus $r '.shadow-stream.json'}
function Q($r,$mode,$id=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($id){& $probe $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& $probe $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 10};throw "Read $r $mode"}
function Sample($src,$dst,$trial,$ms){
 $m=M $dst;$s=S $dst;if(!$m.active-or!$s.armed-or!$s.ready){throw "Stream retired $src $trial $($s.result)"}
 if(!(ReadStatus $dst '.observer-isolation.json').ready-or!(ReadStatus $src '.observer-isolation.json').ready){throw 'Native fixture retired'}
 $row=[pscustomobject]@{source=$src;trial=$trial;ms=$ms;movement=$m;stream=$s;native=(Q $src '--player-states');sword=(Q $dst '--avatar-sword' $handles[$dst]);equipment=(ReadStatus $dst '.shadow-equipment.json')};$rows.Add($row);return $row
}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'}
  $pids[$r]=$l.pid;$handles[$r]=(B $r).probeActorHandle;I $r;C $r 'coop_movement_bank off';C $r 'coop_shadow_stream off'
  $role=if($r-eq'host'){'emily'}else{'corvo'};$bank=Get-Content "$PSScriptRoot/outofmana-context-bank-manifest-v46.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json|Where-Object role -eq $role
  $path=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $bank.bank;if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path).Hash-ne$bank.sha256){throw 'Bank differs'}
````

## work/natural-moveset/Export-NativeMesh.ps1

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Mesh,[string]$Skeleton,[Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Output)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$out=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Output)
if(!$out.StartsWith((Join-Path $root 'work/natural-moveset'),[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){throw 'Output outside proof workspace'}
$tool=Join-Path $root 'work/tools/void-tools-1.2.0/Void Explorer'
$dll=Join-Path $tool 'Void.Utils.dll'
if((Get-FileHash $dll).Hash -ne '59CCE9A1316157FFE795F0E8F179C6EE2BE3DEA43036A106B38834913AFD4A1F'){throw 'Unexpected library'}
[void][Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom((Join-Path $tool 'ComponentAce.Compression.Libs.zlib.dll'))
[void][Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom($dll)
$bones=$null
if($Skeleton){$sk=[Void.Utils.Resources.Meshes.EdgeSkeleton]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Skeleton));$bones=[Void.Utils.Meshes.VoidBone]::GetBones($sk)}
$model=[Void.Utils.Resources.Meshes.BMD6Model]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Mesh))
$data=$model.GetMeshData($bones)
$geo=$data.GeometryData
$verts=@($geo.Vertices)
$weights=@(for($i=0;$i -lt $verts.Count;$i++){
  ,@(if($geo.VertexBoneWeights){foreach($w in $geo.VertexBoneWeights[$i]){,@($w.BoneName,$w.BoneWeightDouble)}})
})
````

````text
$captures=@();$trace=$null;$pausedRole=$null;$Crouched=$false;$Holstered=$false;$FrontView=$true;$TriggerMs=250;$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take

  foreach($c in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_power_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $c}

 C host 'setviewpos -33.5 -153 68.1 90 0';C client 'setviewpos -30.7 -151.8 68.1 203 0'
 if($FrontView){C client 'setviewpos -33.5 -150 68.1 270 0'}

 if((Q host '--player-states').stance-ne[int][bool]$Crouched){I host 0 100 B;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700}
````

## work/natural-moveset/finalize_skin_review.py

[finalize_skin_review.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/finalize_skin_review.py>)

````text
"""Finalize only after the corrected library actually finishes and audits pass."""
import json,sys,subprocess,datetime
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert read(P/'boot-seam-v1/rebuild-status.json')['complete']
for script in ['build_review_catalog.py','audit_skin_rebuild.py','audit_recorded_library.py']:
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(P/script)],check=True)
qa=read(P/'quality-review-pass07.json')
qa['corvo_calf_correction']=dict(user_report='Persistent chicken-leg deformation at the boot/trouser seam',cause='Offline calf helpers followed the foot pivot',fix='Shin-relative calf helper anchoring in all review renderers; original weights and animation bytes retained',validation='boot-seam-v1/validation.json',rebuild='boot-seam-v1/rebuild-audit.json',visual_comparison='boot-seam-v1/comparison-grid.jpg',native_capture='boot-seam-native-test-1/result.json',limits='Native axial twist remains approximate; not full movement acceptance',finished=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat())
(P/'quality-review-pass07.json').write_text(json.dumps(qa,indent=2))
checkpoint=P/'boot-seam-v1/task-state.json';state=read(checkpoint)
state.update(stage='Calf correction and all 482 regenerated recordings validated',active_exec_session=None,completed_checked=482,remaining=['Final browser refresh and user-facing report; production moveset work remains separate'])
checkpoint.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2))
text=(P/'REVIEW-PASS07.txt').read_text();text=text.replace('The final pass archive will be written after the calf-correction recording\nrebuild and delivery audit finish; do not assume it exists until verified.','authoring-pass-07/review-package.zip preserves this reviewed pass and evidence.')
catalog=read(P/'review-catalog.json');covered=sum({e['role']for e in m.get('pose_publication_evidence',[])}=={'corvo','emily'}for m in catalog['motions'])
text=text.replace('103 paired candidates',str(covered)+' paired candidates')
(P/'REVIEW-PASS07.txt').write_text(text)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(P/'preserve_authoring_pass.py'),'--name','authoring-pass-07'],check=True)
statepath=P.parent/'current-task-state.json';state=read(statepath);state['CorvoCalfPreviewCorrection']=qa['corvo_calf_correction'];statepath.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2))
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$missing=@((Get-Content "$PSScriptRoot/native-expanded-sample-manifest.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).rows|Where-Object status -eq 'missing_asset'|Select-Object -ExpandProperty asset -Unique)
for($i=0;$i-lt$missing.Count;$i+=60){
 $last=[Math]::Min($i+59,$missing.Count-1)
 $pattern='^('+(@($missing[$i..$last]|ForEach-Object {[regex]::Escape($_)})-join'|')+')$'
 $batch='natural-native-other-'+[int]($i/60)
 $manifest="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports/$batch/manifest.json"
 if(Test-Path $manifest){Write-Output "Already exported $batch";continue}
 $found=@(& "$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab/Read-D2Assets.ps1" -NamePattern $pattern -CatalogPattern '.*' -Export -Batch $batch -Limit 1000)
 Write-Output "$batch : $($found.Count) resources"
}
````

````text
"""Read exact PE unwind boundaries for targeted Ghidra function creation."""
import hashlib,struct,sys,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'asset-game/Dishonored2.exe';data=p.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest().upper()=='B671F8249422862BF557D00AAB2F4BB671ED4515CC10AD8A8A9DECAD84516180'
pe=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,0x3c)[0];assert data[pe:pe+4]==b'PE\0\0'
count=struct.unpack_from('<H',data,pe+6)[0];opt=struct.unpack_from('<H',data,pe+20)[0]
section=pe+24+opt;base=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,pe+24+24)[0]
for i in range(count):
    s=section+40*i
    if data[s:s+8].rstrip(b'\0')!=b'.pdata':continue
    size,raw=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,s+16);entries=[struct.unpack_from('<III',data,j)for j in range(raw,raw+size-11,12)]
    break
else:raise ValueError('No unwind directory section')
for address in sys.argv[1:]:
    v=int(address,16);rva=v-base if v>=base else v
    print(json.dumps(dict(query=hex(v),matches=[dict(start=hex(base+a),end=hex(base+b),unwind=hex(base+c))for a,b,c in entries if a<=rva<b])))
````

## work/natural-moveset/finger_reference.py

[finger_reference.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/finger_reference.py>)

````text
import re
from clip_io import *
SR=NativeRig(read(P/'fp-leftarm-skeleton.json')['joints'])
SN={j['nativeName']:i for i,j in enumerate(SR.joints)}

def palm(g,w,i,p,m):
 inv=g[w].inverted();a=inv@g[i].translation;b=inv@g[p].translation;c=inv@g[m].translation
 x=(a-b).normalized();y=(c-x*c.dot(x)).normalized();return Matrix((x,y,x.cross(y))).transposed()

class HandReference:
 def __init__(self,rig):
  self.rig=rig;self.names={j['nativeName']:i for i,j in enumerate(rig.joints)};self.mapping={}
  for i,j in enumerate(rig.joints):
   match=re.fullmatch(r'left_(thumb|index|middle|ring|pinky)(\d\d)_jnt',j['nativeName'])
   if not match:continue
   finger,part=match.groups();k=int(part)
   # FP index/middle/ring have a metacarpal absent from the target. The
   # target pinky retains that extra segment; thumb layouts agree.
   if finger in ('index','middle','ring'):k+=1
   src='left_'+('medium'if finger=='middle'else finger)+'_'+str(k).zfill(2)+'_jnt'
````

````text
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/build/Release/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
````

````text
$pids=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
````

## work/natural-moveset/grenade-reader-equip-v320/reader-regression-wrapper.ps1

[reader-regression-wrapper.ps1](<../../../work/natural-moveset/grenade-reader-equip-v320/reader-regression-wrapper.ps1>)

````text
param([ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
$failure=$null;$restored=$false
try {
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Test-NativeGrenadeScene-v53.ps1" -Source $Source -Take $Take
} catch {$failure=$_.Exception.Message} finally {
 if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $out){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $PSCommandPath -Destination "$out/reader-regression-wrapper.ps1"}
 try {
  & "$root/work/PrepareShadowSword.ps1" *> "$out/reader-checkpoint-restore.log"
  if(!$?){throw 'Checkpoint preparation failed'}
  foreach($r in 'host','client'){
   $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
   $p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid
   if($p.Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Unexpected isolated process'}
   $raw=& "$root/work/build/Release/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $l.pid --player-grenade
   if($LASTEXITCODE){throw 'Grenade restoration read failed'}
   $item=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($item.quantity-or$item.equipped-or$item.started){throw 'Grenade acquisition survives checkpoint'}
  }
````

````text
param([ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-grenade-equip-v52')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventories=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$start=0
function C($r,$text){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $text -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function I($r,$button='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$handle=0){for($a=0;$a-lt12;$a++){$raw=if($handle){& "$root/work/build/Release/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $handle}else{& "$root/work/build/Release/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 25};throw "Native read $r $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_grenade_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventories[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventories[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 if((Q $Source '--player-grenade-scene').valid){throw 'Unexpected baseline scene'}
 $before=Q $Source '--player-grenade';if($before.quantity-or$before.equipped-or$before.started){throw 'Grenade already owned/selected'};$before|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$out/before.json"
 if((Q $Source '--player-states').stance-ne0){I $Source B 180;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700}
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role $Source -Pitch 0 -Evidence "$out/source-camera.json"
 $hwnd=(Get-Process -Id $pids[$Source]).MainWindowHandle.ToInt64();if(!$hwnd){throw 'No source window'}
````

## work/natural-moveset/hard_landing_contacts_v22.py

[hard_landing_contacts_v22.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/hard_landing_contacts_v22.py>)

````text
import json,sys,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;take=sys.argv[1];root=P/take
rows=json.loads((root/'states.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));out=[]
for armed in (True,False):
 for repeat in (1,2):
  samples=[r for r in rows if r['armed']==armed and r['repeat']==repeat and r['movement']['traversalVariant']==6 and r['movement']['traversalWeight']>.9 and r.get('videoTime')]
  if not samples:continue
  start=min(r['videoTime']for r in samples)-.65
  times=[max(0,start+.18*f)for f in range(10)]
  filename=f"contact-{'armed'if armed else'empty'}-{repeat}.jpg"
  subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(P/'make_contact_sheet.py'),str(P/f'{take}.mp4'),str(root/filename),*[str(t)for t in times]],check=True)
  out.append(dict(armed=armed,repeat=repeat,video_times=times,selection='Expanded approximate wall-time interval; video frames show actual phases. Encoder startup and status publication are not phase-synchronized.',contact=filename))
(root/'contact-times.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');print('CONTACTS',take,len(out))
````

## work/natural-moveset/import_mixamo_dynamics.py

````text
"""Pin UI-downloaded full-body sources. No game assets were uploaded."""
import json,hashlib,shutil
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;D=Path.home()/'Downloads';O=P/'mixamo-dynamics';O.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
clips=[
 ('Running Slide','Running To Slide And Back To Running',47,None,'slide','traversal'),
 ('Two Cycle Sprint','Full Speed Sprint For Two Cycles',33,True,'sprint','locomotion'),
 ('Running Jump','Jumping From A Sprint',28,None,'sprint','traversal'),
 ('Crouch Walk Back','Walking Backwards While Crouched',38,True,'crouch','stance'),
 ('Crouch Walk Left','Walking Left While Crouched',36,True,'crouch','stance'),
 ('Crouch Walk Right','Walking Right While Crouched',39,True,'crouch','stance')]
rows=[]
for title,description,frames,in_place,query,family in clips:
 src=D/(title+'.fbx');dst=O/src.name;digest=hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
````

````text
"""Pin and safely unpack the user-authorized Mixamo body-motion source bundle."""
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile,hashlib,json,shutil
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;source=Path.home()/'Downloads/Action Adventure Pack.zip';out=P/'mixamo-adventure';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
target=out/'source.zip'
if target.exists():assert target.read_bytes()==source.read_bytes()
else:shutil.copy2(source,target)
rows=[]
with zipfile.ZipFile(target) as z:
 assert len(z.infolist())<100 and sum(e.file_size for e in z.infolist())<100_000_000
 for e in z.infolist():
  name=Path(e.filename);assert name.name==e.filename and name.suffix.lower()=='.fbx'
  data=z.read(e);path=out/name
  if path.exists():assert path.read_bytes()==data
  else:path.write_bytes(data)
  rows.append(dict(file=e.filename,sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),bytes=len(data)))
report=dict(source_url='https://www.mixamo.com/#/?page=1&query=Crouched+Walking&type=Motion%2CMotionPack',source_title='Action Adventure Pack',advertised_animations=22,character='X Bot',format='FBX Binary',pose='T-pose',fps=60,keyframe_reduction='none',pack_settings='Bundle defaults; individual Posture/In Place controls unavailable for bundle. Original root motion retained only as authoring metadata; must never drive network world placement.',download='2026-10-10',archive_sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),files=rows)
(out/'source-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print('PINNED',len(rows),'FBX files',report['archive_sha256'])
````

````text
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=P.parent.parent
def read(p): return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
def write(p,v):
    t=p.with_suffix(p.suffix+'.tmp');t.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');t.replace(p)
backup=P/'catalog-before-carry-carrier-v3'
backup.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for name in ['runtime-video-manifest.json','review-evidence-annotations.json','review.html','review-catalog.js']:
    if not (backup/name).exists(): shutil.copy2(P/name,backup/name)
manifest=read(P/'runtime-video-manifest.json');cases={}
for character in ['corvo','emily']:
    take=f'native-carry-carrier-{character}-v3';folder=P/take
    result=read(folder/'validation.json');visual=read(folder/'visual-review.json')
    assert result['passed'] and result['carrier_gameplay_bound'] and not result['corpse_gameplay_bound']
    assert not result['complete'] and not result['visual_accepted'] and visual['inspected'] and not visual['accepted']
    assert result['actual_capture_hz']>=24 and sha(folder/'native.mp4')==result['video_sha256']
````

````text
folder=ROOT/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports/natural-fullbody-sets'
families={
 'locomotion':r'walk|run|sprint|idle|turn|pivot|start|stop|stair|slope',
 'stance':r'crouch|sneak|undertable|lean|peek|keyhole',
 'traversal':r'jump|fall|land|climb|vault|ladder|slide|swim|dive|window|ledge|rope',
 'combat':r'sword|attack|parry|dodge|hit|block|death|stagger|knock|kick|shove',
 'ranged_and_items':r'pistol|gun|crossbow|shoot|reload|grenade|throw|mine|heart|elixir|drink',
 'paired_actions':r'assass|choke|fatal|kill|takedown|struggle|carry|victim|grip|body',
 'powers':r'cast|power|blink|possession|domino|swarm|shadow|mesmer|doppel|teleport|windblast',
 'interactions':r'door|lever|button|crank|wheel|pickup|pick_up|loot|key|book|note|eat|sit|chair|standup|object|talk|open|close|place|inspect'}
entries=[];seen=set()
for path in folder.rglob('*.decl'):
    text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');sk=re.search(r'\bskeleton\s+"([^"]+)"',text)
    if not sk or not any(x in sk[1] for x in ('base_tall','base_female')):continue
    for alias,asset in re.findall(r'alias\s*\{\s*name\s+"([^"]+)"\s+anim\s+"([^"]+)"',text):
        key=(sk[1],alias,asset)
````

## work/natural-moveset/index_windblast_v27.py

[index_windblast_v27.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/index_windblast_v27.py>)

````text
"""Index the bounded native Windblast body proof, without claiming world FX."""
import json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def write(p,o):p.write_text(json.dumps(o,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
take='windblast-corvo-body-v27-v1';folder=P/take;r=read(folder/'result.json')
assert r['passed'] and len(r['checks'])==8 and len(r['nativeScenes'])==len(r['seenEvents'])==2
assert r['dll']=='C3B2A7717B973CBEFF8A27E0AF480C71F6D0CAA5E16FBB2E2F2C9198E6E41E0F'
review=dict(inspected=True,accepted=False,method='Selected temporal frames of actual source and remote D2 recordings inspected.',
 contact_sheets=[f'{take}/contact.jpg',f'{take}/source-contact.jpg'],
 observations=['Remote Corvo shows a complete-body casting stance, left-arm extension and standing recovery on both native casts.',
  'Original native first-person cast and screen distortion appear in the source view; observer camera stays unchanged.'],
 limitations=['Only standing, sword drawn, stationary basic Windblast is integrated.',
  'Remote world effects, impacts and gameplay outcomes are not implemented by this build.',
  'Fine hand-to-hilt contact and complete continuous visual quality remain unaccepted.'])
for f in review['contact_sheets']:assert (P/f).is_file()
write(folder/'visual-review.json',review)
manifest=read(P/'runtime-video-manifest.json');annotations=read(P/'review-evidence-annotations.json');paths=[]
req='corvo_windblast_cast';evidence=f'{take}/result.json'
````

````text
"""Compare one identical pose with old helpers, shin-bound helpers and D2 helpers."""
import bpy,sys,json,struct
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix,Quaternion,Vector
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from rig_math import NativeRig
exec(compile((P/'preview_natural_walk.py').read_text().split("for name in ('idle'")[0],str(P/'preview_natural_walk.py'),'exec'),globals())
OUT=P/'boot-seam-v1';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for role,rig,J,B,sword in rigs:
 sword.hide_render=True
 if role=='emily':
  for obj in rig.children:obj.hide_render=True
role,rig,J,B,sword=rigs[0];rig.location=(0,0,0);nr=NativeRig(J)
result=read(P/'boot-seam-native-test-1/result.json');case=next(c for c in result['cases']if c['role']=='corvo')
m=next(m for m in read(P/'library-retarget-manifest.json')if m['id']==case['id']);binary=(P/m['binary']).read_bytes()
local=[matrix(struct.unpack_from('<7f',binary,28+(case['frame']*m['joints']+j)*28))for j in range(m['joints'])]
s=read(Path(case['poseFile']))['samples'][0]
actual=[Matrix([[a[col*4+row]if row<3 else float(col==3)for col in range(4)]for row in range(4)])for a in s['local']]
scene.render.resolution_x=1000;scene.render.resolution_y=1000
g=nr.fk(local);center=(g[20].translation+g[24].translation+g[21].translation+g[25].translation)*.25
````

````text
import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))

L=Library(['carry-victim-retarget-manifest.json'],'carry-research');rig=rig_for('corvo');report=[]

 _,ps=L.load('corvo',m['selection']['alias']);raw=raw_poses(P/m['source']['sample_file']);samples=[]
 for f in [0,len(ps)//2,len(ps)-1]:
  g=rig.fk(ps[f]);anchor=qts(raw['frames'][f][1]);origin=qts(raw['frames'][f][0]);placement=anchor.inverted()
  samples.append(dict(frame=f,anchor=row(anchor),origin=row(origin),points={rig.joints[i]['nativeName']:[round(x,4)for x in placement@origin@g[i].translation]for i in [2,5,11,9,16,19,20,21,23,24,25]}))
 report.append(dict(alias=m['selection']['alias'],samples=samples))
(P/'carry-research/reference-frames.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
for r in report:
 print(r['alias'],json.dumps(r['samples'][len(r['samples'])//2]),flush=True)
````

## work/natural-moveset/inspect_carry_scenes.py

[inspect_carry_scenes.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/inspect_carry_scenes.py>)

````text
"""Record carry phases and ownership markers from exact native scenes."""
import json,hashlib,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from inspect_midnight_events import parse,walk
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;out=P/'carry-research';rows=[]
assets=json.loads((P.parent.parent/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports/natural-carry-scenes/manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))['Resources']
for asset in assets:
 if '/carrycorpse/'not in asset['Name']:continue
 path=Path(asset['ExportFile']);d=parse(path.read_text());groups={v['m_UID']['m_objUID']:v['m_name']for k,v in d['edit']['m_groupsInfo'].items()if k.startswith('item[')};events=[];names={}
 for o in walk(d):
  if 'm_properties'in o and'm_groups'in o:names[o['m_objUID']['m_objUID']]=o['m_properties']['m_name']
  if 'm_keyProp'in o:
   prop=o['m_keyProp'];h=o['m_handle'];body=prop.get('m_object',{});events.append(dict(scene=h['sceneUID'],group=groups.get(h['groupUID']),start_ms=o['m_startTime'],duration_ms=o['m_duration'],class_name=prop.get('m_class'),properties=body))
 for e in events:e['scene_name']=names.get(e['scene'])
 local=out/path.name;shutil.copyfile(path,local);rows.append(dict(asset=asset['Name'],sha256=asset['Sha256'],file=str(local.relative_to(P)),rows=events))
 print(asset['Name'])
 for e in events:
  if any(s in e['class_name']for s in ['Anim','Ragdoll','Carry','Event']):print(e['scene_name'],e['group'],e['start_ms'],e['duration_ms'],e['class_name'],{k:v for k,v in e['properties'].items()if k in ['m_AnimName','m_event','m_tag','m_entity']})
(out/'native-carry-scenes.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
````

## work/natural-moveset/inspect_context_events.py

[inspect_context_events.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/inspect_context_events.py>)

````text
"""Read exact native scene clocks for sliding/window victim references."""
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
from inspect_midnight_events import parse,walk
manifest=json.loads((P/'pair-research/native-scenes/manifest.json').read_text());out=[]
for r in manifest:
 if not r['asset'].endswith(('choke_slide_back.midnightscene','assassination_slide_back.midnightscene','choke_window_back.midnightscene','assassination_window_back.midnightscene')):continue
 path=P/r['file'];d=parse(path.read_text());groups={v['m_UID']['m_objUID']:v['m_name']for k,v in d['edit']['m_groupsInfo'].items()if k.startswith('item[')};mapping={};rows=[]
 for obj in walk(d):
  if 'm_md6'in obj and 'm_nextInfo'in obj:mapping[obj['m_nextInfo']['m_nextCPoint']['sceneUID']]=obj['m_md6']
  if 'm_keyProp'not in obj:continue
  prop=obj['m_keyProp'];cls=prop.get('m_class','');h=obj['m_handle']
  if groups.get(h.get('groupUID'),'').startswith('AI')and('StartRagdoll'in cls or cls=='arkMidnightKeyPropAnim'):
   rows.append(dict(scene=h['sceneUID'],group_name=groups[h['groupUID']],class_name=cls,start_ms=obj['m_startTime'],duration_ms=obj['m_duration'],properties=prop.get('m_object',{})))
 for row in rows:row['player_body']=mapping.get(row['scene'])
 out.append(dict(asset=r['asset'],sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),rows=rows))
 print(r['asset'],[(x['player_body'],x['class_name'],x['start_ms'],x['duration_ms'])for x in rows])
(P/'pair-research/native-context-event-times.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
````

````text
import json,hashlib,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from inspect_midnight_events import parse,walk
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;out=P/'item-research';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True);result=[]

for r in manifest['Resources']:
 path=Path(r['ExportFile']);local=out/path.name;shutil.copyfile(path,local);d=parse(path.read_text());groups={v['m_UID']['m_objUID']:v['m_name']for k,v in d['edit']['m_groupsInfo'].items()if k.startswith('item[')};names={};rows=[]
 for o in walk(d):
````

## work/natural-moveset/inspect_crouch_stride.py

[inspect_crouch_stride.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/inspect_crouch_stride.py>)

````text
import sys,struct,statistics,json
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from rig_math import read,NativeRig,qts
for r in read(P/'mixamo-retarget-manifest-v5.json'):
 if r['selection']['alias']!='mixamo_crouched_walking_posture100':continue
 rig=NativeRig(read(P.parent/f'mixamo-crouch/native-{r["role"]}.json')['joints']);raw=(P/r['binary']).read_bytes();n=r['joints'];feet=[]
 for f in range(r['frames']):
  g=rig.fk([qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',raw,28+(f*n+j)*28))for j in range(n)]);feet.append([g[i].translation for i in [21,25]])
 result=[]
 for foot in range(2):
  low=min(v[foot].z for v in feet);values=[]
  for f in range(1,len(feet)-1):
   if max(feet[f-1][foot].z,feet[f+1][foot].z)<low+.035:
    value=-(feet[f+1][foot].x-feet[f-1][foot].x)/2*(len(feet)-1)
    if value>.1:values.append(value)
  result.append(dict(foot=foot,height=low,samples=len(values),stride=statistics.median(values)if values else None,range=[min(values),max(values)]if values else []))
 print(r['role'],json.dumps(result))
````

````text
"""Offline hand/holster distances; proximity is a candidate, not contact acceptance."""
import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *

 rig=rig_for(role)
 for alias in ('sword_equipsword','sword_unequipsword'):
  m,fs=L.load(role,alias);samples=[]
  for f,p in enumerate(fs):
   g=rig.fk(p);samples.append(dict(frame=f,time=f/m['fps'],hand_to_holster_m=(g[16].translation-g[195].translation).length,tag_to_holster_m=(g[17].translation-g[195].translation).length))
  best=min(samples,key=lambda x:x['tag_to_holster_m']);print(role,alias,best)
  report.append(dict(role=role,alias=alias,source_sha256=m['sha256'],duration=m['duration'],nearest=best,samples=samples,accepted=False,scope='Relative native-model joints in authored body pose, excluding weapon geometry and attachment offset. No native event timing or usable contact is established by proximity.'))
(P/'equipment-contact-v1/contact.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
````

````text
"""Read-only structured extraction of exact-game midnight timing metadata."""
import re,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def parse(text):
    tokens=re.findall(r'//[^\n]*|"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*(?:\[\d+\])?|[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?|[{}=;]',text);tokens=[t for t in tokens if not t.startswith('//')];i=0
    def value():
        nonlocal i
        token=tokens[i];i+=1
        if token=='{':
            out={}
            while tokens[i]!='}':
                key=tokens[i];i+=1;assert tokens[i]=='=',(key,tokens[i]);i+=1;assert key not in out,key;out[key]=value()
                if tokens[i]==';':i+=1
            i+=1;return out
        if token.startswith('"'):return json.loads(token)
        if re.fullmatch(r'[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?',token):return float(token)if any(c in token for c in '.eE')else int(token)
        return token
    result=value();assert i==len(tokens),(i,len(tokens));return result
def walk(d):
````

````text
"""Extract native ranged animation/event timings without executing them."""
import json,hashlib

from inspect_midnight_events import parse,walk
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;ROOT=P.parents[1];rows=[]
for batch in ('ranged-source-clocks-v1','ranged-fire-fx-reference-v1'):
 manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports'/batch/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
 for r in manifest['Resources']:
  path=Path(r['ExportFile']);d=parse(path.read_text());groups={v['m_UID']['m_objUID']:v['m_name']for k,v in d['edit']['m_groupsInfo'].items()if k.startswith('item[')}
  scene_names={obj['m_UID']['m_objUID']:obj['m_name']for obj in walk(d)if 'm_UID'in obj and 'm_name'in obj}
  keys=[]
  for obj in walk(d):
   if 'm_keyProp'not in obj:continue
   h=obj['m_handle'];prop=obj['m_keyProp'];keys.append(dict(scene=h['sceneUID'],group=groups.get(h['groupUID']),key=h['keyUID'],start_ms=obj['m_startTime'],duration_ms=obj['m_duration'],kind=prop['m_class'],properties=prop.get('m_object',{})))
  rows.append(dict(asset=r['Name'],sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),groups=groups,names=scene_names,keys=keys))
(P/'ranged-native-scene-tracks-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
for r in rows:
 print(r['asset'])
````

````text
"""One-time explicit protocol migration; retain prior candidate archives."""
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src'
def edit(file,pairs):
 p=P/file;t=p.read_text()
 for a,b in pairs:
  assert a in t,(file,a);t=t.replace(a,b)
 p.write_text(t)
edit('ranged_presentation.h',[
 ('elapsed=0,duration=0;','elapsed=0,duration=0,mechanism=0;'),
 ('s.variant<=10&&','s.variant<=10&&s.mechanism<=2&&(!s.mechanism||s.kind==2)&&')])
edit('shadow_action_protocol.h',[
 ('version=25','version=26'),('==252','==256'),('p.version==25','p.version==26'),
 ('rangedTimeMs=0,rangedDurationMs=0;','rangedTimeMs=0,rangedDurationMs=0,rangedMechanism=0;'),
 ('p.rangedTimeMs,p.rangedDurationMs}', 'p.rangedTimeMs,p.rangedDurationMs,p.rangedMechanism}')])
edit('shadow_stream.h',[
 ('#include "native_player_ranged_scene.h"','#include "native_player_ranged_scene.h"\n#include "native_crossbow_presentation.h"'),
 ('airPacket->rangedDurationMs=ranged.durationMs;}', 'airPacket->rangedDurationMs=ranged.durationMs;\n            NativeCrossbowPresentation mechanical{};if(readNativeCrossbowPresentation(memoryRead,base,ranged.weapon,mechanical))airPacket->rangedMechanism=mechanical.state;}'),
 ('if(airPacket)airPacket->rangedKind=held.kind;', 'if(airPacket){airPacket->rangedKind=held.kind;NativeCrossbowPresentation mechanical{};\n                if(readNativeCrossbowPresentation(memoryRead,base,held,mechanical))airPacket->rangedMechanism=mechanical.state;}'),
 ('p.rangedTimeMs,p.rangedDurationMs}', 'p.rangedTimeMs,p.rangedDurationMs,p.rangedMechanism}')])
````
