## work/natural-moveset/keyhole_contacts_v24.py

[keyhole_contacts_v24.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/keyhole_contacts_v24.py>)

````text
"""Extract actual-time keyhole frames, without changing video timing or color."""
import json,sys,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
take=sys.argv[1];root=P/take
rows=json.loads((root/'states.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));out=[]
for repeat in (1,2):
 samples=[r for r in rows if r['repeat']==repeat and r.get('videoTime')]
 phases={}
 for r in samples:
  m=r['movement']
  if 7<=m['traversalVariant']<=16 and m['traversalWeight']>.9:
   phases.setdefault(m['traversalVariant'],[]).append(r['videoTime'])
 if len(phases) not in (1,2,3):continue
 order=sorted(phases,key=lambda v:min(phases[v]));entry,leave=order[0],order[-1];hold=order[1]if len(order)==3 else entry
 start=min(phases[entry]);end=max(phases[leave])
 if len(phases)==1:
  cancel=next((r['videoTime'] for r in samples if any(a.get('id')==24 and a.get('peekingResearch',{}).get('scene24')==0 and a.get('peekingResearch',{}).get('phaseEc')==3 for a in r['native']['active'])),end)
  times=[start-.3,start+.1,cancel,cancel+.15,cancel+.35,cancel+.65,cancel+1,cancel+1.6]
 else:times=[start-.3,start+.25,start+.7,min(phases[hold])+.2,max(phases[hold])-.2,min(phases[leave])+.2,end,end+.7]
````

## work/natural-moveset/make_contact_sheet.py

[make_contact_sheet.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/make_contact_sheet.py>)

````text
"""Extract a reproducible, labelled temporal sheet from a completed review video."""
import argparse, subprocess, io
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('video'); p.add_argument('output'); p.add_argument('times', nargs='+', type=float)
a = p.parse_args()
video = Path(a.video).resolve(); output = Path(a.output).resolve()
duration = float(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe', '-v', 'error', '-show_entries', 'format=duration', '-of', 'default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1', str(video)]))
frames = []
for i, t in enumerate(a.times):
    t = max(0, min(t, duration - .05))
    result = subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-ss', str(t), '-i', str(video), '-frames:v', '1', '-f', 'image2pipe', '-vcodec', 'png', '-'], check=True, capture_output=True)
    frame = Image.open(io.BytesIO(result.stdout)).convert('RGB'); frame.thumbnail((800, 450))
    tile = Image.new('RGB', (800, 478), '#171717'); tile.paste(frame, (0, 28))
    ImageDraw.Draw(tile).text((12, 8), f'{video.stem}  |  {t:.2f}s', fill='white')
    frames.append(tile)
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (1600, 478 * ((len(frames) + 1) // 2)), '#171717')
for i, tile in enumerate(frames): sheet.paste(tile, ((i % 2) * 800, (i // 2) * 478))
````

## work/natural-moveset/mantle_contacts_v20.py

[mantle_contacts_v20.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/mantle_contacts_v20.py>)

````text
import json,sys,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
take=sys.argv[1];root=P/take
rows=json.loads((root/'states.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
out=[]
for armed in (True,False):
 samples=[r for r in rows if r['armed']==armed and r['trial']==1 and r['movement']['traversalWeight']>.7 and r.get('videoTime')]
 assert samples,(take,armed)
 # Harness wall time is an approximate capture index: encoder startup can
 # offset the first frame. Include the lead-in rather than label an image
 # with a native phase that was observed by a separate asynchronous probe.
 start=min(r['videoTime']for r in samples)-.45
 times=[start+.18*f for f in range(8)]
 filename='contact-armed.jpg'if armed else'contact-empty.jpg'
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(P/'make_contact_sheet.py'),str(P/f'{take}.mp4'),str(root/filename),*[str(t)for t in times]],check=True)
 out.append(dict(armed=armed,trial=1,video_times=times,selection='Expanded interval around approximate harness wall time; inspect visible action phases directly. Capture startup is not phase-synchronized.',contact=filename))
(root/'contact-times.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
print('CONTACTS',take)
````

````text
 }

````

````text
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$targetMonitor=$null;$worldMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
````

````text
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$targetMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}

 }
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$before=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$dirty=$false
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($i=0;$i-lt8;$i++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($i=0;$i-lt8;$i++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Probe failed $mode"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or$p.Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-([DateTime]$l.startedAt)).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Isolated process identity changed'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid
  & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -DurationMs 100|Out-Null
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_mesmerize_visual off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  $before[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$before[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean health required'}
 }
 C host 'setviewpos -30.7 -151.8 68.1 230 0';C client 'setviewpos -34.3 -154.8 68.1 0 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role host -Pitch 15 -Evidence "$out/camera.json" -Quick
 $hwnd=(Get-Process -Id $pids.host).MainWindowHandle.ToInt64();if(!$hwnd){throw 'No observer window'}
 $args=@('-hide_banner','-loglevel','warning','-nostdin','-f','lavfi','-i',"gfxcapture=hwnd=${hwnd}:capture_cursor=0:max_framerate=30:width=-2:height=-2,hwdownload,format=bgra",'-t','16','-an','-c:v','libx264','-preset','veryfast','-crf','18','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-fps_mode','passthrough','-movflags','+faststart',"$PSScriptRoot/$Take.mp4")
````

## work/natural-moveset/mesmerize-world-emily-v75/run-script.ps1

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=12)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$worldMonitor=$null;$earlyMana=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --mesmerize-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 C client 'setviewpos -33.5 -153 68.1 270 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role client -Pitch $Pitch -Evidence "$out/source-camera.json" -Quick
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-coin-catalog-v799')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$failure=$null;$pids=@{};$rows=@{};$cache=@{}
function Save($p,$v){$v|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 18|Set-Content -LiteralPath $p}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if($LASTEXITCODE){throw "Probe failed $r $mode"};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
function O($r,$ptr){$key="$r-$ptr";if(!$cache.ContainsKey($key)){$cache[$key]=Q $r '--object' $ptr;Save "$out/$key.json" $cache[$key]};return $cache[$key]}
function Field($o,$offset){$w=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq $offset);if($w.Count-ne1){throw "Missing $offset"};return $w[0]}
function W($o,$offset){[Convert]::ToUInt64((Field $o $offset).word.Substring(2),16)}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Native operation active'}
 if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Unique evidence directory required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 Save "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json" @{pid=$PID;operation='CoinCatalog799';state='running';take=$Take}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or$p.Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-[DateTime]$l.startedAt).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Wrong native instance'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid
  $before=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($before.localGameLogicState-ne1-or$before.localPendingGameLogicState){throw 'Gameplay required for registry inventory'}
  $entities=Q $r '--entities';Save "$out/entities-$r.json" $entities;$coins=@($entities.entities|Where-Object {$_.type-eq'.?AVarkPickup@@'-and$_.name-match'coin'})
  if(!$coins.Count-or$coins.Count-gt128){throw 'Coin-name catalog unexpectedly empty or unbounded'};$list=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
  foreach($e in $coins){
   $cs=Q $r '--components' $e.handle;Save "$out/components-$r-$($e.handle).json" $cs;$pick=@($cs.components|Where-Object type -eq '.?AVarkCpntPickable_Simple@@')
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-guard-choke-v574',[ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidateSet('finish','breakout')][string]$Outcome='breakout')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$peerCapture=$null
````
````text
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$b='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $b -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read failed $mode"}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Another native operation remains active'}
 if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $out){throw 'Unique evidence take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 [ordered]@{pid=$PID;operation='NativeCrouchCombat613';take=$Take;started=(Get-Date).ToString('o');state='running'}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json"
 $dll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash
 $pin=Get-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/candidate-combat-target-v610/identity.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if($dll-ne$pin.dll){throw 'Expected archived610 candidate'}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_probe_follow exact','coop_probe_locomotion on','coop_shadow_loco combat','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Living fixture required'}
````

````text
function DoorSample($r){
 $d=$doorBindings[$r];$o=Q $r '--object' $d.component
 if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntOpenable@@'-or(W $o '0x10')-ne$d.owner-or((W $o '0x18')-band [uint64]4294967295)-ne$d.generation){$o|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7|Set-Content "$out/failed-door-$r.json";throw 'Door component lifetime changed'}
````

## work/natural-moveset/native-fetal-release-corvo-blend-v36/harness.ps1

````text
[CmdletBinding()]
param([ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role='host',[Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[switch]$CrouchedDrop,[switch]$CrouchedStart,[switch]$Paired,[switch]$TraceContact,
 [ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+\.json$')][string]$BankManifest='fetal-bank-manifest-v35.json')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if(!$Paired-or$CrouchedStart-or$CrouchedDrop){throw 'This experiment requires standing paired contextual release'}
if($TraceContact-and!$Paired){throw 'Contact trace requires paired study'}
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
$peer=if($Role-eq'host'){'client'}else{'host'};$character=if($Role-eq'host'){'corvo'}else{'emily'}
$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take;if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $out){throw 'Take exists'}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $PSCommandPath -Destination "$out/harness.ps1"
$launch=@{};foreach($r in 'host','client'){
 $launch[$r]=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if(!$launch[$r].assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $launch[$r].pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'}
}
function C($r,$s){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $s -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function Q($r,$flag,$value=''){
 for($i=0;$i-lt4;$i++){
  $v=if($value){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $launch[$r].pid $flag $value}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $launch[$r].pid $flag}
  if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($v|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 12
 };throw 'Native read unavailable'
````

## work/natural-moveset/native-front-corvo-v607/run-script.ps1

[run-script.ps1](<../../../work/natural-moveset/native-front-corvo-v607/run-script.ps1>)

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-guard-choke-v574',[ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidateSet('finish','breakout')][string]$Outcome='breakout')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$peerCapture=$null
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$b='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $b -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read failed $mode"}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Another native operation remains active'}
 if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $out){throw 'Unique evidence take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 [ordered]@{pid=$PID;operation='NativeFront607';take=$Take;started=(Get-Date).ToString('o');state='running'}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json"
 $dll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash
 $pin=Get-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/candidate-lethal-v604/identity.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if($dll-ne$pin.dll){throw 'Expected archived604 candidate'}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_probe_follow exact','coop_probe_locomotion on','coop_shadow_loco combat','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Living fixture required'}
````

````text
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$failure=$null;$pids=@{};$rows=@{};$cache=@{}
function Save($p,$v){$v|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 18|Set-Content -LiteralPath $p}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if($LASTEXITCODE){throw "Probe failed $r $mode"};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
function O($r,$ptr){$key="$r-$ptr";if(!$cache.ContainsKey($key)){$cache[$key]=Q $r '--object' $ptr;Save "$out/$key.json" $cache[$key]};return $cache[$key]}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Native operation active'}
 if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Unique evidence directory required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 Save "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json" @{pid=$PID;operation='InteractionFamilies827';state='running';take=$Take}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or$p.Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-[DateTime]$l.startedAt).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Wrong isolated incarnation'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid
  $before=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;Save "$out/before-$r.json" $before
  if($before.localGameLogicState-ne1-or$before.localPendingGameLogicState){throw 'Gameplay required'}
  $entities=Q $r '--entities';Save "$out/entities-$r.json" $entities
  $selected=@($entities.entities|Where-Object {$_.type-eq'.?AVarkUsable@@'-or$_.type-eq'.?AVarkMovable@@'-or($_.type-eq'.?AVidEntity@@'-and$_.name-match 'container|drawer|locker|safe_door')})
  $selected+=@($entities.entities|Where-Object type -eq '.?AVarkNPC@@'|Select-Object -First 3)
  if(!$selected.Count-or$selected.Count-gt128){throw 'Inspection scope empty or unbounded'}
  $list=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
````

````text
   $decl=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x8');if($decl.Count-ne1){throw 'Component declaration field missing'};$d=Q $r '--object' $decl[0].word;Save "$out/$tag-declaration-$r.json" $d

 }
````

## work/natural-moveset/native_prop_preview.py

[native_prop_preview.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/native_prop_preview.py>)

````text
"""Offline-only native equipment preview, including skeletal mechanisms."""
import bpy,hashlib
from clip_io import *
from edge_data import poses as edge_poses
class NativePropPreview:
 def __init__(self,name,definition):
  self.definition=definition;self.cache={};self.native=NativeRig(read(P/definition['skeleton'])['joints']);J=self.native.joints
  bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT');self.rig=bpy.data.objects.new(name,bpy.data.armatures.new(name+'_skeleton'));bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(self.rig);bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=self.rig;self.rig.select_set(True)
  bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
  for i,j in enumerate(J):
   bone=self.rig.data.edit_bones.new(j['nativeName']);bone.length=.015;bone.matrix=self.native.global_bind[i]
   if j['parent']>=0:bone.parent=self.rig.data.edit_bones[J[j['parent']]['nativeName']]
  bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT');self.rig.select_set(False)
  for b in self.rig.pose.bones:b.rotation_mode='QUATERNION'
  d=read(P/definition['model']);mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name+'_mesh');ix=d['indices'];mesh.from_pydata(d['vertices'],[],[ix[i:i+3]for i in range(0,len(ix),3)]);mesh.update();self.mesh=bpy.data.objects.new(mesh.name,mesh);bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(self.mesh);self.mesh.parent=self.rig;self.mesh.modifiers.new('native_weights','ARMATURE').object=self.rig
  groups={j['nativeName']:self.mesh.vertex_groups.new(name=j['nativeName'])for j in J}
  for i,weights in enumerate(d['weights']):
   for bone,weight in weights:
    if weight>0:groups[bone].add([i],weight,'REPLACE')
  mat=bpy.data.materials.new(name+'_native_prop');mat.diffuse_color=(.32,.21,.16,1)if definition['kind']=='heart'else(.38,.35,.28,1);mesh.materials.append(mat)
````

````text
param([string]$Take='npc-authority-census-v836')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take;$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab"
$m=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$pids=@{};$epochs=@{}
function Save($p,$v){$v|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20|Set-Content -LiteralPath $p}
function Q($r,$mode,$handle){
 $tag=$mode.TrimStart('-');$path="$out/$r-$handle-$tag.json"
 $raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $handle 2> "$out/$r-$handle-$tag.stderr"
 $code=$LASTEXITCODE;if(!$code){$value=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json;Save $path $value;return @{ok=$true;value=$value;path=$path}}
 return @{ok=$false;code=$code}
}
try{
 try{$owned=$m.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Native operation active'}
 if(!(Test-Path $out)){New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null};if(Test-Path "$out/result.json"){throw 'Completed take already exists'};Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or$p.Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-[DateTime]$l.startedAt).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Wrong isolated identity'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid
  $s=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($s.localGameLogicState-ne1-or$s.localPendingGameLogicState){throw 'Gameplay required'};$epochs[$r]=$s.localEpoch;Save "$out/before-$r.json" $s
  $raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --world-npcs;if($LASTEXITCODE){throw 'World catalog failed'};$catalog=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json;Save "$out/world-$r.json" $catalog
  foreach($n in $catalog.npcs|Where-Object unique){
   $h=Q $r '--health' $n.handle;$row=@{role=$r;npc=$n;health=$h;ai=@{}}
````

````text
function ResetState($r){Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json.reset.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 25};throw "Native query failed $r $mode"}
function Ready($tag,[int]$count=0){
 $w=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();do{$ok=$true;$pair=@{};foreach($r in 'host','client'){$v=N $r;$pair[$r]=$v;if(!$v.enabled-or!$v.session.enabled-or$v.session.menuSuspended-or$v.session.reloadPending-or($count-and$v.entries.Count-ne$count)-or!$v.entries.Count-or@($v.entries|Where-Object {!$_.enabled-or!$_.ready}).Count){$ok=$false}};if(!$ok){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 80}}while(!$ok-and$w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt8000)
 Save "$out/ready-$tag.json" $pair;if(!$ok){throw "NPC channels not ready: $tag expected$count"};return $pair
}
function P($role='host'){Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json.npc-perception.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Factions($tag){
 $map=@{};$state=N host;$partner=(S host).probeActorHandle
 foreach($e in $state.entries){if($e.enabled){$map[[string]$e.handle]=Q host '--faction' $e.handle}}
 $map['player']=Q host '--faction' 1;$map['partner']=Q host '--faction' $partner
 Save "$out/factions-$tag.json" $map;return $map
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take

 C 'setviewpos -38.95 -161.5 68.1 270 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role $Role -Pitch 50 -Evidence "$out/pickup-camera.json"|Out-Null
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-double-jump-v1')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null
$pids=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function I($r,$b='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $b -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Q($r,$mode,$id=0){for($i=0;$i-lt10;$i++){$raw=if($id){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw "Probe $r $mode"}
function Jump($r,$trial,$second){
 I $r;C $r 'setviewpos -34 -153 68.1 0 0';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 900
 I $r A 100;$watch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();$sent=$false;$jumps=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
 while($watch.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt3500){
  # Hold across the native minimum second-impulse time. A short pulse can
  # expire before that time when wall time advances faster than game time.
  if($second-and!$sent-and$watch.ElapsedMilliseconds-ge180){I $r A 650;$sent=$true}
  $n=Q $r '--player-states';$rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{role=$r;trial=$trial;ms=$watch.ElapsedMilliseconds;native=$n;fixture=(S $r '.agility-fixture.json')})
  foreach($a in @($n.active|Where-Object id -eq 2)){$jumps.Add($a.jumpResearch)}
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15
 }
 if(!$jumps.Count){throw "No native jump samples: $r $trial"}
````

````text
param([ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateSet('health','mana')][string]$Kind='health',[ValidateSet('None','B','X','Y','NativeHealth')][string]$WheelButton='None',[switch]$Network,[ValidateRange(0,15000)][int]$Move=0,[switch]$ValidateStatistics)
````

````text
$peer=if($Source-eq'host'){'client'}else{'host'};$peerCapture=$null;$tokens=@{};$moved=$false
$kindId=if($Kind-eq'health'){1}else{2};$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/build/Release/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,[string[]]$buttons=@('Neutral'),$ms=100,$ly=0){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $buttons -DurationMs $ms -LeftY $ly|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}

try{
 if($WheelButton-eq'NativeHealth'-and$Kind-ne'health'){throw 'Native callback fixture only supports health'}

 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
````

## work/natural-moveset/Observe-NativePower.ps1

[Observe-NativePower.ps1](<../../../work/natural-moveset/Observe-NativePower.ps1>)

````text
param([ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-power-corvo-v1')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null
$pids=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$start=0
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function InputState($r,$trigger=0,$ms=100,$button='Neutral'){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs $ms -LeftTrigger $trigger|Out-Null}
function Probe($r,$mode,$id=0){for($i=0;$i-lt10;$i++){$raw=if($id){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $r $mode"}
function State($r,$suffix=''){return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){$l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;InputState $r;C $r 'coop_movement_bank off';C $r 'coop_shadow_stream off';C $r 'coop_power_fixture off';C $r 'coop_movement_fixture off';C $r 'coop_movement_fixture 60000';if((Probe $r '--health' 1).current-ne56){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}}
 C $Source 'setviewpos -33.5 -153 68.1 270 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role $Source -Pitch 12 -Evidence "$out/camera.json"
 Probe $Source '--player-power'|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6|Set-Content "$out/power-before.json"
 C $Source 'coop_power_fixture 20000';$w=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();do{$s=State $Source '.power-fixture.json';if($s.result-eq'native_power_ready'){break};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50}while($w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt6000)
 if($s.result-ne'native_power_ready'){throw "Power did not equip: $($s.result)"}
 $power=Probe $Source '--player-power';$power|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6|Set-Content "$out/power-enabled.json"
 $window=(Get-Process -Id $pids[$Source]).MainWindowHandle.ToInt64();if(!$window){throw 'No source game window'}
 $args=@('-hide_banner','-loglevel','warning','-nostdin','-f','lavfi','-i',"gfxcapture=hwnd=${window}:capture_cursor=0:max_framerate=30:width=-2:height=-2,hwdownload,format=bgra",'-t','12','-an','-c:v','libx264','-preset','veryfast','-crf','18','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-fps_mode','passthrough','-movflags','+faststart',"$PSScriptRoot/$Take.mp4")
 $start=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();$capture=Start-Process -FilePath (Get-Command ffmpeg).Source -ArgumentList $args -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardError "$out/capture.log" -RedirectStandardOutput "$out/capture.stdout" -PassThru
 Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700;if($capture.HasExited){throw 'Recorder failed'}
````

## work/natural-moveset/Observe-NativeSprint.ps1

[Observe-NativeSprint.ps1](<../../../work/natural-moveset/Observe-NativeSprint.ps1>)

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-sprint-observation-v1')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null
$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$failure=$null
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function I($r,$x=0,$y=0,$button='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -LeftX $x -LeftY $y -Button $button -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
try {
 foreach($role in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Unexpected game identity'}
  I $role;C $role 'coop_movement_bank off';C $role 'coop_shadow_stream off'
  $status=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if($status.localPlayerStance-eq1){I $role 0 0 B 180;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1000}
  foreach($trial in @(@('run',0,32767,'Neutral'),@('sprint-forward',0,32767,'LeftThumb'),@('sprint-left',-16000,28000,'LeftThumb'),@('sprint-right',16000,28000,'LeftThumb'))){
   C $role 'setviewpos -34.3 -154.8 68.1 0 0';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600
   I $role $trial[1] $trial[2] $trial[3] 650
   $timer=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
   while($timer.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt1100){
    $raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $l.pid --player-states
    if(!$LASTEXITCODE){$rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{role=$role;trial=$trial[0];ms=$timer.ElapsedMilliseconds;native=($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)})}
````

````text
param([ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-traversal-fixtures-v1',[switch]$VaultOnly,[switch]$SensorTrigger,[switch]$Unarmed,[ValidateRange(1,6)][int]$Repetitions=2)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null
$pids=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$failure=$null
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function I($r,$button='Neutral',$ms=100,$y=0){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs $ms -LeftY $y|Out-Null}

# Native declaration requires speed >=3.65 m/s, obstacle height .55..1.25 m,
# depth <=1.8 m and two metres of clearance behind. These are candidate paths,
# not assumed vaults. No geometry or player-state fields are changed.
$cases=@(
 @{name='desk-clear-front';x=-30.2;y=-151.5;yaw=90;sprint=520},
 @{name='desk-clear-back';x=-30.2;y=-142;yaw=270;sprint=380},
 @{name='desk-side';x=-26.9;y=-146.6;yaw=180;sprint=180},
 @{name='shelf-high';x=-35.3;y=-148.3;yaw=180;sprint=0},
 @{name='bookcase-high';x=-36.7;y=-168.5;yaw=270;sprint=0}
)
if($VaultOnly){$cases=@(
 @{name='front-sprint-jump';x=-30.7;y=-150.5;yaw=90;sprint=260},
 @{name='front-right-sprint-jump';x=-29;y=-150.5;yaw=90;sprint=300},
````

````text
$pids=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$failure=$null
````

````text
function I($r,$button='Neutral',$ms=100,$y=0){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs $ms -LeftY $y|Out-Null}
function Status($r){Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Q($r,$mode,$id=0){for($i=0;$i-lt8;$i++){$raw=if($id){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw "Native read $r $mode"}

 foreach($src in 'host','client'){
  $dst=if($src-eq'host'){'client'}else{'host'};C $dst 'setviewpos -30.5 -149 68.1 233.13 0'
  foreach($stance in 0,1){
   if((Status $src).localPlayerStance-ne$stance){I $src B 180;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1000}
   foreach($axis in 32767,-32767){
    C $src 'setviewpos -33.5 -153 68.1 0 0';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 750
    $before=Q $src '--player';I $src Y 1000 $axis;$watch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    while($watch.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt1900){$state=Q $src '--player-states';$view=Q $src '--player';$rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{source=$src;stance=$stance;axis=$axis;ms=$watch.ElapsedMilliseconds;state=$state;view=$view;baseline=$before});Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 25}
    I $src Neutral 650 -22000;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1100;I $src
   }
````

## work/natural-moveset/patch_snapshot_harness.py

[patch_snapshot_harness.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/patch_snapshot_harness.py>)

````text
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source=P.parents[1]/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/src/carry_attachment_fixture.h'
s=source.read_text()
old='    fprintf(file,"{\\"testFixtureOnly\\":true,'
new='    fprintf(file,"{\\"snapshotCaptured\\":%s,\\"snapshotBound\\":%s,\\"snapshotElapsedMs\\":%llu,",f.snapshot.captured?"true":"false",f.snapshot.bound?"true":"false",f.snapshot.started&&tick>=f.snapshot.started?tick-f.snapshot.started:0);\n    fprintf(file,"\\"testFixtureOnly\\":true,'
assert s.count(old)==1;s=s.replace(old,new);source.write_text(s)
h=P/'Record-CarryAttachment.ps1';s=h.read_text()
s=s.replace("[switch]$CrouchedDrop,","[switch]$CrouchedDrop,[switch]$SnapshotBlend,")
old=" C $Role 'setviewpos -33 -153 68.1 90 0';C $peer 'setviewpos -29 -151.5 68.1 180 0'"
new=" if($SnapshotBlend){C $peer 'setviewpos -35 -160 68.1 180 0'}else{"+old.strip()+"}"
assert s.count(old)==1;s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace(" if($NaturalRelease){$schedule[0].command='coop_carry_attachment 16000'}", " if($NaturalRelease){$schedule[0].command='coop_carry_attachment 16000'}\n if($SnapshotBlend){\n  if($NaturalRelease-or$NativeDrop-or$Interruption-ne'none'){throw 'Snapshot proof is a separate bounded case'}\n  $schedule[0].command='coop_carry_attachment snapshot8000'\n  # Hold still for the complete 0.8s blend and 0.35s contact settle.\n  $schedule[1].ms=3700\n }")
s=s.replace('corpseMutations=$true}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/identity.json"','corpseMutations=$true;snapshotBlendRequested=[bool]$SnapshotBlend}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/identity.json"')
h.write_text(s)
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='pickup-catalog-restoration-v817')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null;$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$baseline=@{};$captures=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$coin='pickups_coin_emily_lowvalue_4'
function Save($p,$v){$v|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 15|Set-Content -LiteralPath $p}
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$b='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $b -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Read failed $r $mode"}
function Money($r){
 $h=Q $r '--health' 1;if($h.logic-ne1){throw 'Currency requires native gameplay'}
 $cs=Q $r '--components' 1;$i=@($cs.components|Where-Object type -eq '.?AVarkCpntInventory@@');if($i.Count-ne1-or$i[0].owner-ne$h.actor){throw 'Currency inventory ownership mismatch'}
 $o=Q $r '--object' $i[0].pointer;$owner=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x10');$w=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x168')
 if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntInventory@@'-or$owner.Count-ne1-or$owner[0].word-ne$h.actor-or$w.Count-ne1-or(Q $r '--health' 1).actor-ne$h.actor){throw 'Currency inventory incarnation changed'}
 $n=[Convert]::ToUInt64($w[0].word.Substring(2),16);return @{currency=[long]($n-shr32);inventory=$i[0].pointer;raw=$w[0];actor=$h.actor}
}
function Target($r){@((Q $r '--entities').entities|Where-Object name -eq $coin)}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Native operation active'}
 if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 Save "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json" @{pid=$PID;operation='PickupValidation817';state='running';take=$Take}
````

````text
 $cs=Q $r '--components' 1;$i=@($cs.components|Where-Object type -eq '.?AVarkCpntInventory@@');if($i.Count-ne1-or$i[0].owner-ne$h.actor){throw 'Currency inventory ownership mismatch'}
 $o=Q $r '--object' $i[0].pointer;$owner=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x10');$w=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x168')
 if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntInventory@@'-or$owner.Count-ne1-or$owner[0].word-ne$h.actor-or$w.Count-ne1-or(Q $r '--health' 1).actor-ne$h.actor){throw 'Currency inventory incarnation changed'}
 $n=[Convert]::ToUInt64($w[0].word.Substring(2),16);return @{currency=[long]($n-shr32);inventory=$i[0].pointer;raw=$w[0];actor=$h.actor}
}
function Target($r){@((Q $r '--entities').entities|Where-Object name -eq $coin)}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Native operation active'}
 if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 Save "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json" @{pid=$PID;operation='PickupValidation825';state='running';take=$Take}
````

## work/natural-moveset/prepare_balanced_crouch_powers_v2.py

[prepare_balanced_crouch_powers_v2.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/prepare_balanced_crouch_powers_v2.py>)

````text
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
s=(P/'build_balanced_crouch_powers_v1.py').read_text()
s=s.replace('balanced-crouch-powers-v1','balanced-crouch-powers-v2').replace('balanced-crouch-power-banks-v1','balanced-crouch-power-banks-v2').replace('balanced-crouch-power-source-manifest-v1','balanced-crouch-power-source-manifest-v2').replace('balanced-crouch-power-bank-manifest-v1','balanced-crouch-power-bank-manifest-v2')
s=s.replace('errors=[];heights=[];poses=[]','errors=[];heights=[];poses=[];arm_clamps=[]')
needle='    pin_feet(rig,p,targets,rotations);g=rig.fk(p);'
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,'''    if wind:
     # Follow the moving authored arm trajectories in actor space. A local
     # shoulder offset inherited the crouched spine bend twice and pointed
     # the cast at the floor. These are animated donor targets, not fixed
     # first-person wrists; shoulder, torso and pelvis still move together.
     def ease(x):
      x=max(0.,min(1.,x));return x*x*(3-2*x)
     weight=ease(t/.12)*(1-ease((t-.78)/.22))
     shift=p[2].translation-source[2].translation
     for shoulder,elbow,wrist in ((7,8,9),(14,15,16)):
      g=rig.fk(p);goal=restG[wrist].translation.lerp(sourceG[wrist].translation+shift,weight)
      pole=restG[elbow].translation.lerp(sourceG[elbow].translation+shift,weight)
      delta=goal-g[shoulder].translation;reach=(rig.bind[elbow].translation.length+rig.bind[wrist].translation.length)*.985
````

## work/natural-moveset/prepare_balanced_crouch_powers_v3.py

[prepare_balanced_crouch_powers_v3.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/prepare_balanced_crouch_powers_v3.py>)

````text
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
s=(P/'build_balanced_crouch_powers_v2.py').read_text()
s=s.replace('balanced-crouch-powers-v2','balanced-crouch-powers-v3').replace('balanced-crouch-power-banks-v2','balanced-crouch-power-banks-v3').replace('balanced-crouch-power-source-manifest-v2','balanced-crouch-power-source-manifest-v3').replace('balanced-crouch-power-bank-manifest-v2','balanced-crouch-power-bank-manifest-v3')
a=s.index('     shift=p[2].translation-source[2].translation')
b=s.index('    pin_feet(rig,p,targets,rotations);',a)
s=s[:a]+'''     # Preserve changing native upper-arm/forearm/hand directions in actor
     # space. Reparenting these orientations to the moving crouched shoulders
     # preserves every bone length without unreachable positional targets.
     for j in (7,8,9,14,15,16):
      g=rig.fk(p);rotation=g[j].to_quaternion().slerp(sourceG[j].to_quaternion(),weight).to_matrix();rig.orient(p,j,rotation)
'''+s[b:]
(P/'build_balanced_crouch_powers_v3.py').write_text(s)
````

## work/natural-moveset/prepare_bendtime_air_test_v43.py

[prepare_bendtime_air_test_v43.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/prepare_bendtime_air_test_v43.py>)

````text
"""Preserve the ground harness and derive guarded paired airborne coverage."""
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
s=(P/'Test-BendTimeContexts.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
s=s.replace("[switch]$Crouched,",'')
s=s.replace("$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';", "$Crouched=$false\n$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';",1)
s=s.replace("'bendtime-corvo-context-v41-v1'","'bendtime-corvo-air-v43-v1'").replace("'bendtime-context-bank-manifest-v41.json'","'bendtime-balanced-bank-manifest-v42.json'")
s=s.replace("$cameraPitch=if($Crouched){21}else{15}","$cameraPitch=0 # Keep the whole jump in frame.")
old="I $Source 255 350 Neutral $walk;$events.Add"
new="I $Source 0 220 A $walk;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 80;$jump=Q $Source '--player-states';$jump|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content -Encoding utf8 \"$out/jump-before-cast-$next.json\";if(!$jump.motionValid-or$jump.motion-ne2){throw 'Native Jump must precede Bend Time casting'};I $Source 255 350 Neutral $walk;$events.Add"
assert old in s;s=s.replace(old,new).replace("action='Native LT press 350ms'","action='Confirmed native A jump, then LT cast 350ms'")
old=" $peerPower=Q $peer '--player-darkvision';"
new=""" $air=@($rows|Where-Object {$_.native.motion-in@(2,3)-and$_.native.powerSceneValid-and$_.movement.powerWeight-gt.5-and$_.movement.airWeight-gt.5})
 if(!$air.Count){throw 'No confirmed native airborne cast overlaps remote cast and jump presentation'}
 if(@($air|Where-Object {$_.movement.airPhase-gt0}).Count-lt1){throw 'Remote airborne cast has no advancing jump phase'}
 $checks.Add('Exact native airborne power scene overlaps remote cast and airborne leg presentation')
 $peerPower=Q $peer '--player-darkvision';"""
assert old in s;s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace("character=$character;crouched=","character=$character;airborneExperiment=$true;crouched=")
s=s.replace('Corvo Bend Time ground stance/equipment/travel context integration.', 'Corvo Bend Time airborne cast, landing and equipment integration.')
````

## work/natural-moveset/prepare_bendtime_air_v43.py

[prepare_bendtime_air_v43.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/prepare_bendtime_air_v43.py>)

````text
"""Derive a bounded source-only air investigation from the verified ground fixture."""
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
s=(P/'Observe-BendTime.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
s=s.replace("'native-bendtime-corvo-v1'", "'native-bendtime-corvo-air-v43'")
old="{I host 255 $TriggerMs;$events.Add"
new="{I host 0 220 A;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 80;$jump=Q host '--player-states';$jump|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content -Encoding utf8 \"$out/jump-before-cast-$next.json\";if(!$jump.motionValid-or$jump.motion-ne2){throw 'Native jump did not precede the cast'};I host 255 $TriggerMs;$events.Add"
assert old in s;s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace('action="Native LT press ${TriggerMs}ms"', 'action="Confirmed native A jump then LT press ${TriggerMs}ms"')
s=s.replace(";$entities=Q host '--entities'",'')
s=s.replace("$wind=@($entities.entities|Where-Object {$_.definitionName-match'bendtime'})",'$wind=@()')
s=s.replace("component=(Q host '--object' $power.component)","power=(Q host '--player-bendtime')")
old="if(($midnight|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 -Compress)-match'power_bendtime_cast'){$sceneCount++}"
new="if(@($midnight.instances|Where-Object {$_.state-eq3-and$_.asset-match'power_bendtime_cast'}).Count){$sceneCount++}"
assert old in s;s=s.replace(old,new)
old="if(!$sceneCount){throw 'No native BendTime cast scene observed'};"
````

## work/natural-moveset/prepare_grenade_fx_v58.py

[prepare_grenade_fx_v58.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/prepare_grenade_fx_v58.py>)

````text
"""Retain native in-hand particles/light/audio, excluding observer rumble."""
import json, hashlib, re
from pathlib import Path
R = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
L = R / 'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
manifest = json.loads((L/'research/asset-exports/grenade-fx-reference-v57/manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
source = next(r for r in manifest['Resources'] if r['Name']=='models/effects/weapons/grenade/grenade_trail_inhand.fx')
raw = Path(source['ExportFile']).read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().upper()==source['Sha256']
text = raw.decode('utf-8-sig')
match = re.search(r'\bm_rumbles\s*=\s*\{', text)
assert match and len(re.findall(r'\bm_rumbles\s*=', text))==1
start = match.start(); depth = 1; end = match.end()
while depth:
    assert end<len(text)
    depth += (text[end]=='{')-(text[end]=='}'); end+=1
output = text[:start] + 'm_rumbles = { num = 0; }' + text[end:]
assert 'grenade_trail_inhand.particledt' in output
assert 'bsp_weapon_grenade_ticking_stop' in output
asset = L/'assets/grenade_inhand_remote.fx'
````

````text
"""Preserve the authored review pass, evidence and original-file integrity."""
import json,hashlib,datetime,zipfile,argparse,re
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;ROOT=P.parent.parent
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--name',default='authoring-pass-01');args=parser.parse_args();assert re.fullmatch(r'authoring-pass-[0-9]+',args.name)
out=P/args.name;out.mkdir(exist_ok=True);archive=out/'review-package.zip';assert not archive.exists(),'Preserved pass already exists'
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with p.open('rb')as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(2**20),b''):h.update(b)
 return h.hexdigest().upper()
now=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat();catalog=read(P/'review-catalog.json')
base=ROOT/'work/baseline-backup/Dishonored2/base';original=Path('C:/Users/adako/Saved Games/Arkane Studios/Dishonored2/base')
checks=[dict(file=str(p.relative_to(base)),matches=sha(p)==sha(original/p.relative_to(base)))for p in base.rglob('*')if p.is_file()]
for role in ['host','client']:
 for name in ['checkpoint.dat','game.details','screenshot.png']:
  candidates=[ROOT/'work/moveset-growth/pre-runtime-saves'/role/s/name for s in ['SLOT81','savegame/SLOT81','base/savegame/SLOT81']]
  prior=next(p for p in candidates if p.exists());current=ROOT/f'work/lab-instances/{role}/base/savegame/SLOT81'/name
  checks.append(dict(file=role+'/SLOT81/'+name,matches=sha(prior)==sha(current)))
````

## work/natural-moveset/preview_skin.py

[preview_skin.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/preview_skin.py>)

````text
"""Offline skin correction, separate from animation and native runtime helpers.

Corvo's helper_ankle bones are calf deformation joints parented to the tibia,
not foot sockets. Native final-publication captures retain their bind-local
translation and apply a small axial twist. The old preview moved these joints
around the ankle pivot, pulling the trouser cuffs away from the boot shafts.

Use the shin-relative bind transform here. This is a conservative preview:
the small native axial twist is not reconstructed. D2 continues to evaluate
its exact model correctives. Mesh weights and anatomical joints are untouched.
"""
VERSION='corvo-shin-anchors-v1'
def correct_calf_helpers(joints,bind,local):
 if len(joints)!=215:return
 for i,j in enumerate(joints):
  if j['nativeName'] in ('left_helper_ankle_jnt','right_helper_ankle_jnt'):
   expected=j['nativeName'].split('_')[0]+'_tibia_jnt'
   assert joints[j['parent']]['nativeName']==expected
   local[i]=bind[i].copy()
````

````text
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or$p.Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-[DateTime]$l.startedAt).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Unexpected isolated incarnation'};$ids[$r]=$l.pid
  $e=@((Q $r '--entities').entities|Where-Object name -eq 'pickups_coin_emily_lowvalue_4');if($e.Count-ne1-or$e[0].type-ne'.?AVarkPickup@@'-or$e[0].vtableRva-ne'0x1c5e258'){throw 'Exact coin identity missing'}
  Save "$out/entity-$r.json" $e[0];Save "$out/entity-object-$r.json" (Q $r '--object' $e[0].pointer)
  $cs=Q $r '--components' $e[0].handle;Save "$out/components-$r.json" $cs
  foreach($type in '.?AVarkCpntLoot@@','.?AVarkCpntPickable_Simple@@'){
   $c=@($cs.components|Where-Object type -eq $type);if($c.Count-ne1-or$c[0].owner-ne$e[0].pointer){throw 'Component owner mismatch'}
   $tag=if($type-eq'.?AVarkCpntLoot@@'){'loot'}else{'pickable'};$o=Q $r '--object' $c[0].pointer;Save "$out/$tag-$r.json" $o
   $decl=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x8');if($decl.Count-ne1){throw 'Component declaration field missing'};$d=Q $r '--object' $decl[0].word;Save "$out/$tag-declaration-$r.json" $d
   if($tag-eq'pickable'){$item=@($d.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0xf8');if($item.Count-eq1-and$item[0].word-ne'0x0'){Save "$out/item-declaration-$r.json" (Q $r '--object' $item[0].word)}}
  }
  Save "$out/inventory-$r.json" (Q $r '--player-inventory')
 }
````

## work/natural-moveset/rebuild_skin_reviews.py

[rebuild_skin_reviews.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/rebuild_skin_reviews.py>)

````text
"""Re-render the current catalog with corrected calf helpers; keep old movies.

Separate headless Blender processes have private scenes and output folders.
No game commands, save writes, animation re-authoring or live DLL changes.
"""
import json,sys,subprocess,concurrent.futures,datetime,hashlib,argparse
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BLENDER='C:/Program Files/Blender Foundation/Blender 5.2/blender.exe'
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--workers',type=int,choices=[1,2],default=1);args=parser.parse_args()
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
catalog=read(P/'boot-seam-v1/before/review-catalog.json')
# Use the exact source precedence of the saved catalog builder, without running
# its output-writing portion. Do not synthesize new animation metadata.
ns={'__file__':str(P/'build_review_catalog.py')}
exec((P/'build_review_catalog.py').read_text().split('motions={};pairs={}')[0],ns)
rows={}
for filename in ns['sources']:
 for r in read(P/filename):rows[(r['selection']['alias'],r['role'])]=r
````

## work/natural-moveset/record_compact_visual_reviews_v37.py

[record_compact_visual_reviews_v37.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/record_compact_visual_reviews_v37.py>)

````text
"""Record human-visible frame inspections actually completed during this turn."""
import json,datetime
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
notes={
'native-fetal-release-corvo-reader-v35':'Native compact source action observed; remote binding absent in v34. Not an accepted paired release.',
'native-fetal-release-corvo-v35':'Native source selected high throw, not compact release. Carrier clips observer edge; lease expires during delayed camera setup.',
'native-fetal-release-corvo-turn-v35':'Lifecycle checks pass; carrier mostly outside observer framing. No reliable full-body visual coverage.',
'native-fetal-release-emily-turn-v35':'Lifecycle checks pass; carrier mostly outside observer framing. No reliable full-body visual coverage.',
'native-fetal-release-corvo-framed-v35':'Useful full-body framing reveals victim straightening above carrier before falling; weak hand contact. Reject visual quality.',
'native-fetal-release-emily-framed-v35':'Useful full-body framing reveals the same upright victim pop, falling across the front with poor hand contact. Reject visual quality.',
'native-fetal-release-corvo-blend-v36':'Release snapshot experiment fails: no sampled release-scene activation and body exits frame above carrier. Trajectory exceeds bounded validator. Reject build for this path.'}
for take,note in notes.items():
 f=P/take;assert(f/'release-sheet.jpg').exists()
 (f/'visual-review.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(inspected=True,visual_accepted=False,
  inspected_at=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),method='Viewed actual-game contact sheet at 8.3, 8.7, 8.9, 9.1, 9.4, 10.4 seconds',
  evidence='release-sheet.jpg',notes=note,complete=False),indent=2))
print(json.dumps(dict(recorded=len(notes),accepted=0)))
````

````text
"""Persist inspected v27 drop comparisons, without accepting complete carry."""
import json, datetime
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(p): return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def write(p,v): p.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2))
cases=[]
for role in ['corvo','emily']:
 for low in [False,True]:
  case=f'native-pickup-walk-{"crouch-" if low else ""}drop-{role}-v27';cases.append(case)
  f=P/case;v=read(f/'pickup-drop-validation.json');assert v['passed']
  if low:
   write(f/'visual-review.json',dict(inspected=True,accepted=False,complete=False,
    method='Actual D2 temporal sheet at 3.5, 5.9, 6.4, 6.8, 7.2 and 8.1 seconds',
    observations='Native pickup, loaded walk, crouch and low drop connect. The body descends beside the carrier and settles locally in the inspected frames; no upward launch like the rejected v26 Corvo standing case. Carrier remains crouched during release. Palm contact is partly obscured and the body swings during release, so this is scoped lifecycle/physics evidence, not final animation acceptance. Crouched pickup and arbitrary bodies remain untested.'))
archive=P.parent/'movement-integration/candidate-drop-handoff-v27/identity.json'
a=read(archive);a['validatedCases']=cases;a['runtimeValidated']=True;a['complete']=False;write(archive,a)
s=read(P.parent/'current-task-state.json');m=s['MovementIntegration'];c=m['LatestContinuation']
m['current']='D2MOVE34 / 232 clips; v27 native sword visibility and carried-body physics handoff validated in bounded Dunwall cases. Complete movement and final visual acceptance unfinished.'
m['liveBuild']=c['live'];c['next']='Add crouched pickup, then remaining interactions, traversal/combat/items/powers and visual acceptance.'
````

## work/natural-moveset/record_high_throw_progress.py

[record_high_throw_progress.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/record_high_throw_progress.py>)

````text
"""Refresh current high-throw evidence while preserving historical records."""
import datetime,hashlib,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;R=P.parent.parent;D=R/'documentation/handoff-2026-10-11'
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
def write(p,v):
 t=p.with_suffix(p.suffix+'.tmp');t.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2));t.replace(p)
stamp=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat();statepath=R/'work/current-task-state.json'
backup=R/'work/movement-integration/current-task-state-before-high-throw.json'
if not backup.exists():shutil.copy2(statepath,backup)
state=read(statepath);m=state['MovementIntegration'];live=sha(R/'work/asset-game/dinput8.dll');cases={}
for folder in sorted(P.glob('native-high-throw-*')):
 if not folder.is_dir() or not(folder/'result.json').exists():continue
 result=read(folder/'result.json');identity=read(folder/'identity.json')if(folder/'identity.json').exists()else{}
 validation=read(folder/'high-throw-validation.json')if(folder/'high-throw-validation.json').exists()else None
 cases[folder.name]=dict(harnessPassed=result['passed'],failure=result.get('failure'),identity=identity,
  validation=validation,visual=read(folder/'visual-review.json')if(folder/'visual-review.json').exists()else None)
m['NativeHighThrowContinuation']=dict(at=stamp,liveDll=live,probe=sha(R/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe'),
 bankManifest='work/natural-moveset/high-throw-bank-manifest-v31.json',cases=cases,complete=False,
````

## work/natural-moveset/render_identity.py

[render_identity.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/render_identity.py>)

````text
"""Pin the animation, trajectories, props, models and renderer behind a video."""
import json, hashlib, functools
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def digest(value):return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
@functools.lru_cache(None)
def file_sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def data_identity(pair):
 data={role:{k:m.get(k)for k in ['sha256','root_track','props','equipment_policy','frames','fps']}for role,m in pair.items()}
 for role,m in pair.items():
  if 'preview_placement'in m:data[role]['preview_placement']=m['preview_placement']
  if 'preview_view'in m:data[role]['preview_view']=m['preview_view']
  if 'preview_caption'in m:data[role]['preview_caption']=m['preview_caption']
 return digest(data)
def fingerprint(pair,overrides=None):
 models={}
 for role in ['corvo','emily']:
  for part in ['body','head']:
   path=(overrides or {}).get(role+'-'+part,(P.parent/'fullbody-proof'if role=='corvo'else P.parent/'moveset-growth')/f'{role}-{part}.json')
   models[role+'-'+part]=dict(path=str(Path(path).relative_to(P.parent)),sha256=file_sha(str(path)))
````

## work/natural-moveset/review_server.py

[review_server.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/review_server.py>)

````text
"""Loopback-only review server with byte ranges for reliable video scrubbing."""
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,re
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
class ReviewHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
 def __init__(self,*args,**kwargs):super().__init__(*args,directory=str(ROOT),**kwargs)
 def send_head(self):
  self.byte_range=None
  path=Path(self.translate_path(self.path)).resolve()
  if not path.is_relative_to(ROOT):self.send_error(403);return None
  if not path.is_file():return super().send_head()
  file=path.open('rb');size=path.stat().st_size;start=0;end=size-1;partial=False
  header=self.headers.get('Range')
  if header:
   match=re.fullmatch(r'bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)',header.strip())
   if not match or not any(match.groups()):file.close();self.send_error(400,'Unsupported range');return None
   a,b=match.groups()
   if a:start=int(a);end=min(int(b),size-1)if b else size-1
   else:start=max(0,size-int(b))
````

## work/natural-moveset/rig_math.py

[rig_math.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/rig_math.py>)

````text
"""Offline native-rig math. No first-person positional constraints or scene state."""
import json, math, re
from mathutils import Matrix, Quaternion, Vector

def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

def qts(q):
    m = Quaternion((q[3], *q[:3])).normalized().to_matrix().to_4x4()
    m.translation = Vector(q[4:7])
    return m

def ease(t):
    t = max(0, min(1, t))
    return t*t*(3-2*t)

class NativeRig:
    def __init__(self, joints):
        self.joints = joints
        self.bind = [qts(j['bindLocalQTS']) for j in joints]
````

````text
  if run.returncode==0:row.update(status='sampled_reference_only',sampling=json.loads(run.stdout),sample_file=str(file.relative_to(P)),sample_sha256=hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
````

````text
"""Read-only geometric screen; approximate blade centreline is not visual acceptance."""
import sys,struct,json,math
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(P))
from clip_io import *
reports=[]
for role in ('corvo','emily'):
 data=(P/'outofmana-context-banks-v46'/f'{role}-outofmana-context-bank.bin').read_bytes()
 magic,version,n,count,fps,layout=struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIQ',data);assert version==41 and count==251
 size=24+121*n*28;rig=rig_for(role)
 q=read(P.parent/('fullbody-proof/inputs/client-target-sword.json'if role=='corvo'else'crouch-grip-reference/host-target-sword.json'))['quaternion']
 binding=Quaternion((q[3],-q[0],-q[1],-q[2])).normalized().to_matrix().to_4x4()
 for cid in (17,239,242,245,249):
  samples=[]
  for f in range(0,120,6):
   pose=[qts(struct.unpack_from('<7f',data,32+cid*size+24+(f*n+j)*28))for j in range(n)]
   g=rig.fk(pose);weapon=g[17]@binding
   samples.append(dict(frame=f,bladeMinZ=min((weapon@Vector((x,0,0))).z for x in(-.1,0,.2,.4,.6,.75)),handZ=g[16].translation.z,ankleZ=[g[j].translation.z for j in(21,25)],toeZ=[g[j].translation.z for j in(22,26)]))
  reports.append(dict(role=role,clip=cid,samples=samples))
(P/'crouch-power-clearance-screen-v49.json').write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2))
````

## work/natural-moveset/screen_release_contacts.py

[screen_release_contacts.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/screen_release_contacts.py>)

````text
"""Summarize separately bracketed published skeleton reads; never visual acceptance."""
import json,math,sys
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def bend(a,b,c):
    u=[x-y for x,y in zip(a,b)];v=[x-y for x,y in zip(c,b)]
    den=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in u)*sum(x*x for x in v))
    return 180-math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1,min(1,sum(x*y for x,y in zip(u,v))/den)))) if den else None
for take in sys.argv[1:]:
    folder=P/take;rows=json.loads((folder/'contact-trace.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));out=[]
    for row in rows:
        m=row['movementBefore']
        if m['carryVariant'] not in [5,8]:continue
        s=row['victim'];j={x['nativeName']:x['globalPose'][12:15] for x in s['joints']}
        out.append(dict(begin_ms=row['beginMs'],end_ms=row['endMs'],variant=m['carryVariant'],amount=m['carrySampleAmount'],
          root=s['root'][:3],anchor=j.get('anchor_jnt'),head=j.get('center_head_jnt'),
          knees={side:bend(*(j[f'{side}_{x}_jnt'] for x in ['femur','tibia','ankle'])) for side in ['left','right']}))
    (folder/'release-contact-screening.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(atomic=False,visual_accepted=False,samples=out),indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(dict(take=take,samples=out)))
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
````

````text
rows=json.loads((P/'native-expanded-sample-manifest.json').read_text())['rows']
requests={}
def add(family,aliases,purpose):
 for a in aliases.split():requests[a]=dict(family=family,purpose=purpose)
add('stance','empty_distraction_look_keyhole_in_walkright empty_distraction_look_keyhole_loop empty_distraction_look_keyhole_out_fast empty_distraction_look_keyhole_out_walk','Authored full-body keyhole sequence; door contact must be adapted')
add('interactions','empty_distraction_loot_ground_in empty_distraction_loot_ground_loop empty_distraction_loot_ground_out empty_distraction_loot_ground_out_fast','Native ground pickup donor, requiring item placement and contact alignment')
add('interactions','empty_distraction_sitting_bench_in empty_distraction_sitting_bench_in_walkright empty_distraction_sitting_bench_loop empty_distraction_sitting_bench_out empty_distraction_sitting_bench_out_fast empty_distraction_sitting_bench_out_walk','Native sit/stand sequence; seat geometry remains a contact parameter')
add('combat','generic_deathfast_back generic_deathfast_front generic_deathfast_left generic_deathfast_right empty_stinghit_death','Native death reactions; ragdoll handoff and shared death UI remain separate')
add('interactions','empty_distraction_wall_lean_front_a_in_walkleft empty_distraction_wall_lean_front_a_loop empty_distraction_wall_lean_front_a_out_walk','Leaning against a wall; NOT player lateral aiming/peeking')
sources={};missing=[]
for a,request in requests.items():
 candidates=[r for r in rows if a in r['aliases'] and r['status']=='native_pose_sampled_offline']
 if not candidates:missing.append(a);continue
 for role in ('corvo','emily'):
  r=min(candidates,key=lambda r:(r['source_role']!=role,'/high/' not in r['asset'],r['asset']))
  s=sources.setdefault(r['id'],dict(alias=a,**request,targets=[]))
````

````text
  if([Math]::Abs($yawError)-le.9-and[Math]::Abs($pitchError)-le.9){$settled++;if($settled-ge2){break};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100;continue};$settled=0
  if([Math]::Abs($yawError)-gt.9){
   if($null-eq$yawRate){
    & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $Role -RightX 20000 -DurationMs 200|Out-Null;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 330
````

## work/natural-moveset/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1

[Set-ObserverPitch.ps1](<../../../work/natural-moveset/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1>)

````text
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Role,[ValidateRange(-70,70)][double]$Pitch=15,[string]$Evidence,[switch]$Quick)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
$launch=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$Role/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
if(!$launch.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $launch.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong camera process'}
$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$settled=0
try{
 for($i=0;$i-lt24;$i++){
  # The read-only probe can race a native player snapshot even when the world
  # is ready. Retry briefly without sending camera input on an invalid read.
  $view=$null
  for($readAttempt=0;$readAttempt-lt8;$readAttempt++){
   $raw=& "$root/work/build/Release/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $launch.pid --player 2> $null
   if(!$LASTEXITCODE){try{$view=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json}catch{$view=$null}}
   if($view.nativeViewOrientation.Count-eq9){break}
   $view=$null;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 125
  }
  if($view.nativeViewOrientation.Count-ne9){throw 'Native camera read failed after bounded retries'}
  $z=[double]$view.nativeViewOrientation[2];if([Math]::Abs($z)-gt1){throw 'Invalid native camera forward vector'}
  $current=-[Math]::Asin($z)*180/[Math]::PI;$error=$Pitch-$current
  $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{iteration=$i;pitch=$current;target=$Pitch;view=$view})
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='shared-coin-catalog-v801',[ValidateSet('batch','simultaneous')][string]$Mode='batch')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null;$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$baseline=@{};$captures=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$coin='pickups_coin_emily_lowvalue_4'
function Save($p,$v){$v|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 15|Set-Content -LiteralPath $p}
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$b='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $b -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Read failed $r $mode"}
function Money($r){
 $h=Q $r '--health' 1;if($h.logic-ne1){throw 'Currency requires native gameplay'}
 $cs=Q $r '--components' 1;$i=@($cs.components|Where-Object type -eq '.?AVarkCpntInventory@@');if($i.Count-ne1-or$i[0].owner-ne$h.actor){throw 'Currency inventory ownership mismatch'}
 $o=Q $r '--object' $i[0].pointer;$owner=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x10');$w=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x168')
 if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntInventory@@'-or$owner.Count-ne1-or$owner[0].word-ne$h.actor-or$w.Count-ne1-or(Q $r '--health' 1).actor-ne$h.actor){throw 'Currency inventory incarnation changed'}
 $n=[Convert]::ToUInt64($w[0].word.Substring(2),16);return @{currency=[long]($n-shr32);inventory=$i[0].pointer;raw=$w[0];actor=$h.actor}
}
function Target($r){@((Q $r '--entities').entities|Where-Object name -eq $coin)}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Native operation active'}
 if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 Save "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json" @{pid=$PID;operation='CoinCatalog801';state='running';take=$Take}
````

## work/natural-moveset/summarize_bendtime_assets.py

[summarize_bendtime_assets.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/summarize_bendtime_assets.py>)

````text
"""Read exact exported power scenes, preserving native phase/event evidence."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from inspect_midnight_events import parse,walk
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
folder=P.parents[1]/'outputs/d2-coop-lab/research/asset-exports/native-bendtime-v1'
m=json.loads((folder/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));out=[]
for r in m['Resources']:
 if r['Class']!='midnightScene':continue
 d=parse(Path(r['ExportFile']).read_text());scenes=[];clips=[];events=[]
 for o in walk(d):
  if 'm_properties'in o:scenes.append(o['m_properties'])
  if 'm_keyProp'in o:
   v=o['m_keyProp']['m_object'];row=dict(start=o.get('m_startTime'),duration=o.get('m_duration'),body=v)
   if o['m_keyProp']['m_class']=='arkMidnightKeyPropAnim':clips.append(row)
   else:events.append(dict(kind=o['m_keyProp']['m_class'],**row))
 out.append(dict(name=r['Name'],sha256=r['Sha256'],scenes=scenes,clips=clips,other_tracks=events))
(P/'bendtime-scene-summary-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
````
