````text
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$worldRows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $visualBaseline=S client '.swarm-rat-visual.json';$visualBaseline|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/visual-baseline.json"
````
````text
 $dirty=$true
 C host 'setviewpos -48.59 -155.07 68.1 90 0';C client 'setviewpos -46.3 -151.8 68.1 220 0';
````

## work/natural-moveset/terrain_contact_v4.py

[terrain_contact_v4.py](<../../../work/natural-moveset/terrain_contact_v4.py>)

````text
"""Sample native stair traversal while the authored stair gait is engaged."""
import sys,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
for take in sys.argv[1:]:
 rows=json.loads((P/take/'states.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
 times=[]
 for trial in ('up','down'):
  samples=[r for r in rows if r['trial']==trial and r['movement']['terrainWeight']>.85 and r['movement']['speed']>.4]
  assert len(samples)>10
  for q in (.15,.45,.75):times.append(samples[round((len(samples)-1)*q)]['videoTime'])
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(P/'make_contact_sheet.py'),str(P/f'{take}.mp4'),str(P/take/'contact.jpg'),*map(str,times)],check=True)
 (P/take/'contact-times.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(times=times,selection='15/45/75 percent of engaged moving stair samples per direction; actual capture timestamps'),indent=2))
````

````text
param([ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='integrated-air-combat-corvo-v1',[switch]$Record,[switch]$AuthoredFeet)

$target=if($Source-eq'host'){'client'}else{'host'};$character=if($Source-eq'host'){'corvo'}else{'emily'};$pids=@{};$handles=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null

 }
 C $target 'setviewpos -28.5 -151.2 68.1 200 0';C $Source 'setviewpos -33.5 -153 68.1 0 0'

 Copy-Item "$PSScriptRoot/air-combat-banks-v1/$character-air-combat-bank.bin" "$root/work/lab-instances/$target/coop-status.json.movement.bin"
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-auto-crouch-emily-v654',[ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidateSet('finish','breakout')][string]$Outcome='breakout')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$peerCapture=$null
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$b='Neutral',$ms=100,$y=0){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $b -DurationMs $ms -LeftY $y|Out-Null}
function S($r){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read failed $mode"}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Another native operation remains active'}
 if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $out){throw 'Unique evidence take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 [ordered]@{pid=$PID;operation='AutoCrouch654';take=$Take;started=(Get-Date).ToString('o');state='running'}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json"
 $dll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash
 $pin=Get-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/candidate-auto-crouch-v651/identity.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 if($dll-ne$pin.dll){throw 'Expected archived651 candidate'}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_probe_follow exact','coop_probe_locomotion on','coop_shadow_loco combat','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Living fixture required'}
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
$mutex=[Threading.Mutex]::new($false,'Local\D2CoopLab_NativeOperation_01a11a65');$owned=$false;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null;$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$baseline=@{};$captures=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$coin='pickups_coin_emily_lowvalue_4'
````
````text
function Save($p,$v){$v|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 15|Set-Content -LiteralPath $p}
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$b='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $b -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Read failed $r $mode"}
function Money($r){
 $h=Q $r '--health' 1;if($h.logic-ne1){throw 'Currency requires native gameplay'}
 $cs=Q $r '--components' 1;$i=@($cs.components|Where-Object type -eq '.?AVarkCpntInventory@@');if($i.Count-ne1-or$i[0].owner-ne$h.actor){throw 'Currency inventory ownership mismatch'}
 $o=Q $r '--object' $i[0].pointer;$owner=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x10');$w=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq '0x168')
 if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntInventory@@'-or$owner.Count-ne1-or$owner[0].word-ne$h.actor-or$w.Count-ne1-or(Q $r '--health' 1).actor-ne$h.actor){throw 'Currency inventory incarnation changed'}
 $n=[Convert]::ToUInt64($w[0].word.Substring(2),16);return @{currency=[long]($n-shr32);inventory=$i[0].pointer;raw=$w[0];actor=$h.actor}
}
function Target($r){@((Q $r '--entities').entities|Where-Object name -eq $coin)}
try{
 try{$owned=$mutex.WaitOne(0)}catch [Threading.AbandonedMutexException]{$owned=$true};if(!$owned){throw 'Native operation active'}
 if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
 Save "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json" @{pid=$PID;operation='CoinCatalog801';state='running';take=$Take}
````

````text
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
````

````text
  foreach($c in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_power_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $c}
````

````text
 $dirty=$true
 # Suspending AI decisions does not stop an existing native navigation animation.
````

````text
function DS($r){$d=@((DAll $r).entries|Where-Object name -eq $DoorName);if($d.Count-ne1){throw 'Selected door channel absent or ambiguous'};return $d[0]}
function CatalogReady($d){$d.enabled-and$d.catalogCount-eq6-and$d.ambiguous-eq0-and$d.ineligible-eq4-and@($d.entries|Where-Object {!$_.enabled-or!$_.ready-or$_.revision-ne1-or$_.applied-ne1}).Count-eq0}
$initialOpen=$DoorName-eq'ld_door_350cm_int_rich_wood_01_2'
$expectedCycle=if($initialOpen){'2,1,0,1,2'}else{'0,1,2,1,0'}
function S($r){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read failed $mode"}
function W($o,$offset){$w=@($o.words|Where-Object offset -eq $offset);if($w.Count-ne1){throw "Missing object field $offset"};[Convert]::ToUInt64($w[0].word.Substring(2),16)}
function DoorSample($r){
 $d=$doorBindings[$r];$o=Q $r '--object' $d.component
 if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntOpenable@@'-or(W $o '0x10')-ne$d.owner-or((W $o '0x18')-band [uint64]4294967295)-ne$d.generation){$o|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7|Set-Content "$out/failed-door-$r.json";throw 'Door component lifetime changed'}
 $state=W $o '0x48';$flags=W $o '0x1e8'
 [pscustomobject]@{handle=$d.handle;current=[uint32]($state-band [uint64]4294967295);pending=[uint32]($state-shr 32);locked=[int]($flags-band 255);flags1e8=('0x{0:x}'-f$flags);state90=('0x{0:x}'-f(W $o '0x90'));movingTarget=('0x{0:x}'-f(W $o '0xb0'));child=[uint32]((W $o '0xd8')-shr 32)}
}
````

````text
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}

function CatalogReady($d){$d.enabled-and$d.catalogCount-eq6-and$d.ambiguous-eq0-and$d.ineligible-eq4-and@($d.entries|Where-Object {!$_.enabled-or!$_.ready-or$_.revision-ne1-or$_.applied-ne1}).Count-eq0}
$initialOpen=$DoorName-eq'ld_door_350cm_int_rich_wood_01_2'

function DoorSample($r){
 $d=$doorBindings[$r];$o=Q $r '--object' $d.component
 if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntOpenable@@'-or(W $o '0x10')-ne$d.owner-or((W $o '0x18')-band [uint64]4294967295)-ne$d.generation){$o|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7|Set-Content "$out/failed-door-$r.json";throw 'Door component lifetime changed'}
 $state=W $o '0x48';$flags=W $o '0x1e8'
 [pscustomobject]@{handle=$d.handle;current=[uint32]($state-band [uint64]4294967295);pending=[uint32]($state-shr 32);locked=[int]($flags-band 255);flags1e8=('0x{0:x}'-f$flags);state90=('0x{0:x}'-f(W $o '0x90'));movingTarget=('0x{0:x}'-f(W $o '0xb0'));openSide=[int]((W $o '0xc8')-band 255);child=[uint32]((W $o '0xd8')-shr 32)}
}
````

````text
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
````

````text
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'client','host'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_domino_fixture off','coop_swarm_fixture off','coop_possession_fixture off','coop_doppelganger_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
````
````text
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
````
````text
 $cloneStart=S client '.doppelganger-world.json';$sequenceFloor=[uint64](($cloneStart.history.sequence|Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum)
 $epochStart=@{host=(S host).localEpoch;client=(S client).localEpoch}
 $epochStart|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$out/world-start.json"
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$targetMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
````
````text
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --mesmerize-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_mesmerize_visual off','coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
````
````text
 $visualBefore=S host '.mesmerize-visual.json';$worldBefore=S host '.mesmerize-world-stream.json'
````
````text
 $filterBefore=S client '.mesmerize-partner-filter.json';$filterBefore|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$out/filter-before.json"
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(-15,45)][int]$Pitch=12,[ValidateSet('receiver-stop','source-pause','receiver-pause')][string]$Interrupt='source-pause')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$inventory=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$events=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$recorders=@();$capture=$null;$monitor=$null;$targetMonitor=$null;$dirty=$false;$failure=$null
$initialDll=(Get-FileHash "$root/work/asset-game/dinput8.dll").Hash;$initialProbe=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe").Hash
function C($r,$cmd){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $cmd -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function I($r,$lt=0,$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button Neutral -LeftTrigger $lt -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){try{$v=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null-ne$v){return $v}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($a=0;$a-lt8;$a++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $mode failed"}
function OptionalFx($r){$raw=& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] --mesmerize-effects;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;if($code){return [pscustomobject]@{stable=$false;exitCode=$code}};return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated game'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;I $r
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_mesmerize_visual off','coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_potion_fixture off','coop_bendtime_fixture off','coop_darkvision_fixture off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}
  $inventory[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$inventory[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
 }
 $visualBefore=S host '.mesmerize-visual.json';$worldBefore=S host '.mesmerize-world-stream.json'
 $eyesBefore=S host '.mesmerize-eyes.json';$eyesBefore|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/eyes-before.json"
````

## work/natural-moveset/Test-MesmerizeVisual-v76.ps1

[Test-MesmerizeVisual-v76.ps1](<../../../work/natural-moveset/Test-MesmerizeVisual-v76.ps1>)

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab="$root/outputs/d2-coop-lab";$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!$Take-or(Test-Path $out)){throw 'Unique take required'};New-Item -ItemType Directory $out|Out-Null;Copy-Item $PSCommandPath "$out/run-script.ps1"
$pids=@{};$before=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null;$dirty=$false
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed -ReceiptTimeoutMs 8000|Out-Null}
function S($r,$suffix=''){for($i=0;$i-lt8;$i++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$arg=0){for($i=0;$i-lt8;$i++){$raw=if($arg){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $arg}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Probe failed $mode"}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Get-Process -Id $l.pid
  if(!$l.assetExperiment-or$p.Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')-or[Math]::Abs(($p.StartTime-([DateTime]$l.startedAt)).TotalSeconds)-gt5){throw 'Isolated process identity changed'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid
  & "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -DurationMs 100|Out-Null
  foreach($cmd in 'coop_movement_resume off','coop_movement_bank off','coop_review_clip off','coop_shadow_stream off','coop_mesmerize_visual off','coop_mesmerize_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture off','coop_movement_fixture 60000'){C $r $cmd}
  $before[$r]=Q $r '--player-inventory';$before[$r]|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content "$out/inventory-before-$r.json"
  if((Q $r '--health' 1).current-ne56-or(Q $r '--health' (S $r).probeActorHandle).current-ne40){throw 'Clean health required'}
 }
 C host 'setviewpos -30.7 -151.8 68.1 230 0';C client 'setviewpos -34.3 -154.8 68.1 0 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role host -Pitch 15 -Evidence "$out/camera.json" -Quick
 $hwnd=(Get-Process -Id $pids.host).MainWindowHandle.ToInt64();if(!$hwnd){throw 'No observer window'}
 $args=@('-hide_banner','-loglevel','warning','-nostdin','-f','lavfi','-i',"gfxcapture=hwnd=${hwnd}:capture_cursor=0:max_framerate=30:width=-2:height=-2,hwdownload,format=bgra",'-t','16','-an','-c:v','libx264','-preset','veryfast','-crf','18','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-fps_mode','passthrough','-movflags','+faststart',"$PSScriptRoot/$Take.mp4")
````

````text
 };return $pair
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$TakePrefix='v16-timeline-v1',[switch]$AuthoredFeet)
````

````text
 }
 foreach($speed in 14000,32767){

   C $Source 'setviewpos -34.3 -154.8 68.1 0 0';C $target 'setviewpos -29 -151.5 68.1 214 14';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
   foreach($r in 'host','client'){C $r 'coop_shadow_stream 15000'};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 350;C $target 'coop_movement_bank 60000';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
````

````text
function C($r,$text){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $text -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function I($r,$button='Neutral',$ms=100){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs $ms|Out-Null}

 }
 $before=Q $Source '--player-grenade';if($before.quantity-or$before.equipped-or$before.started){throw 'Grenade already owned/selected'};$before|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$out/before.json"
 if((Q $Source '--player-states').stance-ne0){I $Source B 180;Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700}
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role $Source -Pitch 0 -Evidence "$out/source-camera.json"
 $hwnd=(Get-Process -Id $pids[$Source]).MainWindowHandle.ToInt64();if(!$hwnd){throw 'No source window'}
 $args=@('-hide_banner','-loglevel','warning','-nostdin','-f','lavfi','-i',"gfxcapture=hwnd=${hwnd}:capture_cursor=0:max_framerate=30:width=-2:height=-2,hwdownload,format=bgra",'-t','16','-an','-c:v','libx264','-preset','veryfast','-crf','18','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-fps_mode','passthrough','-movflags','+faststart',"$PSScriptRoot/$Take.mp4")
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-power-fixture-v1',[ValidateSet('host','client')][string[]]$Sources=@('host','client'),[ValidateSet('cancel','expire','pause')][string]$Mode='cancel')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
````

````text
$pids=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function InputState($r,$button='Neutral') {& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs 180|Out-Null}
function Probe($r,$mode,$id=0){for($i=0;$i-lt12;$i++){$raw=if($id){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50};throw "Native read $r $mode"}
function State($r,$suffix='.power-fixture.json'){return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}
function AwaitResult($r,$result,$ms=6000){$w=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();do{$s=State $r;$rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{role=$r;ms=$w.ElapsedMilliseconds;state=$s});if($s.result-eq$result){return $s};if($s.lost){throw "Power fixture cleanup lost: $($s.result)"};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 60}while($w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt$ms);throw "Power fixture deadline: $($s.result)"}
$protected=Get-Content "$root/work/movement-integration/protected-save-hashes-before-v4.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
try{
 foreach($f in $protected){if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.Path).Hash-ne$f.Hash){throw 'Protected save differs'}}
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){$l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;InputState $r;C $r 'coop_movement_bank off';C $r 'coop_shadow_stream off';C $r 'coop_movement_fixture off';C $r 'coop_power_fixture off'}
 foreach($r in $Sources){
  $peer=if($r-eq'host'){'client'}else{'host'};$before=Probe $r '--player-power';$inventory=Probe $r '--player-inventory';$sword=Probe $r '--player-sword';$health=Probe $r '--health' 1
  $before|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content "$out/$r-before.json";$inventory|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6|Set-Content "$out/$r-inventory-before.json"
  if($before.quantity-ne0-or$before.equipped-or$before.started){throw 'Baseline power is not unavailable'}
  $s=State $r;C $r 'coop_power_fixture 20000';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400;$refused=State $r
  if($refused.active-or$refused.refused-ne($s.refused+1)){throw 'Unisolated fixture did not refuse'};$checks.Add("${r}: grant refused outside NPC-isolated scope")
  C $r 'coop_movement_fixture 60000';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600;C $r 'coop_power_fixture 20000';$ready=AwaitResult $r 'native_power_ready'
````

````text
 if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntUsableWithStateList@@'-or(Field $o '0x10').word-ne$b.actor-or(Field $o '0x8').word-ne$b.declaration-or((W $o '0x18')-band[uint64]4294967295)-ne$b.generation){throw 'Usable incarnation changed'}
 $state=W $o '0x28';$flags=(W $o '0x30')-band255
 return [ordered]@{tick=[Environment]::TickCount64;current=(Signed32 $state);pending=(Signed32 ($state-shr32));flags=$flags;transition=($flags-band2)-ne0;enabled=((W $o '0x20')-band255);instigator=('0x{0:x}'-f((W $o '0xd0')-band[uint64]4294967295));animation=(Field $o '0xd8').word}
}
````

````text
function Ready($tag,[int]$count=0){
 $w=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();do{$ok=$true;$pair=@{};foreach($r in 'host','client'){$v=N $r;$pair[$r]=$v;if(!$v.enabled-or!$v.session.enabled-or$v.session.menuSuspended-or$v.session.reloadPending-or($count-and$v.entries.Count-ne$count)-or!$v.entries.Count-or@($v.entries|Where-Object {!$_.enabled-or!$_.ready}).Count){$ok=$false}};if(!$ok){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 80}}while(!$ok-and$w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt8000)
 Save "$out/ready-$tag.json" $pair;if(!$ok){throw "NPC channels not ready: $tag expected$count"};return $pair
}
function P($role='host'){Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json.npc-perception.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}
function Factions($tag){
 $map=@{};$state=N host;$partner=(S host).probeActorHandle
 foreach($e in $state.entries){if($e.enabled){$map[[string]$e.handle]=Q host '--faction' $e.handle}}
 $map['player']=Q host '--faction' 1;$map['partner']=Q host '--faction' $partner
 Save "$out/factions-$tag.json" $map;return $map
````

````text
 $h=Q $r '--health' 1;if($h.logic-ne1){throw 'Currency requires native gameplay'}
 $cs=Q $r '--components' 1;$i=@($cs.components|Where-Object type -eq '.?AVarkCpntInventory@@');if($i.Count-ne1-or$i[0].owner-ne$h.actor){throw 'Currency inventory ownership mismatch'}

 if($o.type-ne'.?AVarkCpntInventory@@'-or$owner.Count-ne1-or$owner[0].word-ne$h.actor-or$w.Count-ne1-or(Q $r '--health' 1).actor-ne$h.actor){throw 'Currency inventory incarnation changed'}
 $n=[Convert]::ToUInt64($w[0].word.Substring(2),16);return @{currency=[long]($n-shr32);inventory=$i[0].pointer;raw=$w[0];actor=$h.actor}
}
function Target($r){@((Q $r '--entities').entities|Where-Object name -eq $coin)}

 Save "$root/work/movement-integration/native-operation-owner.json" @{pid=$PID;operation='OrdinaryFamilies824';state='running';take=$Take}
````

````text
 }
````
````text
 C host 'setviewpos -33.5 -153 68.1 90 0';C client 'setviewpos -30.7 -151.8 68.1 203 0'

 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role host -Pitch 0 -Evidence "$out/camera.json"
````

````text
 $n=[Convert]::ToUInt64($w[0].word.Substring(2),16);return @{currency=[long]($n-shr32);inventory=$i[0].pointer;raw=$w[0];actor=$h.actor}
}
````

## work/natural-moveset/Test-PowerIntegration.ps1

[Test-PowerIntegration.ps1](<../../../work/natural-moveset/Test-PowerIntegration.ps1>)

````text
param([ValidateSet('host','client')][string]$Source='host',[ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='integrated-power-corvo-v1',[switch]$Record,[switch]$ExpectBlinkFx,[switch]$InspectGrapple,[switch]$ExpectGrappleFx,[switch]$InspectAttachment)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null
$target=if($Source-eq'host'){'client'}else{'host'};$character=if($Source-eq'host'){'corvo'}else{'emily'};$pids=@{};$handles=@{};$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null;$capture=$null
$handReads=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function InputState($r,$trigger=0,$ms=100,$button='Neutral'){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs $ms -LeftTrigger $trigger|Out-Null}
function Probe($r,$mode,$id=0){for($i=0;$i-lt12;$i++){$raw=if($id){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20};throw "Native read $r $mode"}
function State($r,$suffix=''){for($i=0;$i-lt8;$i++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){$l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'};$pids[$r]=$l.pid;$handles[$r]=(State $r).probeActorHandle;InputState $r;C $r 'coop_movement_bank off';C $r 'coop_shadow_stream off';C $r 'coop_power_fixture off';C $r 'coop_movement_fixture off';C $r 'coop_movement_fixture 60000';if((Probe $r '--health' 1).current-ne56){throw 'Clean living fixture required'}}
 C $target 'setviewpos -28.5 -151.2 68.1 180 0';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300;C $Source 'setviewpos -33.5 -153 68.1 90 0'
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role $Source -Pitch 25 -Evidence "$out/source-camera.json"
 & "$PSScriptRoot/Set-ObserverPitch.ps1" -Role $target -Pitch 7 -Evidence "$out/observer-camera.json"
 Copy-Item "$PSScriptRoot/power-banks-v1/$character-power-bank.bin" "$root/work/lab-instances/$target/coop-status.json.movement.bin"
 C $Source 'coop_power_fixture 20000';$watch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();do{$power=State $Source '.power-fixture.json';if($power.result-eq'native_power_ready'){break};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50}while($watch.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt6000)
 if($power.result-ne'native_power_ready'){throw "Power did not equip: $($power.result)"};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1100
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){C $r 'coop_shadow_stream on'};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 550;C $target 'coop_movement_bank on'
 $watch.Restart();do{$m=State $target '.movement.json';if($m.active-and$m.version-eq15-and$m.weight-gt.9){break};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 40}while($watch.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt5000)
 if(!$m.active-or$m.version-ne15-or$m.weight-lt.9){throw 'Power bank did not become ready'}
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='review-test-1',[ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+\.json$')][string]$Manifest='native-retarget-manifest.json',[string[]]$Only=@())

$cases=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$failure=$null

 }
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='native-shadow-equipment-v1')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take already exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null
$probe=Join-Path $lab 'bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe';$pids=@{};$handles=@{};$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$samples=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$failure=$null
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function ReadStatus($r,$suffix=''){for($i=0;$i-lt8;$i++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20}};throw 'Status unavailable'}

function E($r){ReadStatus $r '.shadow-equipment.json'}
function WaitFor($r,$predicate,$message){$w=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();do{$s=E $r;if(&$predicate $s){return $s};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 60}while($w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt5000);throw "$r $message : $($s|ConvertTo-Json -Compress)"}
function SaveSample($r,$label){$samples.Add([pscustomobject]@{role=$r;label=$label;lease=(E $r);equipment=(Q $r '--avatar-sword' $handles[$r]);attachment=(Q $r '--avatar-sword-attachment' $handles[$r]);player=(Q $r '--player-sword')})}
try{
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  $l=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/launch.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(!$l.assetExperiment-or(Get-Process -Id $l.pid).Path-ne(Join-Path $root 'work/asset-game/Dishonored2.exe')){throw 'Wrong isolated process'}
  $pids[$r]=$l.pid;$handles[$r]=(ReadStatus $r).probeActorHandle
  C $r 'coop_movement_bank off';C $r 'coop_shadow_stream off';C $r 'coop_movement_fixture off';C $r 'coop_movement_fixture 60000';C $r 'setviewpos -33.5 -153 68.1 0 0'
 }
 foreach($r in 'host','client'){
  SaveSample $r 'before';$baseline=E $r
  C $r 'coop_shadow_equipment 2500';$held=WaitFor $r {param($s)$s.active-and$s.observed-gt$baseline.observed} 'Native holster not observed'
  SaveSample $r 'holstered';$sword=Q $r '--avatar-sword' $handles[$r]
````

````text
param([ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take='unarmed-special-v1-test',[ValidateSet('both','host','client')][string]$OnlyRole='both')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab';$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(Test-Path $out){throw 'Take exists'};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out|Out-Null
$pids=@{};$handles=@{};$checks=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new();$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$failure=$null
function C($r,$c){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $r -Command $c -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
function I($r,$button='Neutral',$ms=100,$x=0,$y=0){& "$lab/Send-D2Input.ps1" -Role $r -Button $button -DurationMs $ms -LeftX $x -LeftY $y|Out-Null}
function Status($r,$suffix=''){for($i=0;$i-lt8;$i++){try{return(Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/$r/coop-status.json$suffix" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15}};throw 'Status unavailable'}
function Q($r,$mode,$id=0){for($i=0;$i-lt10;$i++){$raw=if($id){& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode $id}else{& "$lab/bin/d2_runtime_probe.exe" $pids[$r] $mode};if(!$LASTEXITCODE){return($raw|ConvertFrom-Json)};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 15};throw "Probe failed $r $mode"}
function Collect($src,$dst,$label,$ms){
 $samples=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$watch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
 while($watch.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt$ms){
  $m=Status $dst '.movement.json';$s=Status $dst '.shadow-stream.json'
  if(!$m.active-or$m.version-ne10-or!$s.ready-or!$s.armed){throw "Presentation retired during $label"}
  if(!(Status $src '.observer-isolation.json').ready-or!(Status $dst '.observer-isolation.json').ready){throw 'Fixture retired'}
  $base=Status $src;$row=[pscustomobject]@{source=$src;label=$label;ms=$watch.ElapsedMilliseconds;movement=$m;stream=$s;nativeMotion=$base.localPlayerMotion;sourcePosition=$base.localPosition;observerPosition=(Status $dst).localPosition};$samples.Add($row);$rows.Add($row);Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 35
 }
 $sword=Q $dst '--avatar-sword' $handles[$dst]
 if($sword.equipped-or$sword.started){throw "Weaponless action $label redrew remote sword"}
 return $samples
}
````

## work/natural-moveset/Trace-BendTimePresentation.ps1

[Trace-BendTimePresentation.ps1](<../../../work/natural-moveset/Trace-BendTimePresentation.ps1>)

````text
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$Take,[ValidateRange(1000,15000)][int]$DurationMs=10800)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'));$out=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Take
if(!(Test-Path "$out/result.json")-and(Test-Path $out)){
 $rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new();$w=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
 while($w.ElapsedMilliseconds-lt$DurationMs){
  try{
   $m=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/client/coop-status.json.movement.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
   $s=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/host/coop-status.json.shadow-stream.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
   $r=Get-Content "$root/work/lab-instances/client/coop-status.json.shadow-stream.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
   $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{utcMs=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();ms=$w.ElapsedMilliseconds;active=$m.active;event=$m.powerEvent;variant=$m.powerVariant;amount=$m.powerAmount;weight=$m.powerWeight;applied=$m.applied;sourceEvent=$s.sourceEvent;sourceState=$s.sourceState;sourceToken=$s.token;targetToken=$r.token;remoteEvent=$r.remoteEvent;ready=$r.ready;epoch=$r.epoch;peerEpoch=$r.peerEpoch})
  }catch{}
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20
 }
 $rows|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content "$out/presentation-trace.json"
 "PRESENTATION_TRACE $($rows.Count) samples"
}else{throw 'Existing or missing take; trace refused'}
````

````text
}
````

````text
"""Assess a mechanics experiment; ownership alone is not successful carrying."""
import hashlib,json,math,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def distance(a,b):return math.sqrt(sum((x-y)**2 for x,y in zip(a,b)))
take=sys.argv[1];folder=P/take;rows=read(folder/'observations.json');identity=read(folder/'identity.json')
held=[r for r in rows if r.get('retarget',{}).get('count')==1 and r.get('attachment',{}).get('active')]
# Counters persist across cases in one process. An earlier case's completed
# release must never count as cleanup of this case.
initial=rows[0].get('attachment',{}) if rows else {}
after=[r for r in rows if r.get('attachment',{}).get('released',0)>initial.get('released',0) and not r['attachment']['active']]
checks=[]
def check(name,passed):checks.append(dict(check=name,passed=bool(passed)))
check('harness completed',read(folder/'result.json')['failure']is None)
check('strict reciprocal attachment observed',len(held)>=20 and all(r['retarget']['valid']for r in held))
check('one exact mapped corpse generation',len({r['retarget']['targetHandle']for r in held})==1 and all(r['retarget']['targetHandle']==r['stream']['carryLocalHandle']for r in held))
check('native release empties attachment list',len(after)>=10 and all(r['retarget']['valid']and r['retarget']['count']==0 for r in after))
final=rows[-1].get('attachment',{}) if rows else {}
check('this case starts and releases exactly one attachment',final.get('started',0)-initial.get('started',0)==1 and final.get('released',0)-initial.get('released',0)==1 and not final.get('active',True))
````

````text
"""Catch carried-body yaw drift during a fixed-heading native carry walk."""
import json,math,sys

def diff(a,b):return (a-b+180)%360-180
for take in sys.argv[1:]:
 f=P/take;i=read(f/'identity.json');a=read(f/'carrier-held.json');b=read(f/'victim-held.json')
 final=read(f/'loaded-stance-contact.json')['pair'];c=final['carrier'];v=final['victim']
 before=diff(yaw(b),yaw(a));after=diff(yaw(v),yaw(c));drift=diff(after,before)
 checks=dict(completed_carrier_publication=final['carrierFinalPublicationComplete'],
  sequential_read_under_50ms=final['readEndTick']-final['readBeginTick']<=50,
  fixed_carrier_heading=abs(diff(yaw(c),yaw(a)))<1,
  held_body_yaw_drift_under_5deg=abs(drift)<5)
 out=dict(passed=all(checks.values()),checks=checks,relative_yaw_before_deg=before,relative_yaw_after_deg=after,
  drift_deg=drift,dll=i['dllSha256'],bank_sha256=i['bankSha256'],complete=False,
  scope='Two stable actor-root observations across one bounded fixed-heading native carry walk. Not turning, arbitrary corpses or visual acceptance.')
 (f/'orientation-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2));print(json.dumps(dict(take=take,**out)))
 if not out['passed']:raise SystemExit(1)
````

````text
assert interruption in ['cancel','stream']
command='coop_carry_attachment off' if interruption=='cancel' else 'coop_shadow_stream off'
````

````text
"""Validate recorded candidate bytes with the production review decoder."""
import json, subprocess, hashlib, argparse
from pathlib import Path
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('manifests',nargs='+');p.add_argument('--out',required=True);args=p.parse_args()
exe=P.parent/'build/Release/d2_review_clip_tests.exe';reports=[]
for name in args.manifests:
 rows=json.loads((P/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));failures=[]
 for row in rows:
  path=P/row['binary'];raw=path.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
  r=subprocess.run([str(exe),str(path)],capture_output=True,text=True)
  if r.returncode:failures.append(dict(id=row['id'],duration=row['duration'],frames=row['frames'],error=(r.stdout+r.stderr).strip()))
 reports.append(dict(manifest=name,clips=len(rows),passed=not failures,failures=failures))
(P/args.out).write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2));print(json.dumps(reports,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(int(any(not r['passed']for r in reports)))
````

````text
   }
````

````text
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
        $s=Get-Content (Join-Path $client 'coop-status.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
        if($s.localEpoch -ne $old.localEpoch -and $s.localGameLogicState -eq 1 -and !$s.localPendingGameLogicState){return $s}
        if($watch.ElapsedMilliseconds -gt 6000 -and $s.localGameLogicState -in 8,15){& (Join-Path $lab 'Send-D2Input.ps1') -Role client -Button A -DurationMs 200|Out-Null}
````

## work/Test-D2PartnerRegressions.ps1

[Test-D2PartnerRegressions.ps1](<../../../work/Test-D2PartnerRegressions.ps1>)

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$lab=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../outputs/d2-coop-lab';$rows=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
function Exact {
 foreach($role in 'host','client'){& "$lab/Send-D2Command.ps1" -Role $role -Command 'coop_probe_follow exact' -WaitConsumed|Out-Null}
 Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600
}
function Check($stage){
 foreach($role in 'host','client'){
  $s=Get-Content "$PSScriptRoot/lab-instances/$role/coop-status.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  if(!$s.probeFollowEnabled-or!$s.probeFollowExact-or!$s.remoteFresh-or$s.localGameLogicState-ne1){throw "$stage $role follow scope failed"}
  for($i=0;$i-lt3;$i++){if($s.probeOffset[$i]-ne0-or[Math]::Abs($s.probeRenderPosition[$i]-$s.remotePosition[$i])-gt0.005){throw "$stage $role world coordinate mismatch"}}
  $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{Stage=$stage;Role=$role;Bridge=$s})
 }
}
Exact;Check Initial
& "$lab/Test-D2SharedCheckpoint.ps1" -RequestRole client -DelayRole client|Out-Null;Check ClientReload
& "$lab/Test-D2SharedCheckpoint.ps1" -RequestRole host -DelayRole host|Out-Null;Check HostReload
& "$lab/Test-D2SharedDeath.ps1" -DeathRole client -RetryRole host -DamageTelemetry|Out-Null;Check ClientDeath
& "$lab/Test-D2SharedDeath.ps1" -DeathRole host -RetryRole client -DamageTelemetry|Out-Null;Check HostDeath
[ordered]@{Passed=$true;ObservedAt=[DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToString('o');DllSha256=(Get-FileHash "$lab/bin/dinput8.dll").Hash;Scope='Both avatars use exact remote world coordinates before and after either player shared reload or natural death and coordinated retry.';Samples=$rows}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 15|Set-Content "$lab/research/exact-partner-recovery-verification.json"
````

## work/Test-D2RecoveryInitialization.ps1

[Test-D2RecoveryInitialization.ps1](<../../../work/Test-D2RecoveryInitialization.ps1>)

````text
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$lab=Join-Path $root 'outputs/d2-coop-lab'
function Command([string]$role,[string]$text){& (Join-Path $lab 'Send-D2Command.ps1') -Role $role -Command $text|Out-Null}
$results=@()
foreach($role in 'host','client'){Command $role 'coop_probe_follow off';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200}
& (Join-Path $lab 'Test-D2SharedCheckpoint.ps1') -RequestRole client -DelayRole client|ConvertTo-Json
foreach($role in 'host','client') {
    Command $role $(if($role -eq 'host'){'coop_spawn_probe emily'}else{'coop_spawn_probe corvo'})
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800
    Command $role 'coop_probe_follow on';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
}
try{& (Join-Path $lab 'Test-D2Locomotion.ps1')|Out-Null}catch{Write-Output $_.Exception.Message}
$r=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $lab 'research/locomotion-verification.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $lab 'research/locomotion-verification.json') -Destination (Join-Path $root 'work/locomotion-canonical82-manual-initialization.json') -Force
$results+=[pscustomobject]@{Mode='Manual SLOT82';Passed=$r.Passed;Dll=$r.DllSha256;Results=$r.Results}
foreach($role in 'host','client'){Command $role 'coop_checkpoint_sync off';Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 350}
& (Join-Path $lab 'Test-D2SharedCheckpoint.ps1') -RequestRole client -DelayRole client|ConvertTo-Json
try{& (Join-Path $lab 'Test-D2Locomotion.ps1')|Out-Null}catch{Write-Output $_.Exception.Message}
$r=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $lab 'research/locomotion-verification.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
````
